Skin. — Eruption like variola. Lupus; wlcers, cancerous formations. General tendency to profuse perspiration and unhealthy skin. [Hecpar.]

Relationship. — Antidote: Sulph. Useful after too much Chlorate of Potash for sore throat. Compare: Xanthorrhisa apifolia; Kali bich.; Conium; Ars, iod.; Phytol.; Golium (cancer —nodulated tumor of the tongue); Asteries; Stann.; Puls. Also Mansonita (diarrhoea, gonorrhoea, gleet, leucorrhwa, catarrhal conditions). Hydrastinum mwuriaticum — Muriate of Hydrastia. (Locally, about one ounce of water, in aphthous sore mouth, ulcers, ulcerated sore throat, ozena, etc. Internally, third dec. trit., i dilatation of the stomach, and chronic digestive disorders}. Hydrastin sulph. ix {haemorrhage of bowels in typhoid). Hydrastinimum —a modification of Hydrastinum. (A remedy for haemorrhages, fibroid tumors. Metrorrhagia. Third dec, trit.) Marrubium —- Hoarhound — (a stimulant to mucous membranes, especially laryngeal and bronchial; chronic bronchitis, dyspepsia, and hepatic disorders; colds and coughs). Dose. —- Tincture, to thirtieth attenuation. Locally colorless Hydrastis, mother tincture, or fluid extract.

remedies.name: Hydrocotyle
remedies.text:
(Indian Pennywort) Has considerable reputation in leprosy and lupus, when there is no ulceration. The skin symptoms are very important. Of great use in ulceration of womb. Difficulty in maintaining the upright posture. Very copious perspiration. Pains of cervical cancer.

Face. — Pain in left cheek-bones, and about orbits. Female. —- Pruritus of vagina. Inflammation of neck of bladder. Heat within vagina. Granuler ulceration of womb. Profuse leucorrhoea. Dull pain in ovarian region, Cervical redness.

Skin. — Dry eruptions. Great thickening of epidermoid layer and exfoliation of scales, Psoriasis gyrate, on trunk and extremities, palins and soles, Pustules on chest. Circular spots, with scaly edges. Intolerable itching, especially of soles, Profuse sweat. Syphilitic 1 géfections. Acne. Leprosy, Elephantiasis [Ars.]

Relationship. — Compare: Eleis— South American Palm — (scleroderma, elephantiasis, leprosy, skin thickened, itching and hardened. Anesthesia). Hwura; Trychnos Gaultheriana (bites of serpents, ulcers and cutaneous affections generally); Hoang-Nan (removes fetor and hamorrbage in cancer; follows Arsenic; revives the healing process. Leprosy). Chaslomoogre oil; Hydrest.; Arsenic; Aurum; Sepia. Dose, — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Hydrocyanic Acid
remedies.text:
(Prussic Acid) Convulsions and paralysis express the action of this remedy, Spasmodic constriction in larynx, feeling of suffocation, pain and tightress in chest, palpitation; pulse weak, irregular. Singing sensotion at the epigastrium. Hysterica) and epifeptic convulsions. Cyanosis, Collapse, due to some pulmonary condition not a cardiac collapse. Catalepsy Cholera. Stage of collapse. [4rs.; Verat.]

Mind. — Unconscious. Wild delirium. Fear of imaginary troubles. Fears everything —~ horses, wagons, houses falling, etc.

Head. — Violent stupefying headache. Brain feels on fire. Pupils motionless or dilated. Supra-orhital neuralgia, with flushing on same side of face. Face.—- Jaws clenched in rigid spasm. Froths at mouth. Pale, bluish lips.

Stomach. — Tongue cold. Drink rumbles through throat and stomach. Gastralgia; worse when stomach is empty. Great sinking at pit of stomach. Pulsative fain in pracordial region, Respiratory. — Noisy and agitated breathing. Dry, spasmodic, suffocative cough. Asthma, with contraction of throat. Whooping-cough. Paralysis of lungs. [Aspidos.] Marked cyanosis; venouslty congested lung.

Heart. — Violent palpitation. Pulse, weak, irregular. Cold extremities. Torturing pain in chest. Angina pectoris. [Spigel.; Oxal. ac.) Sleep. — Yawning, with shivering. Irresistible drowsiness. Vivid, incoherent dreams.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Ammon: Camph.; Opiem. Compare: Cicuia; Ginanthe; Camph.; Lauroc, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Hydrophobinum
remedies.text:
(Lyssin --- Sativa of Rabid Dog} Affects principally the nervous system; aching in bones. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Convulsions bronght on by dazzling light or sight of running water, Mind, — Lyssophobia; fear of becoming mad. Emotion and bad news aggravate; also, thinking of fluids. Hypersensitivencss of all senses.

Mouth. — Constant spitting; saliva tough, viscid. Sore throat; constant desire to swallow, which is difficult; gagging when swallowing water. Froths at mouth, Male. — Lascivious; priapism, with frequent emissions, No emission during coition. Atrophy of testicles. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire, Female. — Uterine sensitiveness; conscious of womb (Helon.j Feels prolapsed. Vagina sensitive, rendering coition painjul. {Rerberis.] Uterine displacements, Respiratory. — Voice altered in tone, Breathing held for a time. Spasmodic contraction of respiratory muscles.

Stool. — Desire for stool on hearing or seeing running water. Profuse, watery stools, with pain in bowels; worse, evening. Constant desire to urinate on seeing running water.

Modalities. — Ilorse, sight ar sound of running water or pouring water, or even thinking of fluids; dazzling or reflected light: heat of sun; stooping, Relationship. — Compare: Xanthinim spinostam (said to he specie for hydrophohia). Canth.; Bell; Stram.; Laci; Nat, mur. Dose, — Thirtieth putency.

remedies.name: Hyoscyamus
remedies.text:
(Henbane) Disturhs the nervous system profoundly. It is as if sume diabolical force tuok possession of the brain and prevented its functions, It causes a perfect picture of mani of a quarreclsome and obscene character, Inchted to be unseemly and immodest in acts, gestures and expressions. Very talkative, and persists in stripping herself, or uncovering genitals. Is jealoys, afraid of heing poisoned, ete. Its symptoms also point to weakness and nervoxs agitation; hence typhoid and other infections with coma vigil. Tremulous weakness and twtiching of tendons.’ Subsultas tendinum. Muscular twitchings, spasmodic affections, generally with delirium. Non-inflammatory cerebral activity. Toxte gastritis.

Mind. — Very suspicious Talkative, obscene, jealous. foolish. Great hilarity; inclined to laxyh at everything. Delirium, with attempt to run away. Low, muttering speech: constant carphologia, deep stupor.

Head. — Feels light. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Brain feels loose, fluctuating. Inflammation of brain, with unconsciousness; head is shaken to and fro.

Eyes. — Pupils dilated, sparkling, fixed. Eyes open, but does not pay attention; downcast and dull, fixed. Strabismus. Spasmodic closing of lids. Diplopia. Objects have colored borders.

Mouth. — Tongue dry, red, cracked, stiff and immovable, protruded with difficulty; speech impaired. Foams at mouth. Teeth covered with sordes. Lower jaw drops. Throat, — Stinging dryness. Constriction. Cannot swallow liquids. Uvula elongated.

Stomach. — Higcough, eructations empty, hitter. Nausea, with vertigo, Vomiting, with convulsions; hematemesis; violent cramps, relieved by vomiting, Lurning in stomach; epigastrium tender. After irrifating food. Abdomen, — Colic, as if abdomen would burst. Distention. Colic, with vomiting, belching, hiccough screaming. Tympanites. “Red spots on abdomen, Stool, -—— Diarrhoea, colicky, pains; involuntary, aggra~ vated by mental excitement or during sleep. Diarrhoea during the lying-in period. Involuntary defecation. Urine. —Involuntary. Bladder paralyzed. Has no will to urinate. [Cuxst.] Retention of urine, Male.— Impotence. Lascivious; exposes his person; plays with genitals during fever..

Female. — Refore menses, hysterical spasms, Excited sexual desire During menses, convulsive movements, urinary flux and sweat. Lochia suppressed. Spasms of pregnant women. Puerperal mania.

Chest. — Suffocating fits, Spasm, forcing bending forward. Dry, spasmodic cough at night (worse lying down; better sitting up), from itching in the throat, as if uvula were too long. Hemoptysis.

Extremities. — Picking at bed-clothes; plays with hands; reaches out for things. Epileptic attacks ending in deep sleep. Spasms and convulsions. Cramps in calves and toes. Child sobs and cries without waking.

Sleep. — Intense sleeplessness. Sopor, with convulsions. Starts up frightened. Coma vigil, Nerves. — Great restlessness; every muscle twitches. Will not be covered. Modalities. —— Worse, at night, during menses, after eating, when lying down. Better, stooping.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Bell.; Camph, Compare: Bellad.; Siram.; Agaric.; Gels.; Hyoscin, sulph. Hyosc. hydrobrom, — Scopolamine hydrobromide. (Paralysis agitans; tremors of disseminated sclerasis, Sleeplessness and nervous agitation. Dry cough in phthisis. Third and fourth dec. trituration, Similar in its effects to alcohol, both recent and remote. Corresponds to the effects of strong poisons introduced into or generated within the body. Symptoms of uremia and acute nervous exhaustion. A remedy for shock. Scopola (Japanese Belladonna) — chemically identical with Hyoscine, (Joyous delirium, licking of lips and smacking of mouth; sleepless; tries to get out of bed; sees cats, picks imaginary hairs, warms hands before imaginary fire, ete.) Dose, — Sixth. to 200th potency,

remedies.name: Hypericum
remedies.text:
(St. John’s-wort) The great remedy for injuries to nerves, especially of fingers, tocs and nails. Crushed fingers, especially tips. Excessive painfulness is a guiding symptom to its use. Prevents lockjaw. Punctured wounds. Relieves pain after operations, Spasms after every injury. Has an important action on the rectum; bxmorrhoids. Ceecydynia, Spasmodic asthmatic attacks with changes of weather or before storms, better by copious expectoration.

Mind. — Feels as if lifted high in air, or anxiety lest he fall from heights, Mistakes in writing. Effects of shock, Head. — Heavy; feels as if touched by an tcy cold hand. Throbbing in vertex; worse in close room. Right side of face aches. Brain-fag and neurasthenia, [Pirric acid], with saducss. Ffead feels longer — elongated to a point. In fractured skull, bone splinters. Brain feels alive. Pains in eyes and ears, Stomach.—-Craving for wine. Thirst; nausea. Tongue coated white at base, tip clean. Feeling of lump in stomach. [Abies nig.; Bry.]

Rectum. — Urging, dry, dull, pressing pain. Haemorrhoids, with pain, bleeding, and tenderness, Back, -- Pain in nape of neck. Pressure over sacrum, Spinal concussion.

Extremities. — Darting pain in shoulders. Pressure along ulnar side of arm. Cramp in calves. Pain in toes and fingers, especiafly in tips. Crawling in hand and fect. Lancinating pain in upper and lower limbs. Neuritis, with tingling, burning pain, numbness and flossy skin. Joints feel bruised. Hysterical joints. Tetanus, [Physost.; Kali brom,]

Skin. — Hyperidrosis, sweating of scalp, worse in morning after sleep; falling of hair from injury; eczema of hands and face, intense itching, eruption seems to be under the skin. Herpes zoster. Modalities. —- Worse, in a fog; in close room; least exposure, Betic:, bending head backward.

Relationship. — Compare: Arnica; Stephis.; Calend.; Ruta; Coff, Antidotes: Arc.; Cham.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Iberis
remedies.text:
(Bitter Candytuft) State of nervous excitement, Has marked action upou the heart. Possesses great efficacy in cardiac diseases. Controls vascular excitement in hypertrophy with thickening of the heart’s walls. Cardiac debility after influenza, Liver region fuli and painful. White stools. Mind, — Sad and sighing; fearful and trembling. Irritable, Head.— Vertigo and pains around heart. Constant hawking of thick, stringy mucus until after a meal. Hot, flushed face, Vertigo, as if occiput were turning around, eyes feel forced outwards.

Heart. — Conscious of heart’s action. On turning on left side, stitching pain as if needles through ventricles felt at each systole. Palpitation, with vertigo and choking in throat, Stitching pains in cardiac region. Pulse full, irregular, intermittent. Worse, least motion and in warm room. Sensation of weight and pressure, with occasional sharp, stinging pains. Dropsy, with enlarged heart. Violent palpitation induced by slightest exertion, or by laughing, or coughing. Darting pains through heart. Cardtac dyspnoea. Dilation of heart. Wakes with palpitation about 2 4, M. Throat and trachea fills up with mucus. Cough causes redness of face. Tachycardia, Extremities. — Numbness and tingling in left hand and arm. Whole body sore, lame and trembling.

Modalities. — Worse, lying down; on left side; motion, exertion; warm room.

Relationship. — Compare: Cact.; Dig.; Amyl.; Bell.

Dose. — Tincture and first potency. ICHTHYOLUM (A Combination of Sulphonated Hydrocarbons; a Fossi) Product of Complex Structure found in Tyrol, supposed to be Fish Deposits) Its action on skin, mucous membranes, and kidneys is prompt and useful. It is strongly antiparasitic; redness, pain and inflanunation; decreases tension. Excellent in winter coughs of old people. Chronic rheumatism. Uric acid diathesis. Hay-fever. Chronic hives. Tuberculosis, aids nutrition, Alcoholism when nothing will stay on stomach.

Mind. — Irritable and depressed. Forgetful, tack of concentration, Head, — Dull, aching; better cold, pressure. Dull frontal and supra-orbital headache; worse moving eyes, cold air; better, warmth.

Face. — Skin feels dry and itches. Acne on chin.

Throat. — Irritated; pain to ears; sore, dry, with hawking and expectoration.

Eyes. — Burn, red; worse, any change of temperature.

Nose. — Bland coryza; stuffed feeling; feels sore inside. Irresistible desire to sneeze. Stomach, — Disagreeable taste, burning sensation, very thirsty. Nausea. Increased appetite., Abdomen. — Disposition to soft, shapeless stools. Griping in umbilical and left hypogastric region. Early morning diarrhoea, Urine, — Increased in quantity and frequency. Burning pain in meatus. Uric acid deposits. Female, — Fullness in lower abdomen. Nausea at time of menses.

Respiratory. — Coryza; dry, teasing cough. Bronchiectasis and phthisis, Bronchitis, especially of the aged.

Skin. — Heat and irritation; itching. Scaly and itching eczema. Crops of boils. Pruritus of pregnancy. ‘Extremities. — Lameness in right shoulder and right lower extremity. Relationship,— Compare: Hepar; Cale.; Silica; Sulph.: Ars.; Petrol, Dose. — Lower potencies. Externally, it is used as an ointment, with Lanoline 20 to 50 per cent.; for chronic eczema and psoriasis, also acne rosacea and gouty joints, Chilblains, scabies,

remedies.name: Ignatia
remedies.text:
(St. Ignatius Bean) Produces a marked hyperesthesia of all the senses, and a tendency to clonic spasms. Mentally, the emotional element is uppermost, and co-ordination of funcfion is interfered with. Hence, it is one of the chief remedies for hysteria. It is especially adapted to the Nervous temperament -— women of sensitive, easily excited nature, dark, mild disposition, quick to perceive. rapid in execution. Rapid change of mental and physical condition, opposite to each other. Great contradictions. Alert, nervous, apprehensive, rigid, trembling patients who suffer acutely in mind or body, at the same time made worse by drinking coffee, The superficial and crraiic character of its symptoms is most characteristic. Cannot bear tobacco. Pain is small, circumscribed spots.* [Oxral. ac.] The plague, Mind. — Changeable mood; introspective; silently brooding. Melancholic, sad, tearful. Not communicative. Sighing and sobbing. After shocks, grief, disappointment.

Head. — Feels hollow, heavy; worse, stooping. Headache as if a nail were driven out through the side. Ctamp-like pain over root of nose. Congestive headaches folluwing anger or grief; worse, smoking or smcling tobacco, inclines head forward.

Eyes. — 4sthenopia, with spasms ot lids and neuralgic pain about eyes. [Nat. m.} Flickering zigzags. * Face.— Twitching of muscles of face and lips. Changes color when at rest.

Mouth. — Sour taste. Easily bites inside of cheeks. Constantly full of saliva. Toothache: worse atter drinking coffee and smoking. Throat. -~ Feeling of a lump in throat that cannot be swallowed, Sore throat; stitches wher not swallowing; better, eating something solid. Stitches between acts of swallowing. Stitches extend to ear. [Afep.] Ton sils inflamed, swollen, with small uicers, Follicular ton- Sillités, Stomach, — our eructation, AH-gone feeling in stomach; much flatulence; hiccough. Cramps in stomach; worse slightest contact. Averse to ordinary diet; longs for great variety of indigestible articles. Sinking in stomach, relieved by taking a deep breath.

Abdomen. — Rumbling in bowels. Weak feeling in upper abdomen. Throbbing in abdomen. [4loc; Sang.] Colicky, griping pains in one or both sides of abdomen. Rectum: — itching and stitching up the rectum. Prolapse. Stools pass with difficulty; painful constriction of anus after siool, Stitches in haemorrhoids during cough. Diarrhoea fram fright. Stitches from anus deep into rectum. Haemorrhage and pain: worse when stool is loose. Pressure as of a sharp instrument from within outward. Urine, — Profuse, watery. [Phos, ac.] Respiratory, -— Dry, spasmodic cough in quick successive shocks. Reflex coughs. Coughing increases the desire to cough. Afnch stghing, Hollow spasmodic cough, worse in the evening, little expectoration, leaving pain in the trachea, Female. — Menses, black, too early, too profuse, or scanty. During menses great Janguor, with spasmodic pains in stomach and abdomen, Feminine sexual frigidity. Suppression from grief.

Extremities. — Jerking of limbs. Pain in tendo- Achilles and calf. Ulcerative pain in soles, Sleep, — Very light.: Jerking of limbs on going to sleep. Insomnia from grief, cares, with itching of arms and violent yawning. Dreams continuing a long time; troubling him.

Fever. — Chitl, with thirst; not relieved by external heat. During fever, itching; nettle-rash all over body. Skin. —Itching, nettle-rash. Very sensitive to draught of air. Excoriation, especiafly around vagina and mouth,.

Modalities. — Worse, in the morning, open air, after meals, coffee, smoking, liquids, external warmth. Better, while eating, change of position,.

Relationship. — Compare: Zinc.; Kali phos.; Sep.; Cimictf. Complementary: Nat, mur. Incompatible: Coffea; Nux; Tabac. Antidotes: Puls.; Cham.; Cocc.

Dose. — Tincture, to 200th potency.

remedies.name: Illicium
remedies.text:
(Anise) Should be remembered in the treatment of flatulent conditions. So called three-manths' catin, especialty if it recurs at regular hours; much rumbling in abdomen One symptom is worthy of special remembrance — pain in region of third rib, about an inch or two from the sternum, generally on right side, but occasionally on left. Frequent cough with this pain. Purulent tracheal and gastric catarrh of old drunkards. Old asthmatics. Vomiting, epileptiform convulsions with biting of tongue. Nose, — Sharp stitches beneath Jip. Acute catarrh. Burning and numbness of inner lower lip.

Respiratory. — Dyspno:a. Pain near third intercostal cartilage. Cough, with pus-like phlegm. Palpitation, with aphthe. Hemoptysis. a

Dose. — Third potency, ILEX AQUIFOLIUM (American Holly} Marked eye symptoms, spleen pain, All symptoms.better in winter.

Eye. — Infiltration of cornea; staphyloma; nightly burning in orbits, rheumatic inflammation of eye; psilosis.. INDIGO (indigo — Dye-stuff) Marked action on the nervous system, and of undoubted benefit in the treatment of epilepsy with great sadness. Excited mood and desire to be busy. Neurasthenia and hysteria. Pure powdered Indigo placed on the wound cures snake and spider poison. [Kalé permang.; Colondrina; Cedron.} Head, — Vertigo wtih nausea. Convulsions. Sensation of a band around forehead. Undulating sensation through whole head. Sensation as if brain were frozen, Gloomy; cries at night. Hair feels pulled from vertex. Head feels frozen, Nose. -- Excessive sneezing and bleeding from nose. Ears, — Pressure and roaring.

Stomach. — Metallic taste. HEructations. Bloating. Anorexia, Flushes of heat rising from stomach to head.: Rectum, — Falling of rectum. Aroused at night with horrible itching at anus. Urinary. ~— Constant desire to urinate. Urine turbid. Catarrh of bladder.

Extremities. — Scictica. Pain from middle of thigh to knee. Boring pain in knee-joint; better, walking. Pais in limbs worse after every meal, Nerves. — Hysterical symptoms where pain predominates. Excessive nervous irritation. Epilepsy; flashes of heat from abdumen to head; fit begins with dizziness. Aura from a painful spot between shoulders. Reflex spasms from worms.

Modalities. — Worse, during rest and sitting. Better, pressure, rubbing, motion. Relationship. —-Compare: Gistrs cameh, an Indian medicine for epilepsy.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Indium
remedies.text:
(The Metal Indium) Headaches and migraine. Seminal emissions, Lackache. Head. ~— Pain in cud when straining af stuol, Burst ing in head during stool. Dull pains in temples and forehead, with nausea, weakness, sicepiness. Gone feeling in stomach about 11 a.m. Violent attack of sneezing. Sexual psychopathy. Face,— Painful suppurating pimples. Corners of mouth cracked and sore, [Condur.] Male. -- Horribly offensive smell of urine after standing a short time. Emissions too frequent. Diminished power. Testicles tender; drawing pains along spermatic cord.

Extremities. — Stiffness in neck and shoulders. Pain, especially in left arm. Legs restless and weary. Toes itch, [4gar.} Dose. — Sixth to 200th potency, INDOL (A Crystalline Compound Derivable from Indigo, but also a product of Putrefaction of Proteids) Primary action is to increase the elimination of Indican, Auto-intoxication. Compare: Skatol. Persistent desire to sleep, dull, discontented mental state, hideous, delusions and nervousness, constant molion of fngers and feet. Intestinal putrefaction.

Head. — Dull occipital and frontal headache in aiternoon, Dull sensation over eyes. Eyebalis hot and hurt when moved. Pupils dilated with headache.

Stomach. — Bloated feeling. Hungry sensation after full meal. Great thirst. Constipacion, Extremities. — Very tired and sore in lower limbs. Feet burn. Kyee-joints sore.

Sleep. — Sfecpiness. Continuous dreaming.

Dose. — Sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Inula
remedies.text:
(Scabwort) A mucous membrane medicine. Bearing-down sensa~ tions in pelvic organs and Lronchia] symptoms are most marktd, Head. — Vertigo on stooping; throbbing after eating, pressure in temples and forehead.

Respiratory. — Dry cough; worse at night and lying down; larynx painfut. Chronic bronchitis; cough, with much thick expectoration, with Janguor and weak digestion, Stitches behind sternum. Teasing cough with much and free expectoration.

Female. — Menses too early and painful. Labor-like pains; urging to stool; dragging in genitals, with violent backache. Itching of legs during menses, chattering of teeth from cold during menstruation. Moving about in abdomen, stitches in genitals.

Rectum. — Pressing toward rectum as of something extruding. Urinary, — Frequent urging to urinate; passes only in drops. Violet odor. [Tereb.]} Extremities, — Pain in right shoulder and wrist; tearing in left palm, unable to double fingers; pain in lower limbs, feet and ankles.

Relationship. — Compare: Crocus; I[gnatia; Artm dracontium (loose cough worse at night on lying down).

Dose. — First to third potency.

remedies.name: Iodoformum
remedies.text:
(Iodoform) Should not be forgotten in the treatment of tubercular meningitis, both as a local application to the head and internally. [Bacil.] Tuberculous conditions.

Head. — Sharp, neuralgic pain. Ifead feels heavy, a3 if it could not be lifted from pillow. Itching of occiput. Meningitis. Sleep interrupted by sighing and,cries. Very drowsy, Eyes.— Pupils, difated; contract unequally, react pourly. Diplopia. Failing sight due to retro-bulbar heuritis, central scotoma — partial atrophy of optic disc.

Chest. — Sure pain in apex of right lung. Feeling of a weight on chest, as if smothering. Cough and wheezing on guing to bed. Pain in left breast, tike a hand grasping at the base of the heart. Hzmoptysis. Asthmatic breathing.

Abdomen. — Scaphoid abdomen. Chronic diarrhoea. with suspected tuberculosis, Abdomen distended; mesenteric glands enlarged. Cilolera infantum. Chronic diarrhara; stools greenish, watery, undigested, with irvitable temper.

Extremities. — Legs weak; cannot stand and walk with eyes closed. Weakness of knees when going upstairs, Dose. — Second trituration. Three grains on the back of the tongue will relieve attack of asthmatic breathing. (lodine) Ali glandular structures, respiratory organs, circulatory system are especially affected; they atrophy. Jodine arouses the defensive apparatus of the system Ly assembling the moenonucicar feucocytes whose phagacytic action is marked, at a given point. Lead poisonimg. Tremor, vleute exacerbation of chronic inflammation, Arthritis deformans, Acts prominently on connective tissuc. The plague, Atmormal vaso-constriction, capillary congestion followed by cedema, ecchymoses, haemorrhages, and nutritive disturbances are the pathological conditions at the basis of its symptomatology. Sluggish ‘vital reaction, hence chronicity in many of its aspects, Acute catarrh of all mucous membranes, rapid emaciation, notwithstanding good appetite, and glandular atrophy call for this remedy, in numerous wasting diseases and in scrofulous patients. Acute affections of the respiratory organs. Pneumonia, rapid extension. Todine is warm, and wants cool surroundings. Weakness and loss of breath going upstairs. Adenoid vege- 402 1oDUM fetions, Tincture internally and locally to swollen glands, Mind. — Anxiety when quiet, Present anxiety and depression, no reference to the future. Sudden impulse to run and dn viulence. Forgetful. Must be busy. Fear of people, shuns every one. Melancholy, Suicidal tendency.

Head. — Throbbing; rush of blood, and feeling of a tight band. Vertigo; worse from stooping, worse in warm room. Chranic, congestive headache of ald peopte. [Phes.} Eyes. — Violent lachrymation. Pain in eyes. ipl dilated. Constant motion of eyeballs. cleute daryocys+ titis.

Nose. — Sneezing. Sudden violent influenza. Dry coryza becomes fluent wm open air, also a fluent het coryca with general leat of skin. Pain at root of nose and frontal sinus. Nose stopped up. Tendency to ul!- ceration, Loss of smell..feute use! enyorgrornt associated with high hlood pressure, Mouth. — Gums Joose and bleed easily. Foul ulcers and salivation. Profuse, fetid ptyalism. Tongue tiickly coated. Offensive odor from mouth.

Throat. — Larynx feels coustricted. Eustachian deafsess, Thyroid enlarged. Goitre, with sensation of constriction, Swollen submaxillary glands. Uvula swollen, Stomach. — Throbbing at pit of stomach, Ravenous hunger and much thirst. Empty eructations, as if every Particle of food were turned into gas. Anxious and worried if he does not eat. [Ciaa; Sulph.] Loses flesh, yet hungry and eating well. [Abrot.]

Abdomen. — Liver and spleen sore and enlarged. Jaundice. Mesenteric glands enlarged. Pancreatic disease, Cutting pain in abdomen, Stool. — Haemorrhage at every stool. Diarrhoea, whitish, frothy, fatty. Constipation, with ineffectual urging; better by drinking cold milk. Constipation alternating with diarrhoea. [Ant. cr.} Urine, — Frequent and copious, dark yellow-green (Hovista), thick, acrid with cuticle on surface.

Male. — Testicles swollen and indurated. Hydrocele. Lass of sexual pewer, with atrophied testes. Female. -—- Great weakness during menses. [4lunt.; Carbo an., Coccul; Hamatoz.] Menstruation irregular. Uterine haemorrhage. Ovaritis, [Apis; Bell; Lach.) Wedne-khe pain from ovary to uterus. Dwindling of mammary glands. Nodosities iu skin of mamma. Acrid leucorrhoea, thick, slimy, corroding the linen. Wedge-like pain in the right ovarian region, Respiratory. — Hoarse. A’aze and tickling feeling provoking a dry cough, Pain ia larynx. Laryngitis, with painful roughness; worse curing cough. Child grasps throat when coughing. Right-sided pneumonia with high temperature” Pneumonia, Difficult expansion of chest, blood-streaked sputum; internal dry heat, external caldness. Violent heart action. Hepatization spreads rapidly. Croup in screfulous children with dark hair and eyes. [Brom, opposite.} Inspiration difficult. Dry, morning cough, from tickling in larynx. Croupy cough, with difficult respiration; wheezy. Cold extends downwards from head to throat and bronchi. Great weakness about chest. Palpitation from least exertion,~ Pleuritic effusion, Tickling all over chest. Iod. cough is worse indoors, in warm, wet weather, and when lying on back.

Heart. — Heart feels squeezed. Myocarditis, painful compression around heart. Feels as if squeezed by an iron hand [Cactus] followed by great weakness and faintness. Palpitation from feast exertion. Extremities. = “Foints inflamed and painful. Pain in - bones at night. White swelling. Gonorrheeal rheumatism. “Rheumatism of nape and upper extremities. Cold hands and feet, Acrid sweat of fect. Pulsation in large atterial trunks. “Rheumatic pains, nightly pains in joints;° constrictive sensations.

Skin. — Hot, dry, yellow and withered. Glands eularged. Nodosities. Anasarca of cardiac disease, Fever. — Flushes of heat all over body. Marked fever, restlessness, red cheeks, apathetic. Profuse sweat.

Modalities. — Worse, when quiet, in warm room. right side, Better, walking about, in open air.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Hepar; Sulph.; Gratiola. Complementary: Lycopod.; Badiaga. Compare: Brom.; Hvpar; Mercur.; Phosph.; Abrot; Nat, mur.; Sanic.; Tuber. Dose, — The crnde drug in saturated solution may be required. Third to thirtieth potency. lIoduretted solution of Potass. iod. (35 grains Potassa and 4 grains Iodine to 1 oz. of water, 10 drops three times a day) expels tapeworms dead. Locally the most powerful, least harmful and easily manayed microbicide. Ideal agent to keep wounds clean and disinfected, Bites of insects, reptiles, etc. Gunshot wounds and compound fractures, excellent. Great skin disinfectant.

remedies.name: Ipecacuanha
remedies.text:
(Ipecac-root) The chief action is on the ramifications of the pneumogastric nerve, producing spasinodic irritation in chest and stomach. Morphia habit, The principal feature of Ipecacuanha is its persistent nausea and vomiting, which form the chief guiding symptoms, Indicated after indigestible food, raisins, cakes, etc. Especiatly indicated in fat children and adults, who are feeble and catch cold in relaxing atmosphere; warm, moist weather. Spasmodic affections. Haemorrhages bright-red and profuse, Mind, — Irritable; holds everything in contempt. Full of desires, for what they know not.

Head. — Bones of skull fee] crushed or bruised. Pain extends to teeth and root of tongue.

Eyes. — Inflamed, red. Pain through eyeballs, Profuse lachrymation. Cornea dim, Eyes tire from near vision. State of vision constantly changing. Spasm of accommodation from irritable weakness of the ciliary muscle, Nausea from looking on moving objects.

Face. — Blue rings around eyes. Periodical orbital neuralgia, with lachrymation, photophobia, and smarting eyelids.

Nose. — Coryza, with stoppage of nose and nausea. Epistaxis.

Stomach. — Tongue usually clean, Mouth, moist; much saliva, Constant nausea and vomiting, with pale, twitching of face. Vomits food, bile, blood, mucus. Stomach feels relaxed, as if hanging down. Hiccongh. Abdomen, — Amebic dysentery wtih tenesmus; white straining pain so great that it nauseates; little thirst. Cutting, clutching; worse, around the navel. Body rigid; stretched out stiff. Stools, — Pitch-like, green as grass, like frothy molasses, with griping at navel. Dystenteric, slimy.

Female. — Uterine haemorrhage, profuse, bright, gushing, with nausea. Vomiting during pregnancy. [Ant. t.; Arg,.3 Nux v.; Tabac; Sep.; Sulph.) Pain from navel ta sterus. Menses tuo early and too profuse.

Respiratory. — Dyspnoea; constant constriction in chest. Asthma, Yearly attacks of difficult shortness of breathing. Continued sneezing; coryza; wheezing cough. Cough incessant and vioicnt, with every breath. Chest seems full of phlegm, but does not yield to coughing. Bubbling rales. Suffocative cough; child becomes stiff, and blue in the face. Whooping-cough, with nosebleed, and from mouth. Bleeding from lungs, with nausea,; feeling of constriction; rattling cough. Croup. Hemoptysis from slightest exertion. {Afillef. Hoarseness, especially at end of a cold. Complete aphonia.

Fever. — Intermittent fever, irregular cases, after Quinine. Slightest chill with much heat, nausea, vomiting, and dyspnoea. Relapses from improper diet.

Sleep. — With eyes half open. Shocks in all limbs on going to sleep. [Jgn.]

Extremities. — Body stretched stiif, followed by spasmodic jerking of arms towards each other, Skin. — Pale, lax, Biue around eyes. Miliary rash.

Modalities. — Vorse, periodically; from veal, moist warm wind, lying down. Relationship. —- Compare: Emsctine — principal alkaloid of Ipecac. A powerful amebicide, but is not a bactericide. Specific for amebiasis; of remarkable value in treatment of amabic dysentery; also as a remedy in pyorrheea, % gr. daily for three days, then Jess. Emetin, 44 gr. hypodermically, in Psoriasis. Emetin hydroch, 2x, diarrhoea with colicky, abdominal pains and nausea. Emetin for endameebic dysentery, In physiological doses must be carefully watched. May produce hepatization of lungs, rapid heart action, tendency for the head to fall forward and lohar pneumonia, in hemetemesis and other haemorrhages, compare: Gelatin (which has a marked effect on the coagulability of the blond, Hypodermically; or if by mouth, a 10 per cent, jelly, about 4 oz., three times a day). Arsenic; Cham.; Puls; Tort. em.; Squill, Convolvulus (colic and diarrhoea). Typha latifolia — Cat-tail flag (dysentery, diarrhoea) and summer complaint). In Asthma, compare: Blutta erientalis, Antidotes: Arsenic; China; Tabac. Complementary: Cuprum,; Arn, Dose. — Third to 200th potency.

remedies.name: Iridium
remedies.text:
(The Metal) Intestinal putrefaction and septicemia. Anaemia, increases red corpuscles. Epilepsy; lupus, Rheumatism and gout. Uterine tumors. Spinal paresis. Exhaustion after disease, Children who are puny, weak-limbed, and grow too fast. Nephritis of pregnancy.

Head. — Difficult concentration of thought. Sensation as if mind were void. Thought confused. ‘“Woodeny” feeling in right side of head. Right side of scalp sensitive. Profuse, watery coryza, better indoors. Ozena.

Respiratory. — Hoarse cough, worse talking; posterior nares feel raw, inflamed, profuse, thick, yellowish discharge. Chronic laryngeal catarrh. Back and

Extremities. — Weakness in the kidney region. Spinal paresis, especially for the aged and after disease. Pressing in groin and leit thigh. Tension in both thighs, especially left. Dislocated feeling in left hip-joint and duil pain toward left gluteal region.

Relationship. — Compare: Iridium chloride. (Produces salivation and stiffness of jaws followed by head and nervous symptoms, Congestion of nares and bronchi. Dragging pain in lower back. Headache worse right side, heavy feeling as of liquid lead.) Compare: Platina; Palladium; Osmiuns, Dose. — Sixth and higher,

remedies.name: Iris Versicolor
remedies.text:
(Blue Flag) Thyroid, pancreas, salivary, intestinal glands, and gastro-intestinal mucous membrane, are especially affected. Increases the flow of bile. Sick headaches and cholera morbus are a special therapeutic field for its action.

Head. — Frontal headache, with nausea. Scalp feels constricted. Right temples especially affected. Sick headache, worse rest; begins with a blur before eyes Pustular eruption on scalp. Ears, — Roaring, buzzing, ringing in ears, with deafness. Aural vertigu, with intense noises in ears, Vomiting and flickering before eyes, Face. — Neuralgia after breakfast, beginning in infraorbital nerve, and involving whole face.

Throat. — Mouth and tongue feel scalded. Heat and smarting in throat. Burning. Frofuse flow of saliva; ropy. Goitre.

Stomach. — Burning of whole alimentary canal, Vomiting, sour, bloody, biliary. Nausea. Profuse flow of saliva. [Aferc.; Ipec.; Kali iod.] Deficient appetite, Abdomen. — Liver sore, Cutting pain. Flatufent colic. Diarrhoea; stools watery, with burning at anus and through intestinal canal. Periodical night diarrhoea, with pain and green discharges. Constipation (give 30th).

Extremities. — Shifting pains. Sciatica, as if left hipjoint were wrenched. Pain extends to popliteal space. Gonorrheal rheumatism (use /risin}.

Skin. — Herpes zoster, associated with gastric derangements, Pustular eruptions, Psoriasis; irregular patches with shining scales. Eczema, with nightly itching.

Modalities. — H’orse, in evening and at night, from rest. Better, from continued motion.

Relationship. — Antidote: Nux. Compare: Jris florentina — Orris-root — (delirium, convulsions, and paralysis); Jris factissima (headache and hernia); Jris germanica— Blue Garden Iris — {dropsy and freckles); /ris tenar—J. minor — (dry mouth; deathly scnsation at point of stomach, pain i deo-crcal region; appendicitis. Pain from adhesions after), Pancrcatinum (diseases of pancreas, gout, diabetes); /pee.; Podoph.; Sanguin.; Ars.; Ant. cr.

Dose. — Tincture to thirtieth potency. Favorable reports from the very highest potencies.

remedies.name: Jacaranda
remedies.text:
(Brazilian Caroba-tree) Has reputation as a remedy in venereal diseases and rheumatism. Morning sickness. The urinary and sexual symptoms are important. Rheumatic symptoms.

Head. — Vertigo on rising, with heavy forehead. Eyes pain; are inflamed and watery Coryza with heavy head. Throat, ~ Sore, dry, constricted. Vesicles in pharynx.

Urinary. — Urethra inflamed; discharge of yellow Matter. Male, —- Heat and pain in penis; painful erections; phimosis, Prepyce painful and swollen. Chancroid. Chordee. Itching pimples on glans and prepuce, Extremities. — Rheumatic pain in right knee. Weakness of lumbar region. Morning soreness and stiffness of muscles. Gonorrhceal rheumatism. Wching pimples on hands. Relationship. -—— Compare: Thuja: Corallinm; Jacaranda Gualandas (in syphilitic symptoms, especially of eye and throat. Chancroids. Dark, painless diarrhoea.) Dose. — Tincture, to third potency,

remedies.name: Jalapa
remedies.text:
(Jalap) Causes and cures colic and diarrhoea. The child is good alf day, but screams and is restless and troublesome at night, Gastro-intestinal. — Tongue, smooth, glazed, dry, smarting. Pain in right hypochondrium. Flatulence and nausea. DPinching and griping. Watery diarrhoea; thin, muddy stools, Abdomen distended. Face cold and blue, Anus sore. Extremities, — Aching in arms and legs. Pain in farge joint of great toe. Smarting at root uf nail. Burning of soles.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Elater.; Cann. sat Compare: Camiph.; Calocy.

Dose. — Third to twelfth potency,

remedies.name: Jatropha
remedies.text:
(Purging Nut) Of value in cholera and diarrhoea. The abdominal symptoms are most important, Stomach, — Hiccough, followed by copious vomiting. Nausea and vomiting, brought on by drinking, with acrid feeling from throat. Great thirst. H’ery cusy vomiting, Fleat and burning in stomach, with crampy, constrictive pain in epigastrizm.

Abdomen. — Distended, with gurgling noises. Pain in hypochendria. Pain in region of liver and under right scapula to shoulder, Violent urging to urinate. Stool, — Sudden, profuse, watery, like rice-water. Diarrhao; forced discharge; loud noise in ubdemen like gurgling of water coming oul of a bung-holy, associated with coldness, cramps, nausea, and vomiting.

Extremities. — Cramps in muscles, especially calves, legs, and feet. Coldness of whale body. Modalities, — Better, by placing hands in cold water.

Relationship. — Compare: Camph.; Verat.; Gambog.: Croton.; Jatropha urens — Sponge-nettle — (oedema and cardiac paresis).

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Jequirity
remedies.text:
(Indian Liquorice) Epithelioma, lupus, ulcers, granular lids. Eyes. —~ Purulent conjunctivitis; inflammation spreads to face and neck, Granular ophthalmia.

Relationship. — Compare: Jequiritol (in cases of trachoma and pannus to engraft a new purulent inflammation, The proteid poisons contained in Jequirity seeds are almost identical in their physiological and toxic properties with the similar principles found m snake venom),

remedies.name: Jonesia Asoca
remedies.text:
(Bark of an Indian Tree, introduced by Dr. N. D. Ray, Calcutta) Has extensive sphere of action on female organs. Amenorrhea and metrorrhagia, Head.— Unilateral headache; reflex uterine, congestive headache, better open air and by free flow. Pain in eyeballs; supra-orbital pains. photophobia, Nasal catarrh, profuse, watery discharge. Loss of sense of smell.

Gastric. — Desire for sweets, also acid things. Thirsty, excessive nausea; obstinate constipation, haemorrhoids.

Female. — Delayed and irregular menses; menstrual colic: amenorrheea, pain in ovaries before flow; menorrhagia, irritable bladder; leucorrhoea.

Sleep. — Disturbed. Dreams of traveling.

Back. — Pain along spine radiating to abdomen and thighs.

Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Juglans Cinerea
remedies.text:
(Butternut) A faulty elimination that produces jaundice and various skin eruptions, is pictured by this drug. The sharp, occipital headache, usually associated with liver disturbances, is very characteristic. Pain in chest, axilla aml scapula, with suffocative sensation. Cholelithiasis.

Head. — Dull, full head. Eruption on scalp. Sharp, occipital headache. Head feels enlarged. Pustules on lids and around eyes.

Nose. — Tingling in nose; sneezing. Coryza, preceded by pain under sternum, with threatening suffocation, Later, copious, bland, thick mucus discharge. Mouth, — Acrid feeling in mouth and throat. Soreness in region of tonsils externally. Dryness of root of tongue and fauces.

Stomach. — Atonic dyspepsia with much eructation and flatulent distention. Soreness in region of liver.

Back. — Muscles of neck rigid, lame. Pain between scapula and under right. Pain in lumbar vertebrz. Skin, -- Jaundice, with pain about liver and right scapula. Itching and pricking when heated. Pustules. Eezema, especially on lower extremities, sacrum and hands, Erythema and erysipelatous redness.

Stool. — Yellowish-green, with tenesmus and burning at anus. Camp diarrhcea.

Modalities. — Bciter, getting heated, exercise, scratching, on rising in morning. Worse, walking.

Relationship. — Compare: Juglandis (duodenal catarrh; bilious diarrhoea); Chelidon.; Bryon., Tris.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Juglans Regia
remedies.text:
(Walnut) Skin eruptions are prominent.

Head. — Confused; feels as if head were floating in air, Occipital sharp pain. (Juglans cin.) Styes. Female. —~ Menses early, black, pitch-like coagula. Abdomen distended, Skin.— Comedones and acne of the face. Crusta Jactea, with soreness around ears. Itching and eruptions of small red pustules. Scalp red, and itches vio~ lently at night. Chancre-like ulcer. Axillary glands suppurate, Relationship. — Compare: Juglans cinerea, Dose. — Tincture, and lower potencies.

remedies.name: Juncus Effusus
remedies.text:
(Common Rush) Urinary affections. Dysuria, strangury, and ischuria. Asthmatic symptoms in haemorrhoidal subjects. Bubbling sensations. Abdominal fiatulence.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Juniperus
remedies.text:
(Juniper Berries) Catarrhal inflammation of kidneys. Dropsy, with suppression of urine. Old persons, with poor digestion and scanty secretion of urine. Chronic pyelitis.

Urinary. — Strangury; bloody, scanty urine, violet odor, [Yered.] Weight m kidney region. Prostatic discharge. Renal hyperemia. [Lucalypiol.]

Respiratory. — Cough with scanty, loaded urine.

Relationship. — Compare: Sabina, Juniperus Virginfanus— Red Cedar — (apoplexy, convulsions, strangury, uterine haemorrhage), Terebinthina.: Dose. — Best form is the infusion. Qile ounce to a pint of boiling water. Dose, one half tétwo ounces, or tineture, one to ten drops.

remedies.name: Justicia Adhatoda Basaka
remedies.text:
(An Indian Shrub, Singhee) Highly efficacious medicine for acute catarrhal conditions of the respiratory tract (used in the beginning).

Head. — Irritable, sensitive to external impressions; hot, full and heavy head; lachrymation, with cerysa profuse. fluent, with consiant sneezings; loss of smell and taste; coryca wiih cough.

Throat. — Dry, pain during empty swallowing, tenacious mucus, Mouth dry.

Respiratory. — Dry cough from sternal regien all over chest. Hoarseness, larynx painful. Paroxysmal cougi, with suffocative obstruction of respiration. Cough with sucezing. Severe dyspneea with cough. Tightness across chest. Asthmatic attacks, cannot endure a close, warm room. Whuoping-cough..

Relationship. — Seems to come between Cepa and Euphrasia, which compare, Dose. — Tincture and third potency.

remedies.name: Kali Arsenicum
remedies.text:
(Fowler’s Solution) The Keli ars: patient: tends towards malignancy, and inveterate skin diseases, Skin. — Intolerable itching, worse undressing. Dry, scaly, wilted. Acne; pustules worse during menses, Chronic eczema; itching worse from warmth, walking, undressing. Psoriasis, tichen. Phagedenic ulcers. Fissures in bends of arms and knees. Gouty nodosities; worse, change of weather. Skin cancer, where suddenly an alarming malignancy without any external signs sets in, Numerous small nodules under skin.

Female. — Cauliflower excrescences of os uteri, with flying pains, foul smelling discharge, and pressure below pubis.

Relationship. — Radium.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Kali Bichromicum
remedies.text:
(Bichromate of Potash) The special affinities of this drug are the mucous membrane of stomach, bowels, and air-passages; bones and fibrous tissues. Kidneys, heart, and liver are also affected, Nephritis with gastric disturbances. Cirrkois of liver. Anzmia and absence of fever are characteristic. General weakness, It is especially indicated for fleshy, fat, light complexioned persons subject to catarrbs or with syphilitic or scrofufous history. Symptoms are worse in the morning; pains migrate guickly, rheumatic and gastric symptoms alternate. More adapted to subacute rather than the violent acute Stage. Mucous membranes ever}where are affected, and a tough, stringy, visctd secretion is produced, which condition is a very strong guiding symptom for this drug. Pvrforation of the septum. Chronic atonic catarrh.

Head. — Vertigo with nausea when rising from seat. Headache over eyebrows, preceded by blurred vision. Aching and fullness in glabetls, Semilateral Headache in smalt spots, and from suppressed catarrh. Frontat pain; usually over one eye. Bones and scalp feel sore.

Eyes. — Supra-orbital neuralgia, right side. Eyelids bart, swolfen, oedematous. Discharge ropv and vellow. Ulcers on cornea; no pain or photophobia. Descemetitis, with only moderate irritation of eye. Croupous conjunctivitis; granular lids, with pannus. Iritis,s with punctate deposits on inner surface of cornea. Slight pain, with severe ulceration or inflammation. [Conium opposite. ]

Ears. — Swollen, with tearing pains, Thick, yellow, stringy, fetid discharge. Sharp stitches in left ear. Nose. --Snuffles of children, especially fat, chubby babics. Pressure and pait at root of nose, and sticking pain in nose. Scptum ulcerated; round ulcer. Fetid sucll. Discharge thick, ropy, oveenish-yellow, “ough, clastic plugs from nose; leave a raw surface. Inflammation extends to frontal sinuses, with distress and fullness at root of nose. Dropping from posterior nares. Hydr.] Loss of smell. Much hawking. Inability to breathe through nore, Dryness. Coryza, with obstruction of nose, Violent sneesing., Profuse, watery nasal discharge.. Face. -- Florid c mplexion. Blotchy, red appearance. Acne. [/ugiens; Kal, ars.] Bones sensitive, especially beneath orbits. Mouth,— Dry; viscid saliva. Tongue mapped, red, shining, smooth, and dry, with dysentery; broad, flat, indented, thickly coated. Throat, ~~ Fauces red and inflamed. Dry and rough. Parotid glands swolien. Uvula relaxed, aoedematous, bladder-like. Pseudo-membranous deposit on tonsils and soft palate. Burning extending to stomach. Aphthe. Diphtheria, with profound prostration and soft pulse. Discharge from mouth and throat, tough and stringy. Stomach, —- Natsea and vomiting after heer, Load immediately after eating. Feels as if digestion had stopped, Dilatation of stomach. Gastritis. Round slcer of stomach, Stitches in region of liver and spleen and through to spine. Dislikes water. Cannot digest meat. Desire for beer and acids. Gastric symptoms are relieved after eating, and the rheumatic symptoms reappear, Abdomen. — Cutting pain in abdomen, soon after eating. Chronic intestinal ulceration, Soreness in right hypochondrium. Fatty infiltration of liver and increase in soft fibrous tissue. (Ilinsdale.) Painful retraction, soreness and burning.

Stool. — Jelly-like, gelatinous; worse, mornings. Dysentery; tenesmuas, stools brown, frothy. Sensation of a plug in anus, Periodic constipation, with pain across the loins, and Lrown urine.

Urinary. — Burning in vrethra, After urinating a drop scents to remain which cannct be expelled. Ropy mucus in uring. Urethra becomes clogged up. Congestion of kidneys; nepisilis, with scanty, albuminous urine and casts, Pyelitis; urine mixed with epithelial cells, mucus, pus, or blood. Haematochyluria, Male. — itching and pain of penis, with pustules. Ulcers, with paroxysmal stitches; aggravated at night. Constriction at rort of penis, at night on awakening. Syphilitic ulcers, with cheesy, tenacious exudation. Erections. [Picric. ac.) Female, — Yellow, tenacious leucotrheea. Pruritus of vulva, with great burning and excitement. Prolapsus uteri; worse in hot weather.

Respiratory. — Voice hoarse; worse, evening. Metallic, hacking cough. Profuse, yellow expectoration, very glutinous and sticky, coming out in long, stringy, and very tenacious mass. Tickling in larynx. Catarrhal Yaryngitis cougit has a brassy sound. True membranous croup, extending to larynx and nares. Cough, with pain in sternum, extending to shoulders; worse when undressing. T’ain at bifurcation of trachea on coughing; from mid-sternum to back.

Heart. — Dilatation, especially from coexisting kidney lesion. Cold feeling around heart. ]Kalt nit.} Back. — Cutting through loins; cannot walk; extends to groins. Pain in coccyx and sacrum extending up and down. Extremities. —Tains fly rapidly from one place to anather. [Aalt sulph.; Puls.) Wandering pains, along the bones; worse cold. Left-sided sciatica; better, motion. Bones feel sore and bruised. Very week. Tearing pains in. tibi syphilitic rheumatism. [Mec] Crackling of all joints. Soreness of heels when walking, Tendo Achilles swollen and painful. Pains in sinall spots. [O.xalic ac.] Skin, — Acne. Papular eruptions. Uleer with punchedout ¢dyes, with tendency to penetrate and tenacious exudation. Pustular eruption, resembling small-pox, with burning pains.

Modalities. — Better, from heat. Tforse, beer, morning, hot weather, undressing, Relationship. — Compare: Tart, emet.; Brom.; Hepar; Ind.; Cale.; Ant. cr, In the production of false membranes compare: Brom.; Ammon, caust.; Sulph. ac.; Ipecac. Antidotes: <frs.. Lach.

Dose. — Third and sixth trituration, also thirtieth attenuation, The lower preparations of this salt should not be kept too long.

remedies.name: Kali Bromatum
remedies.text:
(Bromide of Potash) Like all Potash Salts, this weakens the heart and lowers temperature. Brominism is caused by it. General failure of mental power, loss of memory, melancholia, anesthesia of the mucous membranes, especially of eyes, throat, and skin; acne; loss of sexuat desire, paralysis. Leading remedy in psoriasis. Nodular form of chronic gout. Symptoms of upoplectic attacks, uramic or otherwise; somnolence and stertor, convulsions, aphasia, albuminaria, Mind. — Profound, melancholic delusion; feeling of moral deficiency; religious depression; delusions of conspiracies against him. Imagines he is singled out as an object of divine wrath, Loss of memory. Must do something — move about; gets fidgety. [ferant.] Fear of being poisoned. [#fyos.} Amnesic aphasia; can pronounce any word tofd, bur catinot speak utherwise. Night terrors. Horrid illusions. Active delirium. Head, — Suicidal mania with tremulousness. Face Rushed. Numb feeling in head. Brain-fag. Coryza with tendency to extension into throat

Throat. — Congestion of uvula and fauces. Anasthesia of fauces, pharnyx, and larynx. Dysphagia, especially of liquids. [/7yos,]

Stomach. — Vomiting, with intense thirst, after each meal. Persistent hiccough. [Sulph, ac.]

Abdomen. — Sensation as if bowels were falliig ont Cholera infantum, with reflex cerebral irritation, jerking and twitching of muscles. Green, watery stools with intense thirst. vomiting, eyes sunken. Prostration, Internal coldness of abdomen. Diarrhoea, with much blood. Green, watery stools. Retraction of abdomen.

Urinary. — Sensibility of urethra diminished. Urine profuse, with thirst. Diabetes. [Pdos. ae.]

Male. — Debdility and impotence. Effects of sexual excesses, especially loss of memory, impaired co-ordination, numbness and tingling in limbs. Female. ---Pruritus. Ovarian neuralgia with great nervous uneasiness. Exaggerated sexual appetite. Cystic tumors of ovaries. Respiratory. -— Spasmodic croup. Reflex cough dur ing pregnancy. Dry, fatiguing, hacking cough at night.

Extremities. — Fidgety hands; busy twitching of fingers. Jerking and twitching of muscles.

Skin. — Acne of face, pustules. Itching; worse on chest, shoulders, and face. Anzsthesia of skin, Psorfasts, Sleep. ~- Restless sleep. Extreme drowsiness. Sleep- essness due to worry and grief. Night terrors. Grinding teeth in sleep. Horrible dreams. Somnambulism. Modalities. -—- Better, when occupied mentally or physically, Dose. — A few grains of the crude salt to the third trituration, Remember the unstable character of this salt. Said to he much more active if salt is eliminated from the diet.

remedies.name: Kali Carbonicum
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Potassium) The weakness characteristic of all Potassium Salts is seen especially in this, with soft pulse, coldness, general depression, and very characteristic stitches, which may be felt in any part of the body, or in connection with any affection, Sensitive to every atmospheric change, and intolerunce uf cold weather, One of the best remedies following labor, Miscarriage, for consequent debilitated states. Early morning aggravation is yery characteristic. Fleshy aged people, with dropsical and paretic tendencies. Sweat, backache, and weakness. Pains from within out, and of stinging character. “Giving-out™ sensation, Fatty degenerations. Stinging pains in museles and internal parts. Twitching of muscles. Pain in small spot on left side Mind, — Despondent. Alternating moods. Very trritable. Full of fear and imaginations, Anaiely felt in stomach, Sensation as if bed were sinking. Never wants to be left alone.

Head. — Vertigo on turning. Headache from riding in cold wind, Headache comes on with yawning. Stitches in temples; aching in occiput, one-sided, with nausea, on riding in’ carriage. Loose f{celing in head. Great dryness of hair. falls ant. {Fluor ac]

Eyes. — Stitches in eyes. Spots, gauze, and black points before eyes. Lids stick together in morning. Swelling over upper tid, like little bags. Swelling of glavella between brows. Asthenopia. Weak sight from excessive sexual indulgence. On shutting eyes, painful sensation of light pentrating the brain. Ears, — Stitches in ears. Itching. cracking, ringing and roaring. Nose. --- Nose stuffs up in warm room. Thick, fluent, yellow discharge. Post-nasal dropping. [Spiget.] Sore, scurfy nostrils; bloody nasal mucus. Crusty nasal openings. Nosebleed on washing face in morning. Ulecrated nossrits.

Mouth. — Gums separate from teeth; pus oozes out. Pyorrhea, Aphthe. Tongue white. Much saliva constantly in mouth. Bad, slimy taste.

Throat. — Dry, parched, rough. Sticking pain, as from a fish-bone. Swallowing diflicult; food goes down cesophagus slowly. Stomach, — Flatuieuce, Desire for sweets. Feeling of lump in pit of stomach. Gagging. Dyspepsia of old people; burning acidity, bloating. Gastric disorders from ice-water, Sour ertctations. Nausea; better lying down. Constant feeling as if stomach were full of waiter, Suur vomiting; throbbing and cutting in stomach. Disgust for food. cinsxiety felt in stomach, Episgastrium sensitive externally, Easy choking when eating. Abdomen, — Stitches in region of liver. Old chronic liver troubles, with soreness. Jaundice and dropsy. Distention and coldness of abdomen. Pain from left hypochondrium through abdomen; must turn on right side before he can rise. Rectum — Large, difficult stools, with stitching pain an hour before. Hiamorrhoids, large, swolien, painful. Itching, ulcerated pimples around anus, Large discharge of blood with natural stool. Pain in hmemorrhoids when coughing. Burning in rectum and anus. Easy prolapsus. [Graph.; Pod.] Itching. [/gsat.]

Urine. — Obliged to rise several times at night to urinate, Pressure on bladder long before urine comes. Inveluntary urination when coughing, sneezing, etc.

Male. — Complaints from coition. Deficient sexual instinct. Excessive emissions, followed by weakness. Female, —Menses early, profuse [Calc. c.] or tee late, pale and scanty, with soreness about genitals; pains from back pass down through gluteal musctes, with cutting in abdomen. Pain through left labium, extending through abdomen to chest. Delayed menses in young girls, with chest symptoms or ascites. Difficult. first menses. Coniplainis after parturition, Uterine haemorrhage; constant oozing after copious flow, with violent backache, relieved by sitting and pressure.

Respiratory. — Cutting pain in chest; worse lying on right side. Heoarseness and loss of voice. Dry, hard cough about 3a. M., with stitching pains and dryness of pharnyx. Expectoration scanty and tenacious, but sncreasing in morning and after eating; aggravated right lower chest and lying on painful side. Hydrothorex. Leaning forward relieves chest symptoms. Expectoration must he swallowed; cheesy taste; copious, offensive, lump. Colduess of chest. Wheezing. Cough with relaxed uvula. Tendency to tuberculosis; constant cold taking; betier in warns climate, Reart.— Sensation as if heart were suspended Palpitation and buruing in heart region, Weak, rapid pulse; intcrmits. Threatened heart failure.

Back. — Great exhaustion. Stitches in region of kidneys and right scapula. Sonali of back feels weak. Stiffness and paralytic feeling in back. Burning in spine, [Guaco.[ Severe backache during pregnancy, and after miscarriage. Hip-disease. Pain in nates and thighs and hip-joint. Lumbago with sudden sharp pains extending up and down back and to thighs, Extremities. — Bacis and legs give out. Uneasiness, heaviness, and tearing in limbs and jerking. Tearing pain in limbs with swelling. Limbs sensitive to pressure. White swelling of knee. Tearing in arms from shoulder to wrist, Lacerating in wrist-joint. Paralysis of old people, and dropsical affections. Limbs go to sleep easily. Tips of toes and fingers painful. Soles very sensitive. Itching of great toe, with pain. Pain from hip to knee. Pain in knees, Skin. — Burning as from a mustard-plaster.

Sleep. — Drowsy after eating. Wakes about two o'clock and cannot sleep again.

Modalities. — Worse, after coition; in cold weather; from soup and coffee; in morning about three o’clock: lying on left and painful side. Bettcr, in warm weather, though moist; during day, while moving about.

Relationship. — Complementary: Carbo; Nat. mur. Follows Nux often in stornach and bladder troubles. Compare: Kali salicylcum (vomiting, especially of pregnancy; arteriosclerosis); Aah silirwm (gouty nodosities); Aali accticum (diabetes, diarrhcea, dropsy, alkaline urine, very much inercased in quantity); Aoef citricum (Bright's disease—1 gr, to wine-glass of water): Aali ferrocvanatum (physical and mental prastration following infection. Inability to sustained routine work. Use 6x. Uterine symptoms, like Sepia. bearing-down sensation and gastric sinking; fatty heart}; Kali oxaticum (umbago, convulsions);Kali picro-nitricum and Kali picrictom (jaundice, violent cructations); Keli suipkuration (gastritis, hiccough, redness of face); Kali tartoricuwm (paraplegia); Kali tclluricum (gar- Sicky odor of breath, salivation, swollen tongue}. Also compare: Cale.; Amnon. phos; Phos.; Lycop.; Bry.; Natrum; Stann.; Sepio. Antidotes: Camph.; Coffea.

Dose. — Thirtieth and higher. Sixth trit. Do not repeat too often. Use cautiously in old gouty cases, advanced Bright's and tuberculosis.

remedies.name: Kali Chloricum
remedies.text:
(Chlorate of Potassium) Acts very destructively upon the kidneys, producing a croupous nephritis, hemoglobinuria, ete. Produces most acute ulcerative and follicular stomatitis. Noma. Toxemic conditions of pregnancy (urinary symptoms). Chronic nephritis; hepatitis.

Mouth. — Profuse secretion of acid saliva, Whole mucous surface red, tumid, with gray-based ulcers. Tongue swollen.

Stomach. — Feeling of weight in epigastric and umhilical region. Flatulence, Vomiting of greenish-black matter.

Stool. — Diarrhoea; profuse, greenish mucus.

Urine. — Albuminous, scanty. suppressed. Hamaturia. diuresis. Nucleo-albumin and bile, high Fhosphoric acid, with Jow total solids. Skin, — Jaundice. Itching miliary or papular eruptions. Discolored; chocolate tint.

Dose. — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Kali Cyanatum
remedies.text:
(Potassium Cyanide) Cancer of tongue and agonizing neuralgia have been benefited by this drug. Aqueous solution prevents spread of small-pox.

Tongue. — Ulcer of tongue, with indurated edges. Speech difficuit.

Face. — Severe neuralgia in temporal region, recurring daily at same hour. Pain in orbital and supramaxillary region, with screaming and loss of consciousness, Respiratory. -- Cough prevents sleep; respiration weak; cannot take deep breath.

Modalities. — Horse, from 4 A.M. to 4 PM. Relationship, — Compare: Plotin.; Stonn.; Cedron; Mesen; Mur, ac, Dose. — Third centesimal trituration.

remedies.name: Kali Hydriodicum
remedies.text:
(lodide of Potassium) The profuse, watery, acrid coryza that the drug produces serves as a sure guiding symptom, especially when associated with pain in frontal sinus. It acts prominently on fibrous and connective tissues, producing infiltration, oedema, etc. Glandular swellings, Purpura and haemorrhagic diathesis. Syphilis may be indicated in all stages: I. In acute form with evening remitting fevet, gomg off in nightly perspiration. 2. Second stage, mucous membranes and skin ulcerations. 3. Tertary symptoms; nodes, Give material doses only. Mind, — Sad, anxious; harsh tempcr. Irritable; congestion to head, heat and throbbing.

Head. — Pain through sides of head. Violent headache. Cranium swells up in hard lump. Pain intense cover eyes and root of nose. Brain feels enlarged. Hard nades, with severe pain. Facial neuralgia. Lancinating pain in upper jaw.

Nose. — Red, swollen. Tip of nose red; profuse, acrid, hot, watery, thin discharge. Ozana, with perforated septum. Sneezing. Nasal catarrh, involving frontal sinus. Stuffiness and dryness of nose, without discharge. Profuse, cool, greenish, unirritating discharges, Eyes. — Conjunctiva-red, injected; profuse lachrymation. Syphilitic iritis, Pustular keratitis and chemosis. Bony tumors of the orbit. Ear. —- Noises in ear. Boring pain in ears.

Stomach. — Saliva increased, Faintness at epigastrium. Cold food and drink, especially milk, aggravate. Much thirst. Throbbing, painful) burning. Flatulence. Female,—Menses late, profuse. During menses uterus feels as if squeezed. Corrosive leucorrhoea, with subacute inflammatory conditions of the womb in young married women.

Respiratory. — Violent cough; worse in morning. Pulmonary oedema, Larynx feels raw. Laryngeal oedema. Awakes choking. Expectoration like soapsuds, greenish, Pneumonia, when hepatization commences, Pnreumoceccic meningttis, Stitching pains throngh lungs to back. Asthma. Dyspnoea on ascending, with pain in heart. Hydrothorax. [Mere sudph.] Pieuritic effusion. Cold travels downward to chest.

Extremities. — Severe hone-pains. Periosteum thickened, especially tibia; sensitive to touch. [ Kali b.; tsaf.] Rheumatism; pains worse at night and in damp weather, Contraction of joints. Rheumatism of kuces with effusion, Pain in small of back and coccyx. Pain in hip, forcing limping. Sciatica; cannot stay in bed; worse at night and lying on affected side. Formication of lower extremities when sitting, Letter lying down. Skin. -- Purple spots; worse on legs. Acne, hydroa. Smal) boils. Glands enlarged, indurated. Hives, Rough nodules all over, watse any covering; heat of body intense. Fissured anus of infants. Tendency te cedematous swellings, eyelids, mouth, uvula, etc. Acne rosacea, Modalities. — Horse, warm clothing, warm room, at night, damp weather. etter, motion, open air.

Relationship. — Antidote: Ffepar. Compare: Jod., Mercur.; Sulph.; Meser. Chupheence, a Hindoo remedy for syphilitic eruptions, ulcerations and bone-pains. Used in tincture.

Dose. — Crude drug, in material officinal dosage and when strictly homcopathically indicated, as in acute respiratory affections the third potency.

remedies.name: Kali Muriaticum
remedies.text:
(Chloride of Potassium) Although not proven, this remedy has a wide clinical use, through its introduction by Schuessler. It certainly is of great value in catarrhal affections, in subacute inflammatory states, fibrinous exudations, and glandular swellings. White or gray coating of base of tongue, and expectoration of thick, white phlegm, seem to be special guiding symptoms. Head. —- Imagincs he must starve. Headache, with vomiting. Crusta lactea, Dandruff, Eyes. —- White mucus, purulent scabs. Superficial ulcer. Trachoma.

Ears. — Chronic. cutarrhal conditions of the middle car. Glands about the ear swollen. Snapping and noises in the ear.

Nose. — Catarrh; phlegm white, thick. Vault of pharynx covered with adherent crusts. Stuffy cold. Nosebleed. [Aran.; Bry.) Face. — Cheek swollen and painful.

Mouth. — Aphthe; thrush; white ulcers in mouth, Swollen glands about jaw and neck. Coating of tongue grayish-white, dryish, or slimy.

Throat. — Follicular tonsillitis. Tonsils inflamed; enlarged so much, can hardly breathe. Grayish patches or spots in the throat and tonsils, Adherent crusts in vault of pharynx. “Hospital” sore throat.

Stomach. — Fatty or rich food causes indigestion. Vomiting of white, opaque mucus; water gathers in the mouth, Pain in the stomach, with constipation, Butimia; hunger disappears by drinking water.

Abdomen. — Abdominal tenderness and swelling. Flatulence. Thread-worme, causing itching at the anus.

Stool. — Constipation; light-colored stools. Diarrhoea, after fatty food; clay-colored, white, or slimy stools. Dysentery; purging, with slimy stools. [famorrhoids: bleedmg; blood dark and thick; fibrinous, clotted.

Female. — Menstruation too late or suppressed. checked or too early; excessive discharge; dark-clotted. er tough, black blood, like tar. ([Péat.] Leucorrhoea; discharge of milky-white mucus, thick, non-irritating, bland. Morning sickness, with vomiting of white phleem. Bunches in breast feel quite soft and are tender, Respiratory

Organs. — Loss of voice; hoarseness. Asthma, with gastric derangements; mucus white and hard to cough up. Loud, noisy stomach cough; cough short, acute, and spasmodic, like whoopiny-cough; expectoration thick and white. Rattling sounds of air passing through thick, lenacicus mticus in the bronchi; dificult to cough up. Back and

Extremities. — Rheumatic fever; exudation and swelling around the joints. Rheumatic pains felt only during motion, er increased by it, Nightly rheumatic pains; worse from warmth af bed; lightning-like from smalf of back to feet; must get out of bed and sit up. Hands get stiff while writing, Skin.-- Acne, erythema, and eczema, with vesicles containing thick, white contents. Dry, flour-like scales on the skin. [Arsenic.]

Modalities. — Worse, rich food, fats, motion. Relationship —Compare: Kino (ootorrhoea, with stitghes in right ear); Bry; Mereur.; Puls.; Sulph. Bose, — Third to twelfth potency.

remedies.name: Kali Nitricum
remedies.text:
(Nitrate of Potassium — Saltpeter) Ojten indicated in asthma, also valuable in cardiac asthma; of great value in sudden dropiscal swellings over the whole body, Gastro-intestinal inflammation, with much debility, and relapses in phthisis, call for this remedy. Suppurative nephritis, Head. — Scalp very sensitive. Headache, with vertigo, as if falling to right side and backwards; worse, stooping. Ennui. Eyes. -— Vision becomes clouded. Turbid corpus vitreum. [Arn.; Ham.; Solan. 2.; Phos. Variegatedcolored rings before eyes. Burning and lachrymation.

Nose. — Sneezing. Swollen feeling; worse, right nostril, Point red and itching. Polypus. [Sang. nit.] Mouth. -— Tongue red, with burning pimples; burns at tip. Throat constricted and sore.

Stool. — Thin, watery, bloody. Membranous shreds, with tenesmus. Diarrhoea from eating veal.

Female. — Menses too early, profuse, black; preceded and with violent backache. Leucorrhoea. Burning pains in the ovarian region only during menses. [Zine. after.]

Respiratory. — Hoarseness. Dry, morning cough, with pain in chest and bloody expectoration. Bronchitis. Asthma, with excessive dyspnoea, fausea, dull stitches, and burning in chest. Dyspnoea so great that breath cannot be held long enough to drink, thongh thirsty. Chest feels constricted. Oppression worse in morning, Sour-smelling expectoration. Expectoration of clotted blood, after hawking mucus Acute exacerbations in phthisis; congestion of lungs. Spasmodic croup; paroxysm of crowing. Laryngeal diphtheria

Heart. — Pulse weak, smail, thready. Violent stitch in precordia, and heating of heart.: Extremities. — Stitches between — shoulder-blades. Tearing and sticking in shoulders and joints. Hands and fingers seem swollen.

Modalities. — Worse, eating veal; towards morning and in afternoon. Bettcr, drinking sips of water.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Opium; Nitr. sp. dute. Antidote to Opium and Morphine poisoning, 8-10 grains to glass of water. Compare: Gun-powder (Nitre with sulphur and charcoal —2x trit. IZerpes facialis; crops of boils. Carbuncles). Cannab, sat. (which contains a large amount of Kali sit.). Lycop.; Sanguin.; Alum sat.; Antimon, tod, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Kali Permanganicum
remedies.text:
(Permanganate of Potassium) lntense irritation of nose, throat, and larynx. Diphtheria. Dysmenorrhoa. Bites of serpents and for other animal poisons.

Respiratory. — Bleeding from nose. Nasal discharge. Smarts and irritates, Constrictive, smarting sensation in throat. Larynx feels raw. Short, hacking cough, Throat. — Swollen and painful. Everything hawked up streaked with blood. Posterior nares painful. Muscles of neck feel sore. Swollen uvula. Fetor of breath, Dose. — Locally, i dram to a quart of water, to correct fetor in cancer, weer, vena, and other foul odors. Also as an injection in leucorrhoea and gonorrhoea. Internally, 2x dilution in water Saturated solution locally im eruption of small-pox. Potassium Permanganate for Morph'ne Poisoning — Potassium permanganate is recognized as Leing the mast effective chemical antidote in cases of morphine or fpium poisoning, acting directly on the morphine and oxidizing it to less toxic substances. To be effective the permanganate must come in direct contact with the opium or morphine in the stomach; hypodermatic or intravenous injections are absolutely useless, as the salt would be decomposed by the blood serum at once. The approved treatment is administration of two to five grains of potassium permanganate in dilute aqueous solution as soon as possible after the puison is taken, this amount to be increased if very large doses of the poison have been taken. Wahing out the stomach with a quantity of I to 500 solution of permanganate is also recommended, ustwg at least a pint of this solution either by a stomach pump or by enforced vomiting

Permang. — Potash counteracts effects of alkaloids of many poisonous plants. Owing to its oxidizing powers if given before the alkaloid has been absorbed, (Dr. Chestnut in Dept. of Agriculture.)

remedies.name: Kali Phosphoricum
remedies.text:
(Phosphate of Potassium) One of the greatest nerve remedies, Especially adapted to the young. Marked disturbance of the sympathetic nervous system. Conditions arising from want of nerve power, neurasthenia, mental and physical depression, are wonderfully improved by this remedy. Besides, it corresponds to states of adynamia and de- ¢ay, gangrenous conditions. In these two directions it has won many clinical laurels. After removal of cancer when in healing process skin is drawn tight over the wound. (Eli G, Jones, M. D.) Mind. — Anxiety, nervous dread, lethargy. Indisposition to meet people. Extreme lassitude and depression. Very nervous; starts easily, irritable. Brain-fag; hysteria; night terrors. Somnambulance. Loss of mem, ory. Slightest labor seems a heavy task. Great despondency about business. Shyness; disinclined to converse, Head, — Occipital headache; better, after rising. Vertigo, from lying, on standing up, from sitting, and when looking upward. [Granat.] Cerebval anaemia. Headache of students, and those worn out by fatigue. Headaches are relieved by gentle motion. Headaclie, with weary, empty, gone feeling at stomach. [Jgn,; Sep.) Eyes. — Weakness of sight; loss of perceptive power; after diphtheria; from exhaustion. Drooping of eyelids. [Caust.]

Ears. — Humming and buccing i the cars. Nose. —- Nasal discase, with offensive odor; fetid discharge: Face. — Livid and sunken, with hollow eves. Right~ sided neuralgia, relieved by cold applications, Mouth. — Breath offensive, fetid. Tongue coated brownish, like mustard. Excessively dry, in the morning. Toothache, with easily-bleeding gums; they have a bright-red scam on them. Gums spongy and receding. [Caps.; Haman.; Loch.] Throat. -- Gangrenous sore throat, Paralysis of the vocal cords, Stomach. — A nervous “gone” sensation at the pit of the stomach. [/gn.; Sep.; Sulph.] Feels seasick without navsea, Abdomen. — Diarrhoea: foul, putrid odor: occasioned by.fright, with depression and exhaustion, Diarrhoea while eating. Dysentery; stools consist af pure blood; patient becomes delirious; abdomen swells, Cholera; stools have the appearance of rice water. [Wcrat,; Ars.; Jatrop.) Prolapsus reeti. [/gn.; Pod.]

Female. — Menstruation tva late or too scanty in pale, irritable, sensitive, lachrymose females. Too profuse discharge, deep-red or blackish-red, thin and not coagulating; sometimes with offensive odor, Male. — Nocturnal emissions; sexual power diminished; utter prosttation after coitus. [{Aafi carb] Urinary Organ:—Enuresis. Incontinence of urine. Bleeding from the urethra. Very yellow urine. Respiratory. —- Asthma; least food aggravates. Short breath on going upstairs. Cough; yellow expectoration. Extremities. —- Paralytic lameness in back and extremities. Exertron aggravates. Pains, with depression, and subsequent exhaustion.

Fever. — Subnormal temperature. Modalities. —JVorsv, eating, cold, carly morning. “Better, warmth.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali hypophosph, (chronic bronchitis where the expectoration is thick and fetid, sometimes scanty and fough. Marked muscular debility). Genista— Dyer’s weed — (frontal headache and vertigo, werse motion, better open air and eating. Dry throat, awakes with waterbrash. Itching eruption on elbows, knees and ankles. Promotes diuresis in dropsical conditions), Afacrozamia Spiralis, (Extreme debility after severe iliness; collapse. Weariness from no assignable cause, no pains, Boring pain at vertex; vomiting and retching all night; impossible to open eyes, giddiness and cold.) Zinc.; Gels.; Cimicif.; Laches.; Mur. ac.

Dose. — Third to twelfth trituration. The highest potencies seem to be indicated in certain cases.

remedies.name: Kali Sulphuricum
remedies.text:
(Potassium Sulphate) Ailments accompanied by profuse desquamation. Applicable ta the later stages of inflammation. Yellow mucous and serous discharges, Has been found of much use in oxaluria.

Head. — Rheumatic headache, begirining in evening. Bald spots. Dandruff and scaldhead.

Ears. — Eustachian deafness. Discharge of yellow matter. {Hydr.} Nose, — Colds, ath yellow, slimy expectoration. Nose obstructed. Smell Jost. [Nat, mur.) Engorgement of the nasal pharyngeal mucous membrane, mouth breathing, snoring, etc., remaining afler removal of adenoids. Face, — Aches in heated room, Epithelioma. Stomach, — Tongue coated yellow and slimy. Insipid, pappy taste. Gums pamtul. Burning thirst, nausea, and vomiting. Load feeling. Dread of hot drinks.

Abdomen. — Colicky pains; abdomen feels cold to touch: tympanitic, tense, Yellow, slimy diarrhcea, Constipation, with haemorrhoids. {Sulth.)} Male. — Gonorrhoea; discharge slimy, yellowish-green. Orchitis, Gleet, Female. — Menses too late, scanty, with feeling of weight in abdomen. Metrorrhagia.

Respiratory. — Coarse rales. aitling of mucus in chest. [Tart. em] Post-grippal cough, especially in children. Bronchial asthma, with yellow expectoration. Cough; worse in evening and in hot asmosphere. Croupy hoarseness, [Hep.; Spong.] -Mxtremities. — Pain in nape, back and limbs, worse in warm room. Shifting, wandering pains.

Fever. — Rise of temperature at night. Intermittent fever, with yellow, slimy tongue.

Skin. — Psoriasis. [Ars.; Thyroid.] Eczema; burning, itching, papular eruption. Nettle-rash. Polypi. Epithelioma. Sehorrhea, Favus. Ring-worni of scalp or beard with abundant scales.

Modalities. — Worse, in evening, heated room. Better, cool, open air. Relationship.-~ Compare: Kali sulph, chromico.— Alum of chrome —3x (affections of nasal fossa and hay-fever. Chronic colds. Sneezing, red. watery eyes, irritation of mucous membrane). Pulsat.; Kali bich.; Nat. m. Dose, — Third to twelfth potency,

remedies.name: Kalmia Latifolia
remedies.text:
(Mountain Laurel) A rheumatic remedy. Pains shift rapidly. Nausea and slow pulse frequently accompanying. Has also a Prominent action on the heart. In small doses, it accelerates the heart’s actictt; in larger it moderates it greatly, Neuralgia; pains shoot downwards, with numbness. Fulgurating pains of locomotor ataxia, Protracted and continuous fevers, with tympanites. Paralytic sensations; pains and achings in limbs accompany nearly every group of symptoms. ilbusminuria. Head. —Vertigo; worse stooping. Confusion of brain. Pain in front and temporal region from, head to nape and to teeth; from cardiac origin.

Eyes. — Vision impaired. Stiff, drawing sensation when moving eyes. Rheumatic iritis.¥ Scleritis, pain increased by moving the eve. Face. Neuralgia; worse right side. Stitches in tongue. Stitches and tearing in bones of jaw and face. Stomach. —- Warm, glowimg sensation in epigastrium. Nausea; vomiting. Pain in pit of stomach; worse by bending forward; rclieved by sitting ercct, Bilious attacks, with nausea, vertigo, and headache. Sensation of something being pressed under the epigastrium.
