Urinary. — Frequent, with sharp pains in lumbar region. Post-scarlatinat nephritis.

Heart. — Weak, siow pulse. [Dig.; Apoc. can] Fluttering of heart, with anxiety. Palpitation; worse leuning forward, Gouty and rheumatic metastasis to heart. Tachycardia, with pain. TAyroid.] Tobacco heart. Dyspnoea. Shooting through chest above heart into shoulder-blades. Frequent pulse. Heart's action tumultuous, rapid and visible. Paroxysms of anguish around heart, Female. — Menses too early, or suppressed, with pain in limbs and back and inside of thighs. Leucorrhoea follows menses. Back. —~ Pain from neck down arm; in upper three darsa! vertebre extending to shoulder-blade. Pain down back, as if it would break; in localized regions of spine; through shoulders, Lumbar pains, of nervous origin.

Extremities. — De!toid rheumatism especially right. Pains from hips to knees and feet. Pains affect a large part of a limb, or several joints, and pass through quickly, Weakness, numbness, pricking, and seuse of coldness in timbs. Pains along ulnar nerve, index finger. Joints red, hot, swollen, Sleep. — Sleepless, wakes ucry early in morning.

Modalities. — [Vorsc, leaning forward [opposite, Kali carb,); jaoking down; motion, open air.

Relationship. — Compare: Derris pinuta (of great service in neuralgic headaches of rheumatic origin). Compare: Spigclia; Pulsat, Complementary: Benz, acid.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Kaolin
remedies.text: (China Clay) A remedy for croup and bronchitis, Nose. — ltching and burning. Discharge yellow. Sore, seabby, stopped up. Respiratory. -- Sorcness of chest along trachea; cannot stand percussion. Gray sputa. Capiflary bronchitis, Larynx and chest sure, Membranous croup — extends down trachea, Dose. —~ Lower triturations. Kousso (Hagenia Abyssinica) A Vermifuge — Nausea and vomiting, vertigo, precordiat anxiety slowing and irregular pulse, subdelirium and collapse. Rapid and extreme prostration. KREOSOTUM (Beechwood Kreosote} Kreosotum is a mixture of phenols obtained from this distillation. Pulsations all over the body, and profuse bleeding from small wounds. Very severe, old neuralgic affections; pains rather aggravated hy rest. Excoriating, burning, and offensive discharges. Haemorrhages, ulcerations, cancerous affections. Rapid decomposition of fluids and secretions, and burning pains.. Overgrown, poorly developed children. Post-climacteric diseases. Tumefaction, puffiness, gangrene. Ailings of teething children.

remedies.name: Kreosotum
remedies.text:
Mental. — Music causes weeping and palpitation. Vanishing of thought; stupid, forgetful, peevish. Head, — Dull pain, as from a hoard pressing against forehead. Menstrual headache, Occipital pain. [Gels.; Zine. pic.) Eyes. — Salty lachrymation. Lids red and swollen. Ears, — Eruption around and pimples within. Difficult hearing and buzzing.

Face. — Sick, suffering expression; hot, cheeks red.

Mouth. — Lips red, bleeding. Very painful dentition: child will not sleep, Very rapid decay of teeth, with spongy, bleeding gums; teeth dack and crumbly. [Staph.; Ant, c.] Putrid odor and bitter taste.

Nose. — Offensive smeil and discharge, Chronic catarrh of old people. Acrid rawness. Lupus. {4rs.; X-ray.) Throat. — Burning, choking sensation. Pririd oder. Stomach. -- Nausea; vomiting of food several hours after eating; of sweetish water in the morning. Feeling of coldness, as of ice water in stomach. Soreness; better eating. Painful hard spot. Hzmatemesis. Bitter taste after a swallow of water.

Abdomen. — Distended. Burning haemorrhoids. Diarrhoea; very offensive; dark brows. Bloody, fetid stoots. Cholera infantum in connection with painful dentition, grecn stools, nausea, dry skin, exhaustion, etc, Urine. — Offensive. Violent itching of vulva and vagina, worse whet urinating. Can urinate only when lying; cannot get out of bed quick enough during first sleep. Dreams of urinating. Enuresis in the first part of night. Must hurry when detire comes to urinate, Female. -- Corrosive itching within vulva, burning and swelling of labia; violent itching between labia and thighs. During menses, dificult hearing; buzzing and roaring; eruption after. Burning and soreness in external and intcrnal parts. Leucorrhoea, yellow, acrid; odor of green corn; worse between periods. Hamorthage after coition. Menses too early, prolonved. Vomiting of pregnancy, with ptyalism. Menstrual flow intermits [Puls.]; ceascs on sitting or walking; reappears on lying down. Pain worse after menses. Lochia offensive; fntermits. Respiratory. -- [foarse, with pain in larynx, Cough; worse evening, with efforts ta vomit, with pain in chest. Raw burning in chest: pains and oppression, Cough after influenza. [Hriodyction.] Winter coughs of old people, wath heavy pressure on sternum. Gangrene of lungs. After every cough, copious, purulent expectoration, Hemoptysis; periadic attacks. Sternum feels Pressed in.

Back. — Dragging backache, extending to genitals and down thighs. Great debility.

Extremities. — Pain in joiuts, hip and knee. Boring pain in hip-joints. Scapule sore. Skin. —Itching, werse tewards evening. Burning in soles. Senile gangrene. Simall wounds bleed freely. (Crot.; Lach.; Phos.) Pustules and herpes. Ecchymosis; dorsal surface of fingers and hands eczematous.

Sleep. — Disturbed with tossing. Paralytic sensation in limbs on waking. Anxious dreams of pursuit, fire, erections, etc, Modalities. -—Jerse, in open air, cold, rest, when lying; after menstruation, Better, from warmth, motion, warm diet,.

Relationship. — Antidote: Nux. Inimical: Carbo, Complementary in malignant diseases: Ars.; Phos.; Suiph. In lJeucorrhea compare Matico. Lippia Mexicana (difficult, dry, deep, winter cough). Guaiacol is the principal constituent of Kreosote, and similar in action, Used in pulmonary tuberculosis. Compare also: Fuligo ligni; Carbol. ac.; lod.; Laches.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. The 200th in senpitive patients.

remedies.name: Laburnum
remedies.text:
(Cystiaus Laburnum) Coustant vertigo, intense sleepiness, vomiting, widespread anesthesia, and convulsions are some of the chief effects of this drug. Cerebro-spinal meningitis. Great prostration, sense of constriction in throat, stiffness of nape, tearing from nape into occiput, lustreless eyes. Head. ~~ Stupefaction; indifference, [Phos. ac.] Unequally dilated pupils; giddiness; twitching of facial muscles. [4geric.] Hydrocephalus.

Stomach. — Excessive thirst. Constant nausea, vomiting; burning pain in epigastrium., Abdomen. — Tenesmus and erections. Grass-green urine, ‘ Extremities. — Numbness and pain in hands. Difficulty in moving them.

Relationship. — Antidote: Coffee. Compare: Nux; Gels. Cystine (produces mator paralysis resembling that of curare).

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Lac Caninum
remedies.text:
(Dog’s Milk) This remedy is of undoubted value in certain furis of sore throat and diphtheria, and rheumatism. Corresponds to a low-vitiated, non-feverish type of sicknesg,.. The keynote symptom is, erratic pains, alternating bides. Feels as if walking on air, or of not touching the bed when lying down, Great lassitude, Ozana. Decided effect in drying up milk in women who cannot nurse the baby. Great weakness and prostration. Sinking spelfs every morning.

Mind. — Very forgetful; in writing, makes mistakes. Despondent; thinks her disease incurable. Attacks of rage. Visions of snakes. Thinks himself of little consequence.

Head. — Pain first one side, then the other. Blurred vision, nausea and vomiting at height of attack of headache. Occipital pain, with shooting extending to forehead. Sensation as if brain were alternately contracted and relaxed. Noises in ears. Reverberation of vuice.

Nose. — Coryza; one nostril stuffed up, the other free; alternate, Ala nasi and cerners of mouth cracked. Boties of nose sore to pressure, Bloody pus discharged.

Mouth. — Tongue coated uhite with bright red edges; profuse salivation. Drooling in diphtheria. Cracking “of jaw while eating. (Nit. ac.: Rhus.) Putrid taste increased by sweets.

Throat. — Sensitive to touch. Painful swallowing; pain extends to ears. Sore throat and cough with menstruation. Tonsillitis and diphtheria symptoms change repeatedly from side to side. Shining glascd appearance of deposit. Stiffness of neck and tongue. Throat feels burned raw. Tickling sensation causes constant cough. Sore throat beginning and ending with menses, Female. — Menses too early, profuse, floty in gushes, Breasts swollen; painful before [Cale. c.; Con.; Puls.], and better or appearance of menses. Mastitis; worse, least jar. Helps to dry up mitk, Sinking at epigastrium. Sexual organs easily excited. Backache; spine very sensitive to toch or pressure. Galacforrhaa.

Modalities. — Worse, morning of one day and in the evening of next. Better, cold, cold drinks. Relationship, — Compare: Lach.; Con., Lae felinum ~~ Cat’s Milk — (ciliary neuralgia; eye symptoms, photophobia; asthenopia; dysmenorrhea); Lec vaccinum — Cow’s Milk — (headache, rheumatic pains, constipation); Lac vaccinum coagulatum — Curds — (nausea of pregnancy); Lactis vaccini floc — Cream — (diphtheria, leucorrhoea, menorrhagia, dysphagia); Lactic ac.

Dose. — Thirtieth and the highest potencies.

remedies.name: Lac Defloratum
remedies.text:
(Skimmed Milk) A remedy for diseases with faulty nutrition; sick headaches, with profuse flow of urine during pain, Car Sickness.

Head. — Despondent. Pain begins in forehead to occiput, in morning on rising, Jntense throbbing, with nausea, vomiting, blindness, and obstinate constipation; worse, noise, light, motion, during menses, with great prostration, and better by pressure and bandaging head tightly.

Stool. — Constipation. Stools hard, large, with great straining; painful, lacerating anus.

Relationship. — Compare: Colostrum. (Diarrhoea in infants. Whole body smells sour. Colic.) Nat. mur.

Dose. — Sixth, to thirtieth potency and higher,

remedies.name: Lachesis
remedies.text:
(Bushmaster or Surucucy) Like ail snake poisons, Lachesis decomposes the blood, rendering it more fluid; hence a haemorrhagic tendency is marked. Purpura, septic states, diphtheria, ald other low forms of disease, when the system is thoroughly poisoned and the prostration is profound. The modalities are most important in guiding to the remedy. Delirium tremens with much trembling and confusion. Very important during the climacteric and for patients of a melancholic disposition. Il) effects of suppressed discharges. Diphtheritic paralysis. [Botuliaxm.) Diphtheria carriers, Mind. — Great loguacitx. Amative. Sad in the morning; no desire to mix with the world. Restless and uneasy; does not wish to attend to business; wants to be off somewhere all the time. Jealous, {Hyvos.] Mental labor best performed at night. Religious insanity. [Verat.: Straus] Derangement of the time sense, Head. — Pain through head on awaking. Pain at root of nose Pressure and burning on vertex. Waves of pain: worse after moving. Sun headaches. With headache, very pale face. Vertigo.

Eyes. — Defective vision after diphtheria, extrinsic muscles too weak to maintain focus. Sensation as if eyes were drawn together by cords which were tied in a knot at root of nose.

Ears. — Tearing pain from zygoma into ear; also with sore throat, Ear-wax hard, dry.

Nose. — Bleeding, nostrils sensitive. Coryza, preceded by headache. Hay asthma; paroxysms of sneezing. (Silica.; Sabad.]

Face. — Pale. Triiacial neuralgia, left side, heat running up into head. [Phos.] Tearing pain in jaw-bones. (Amphisbana; Phos.) Purple, mottled, puffed; looks swollen, bloated, jaundiced, chlorotic. Mouth.-—Gums swollen, spongy, bleed. Tongue swollen, burns, trembles, red, dry and cracked at tip, catches on teeth. Aphthous and denuded spots with burning and rawness. Nauseous taste. Teeth ache, pain extends to vars. Pain in facial bones.

Throat. — Quinsy. Dry, intensely swollen, externally and internally. Diphtheria; membrane dusky, blackish; pain aggravated by hot drinks; chronic sore throat, with much hawking; mucus sticks, and cannot be forced up or down. Very painful; worse slightest pressure, touch is cven more annoying, Worse on left side, In diphtheria, etc, the trouble dbeyan on the left side. Tonsils purplish. Purple, livid color of throat. Feeling as if something was swollen which must be swallowed; zorse, swallowing sativa or liquids. Pain into cor. Collar and neck-band must be very loose.

Stomach. — Craving for alcohol, oysters. Any food causes distress, Pit of stomach painful to touch. Hungry, cannot wait for food. Gnawing pressure made better hy eating, but returning in a few hours. Perceptible trembling movement in the epigastric region. Empty swallowing more painful than swallowing solids.

Abdomen. — Liver region sensitive, cannot bear anything around watst. Especially suitable to drunkards.” Abdomen tympanitic, sensitive, painful. [Bell.} Stool. — Constipated, offensive stool. Anus feels tight, as if nothing could go throngh it. Pain darting up the rectum every time he sneezes or coughs. Haemorrhage from bowels Jike charred straw, black particles. Haemorrhoids protrude, become constricted, purplish. Stitches in them on sneezing or coughing. Constant urging in rectum, not for stool, Female. — Climacteric troubles, palpitation, flashes of heat, haemorrhages, vertex headache, fainting spells; warse, pressure of clothes. Menses too short, too feeble; pains aff relicved hy the flow. [Eupion.] Left ovary very painful and swollen, indurated. Mammez inflamed, bluish. Coccyx and sacrum pain, especially on -pising from sitting posture. Acts especially well at be- “ginning and close of menstruation, Male. — Intense excitement of sexual organs, Respiratory. — Upper part of windpipe very susceptible to touch. Sensation of suffocation and strangulation on tying down, particularly when anything is around throat; compels patient te spring from bed and rush for open window. Spasm of glottis; feels as if something ran from neck to larynx. Feels he must take o decp breath. Cramp-like distress in precordial region. Cough; dry, suffocative fits, tickling. Little secretion and much sensitiveness; worse, pressure on larynx, after sleep, open air. Breathing almost stops on falling asleep. [Grind.] Larynx painful to touch. Sensation as of a plug (-lisc.}] which moves up and dewn, with a short cough. Heart, — Palpitation, with fainting spells, especially duriag climacteric. Constricted feeling, causing palpitation, with anxiety. Cyanosis. [Irregular beats. Back, — Neuralgia of coccyx, worse rising from sitting pasture; must sit perfectly still, Pain in neck, worse cervical region, Sleep. — Patient sleeps into an aggravation. Sudden starting when falling steep. Sleepiness, yet cannot sleep. [Bell.; Op.) Wide-awake in evening.

Fever. — Chilly in back; feet icy cold; hot flushes and hot perspiration. Paroxysm returns after acids. Intermittent fever every spring.

Skin. — Hot perspiration, bluish, purplish appearance. Boils, carbuncles, ulcers, with bluish, purple surroundings. Dark blisters. Bed-sores, with black edges, Bluelack swellings. Pyzmia; dissecting wounds. Purpura, with intense prostration. Senile erysipelas. Wens. Cellulitis. Modalities. -~ Worse, after sleep, (Kali bich.) Lachesis sleeps info aggravation; left side, in the spring, warm bath, pressure or constriction, hot drinks, Better, appearance of discharges, warm applications.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Ars.; Mere.; Heat; Alcohol; Salt. Complementary: Lycop.; Hep.; Salamandra, Incompatible: Acet. ac.; Carb. ac. Compare: Cofyledon (climacteric troubles); Net. mt.; Nit. ac.; Crotal.; Amphisbana — snake lizard — (right jaw swollen and painful, lancinating pains; headaches, lancinating pains. Eruption of vesicles and pimples); Naja; Scolo pendra — Centipede — {malignant pustule; angina pectoris), Lepidiun (affections of the breast, heart, lancinating pains).

Dose. — Eighth to 200th potency. Doses ought not be repeated too frequently. If well indicated, a single dose should be allowed to exhaust its action,

remedies.name: Lachnanthes
remedies.text:
(Spirit-weed) Head, chest and circulation are affected. Bridge of nose as if pinched. A remedy for torticollis, rheumatic symptoms about neck. Twberculosts — light-complexioned people. Early stages, and established chest cases, with much coldness. Produces a desire to talk —a flow of language and the caurage to make a speech.

Head. — Rifft-sided pain, exending down to jaw; head feels enlarged; worse. least noise. Scalp painful. Sleepless. Circumscribed red cheeks; scalp feels sore, as if hair was standing on end; burning in palms and soles, Chest, -- Sensation of heat-- bubbling and boiling around heart region rising to head.

Back. — Chilliness benveen the shoulder-blades; pain and stiffness in back.

Neck. — Dratun over to one side in sore throat. Rheumatism of the neck. Stiffness of neck, Pain in nape, as if dislocated.

Skin. — Body icy cold: face yellow, tendency to sweat.

Relationship. — Compare: Dule,; Bry.; Puls.; also Fel tauri (nape of neck pains, and great tension there), Dose. -— Third potency. Tincture in phthisis, unit doses, ance or twice a week, or three drops every four hours.

remedies.name: Lacticum Acidum
remedies.text:
{Lactic Acid) Morning sickness, diabetes, and rheumatism offer a field for this remedy. Troubles is the breasis, Locally, in the tuberculous ulceration of vocal cords. Stomach. -- Tongue dry, parched. Thirst; voracious hunger, Canker, copious salivation and water-brash. Nausea; morning sickness, especially ix pale, unemic women. Hot, acrid eructation. Nausea; better, eating. Burping, hot gas from stomach to throat, causing profuse secretion of tenacious mucus, worse smoking.

Throat. — Fullness or lump like a puff ball. Keeps swallowing. Constricted low down.

Chest. — Pain in breasts, with enlargement of axillary glands, and pain extends into hand.

Extremities. — Rheumatic pain in joints and shoulders, wrists, knees, with much weakness. Trembling of whole body while walking. Limbs feel chilly.

Urine. — Large quantities passed, frequently, Saccharine.

Relationship. — Compare: Sarcolactic acid g. v- Lithia; Phos. oc. ° Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Lactuca Virosa
remedies.text:
(Acrid Lettuce) This remedy acts principally upon the brain and circulatory system. Delirium tremens with sleeplessness, coldness, and tremor, Hydrothorax and ascites. Impotence. Sense of lightness and figktuess affecting whole body, especially chest. Seems to be a true galactogogue.

Mind. — Stupefaction of sense. Great restlessness. Head, — Dull, heavy, confused, dizzy. Heat of face and headache, with general coldness. Headache, with affections of respiratory organs. Abdomen, — Sensation of weight, of fullness; borborygmi; abundant emission of wind. Colic in early morning, abdomen tense, relieved somewhat by evacuation and passing of wind.

Chest. — Difficult breathing. Suffocative breathing” from dropsy of the chest. Constant tickling cough. Incessant, spasmodic cough, as if chest would fly to pieces, Squeezing sensation in lower chest. Female.~- Promotes catamenia. Increase of milk in breasts.

Sleep. — Restless; impossible to get to sleep. Deep, comatose sleep.

Extremities. — Coldness and numbness of feet and legs. Tremor of hands and arms.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Acct. ar.; Coff. Compare: Nabatus — Prenanthes Serpentaria — Rattlesnake root— White Leftuce. similar to Lactuca, (chronic diarrhoea, worse after eating, nights and toqwards morning. Pain in abdomen and rectum; emaciation. Constipation and somnolence; susceptible to aura of others}; Lach.; Kalt carb.; Spiranthes (galacta- Bogue). Dose. ~— Tincture.

remedies.name: Lamium
remedies.text: {White Nettle) Has a special affinity for female and urinary organs. Headache, with backward and forward motion of head. Leucorrhoea and menses too early and scanty. Haemorrhoids; hard stool, with blood. Sensation in urethra as though a drop of water were flowing through it. Tearing in the extremities. Hzmoptysis. Dose, — Third potency.

remedies.name: Lapis Albus
remedies.text:
(Silico-fluoride of Calcium) Affections of glands, goitrc, pre-ulcerative stage of carcinoma, Burning, stinging pain in breast, stomach, and uterus. Connective tissue about glands specially affected. Fat anzmic babies with Iodine appetite. Kavenous appetite. Remarkably successful in scrofulous affections, except in malarial cases. Uterine carcinoma. Fibroid tumors with intense burning pains through the part with profuse haemorrhage. Glands have a certain elasticity and pliability about them rather than the stony hardness of Cate, fluor, and Cistus.

Chest. — Persistent pains in mammary region, Glandular hardening.

Skin. — Scrofulous abscesses and sores. Enlargement and induration of glands, especially cervical, Lipoma, sarcoma, carcinoma. Pruritus.

Relationship. — Compare: Budiaga; Ars. iod.; Cale, tod.; Con; Kal. ted.; Asterias.

Dose. — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Lappa
remedies.text:
(Burdock) Very important in skin therapeutics. Eruptions on the head, face, and neck; pimples; acue. Styes and ulcerations on the edge of the eyelids. Profuse and frequent urination, Extremities. — Pain in hands, knees, and ankles ¢xtending downward to fingers and toes. Pain in all joints. Eruption on extremitics.

Female. — Uterine displacements. An evceedingly sore, bruised feeling in uterus, with grcat relaxation of the vaginal tissues; apparently entire lack of tonicity of pelvic contents. ‘Lhese symptoms all aggravated by standing, walking, a misstep, or sudden jar. Dose, — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Lathyrus
remedies.text:
(Chick-pea) Paralytic affections of lower extremities, with hyperesthesia of the skin, aggravated by damp. Vertigo when standing, with eyes closed. Great exaggeration of the reflexes. Spastic paraplegia, Athetosis. Beri-beri, Infantile paralysis. After grippe and wasting and exhaustive diseases, where there is slow recovery of nerve power. Extremities. Tremulous, tottering gait. Excessive oeigidity of legs; spastic gait. Cannot extend or cross legs when sitting. Myelitis, with marked spastic symptoms, Rheumatic paralysis, Gluteal muscles and Inwer limbs emaciated. Legs biue; swoilen, if hanging down. Stiffness and lameness of ankles and knees, toes do not leave the floor, hecls do not touch floor. Muscles of calves very tense. Patient sits bent forward. straightens up with difficulty.

Urine. — Increased ladder reflex. Frequent, must hurry, else voided inveluntarily. Relationship. -— Compare: Qaytrap.; Secale; Agrastema githage — Corn-cocnle —( Burning, sensations, in stomach, through cesupbavus into throat, in lower ahdomen and anus; naiaa, bitter vomiting, impaired locomotion; difficulty in remaming erect; vertigo and headoche, burning from lower jaw to verter) Dose, — third potency.

remedies.name: Latrodectus Mactans
remedies.text:
. (Spider) A picture of angina pecteris is presented by the action of this drug. The pracordial region seems to be the center of attack. Lowered coagulability.

Head. — Anxiety. Screams with pam. Pain in neck to back of head.

Respiratory. — Extreme apna. Gasping respiration, Fears losing breath.

Chest. — Violent, precardial pain extending to the axilla and down the arm and forearm to fingers, with numbness of the extremity. Pulse feeble and rapid. Sinking sensation at the epigastrium. Extremities, — Pain in teft arm, feels paralyzed. Skin, -- Coldness of whole surface. Skin cold as marble, Relationship. — Compare: Latrodectus Hasselti — New South Wales Black Spider —- (Long lasting effects seem to indicate it as a “chronic” blood poisoning.- Arrests intense pain in pyemia. Great oedema in neighborhond of wound; paralysis of limbs, with great wasting of muscles. Violent, darting, burning pains, preceding paralysis; vertigo, tendency tu fal] forward; septicemic conditions; constant delusion of flying. Loss of memory. Roaring noises.) Aronea; Mygate; Theridion; Latrodectus Kalipe—New Zealand spidec — (lymphangitis and nervous twitchings, scarlet burning eruption.) Dose, — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Laurocerasus
remedies.text:
(Cherry-laure]) Spasmodic tickling cough. is often magically influenced by this drug. Lach of veaction, especially in chest, and heart affections, Drink rolls aucibly through aoesophagus and intestines. General coldness, not ameliorated by warmth, Violent pain in stomach with loss of speech.

Fever. — Colduess; chills and heat alternate. Thirst, with dry mouth in afternoon. Respiratory, --Cyanosis and dyspnoea; worse, sitting up. Patient puts hands on heart. Cough, with valvular disease. Exercise causes pain around heart. Tickling, dry cough. Dyspnoea. Constriction of chest. Cough, with copious, jelly-tike, or bloody expectoration. Small and jiecble pulse. Threatening paralysis of lungs. Gasping for breath; clutches at heart.

Heart. — Mitral regurgitation. Clutching at heart and palpitation. Cyanosis neanotorum.

Sleep. — Spells of deep sleep, with snoring and stertorous breathing.

Extremities. — Toe and finger nails become knotty. Skin blue. Sprained pains in hips, thighs and heels. Cold, clammy feet and legs. Clubbing of fingers. Veins of hands distended. Relationship, -— Compare: Hydrocy. ac.; Camphor; Secale; Ammon. carb.; Ambra, Dose,— Tincture, to third potency. Cheriy-laurel water, two to five drop doses. LECITHIN (A Phosphorus-containing Complex Organic Body prepared from the yolk of egg) Lecithin is important in the vital processes of plant and animal organisms. Lecithin has a favorable influence upon the nutritive condition and especially upon the blood, hence its use in anztnia and convalescence, neurasthenia ahd insomnia. Causes an immediate decrease in the excretion of the phosphates. Found useful in faulty nutrition, Mental exhaustion and impotency. Tuberculosis, causing marked improvement in nutrition and general improvement. Tired, weak, short breath, loss of flesh; symptoms of general break-down. Sexually weak.

Mind. — Forgetful, dull, confused.

Head. — Aching, especially in occiput — pulsating and ringing in ears. Pain in zygoma; face pale. Stomach, — Loss of appetite, thirsty, craves wine and coffee; bloated, sore pain in stomach rising toward throat. Urine, — Scanty, with phosphates, sugar or albumen. Sexual, — Male power lost or enfeebled. Anaphrodisia and ovarian insufficiency. \ Extremities. — Soreness, aching, lack of energy. Tired and weak, Relationship. — Compare: Phosphor.

Dose. — One-half to 2 grains of crude and potencies. Twelfth potency.

remedies.name: Ledum
remedies.text:
(Marsh-Tea) Affects especially the rheumatic diathesis, going through ali the changes, from functional pain to altered secretions and deposits of solid, earthy matter in the tissues. The Ledum rheumatism begins in feet, and travels upward. lt affects also the skin, producing an eruption like Poison-oak, and is antidotal thereto, as well as to stings of insects, There is a general lack of animal heat, and yet heat of bet is intulerabie. For, punctured wounds, produced hy sharp-peinted instruments or bites, particularly if the wounded parts are cold, this is the remedy. Head, — Vertigo when walking, with tendency to fall to one side. Distress when head is covered. Nosebleed. [Mctilot,; Bry.]

Eyes. — Aching in eyes. Extravasation of blood in lids, conjuuctiva, aqueous or vitreous. Contused wounds. Cataract with gout.

Face. — Red pimples on forehead and checks; stinging when touched. Crusty eruption around nose and mouth. Mouth — Dry. retching with cructation. Musty taste with catarrhal atfection.

Respiratory. — Burning in nose. Cough, with bloody expectoration. Dyspnoea: chest feels constricted. Suffovcative arrest of breathing. Haemoptysis, alternating with rheumatism. Chest hurts when touched, Whooping-cough; spasmodic, double mspiration with sobbing.

Rectum. — 4ual fissures, Haemorrhoidal pain, Extremities. — Gouty pains shoot al! through the foot and limb, and im joints, but especially smalt joints. Swollen, hot, pale. Throbbing in right shoulder. Pressure in shoulder, worse motion. Cracking in joints; worse, warmth of bed. Gouty nodosities. Balt of great toe swollen, [Rothrops.] Rheumatism begins in lower limbs and ascends, [Kalmia opposite.] Ankles swollen, Soles painful, can hardly step on them, [Anté. c.: Lye} Easy spraining of ankle. Fever, — Coldness, want of animal heat. Sensation as of cold water over parts; general coldness with heat of face. Skin, —- Acne on forehead, sticking pain therein. Eczema (facial). Itching of feet and ankles; worse, ‘ scratching and warmth of bed. Ecchymosis. Long discoloration after injuries, Carbunctes, Antidote to Rhus potsoning, [Grindel.; Cyprip.; Anac.] Modalities, — Beiter, from cold, putting feet in cold water, Worse, at night, and from heat of bed. Relationship. Compare: Ruta; Ham.; Bellis; Arnica.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Lemna Minor
remedies.text:
(Duckweed) A catarrhal remedy. Acts especially upon the nostrils. Nasal polypi; swollen turbinates. Atrophic rhinitis. Asthma from nasal obstruction; worse in wet weather.

Nose. — Putrid smell; loss of smell. Crusts and muco-purulent discharge very abundant. Post-nasal dropping. Pain like a string from nostrils to ear. Reduces nasal obstruction when it is an oedematous condition. Dryness of naso-pharynx.

Mouth. — Putrid taste on rising in the morning. Dry pharynx and larynx. Abdomen, — Disposition to noisy diarrhoea. Modalities. —- Worse, in damp, rainy weather, especially Acavy rains.

Relationship. — Compare: Duic. (damp surroundings and foggy weather). Cale.; Teucr.; Calend.; Nat. sulph, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. (Cress — Brazilian Cress} Affects the left side principally. With heart symptuius, numbness and pain in left arm, sensation of sinking in pit of stomach, Left side of head, face, chest, hip to knee, all have lancinating pain. A streak of pain from the temple to the chin, as if the face were cut with a razor, Burning in throat, roaring in ears. Sensation of a tight girdle around chest, as of a knife piercing the heart. Pain in neck, back, and extremities. Compare: Arnica.

remedies.name: Leptandra
remedies.text:
(Culver’s Root) A liver remedy, with jaundice and dlack, tarry stools. Bilious states. Fnfeebled portal circulation.

Head. — Dull frontal pain; vertigo, drowsiness, and depression, Smarting and aching in eyes.

Stomach. — Tongue coated yellow. Great distress in stomach and intestines, with desire for stool, Aching in region of liver extending to spine, which feels chilly.

Stool. — Profuse bluck, fetid stools, with pain at umbilicus. Bleeding piles. Typhoid stools turn black and look Jike tar. Clay-colored stools with jaundic® Relationship. —- Compare: Podop.; Iris; Bry.; Merc.; Ptel.; Myvica, Dose. -— Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Lilium Tigrinum
remedies.text:
(Tiger-lily) Manifests powerful influence over the pelvic organs, and is adapted to many reflex states dependent on some pathological condition of uterus and ovaries. More often indicated in unmarried women. The action on ihe heart is very marked. Pain in small spots. [O.al. ac.) Rheumatic arthritis.

Mind. — Tormented about her salvation. Consolation aggravates. Profound depression of spirits. Constant inclination to weep. Anxious; fears some organic ond incurable disease. Disposed to curse, strike, think obscene things. Aimless, hurricd manner; must keep busy. Head. --- Hot, dull, heavy, Faint in warm room. Wild Jeeling in head, Eyes. — Hyperasthesia of retina. Pain, extending back into head; lachrymation; and impaired vision. Myopic astigmia. Stomach, — Flatulent; nausea, with sensation of lump in stomach. Hungry; longs for meat, Thirsty, drinks often and much, and before severe symptoms.

Abdomen. — Abdomen sore, distended; trembling sensation in abdomen, Pressure downwards and backwards against rectum and anus; worse, standing: better, walking in open air. Bearing down in lower part of “abdomen. Urinary. —Frequeut urging. Urine milky, scanty, hot. 3 Stool. — Constant desire to defecate, from pressure ut rectum, worse standing. Pressure down the anus Early-morning urgent stovl. Dysestery; mucus andl blood, with tenesmus, especially in plethoric and nervous women at change of life. Heart. —- Sensation as if heart were grasped iu a vise. fCuct.] Feels full to bursting. Vulsations over whole body. Palpitation; irregular pulse; very rapid. Pain in cardiac region, with feeling of a load on chest. Cold feelmg about heart. Suffocating feeling in a crowded and warm room. [.[fis; fod.; Lyc.: Puls.) Female, —- Menses carly, scanty, dark, clotted, offensive; flow only tehew moaning about, Rearing-down seysation with urgent desire for stool, as though all organs would escupe. Ceases when resting. [Sep.; Lac c.; Belt.] Congestion of uterus, prolapse, and anteyersion, Constant desire to support parts externally. Pain in ovaries and down thighs. Acrid, brawn leucorrhoea: smarting in labia. Sexual instinct awakened. Bloated feeling in uterine region, Sub-involution. Extremities.. — Cannot walk on uneven ground, Pain in back and spine, with trembling, but oftener in front of a pressing-down character. Pricking in fingers. Pain in right hip. Legs ache; cannot keep them still. Pain in ankle joint. Burning palms and soles.

Sleep. — Unrefreshing, with disagreeable dreaius, Unable to sleep, with wild feeling in head..

Fever. — Great heat and lassitude in afternoon, with throbbing throughout body, Modalities. — If’orse, consolation, warm room, Petter, fresh air. Relationship. —- Compare: Cact.: Heion.; Murex; Sep.; Plat.; Pallad. Antidote: Felon.

Dose. — The middle and higher potencies seem to have done best. Its curative action sometimes is slow in developing itself.

remedies.name: Liatris Spicata
remedies.text: (Colic Root) A vascular stimulant. Increases functional activity of the skin, mucons membranes. Of use in dropsy due to liver and spleen diseases, also senal dropsy, [ere the suppressed urination is most favorably influenced. General anasarca due to heart and kidney disease. Diarrhara, with violent urging and pain in lower part of back. Colic, Locally, applied to ulcers end ‘tunhealthy wounds. A prompt diuretic. Dose.—1 to 4 drams of tincture or infusion,

remedies.name: Limulus
remedies.text: (Horse-foot — King-crab) Rush ot blood te face, Pressure above nose and hehind eyes. Painful ful!ness with coryza. Bodily and mental depression; drowsiness, after sca bathing. Painful fullness of whole right side of body. Abdomen hot, hurning, constricted. Crural neuralgia. Soles of feet ache, feel benumbed. Pain in right hip-joint. Itching vesicles on fintners, Relationship, — Compare: Asterias; Homarus; Cuprum. Dose, — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Linaria
remedies.text:
(Toad-flax) Acts prominently within the domain of the pneumogastrics. Eructation, nausea, salivation, pressure on stomach, Enteric symptoms and great drowsiness very marked. Cardiac fointing. Enuresis. Tongue rough, dsy; throat constricted. Coldness. Confusion in head. Irresistible sleepiness. Symptoms worse walking in open air.

Relationship. — Compare: Linum ustiatissimun: (asthma, hay-fever, and urticaria. Trismus and paralysis of tongue), Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Lithium Carbonicum
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Lithium) Chronic rhenmatism connected with heart lesions and* asthenopia offer a field for this remedy. Rheumatic nodes. Head. ~ Tension, as if bound; better, sitting and going out. Externally sensitive. Headache ceases weinte eating, Trembling and throbbing. Pain in heart; cxtends to head. Inspired air feels cold. Eyes. —- Half vision; invisible right half. Photophobia. Pain over eyes. Dry lids, Stomach. — Acidity, nausea. gnawing, relieved by eating. [Anacard.} Cannot endure slightest pressure of clothes. (Laches.]

Urine. — Tenesmus. Jurhid urine, with mucus and red deposit, Pain in region of right kidney. Free and colorless. While urinating, pressure in heart. Cystitis, subacute and chronic.

Respiratory. — Constriction of chest. Vivlent cough when lying down. Air feels cold when inspired. Pain in mammary glands, which extend into the arms and fingers..

Heart. — Rheumatic screness in cardiac region. Sudden shock in heart. Throbbing, dull stitch in cardiac region. Pains in heart before menses, and asso-~ ciated with pains in bladder, and before and after urinating. Trembling and fluttering in heart, extending to hack.

Extremities. — Varalytic stiffness all over. Itching about joints, Kheumatic pains throughout shoulderjoint, arm, and fingers. Pain in hollow of foot, extending to knee. Swelling and tenderness of finger and toe joints; better, hot water. Nodular swellings in joints. Ankles pain when walking. Skin. --—Scabby, tettery eruption on hands, head, and cheeks, preceded hy red raw skin, Dull stitch, ending im itching.

Modalities. — Worse, in morning, right side. Aetter, rising and moving about.

Relationship. — Compare: Lyc.; Ammon. phos.; Bens. ae; Cale; Lithium chlor. (symptoms of cinchonism, viz; Discy head, full, blurring of vision. Ringing in ears; marked tremors; general weakness; marked muscular and general prostration; no gastro-intestinal effects. Nose sore, heartburn, pain in teeth). Lithium lacticum (rheumatism of shoulder, and small joints relieved by moving about; worse, resting). Lithium bensoicum (deep-seated pains in loins; in small of back; uneasiness in bladder, frequent desire. Diminishing uric acid deposit), Dose. — First to third trituration,

remedies.name: Lobelia Inflata
remedies.text:
(Indian Tobacco) Is a vaso-motor stimulant; increases the activity of all vegetative processes; spends its force mainly upon the pneumogastric nerve, producing a depressed relaxed condition with oppression of the chest and episgastrium, impeded respiration, uausea and vomiting. Languor, relaxation of muscles, nausea, tomiturg, and dyspepsia are the general indications that point to the use of this remedy, in asthma and gastric affections. Best adapted to light-complexioned fleshy people. Bad effects of drunkenness. Suppressed discharges. [Sulph.] Diphtheria. Caterrhal jaundice, [Chionanth.]

Head. — Vertigo, and fear of death. Gastric headache with nausea, vomiting, and great prostration, worse, afternoon until midnight; tobacco, Dull, heavy pain.

Face. — Bathed in wld sweat. Sudden pallor.

Ears. — Deafness due to suppressed discharges or eczema, Shooting pain from throat, Mouth. — Profuse flow of saliva; acrid burning taste; mercurial taste; tenacious mucus, tongue coated white.

Stomach. — Acidity, flatulence, shortness of breath after eating. Heartburn with profuse flow of saliva. Extreme novsea and vomiting. Morning sickness. Faintness and weakness at epigastrium. Profuse salvation, with good appetite. Profuse sweat and prostration, Cannot bear smell or taste of tobacco. Acrid. burning taste; acidity, with contractive feeling in pit of stomach. Flatulence, shortness of breath after eating. {(Carbo.] Weartburn.

Respiratory. — Dyspnoea from constriction of chest; worse, any exertion. Sensation of pressure or weight in chest; beticr by rapid walking, Feels as if heart would stop, Asthma; attacks, with weakness, felt in pit of stomach and preceded hy pricking ail over. Cramp, ringing cough, short breath, catching at throat.

Back. — Pain in sacrum: cannut bear slightest touch, Sits leaning forward.

Urinary. — Deep red colour and copious red sediment.

Skin. — Prichling, itching with intense nausea, Modalities. — lore. tol-acca, afternoon, slightest motion, cold, especially cold washing, etirr, by rapid walking (chest pain), toward evening, and from warmth, Relationship. — Antidote: /pec. Compare: Yahac.; Ars.: Tart. ¢.; Verat.; Rosa. Lobetia syphititica or cerulea (gives a perfect picture of sneezing influenza, involving the posterior nares, palate, and fauces. Very depressed. Pain in forehead over eyes; pam and gas in bowels, followed by copious watery stuols with tenestius and soreness of anus. Pain in knees, Prickling im soles. Great epfression in lower fort of chest, as if air conld not reach there. Pain in chest ander short ribs of Ieft side. Dry, hacking cough, Breathing difficult. Dull. aching pain over root cf nose. Eustachian catarrh. Pain in posterior part of spleen.) Lobelia erinus (malignant growths; colloid cancer of the omentum; cork-screw-like pains in ahdomen; great dryness of skin, nasal and buccal mucous membranes; distaste for brandy; dry, eczematous patches covering points of first fingers. Malignant disease of the face. Epithelioma).

Dose. — Tincture, to thirtieth potency. Locally the tincture is antidotal to Poison-oak. Often the Acetum Lobelia acts better than any other preparation. Lobelia hypodermically acts clinically almost precisely as the antitoxin of diphtheria does upon the infection and tenders the system stronger to resist future infections (F. Ellingwood).

remedies.name: Lobelia Purpurascens
remedies.text:
(Purple Lobelia) Profound prostration of all the vital forces and of the nervous system: respiratory paralysis. Nervous prostration of influenca. Coma. Tongue white and paralyzed, Head. — Confused and depressed. Headache with nausea, vertigo; especially between eyebrows. Cannot keep eyes open; spasmodic closure of lids, Chest. — Superficial respiration; heart and lungs feel paralyzed; respiration slow, Heart beats sound to him like boom of a drum.

Eyes. — Impossible to keep open. Drowsy. Relationship.—Comyare: Baptisia; Lobelia cord:natis (debility, especially of lower extremities; oppressed breathing, pleurisy, sticking pain in chest on taking a long breath, Pain in feft lung, intermitting pricking during the day). Dose. -— Third potency.

remedies.name: Lolium Temulentum
remedies.text:
(Darnel) Tlas been made use of in cephalalgia, sciatica, paralysis Prostration and restlesstiess

Head. — Anxious and depressed, confused. Vertigo; must cluse eyes. Head heavy. Noises m cars. Stomach, — Nausea, vomiting. Pain in pit of stomach and abdomen. Severe purging.

Extremities. — Gait unsteady. Trembling of all limbs. Loss of power in extremities. Fiotent pain in calves, as if bound with cords. Cold extremities. Spasmodic motions of arms and legs. Cannot write; cannot hold a glass of water. Trembling of hands in paralysis.

Relationship. — Compare: Secale; Lathyr; Astrag.

Dose. — Sixth potency,

remedies.name: Lonicera
remedies.text:
(Fly-woodbine) Convulsive symptoms, Albuminuria. Syphilis.

Head. — Congestion of head and chest: coma, Contraction of one pupil and dilatation of the other. Sopor, eyes half open, red face.

Extremities. — Jerking of limbs. Trembling of whole body, Violent convulsions, Limbs and head fall over as if paralyzed, Extremities cold. Relationship.-- Compare: Lonicera pericylmenum — Honeysuckle ~~ (irritability of temper, with violent outburst [Crocus.]).

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Lupulus
remedies.text:
(Hops) Is a good remedy in unstrung conditions of the nervcus system attended with nausea, dizziness, headache following a night’s debauch. Infantile jaundice. Ure-~ thral burning. Drawing and twitching in almost every muscle, Nervous tremors; wakefulness and delirium of drunkards. Giddiness and siupefaction. Slow pulse. Perspiration profuse, clammy, greasy.

Head. — Morbid vigilance, Highly excited. Dull, heavy headache with dizziness. Drawing and twitching im every muscle. Sleep, — Drowsy during the day. Sopor.

Male. — Painful erections. Emissious, depending on sexual weakness and after onanism, Spermatorrhea, Skin. — Scarlatina-like eruption on face, Feels like insects crawling under skin; feels chapped, skin peels.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Coffea; Vinegar. Compare: Nux; Urtica; Cannabd, Dose. — Tincture, to third potency. Luptlin 1x trit. (Best in seminal emissions.) T.ocally in painful cancers.

remedies.name: Lycopodium
remedies.text:
(Club Moss) This drug is inert until the spores are crushed. Its wonderful medicinal properties are only disclosed by trituration and succussion, In nearly all cases where Lycopodium is the remedy, some evidence of urinary or digestive disturbance will be found. A lithzmic-neurasthenic remedy, Lycopodium is adapted more especially to ailments gradually developing, functional power weakening, with failures of the digestive powers, where the function of the liver is seriously disturbed. Atony. Mild temperaments of lymphatic constitution, with catarrhal tendencies; older persons, where the skin shows yellowish spots, earthy complexion, uric acid diathesis, etc.; also precocious, weakly children. Symptoms characteristically run from right to left, acts especially on right side of body, and are worse from about 4 to 8 p.m. In kidney affectiuns, ved sand in urine, backache, in renal region; worse before urination. Intolerant of cold drinks; craves everything wirm. Best adapted to persons intellectually keen, bu of weak, muscular power. Deep-seated, progressive, chronic diseases. Lithemia. Marked regulating influence upon the glandular (sebaceous) secretions. Pre-senility. Ascites, in liver disease. Lycop. patient is thin, withered, full of gas and dry. Lacks vital heat; has poor circulation, cold extremities.

Mind. — Melancholy; afraid to be alone, Little things annoy. Extremely sensitive. Averse to undertaking new things. Headstrong and haughty when sick, Loss of self-confidence Hurried when eating. Constant fear of breaking down under stress, Weak memory, confused thoughts; spells or writes wrong words and syllables. Failing brain-power. [Avac.: Phos.; Baryt.] Cannot bear to see anything new. Cannot read what he writes. Sadness in morning on awaking.

Head. — Shakes head without apparent cause. Twists face and mouth. Tressing headache on vertex; worse from 4 to 8 p.M., and from lying down or stooping, if not eating regulatly. [Cact.] Throbbing headache after every paroxysm of coughing. Headaches over ‘eyes in severe colds. [Sulph.] Vertigo in morning on rising. Pain in temples, as if they were screwed toward each other. Tearing pain in occiput; better, fresh air. Great falling out of hair. Eczema; moist oozing behind ears. Deep furrows on forehead, Premature baldness and gray hair.

Eyes. — Styes on lids near internal canthus. Dayblindness. [Bothrops.] Night-blindness more characteristic, Sees only one-half of an object. Ulceration and redness of lids.

Ears. — Thick, yellow, offensive discharge. Eczema about and behind ears. Otorrhcea and deafness with or without tinnitus; after scarlatina. Humming and roaring with hardness of hearing; every noise causes peculiar echo in ear.

Nose. — Sense of smell very acute. Feeling of dryness posteriorly. Scanty excoriating, discharge anteriorly. Ulcerated nostrils. Crusts and elastic plugs. [Kol. b.; Texe.] Fluent coryza, Nose stopped #p. Snuffles; child starts from sleep rubbing nose. Fan-like motien of ala nasi. [Kal brom.; Phos.) Face. — Grayish-yellow color of face. with blue circles around eyes. Withered, shriveled, and emaciated; copper-colored eruption. Dropping of lower jaw, in typhoid fever. [J.ach.; Opivm.] Itching; scaly herpes in face and corner of mouth.

Mouth. — Teeth excessively painful to touch. Toothache, with swelling of checks; relieved by warm application. Dryness of mouth and tongue, without thirst. Tongue dry, black, cracked, swollen; oscillates to and fro. Mouth waters. Blisters on tongue. Bad odor from mouth.

Throat. — Dryness of throat, without thirst. Food and drink regurgitates through nose. Inflammation of throat, with stitches on swaltowing; deiter, wary drinks. Swelling and suppuration of tonsils, Ulceration of tonsils, beginning on right side. Diphtheria; depostts spread from right to left; worse, cold drinks, Ulceration of vocal bands. Tubercrlar laryngitis, especially when ulceration commences. Stomach, —- Dyspepsia due to farinaceous and fermentahle food. Excessive hunger. Aversion to bread, etc, Desire for sweet things. Food tastes sour. Sour eructations, Great weakness of digestion. Bulimia, with much bloating. After eating, pressure in stomach, with bitter taste in mouth. Eating ever so little creates fullness. Cannot eat oysters, Rolling of flatulence. [Chin.; Carb.) Wakes at night feeling hungry. Hiccough. [Suiph. ac.; Hyos.] Incomplete burning eructations rise only to pharynx, there burn for hours, Likes to take food and drink hot, Abdomen. — Immediately afer 2 light meal, abdomen is bloated, full. Constant sense of fermentation in abdomen, like yeast working; upper left side. Hernia, ide. Liver sensitive. Brown spots on abdomen. Dropsy, due to hepatic disease. Hepatitis, atrophic form of nutmeg liver. Pain shooting across lower abdomen from right to left.

Stool. — Diarrhoea. Inactive intestinal canal. Ineffectual urging. Stool Aerd, dificult, small, incomplete, Haemorrhoids; very painful to touch, aching. [Mur. ac.J Urine, — Pain in back before urinating; ceases after fiow; slow in coming, must strain. Retention. Polyuria during the night. Heavy red sedimcnt, Child cries before urinating. [Bor,]

Male. — No erectile power; impotence. Premature emission, [Calad.; Sct; Acn.) Enlarged, prostate. Condytomata. ‘ Female. — Menses too late; last too long. Vagina dry. Coition painful. [Ary. #.; Berb.; Kreos.j Right ovarian pain. Varicose veins of pudenda. Leucorrhoea, with burning in vagina. Discharge of blood from genitals during stool. Respiratory, — Tickling cough. Dyspnoea. Tensive, constrictive, burning pain in chest. Cough worse going down hill, Cough deep, hollow. Expectorations gray, purulent, salty. [Ars.;°Phos.; Puls.) Night cough, tickling as from Sulphur fumes. Catarrh of the chest in infants, seems full of mucus rattling. Neglected pneumonia, Left-sided pneumonia.

Heart. — Aneurism. [Baryte carb.) Aortic disease. Palpitation at night. Cannot lie on left side.

Back. — Burning between ecapulz. Pain in small of back.

Extremities. — Tearing in shoulder and elbow joints. One foot hot, the other cold. Chronic gout, with chalky deposits in joints. Profuse sweat of the feet. Pain in heel on treading as from a pebble. [ep.} Toes and fingers contracted. Sciatica, worse right side. Cannot lie on painful side. Hands and feet numb. Right foot hot, left cold. Cramps in calves and toes at night in bed. Fever, — Chill between 3 and 4 pv. m., followed by sweat. Icy coldness. Sweat from least exertion. {Cate.; Stt.; Hep.]

Sleep. — Drowsy during day. Starting im sleep. Dreams of accidents.

Skin. — Ulcerates. Abscesses beneath skin; worse warm applications. Hives; worse, warmth. Violent itching; Fissured eruptions. dene, Chronic eczema associated with. uginary, gastric and hepatic disorders; bleeds easily. Skin hecomes thick and indurated. Varicose veins, nevi, erectric tumors. Brown spots, frecklés worse on left side of face and nose. Dry, shrunken, especially palms; hair becomes prematurely gray. Dropsies, Offensive secretions; viscid and offensive perspiration, Psoriasis.

Modalities. — Worse, right side, from right to left, from above downward, 4 to 8 e.m. Warm applications, lying on left side, heat, hot air, hot bed, Better, by Motion, after midnight, from warm food and drink, on getting cold, from being uncovered; heat of bed.

Relationship. — Complementary: Lycop. acts with special benefit after Calcar, and Sulphur. Iod.; Graphites; Lach.; Chelidon. Antidotes: Camph.; Pubs; Const, Compare: Alumina, (Lyctop. is the only vegetable that takes up aluminum. F, K. Allen.) Ant. ¢.; Nat. m.; Bry.; Nux; Bothrops (day-blindness; can scarcely ‘see after sunrise; pain in right great toe). FHydrast. follows Lycop. in indigestion.

Dose. — Both the lower and the highest potencies“ are credited with excelicnt results. For purposes of aiding elimination the second and third attenuation of the Tincture, a few drops, 3 times a day, have proved efficacious, otherwise the 6th to 200th potency, and higher, in not too frequent doses,

remedies.name: Lycopus Virginicus
remedies.text:
(Bugle-weed) Lowers the blood pressure, reduces the rate of the heart ands increases the length of systole to a great degree, (Hinadale.} A heart remedy, and of use in exophthalmic goitre and haemorrhoidal bleeding. Indicated in diseases with tumultuous action of the heart and more or less pain, Haemoptysis due to valvular heart disease, Head. — Frontal headache; worse, frontal eminences; often succeeded by labored heart. Nosebleed. Eyes, —- Protrusion, pressing, outward, with tumultuous action of heart. Supraorbital pain, with aching in testicles. Mouth, — Toothache in lower molars. Heart, — Precordial pain; constriction, tenderness, pulse, weak, irregular, intermittent, tremulous, rapid. Cyanosis. Heart's action tumultuous and forcible. Palpitation from nervous irritation, with oppression around heart, Rheumatoid, flying pains, associated with heart disease..

Respiratory. — Wheezing,. Cough, with hemoptysis.

Urine. — Profuse flow of limpid, watery urine, ¢specially when the heart is most irritable; also scanty urine. Bladder feels distended when empty. Diabetes. Pain in testicles.

Rectum. — Bleeding from rectum. Haemorrhoids.

Relationship. — Compare: Ephedra — Teamster's Tea — (in exophthalmic goitre; eyes feel pushed out with tumuliuous action of heart); Fucus; Spartein; Cratargus, Dose. — First to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Magnesia Carbonica
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Magnesia) Gastro-intestinal catarrh, with marked acidity, Often used with advantage for complaints arising in people who have been taking this drug to sweeten th® stomach. Is frequently indicated in children; whole body smells sour, and disposed to boils. Broken-down women, with uterine and climacteric disosders. With numbness and distention in various parts and nerve prostration, Sensitive to the least start, noise, touch, etc. Affections of the antrum of Highmore. Effects of shock, blows, mental distress. Sense of numbness; nerve prostration; tendency to constipation after nervous strain; sensitive to least touch or from excess of care and worry with constipation and heaviness. Intense neuralgic pains. Head. ~~ Sticking pain in the side of the head on which he lies, as if the hair was pulled; worse, menta! exertion, Itching of scalp worse in damp weather. Pain above margin of right orbit. Black motes before eyes.

Ears. — Diminished hearing. Deafness; comes auddenly and varies. Numbness of outer car. Feeling of distention of middle ear, Subdued tinnitus.

Face. — Tearing pain in ene side; worse, quiet; must ¢ about. Toothache, ‘especially during pregnancy; Worse at night: worse, cold and quiet. Teeth feel too long. Ailments from cutting wisdom teeth. [Cheiranthus.) Pain in malar bone, worse during rest, night. Swelling of malar bone with pulsating pain, worse exposure to cold wind.

Mouth. — Dry at night. Sour taste. Vesicular eruption; bloody saliva. Sticking pain in throat; hawking up fetid, pea-colored particles, Stomach, — Desire for fruit, acids, and vegetables. Eructations sour, and vomiting of bitter water. Craying for meat. Abdomen. —Rumbling, gurgling. Dragging towards pelvis. Very heavy; contractive, pinching pain in right iliac region. Stool, — Preceded by griping, colicy pain. Green, watery, frothy, like a frog-pond's scum. Bloody mucous stools. Milk passes undigzsted in nursing children, Sour, with tenesmus, (Ricum.] Constipation after mental shock or severe nervous strain.

Female. — Sore throat before menses appear. Before menses, coryza and nasal stoppage. Menses too fate and scanty, thick, dark, like pitch; mucous leucorrhoea. Menses flow only in sleep; more profuse at night (4m, m.], or when lying down; cease when walking.

Respiratory. — Tickling cough, with salty, bloody ex~ pectoration, Constrictive pains in chest, with dyspnoea. Soreness in chest during motion, Extremities. — Tearing in shoulders as if dislocated, Right shoulder painful, cannot raise it. [Seng.] Whole body feels tired and painful, especially legs and feet. Swelling in bend of knee

Skin. — Earthy, sallow and parchment-like; emaciation. Itching vesicles on hands and fingers. Nodosities under skin. Sore; sensitive to; cold.

Fever. — Chilly in evening. Fever at night. Sour, greasy perspiration, Sleep. — Unrefreshing; more tired on rising than on retiring.

Modalities. — I’orse, warmth of bed; change of temperature; every three weeks; rest. Better, warm air; walking in open air.

Relationship. — Antidotes: rs.; Merc. Complementary: Chem. Compare: Rheum; Kreos.; Alocs; Cheiranthus ~ Wall flower —- (deafness, ctorrheea, nose stopped up at night from irritation of cutting wisdom-teeth.) Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Magnesia Muriatica
remedies.text:
(Muriate of Magnesia) A liver remedy with pronounced characteristic constipation. Chronic liver affections with tenderness ard pain, extending to spine and epigastrium, worse after food. Especially adapted to diseases of women, with a long history of indigestion and uterine disease; children who cannot digest milk. Evil effects of sea bathing. Head, — Sensitive to noise; bursting headache; worse, motion, open air; better, pressure, and wrapping up warmly. [Stl.; Stront.] Much sweating of head. {Cale.; Sil] Nose, ~ Nostrils ulcerated. Coryza. Nose stopped and fluent. Loss of smell and taste, following catarth. Cannot hie down, Must breathe through mouth, Mouth.— Blisters on lips. Gums swollen, bleed easily. Tongue feels buat and scalded. Throat dry, with hoarseness, Stomach.— Appetite poor, bad taste in mouth. Eructations like rotten eggs. Continued rising of white froth into mouth, Cannot digest mifk. Urine can be passed only by pressing abdominal muscles. Abdomen, — Pressing pain in liver; worse lying on right side. Liver enlarged with bloating of abdomen; yellow tongue. Congenital scrotal hernia. Must use abdominal muscles to enalle him to urinate. Urinary.—- Urine difficult to void. Bladder can only be emptied by straining and pressure.

Bowels. — Constipation of infants during dentition; only passing small quantity; stools knotty, like sheep's dung, crumbling at verge of anus. Painful smarting haemorrhoids, Female. — Menses black, clotted. Pain in back and thighs. Metrorrhagia; worse at night. Great excitement at every period. Leucorrhoea with every stoo! and after exercise. Tinea ciliaris, eruptions in face and forehead worse before menses.

Heart. — Palpitation and cardiac pain while sitting; better by moving about, {Gefs.]

Respiratory. — Spasmodic dry cough; worse forepart of night, with burning and sore chest.

Extremities. — Pain in back and hips; in arms and legs. Arms “go to sleep” when waking in morning.

Sleep. — Sleep during day; restless at night on account of heat and shock; anxious dreams.

Modalities. — Worse, immediately after eating, lying on right side; from sea bathing. Better, from pressure, motion; open air, except headache.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Camph.; Cham, Compare: Nat. m.; Puls; Sep.; Amm. m.: Nasturtiums aquaticum (cirrhosis of liver and dropsy).

Dose. — Third to 20th potency,

remedies.name: Magnesia Phosphorica
remedies.text:
(Phosphate of Magnesia) The great anti-spasmodic remedy. Cramping of muscles with radiating pains, Neuralgic pains relieved by warmth, Especially suited to tired, languid, exhausted subjects. Indisposition for mental exertion. Goitre. Mind. ~~ Laments all the time about the pain. Inability to think clearly. Sleepless on account of indigestion.

Head. — Vertigo on moving, falls forward on closing eyes, better walking in open air. Aches after mental labor, with chilliness; always better warmth. [Si.] Sensation as if contents were liquid, as if parts of brain were changing places, as of a cap on head.

Eyes. — Supracrbitai pains; worse, right side; relieved by warmth applied externally. Increased lachrymation. Twitching of lids. Nystagmus, strabismus, ptosis, Eyes hot, tired, vision blurred, colored lights before eyes. ‘ Ears.— Severe neuralgic pain; worse behind right ear; worse, by going into cold air, and washing face and neck with cold water.

Mouth. — Toothache; better by heat and hot liquids. Ulceration of teeth, with swelling of glands of face, throat, and neck, ond swelling of tongue. Complaints of teething children. Spasms without febrile symptoms.

Throat. — Soreness and stiffness, especially right side; Parts seem puffy, twith chslliness, and aching all over. Stomach — Hiccough, with retching day and wight. Thirst for very cold drinks.

Abdomen. — Enteraigia, relieved by pressure. Flaiutent colic, forcing patient to bend double; relieved by mubbing, warmth, pressure; accompanied with belching of gas, which gives no relief. Bloated, full sensation in abdomen; must loosen clothing, walk about, and constantly pass flatus. Constipation in rheumatic subjects due to flatulence and indigestion, Female. — Menstrual colic. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Menses too early, dark, stringy. Swelling of external parts. Ovarian neuralgia. Vaginismus.

Respiratory. — Asthmatic oppression of chest. Dry, tickling cough. Spasmodic cough, with difficulty in lying down, JWWhooping-cough. [Corall.] Voice hoarse, larynx sore and raw. Intercostal neuralgia.

Heart. — Angina pectoris. Nervous spasmodic palpitation. Constricting pains around heart.

Fever. — Chilliness after dinner, in evening. Chills run up and dows the back, with shivering, followed by a suffocating sensation, Extremities. — Involuntary shaking of hands. Paralysis agitans. Cramps in calves. Sciatica; feet very tender. Darting pains, Twitchings. Chorea. Writers’ and players’ cramp. Tetanic spasms. Weakness in arms and hands, finger-tips stiff and numb, General muscular weakness.

Modalities. — Worse, right side, cold, touch. Better, warmth, bending doubie, pressure, friction.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali phos.; Colocy.; Silica; Zine; Diose. Antidotes: Bell,; Gels; Loch.

Dose. — First to twelfth potency. Sometimes the highest potencies are preferable. Acts especially well, given in hot water

remedies.name: Magnesia Sulphurica
remedies.text:
(Epsom Salts) The skin, #rixary, and female symptoms are most marked. The purgative action of Sulphate of Magnesia is not a quality of the drug, but a quality of its physical state, which renders its absorption impossible. The properties inherent in the substance itself can only be discovered by attenuation. (Percy Wilde.) Head.~— Apprehensive; vertigo; head heavy during menses. Eyes burn, noises in ears. Stomach, — Frequent eructations, tasting like bad eggs. Rising of water in mouth, Urinary. — Stitches and burning in the orifice of the urethra after urinating. Stream intermits and dribbles. The urine passed in the morning copious, bright yellow, soon hecomes turbid, and deposits a copious red sediment, The urine is greenish as passed; is of a clear color, and in a large quantity. Diabetes. {Phos. ac.; Laci. ac.; cirs, brom.) Female. — Thick leucorrhera, as profuse as the menses, with weary pain in the small of the back and thighs, on moving about. Some blood fram the vagina between the menses. Menstruation returned after fourteen days; the discharge was thick, black, and profuse. Menses too early, intermit. Neck and Back.—Bruised and ulcerative pain bee tween the shoulders, with a feeling as of a lump as large as the fist, on which account she cotld not lie upon her back or side; relieved by rubbing. Violent pain in the small of the hack, as if bruised, and as before menstruation.

Extremities. — The left arm and foot fall asleep in bed, in the morning after waking. Skin. --- Small pimples over the whole body, that itch violently, Suppressed itch. [Suiph.] Crawling in the tips of the fingers of the Jeft hand; better on rubbing. Warts, Erysipelas {applied locally as a saturated solution).

Fever. — Chill from 9 to 10 a. mM. Shuddering in back; heat in one part and chill in another.

Relationship. — Compare: Magnesia sulphitis (S-geain doses, dark-red color, “beefsteak,” tongue). Dose, — The pure salt to the third potency. Locally 1:4 in water in sep‘; conditions, erysipelas, orchitis, boils, ete.

remedies.name: Magnolia Grandiflora
remedies.text:
(Magnolia) Rheumatism and cardiac Jes‘ons are prominent features in the symptomatology of this drug. Stiffness and soreness. Alternating pains between spleen and heart. Patient tired and stiff. Soreness when quiet. Erratic shifting of pains, Heart. — Suffocated feeling when walking fast or lying on left side. Dyspnoea. Crampy pain im heart. Angina pectoris. Endocarditis and pericarditis. Tendency to faint. Sensation as if heart had stopped beating. Pain around heart accompanied by itching of the feet.

Extremities. — Stiffness and sharp erratic pains; worse in joints. Fect itch, Numbness in left arm. Rheumatic pain in clavicles. Shooting in af] timbs, Modalities. — Worse, damp air, lying on left side; in morning on first rising. Better, dry weather, motion; intermenstrual flow. [Hom.; Bovista; Bell; Elaps.]

Relationship. — Compare: Khus.; Dulcam.; Aurum.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Malandrinum
remedies.text:
(Grease in Horses) A very effectual protection against smali-pox. Iti effects of vaccination. (Thuja; Silice.} Efficacious in clearing of the remnants of cancerous deposits (Cooper). Skin, —~ Scab on upper lip, with stinging pain when torn off. Aching in forehead, Dry, scaly; itching; rhagadcs of hands and fect in cold weather and from washing. Toes feel scalded and itch terribly. Bonelike protuberances.

Dose. — Thirtieth potency and highest.

remedies.name: Mancinella
remedies.text:
(Hippomane — Manganeel Apple) Skin symptoms most marked, Dermatitis, with excessive vesiculation, oozing of sticky serum and formation of crusts. To be remembered in mental depressed States at puberty and at climacteric, with exalted sexuaiity. [Hering.) Loss of vision. Mind, — Silent mood, sadness. Wandering thoughts. Sudden vanishing of thought. Bashiul. Fear of becoming insane.

Head. — Vertigo; head feels light, empty. Scalp itches. Hair falls out after acute sickness, Nose. — Illusions of smell; of gunpowder, dung, etc. Pressure at root of nose.

Mouth. — Feels peppery. Copious, offensive sativa. Taste of blood Burning of iauces. Dysphagia from constriction of throat and oesophagus.

Stomach. — Continual choking sensation rising from stomach. Vomiting of ingesta, followed by griping and copious stools. Burning pains and black vomit.

Skin. — Intense erythema. Vesicles, Fungoid growths. Erysipelas. Lerge blisters, as from scalds. Heavy, brown crusts and scabs. Pemphigus, Relationship. — Compare: Croton; Jatropha; Canth.; Anacard., Dose. — Sixth, to thirticth potency.

remedies.name: Manganum Aceticum
remedies.text:
(Manganese Acetate) Manganum causes anaemia with destruction of the ted corpuscles. Jaundice, nephritis with albuminuria. Fatty degeneration of liver, Symptoms of chronic poisoning, according to Professor von Jaksch, were involuntary laughter and involuntary weeping and walking backwards. Strongly exaggerated reflexes and physical disturbances, evidenced by men making fun of each other’s gait. Tuflammation of bones or’ joints, with nightly digging pains. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow. Syphititic and chlorotic patients with genera! anaemia and paralytic symptoms often are benefited by this drug. Gout. Chronic arthritis, For speakers and singers, Great accumulation of mucus. Growing pains and weak ankles. General soreness and aching; early tuberculosis, Head. — Anxiety and fear; better lying down. Feels large and heavy, with rush of blood; pain from above downward. Field of vision contracted.

Mouth. — Nodes on palate. Toothache; worse, anything cold. [Cogf. opposite} Hemming all the time. {Arg. m.; Sil] Nose, — Dry, obstructed. Chronic catarrh, with bleeding, dryness; tvorse tn cold damp weather.

Ears. — Feel stopped; cracking on blowing nose, Pain from other ports extends to cars. Deafness in damp weather. Alimentary Canal—Tongue sore and irritable with ulcers or warts. Flatulence; chronic enlargement of liver.

Respiratory. — Chronic hoarseness. Larynx dry, rough, constricted. Tuberculosis of Jarynx. Cough; worse evening, and beiier lying down, Mucus difficult to loosen. Stitches in Jarynx extending to ear, Heat in chest. Hzemoptysis, Every cold rouses up a bronchitis, [Dule.]

Female. — Derangements of menstruation, amenorrlicea; menses too early and scanty, in answmic subjects. Flashes of heat at clanacteric, Extremities, — Peculiat gait, walks ou smetacarpophalangeal joint; walks backwards. Ankles painful. Bones very sensitive. Shiny red swelling of joints. Kunecs pain and itch. Rheumatism of feet. Intolerable pain in skin of lower limbs, Burning spots about joints. Feriosteal inflammation. Suppuration of skin around joints.

Sleep. — Vivid dreams, Sleepy very early in evening.

Skin. — Suppuration of skin around joints, Red, elevated spots. /iching; better, scratching. Deep cracks in bends of elbows, etc. Psoriasis and pityriasis. Burning around ulcers. Chronic eczema associated with amenorrhoea, worse at menstrual period or at menopause.

Modalities. — Worse, cold wet weather, change of weather. Better, lying down (cough). Relationship, — Compare: Colloidal Manganese (Boils and other staphylococcal infections); Maengan, mur. (painful ankles, bone-pains); Mangan. oxydaf. (pam in tibia, dysmenorrhea, colic, and diarrhoea). Workers in Mangan. binoxide are frequently affected with bulbar paralysis. Use 3x homeopathically. Mungan. sulph. (liver affections, excess of bite}; Argent.; Rhus.; Sulph, Antidotes: Coff.; Merc.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Mangifera Indica
remedies.text: (Mango Tree) One of the best general remedies for passive haemorthages, uterine, renal, gastric, pulmonary and intestinal. Rhinitis, pharyngius, and other acute throat troubles. Reijaxation ef mucous membrane of alimentary canal. Catarrhal and serous discharges, chronic intestinal irritation, Varicose veins. Relationship, — Compare: Erigeron; Epilobium, Dose, — Tincture.

remedies.name: Medorrhinum
remedies.text:
(The Gonorrheeal Virus) A powerful and deep-acting medicine, often indicated for chronic ailments due to suppressed gonorrhoea. For women with chronic pelvic disorders. Chronic rheumatism, Great disturbance and irritability of nervous system. Pains intolerable, tensive; nerves quiver and tingle. Children dwarfed and stunted. State of collapse and trembling all overs History of sycosis. Often restores a gonorrheeal discharge. Intensity of all sensations.

Mind. — Weak memory. Loses the thread of conversation. Cannot speak without weeping. Time passes too slowly. [Cannab. ind.; Arg. #.] Is in a great hurry. Hopeless of recovery. Fears going insane, (MMancinella,] Sensibility exalted. Nervous, restless. Fear in the dark and of some one behind her. Head. —- Burning pain in brain; worse, occiput, Head heavy and drawn backward. Headache from jarring of cars, exhaustion, or hard work. Weight and pressure in vertex, Hair dry, crispy. Itching of scalp; dandruff.

Eyes. — Feels as if she stared at everything. Eyeballs ache. Feels as if sticks in eyes. Lids irritated.

Ears. — Partial deafness, pulsation in ears. Quick, darting pains in right ear, Nose, — Intense itching. Coldness of tip. Posterior nares obstructed.

Face. — Pallor, acne, blotches of reddish color. Small boils break out during menses, Mouth. — Tongue coated brown and thick, blistered; canker sores. Blisters on inner surface of lips and cheeks..

Stomach. — Coppery taste and eructations of sulpheretted hydrogen. Ravenous hunger soon after eating. Very thirsty. Cravings for liquor, salt, sweets, etc., warm drinks.

Abdomen. — Violent pain in liver and spleen, Rests more comfortably lying on abdomen.

Stool. — Can pass stool only by leaning very far back, Painful tump sensation on posterior surface of sphincter. Oozing of fetid moisture. Intense itching of anus.

Urine. — Painful tenesmus when urinating, Nocturnal enuresis, Renal colic. [Berb.; Ocim.; Pareir.] Urine flows very slowly. 1 Female. — Intense pruritus, Menses offensive, profuse, dark, clotted; stains difficult to wash out, urinates frequently at that time. Sensitive spot near os uteri. Leueerheea thin, acrid, excoriating, fishy odor. Sycotic warts on genitals. Ovarian pain, worse left side, or from ovary to ovary. Sterility, Metrorrhagia. Intense menstrual colic. Breasts cold, sore, and sensitive.

Male. — Nocturnal emissions, followed by great weakmess. Impotence. Gleet; whole urethra feels sore. Urethritis, Respiratory. — Much oppression of breathing. Hoarse while reading. Pain and soreness through chest and Mmammz. Incessant, dry, night cough. Asthma. Incipient consumption. Larynx feels sore. Dyspneea; cannot exhale. [Samb.} Cough; better lying on stomach. Extremities. —- Pain in back, with burning heat. Legs heavy; ache all night; cannot keep them still, [Zinc.} Ankles easily turn when walking. Burning of hands and feet, Finger-joints enlarged, puffy. Gouty concretions. Heels and balls of feet tender, Soreness of soles. Restless; better, clutching hands.

Skin. — Yellow. Intense and incessant itching; worse night and when thinking of it. Fiery red rash about anus in babies. Copper-colored spots. Favus. Tumors and abnormal growth.

Fever. — Wants to be fanned all the time, Chills up and down back; coldness of legs, hands, and forearms. Flashes of heat in face and neck. Night-sweat and hectic. Sleep. ~— Dreams she is drinking. [drs.; Phos.) Sleeps in knee-chest position, Modalities. — Worse, when thinking of ailment, from daylight to sunset, heat, inland. Better, at the seashore, lying on stomach, damp weather. [Cassi]

Relationship. — Compare: Lactation: Galega; Lactuca, Sulph.; Syphil.; Zine.

Dose. — The very highest potencies only of service. Must not be repcated often.

remedies.name: Medusa
remedies.text:
(Jelly-fish) Whole face puffed and cedematous — eyes, nose, ears, lips.

Skin. — Numbness; burning, pricking heat. Vesicular eruption, especially on face, arms, shoulders, and breasts. Nettle-rash. [Apis; Chloral.; Dule.]

Female. — Marked action on lacfeal glands. The secretion of miik was established after lack of it in all previous confinements.

Relationship. — Compare: Pyrarara; Physalia (urticaria); Urtica; Homar.; Sep.

remedies.name: Mel Cum Sale
remedies.text:
(Honey with Salt) Prolapsus uteri and chronic metritis, especially when associated with subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. The special symptom leading to its selection is a feeling of soreness across the hypogastrium from ileum to ileus. Uterine displacements, and in the commencement of metritis. Sensation as if bladder were too full. Pain from sacrum towards pubes. Pain as if in ureters.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency. Honey for itching of anus and worms.

remedies.name: Melilotus
remedies.text:
(Yellow Meliiot — Sweet Clover) Congestions and haemorrhages seem tn be the special manifestations of this drug. Violent congestive and nervous headaches. Infantile spasms. Epilepsy from blow on head. Pain and debdifity point to it. Coldness, tenderness, and pain.

Mind. — Unahie to fix mind. Memory treacherous. Stupor, Wants to run away and hide, Delusions; thinks every one is loohing at her, fears to talk Joud, and wants to run away, ete.

Head. — Headache with retching, vomiting, sense of pressure over orbits, pallor, cold hands and feet, black spots before eyes. Heavy, oppressed; frontal, throbbing, undulating sensation in brain, Sick headache; relieved by epistaxis or menstrual flow. Fullness all over head. Eyes heavy; blurred sight; wants to close them tightly for relief. Netralgia around and over right side of head and neck. Scalp sore and tender to touch, Nose. —Siopped up, dry, must breathe through mouth; dry, hard clinkers in nose; frofuse epistaxis.

Face. — Intensely red and flushed, with throbbing carotids. [Sell.]

Stool. — Difficult, painful, constipated. Anus feels constricted, full, farvabs. No desire until there is a large agcumulation, [Bry.; Alem. Female, — Menses scanty, infermit, with nausea and bearing-down. Sticking pain in external parts. Dysmenorrhaa. Ovarian neuralgia.

Respiratory. — Feels as if smothering, especially from rapid walking. Hemoptysis. Weight on chest. Tickling in throat with cough. Extremities. ~ Pain in knee; wants to stretch leg, but does not relieve. Joints sore. Skin and extremities cold. Numbness and aching in knee-joints, Modalities. — Worse, rainy, changeable weather, ap- Proach of storm, motion; 4 P. m.

Relationship. — Compare: Afelilotus alba (White Clover — practically the same action. (Haemorrhages, congestive headaches, engorged blood vessels, spasms.) Amyl; Bell; Glon.

Dose. — Tincture, for inhaling; lower potencies.

remedies.name: Menispermum
remedies.text:
(Moonseed) A remedy for megrim, associated with restlessness and dreams. Pain in spine. Dryness, itching all over. Dry mouth and throat. Head, — Pressure from within outivard, with stretching and yawning and pain down back. Sick headache; pain in forehead and temples, moving to occiput. Tongue swollen and much saliva.

Extremities. — Pain in back, thighs, elbows, shoulders. Legs sore, as if bruised. * Relationship. — Compare: Cocculus; Bryon.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Mentha Piperita
remedies.text:
(Peppermint) Marked action on respiratory organs and skin.

Abdomen. — Bloated, disturbing sleep. Infantile colic. Biltous colic with great accumulation of gas.

Respiratory. — Voice husky. Tip of nose sore to touch. Throat dry and sore, as if pin crosswise in it. Dry cough, worse from air inte larynx, tobacco smoke (Mere.), talking; with irritation in suprasternal fossa (Rumex] Trachea patnful te touch, Skin. — Every scratch becomes a sore. Itching of arm and hand when writing. Vaginal pruritus. Herpes zoster, [Ars.; Raw, bulb.) Relationship, — Compare: RFumex: Laches.; Mentha pulegium (pain in bones of forehead and extremities).

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. Locally, in pruritus vagine. MENTHOL The stearopten from the essential oi] of Mentha. Mucous membrane of naso-pharynx and spinal nerve plexus, producing neuritic pains and parathesias. Menthol has proved curative in acute nasal catarrh;, in acute eustachian catarrh; pharyngitis; laryngitis; neuralgias, etc. (Wm. B. Griggs, M.D.) Itching, especially pruritus vulyz, Head. -—— Frontal headache. pain over frontal sinus, descends to eyeballs. Mental confusion, Supra orbital pain over left cye. Pain in face above zygoma with numbness. Pain in eyeballs. Coryza with post-nasal dripping. Cold sensation in nose. Eustachian tuhes feel Nlocked and some deafness.

Respiratory. — Tickling in the fauces. Stabbing pains im the precordia, radiating over entire chest. Short, dry cough, worse smoking. Asthmatic breathing, with congestive headache Extremities. — Muscular pain in cervical region. Soreness of lumbar muscles.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali bich.; Spigel. Dose, — Sixth potency. Externally for itching, use 1 per cent. solution or ointment.

remedies.name: Menyanthes
remedies.text:
(Buck-bean) A remedy for certain headaches, intermittent fever. Coldness of abdomen. Twitchings. Sensation of tension and compression. Fidgets and urinary difficulties in women. Head. —Pressing in vertex; better, hard pressure with hand. Pressing-together pain. Weight pressing on brain with every step on ascending. Pain from nape over whole brain; better, stooping, sitting; worse, going upstairs, Cracking in jaw and twitching of facial muscles. Stomach.—No thirst at any time. Ravenous hunger; passing away after eating a little. Desire for meat. Sensation of coldness extending up to esophagus.
