Abdomen. — Distended and full; increased by smoking tobacco. Coldness of abdomen.

Extremities. — Icy coldness of hands and feet, Cramplike pain. As soon as patient lies down, legs jerk and twiteh, Fever. — Cofdness predominates; felt most acutely in abdomen and legs and tip of nose.

Modalities. — Worse, during rest, ascending. Better, pressure on affected part, stooping, motion, Relationship. — Compare: Caps.; Puls.; Cale.; Phos. ac.; Sang. Antidote: Camph, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Mephitis
remedies.text:
(Skunk) A great medicine for zehooping-cough, In order to” insure its full success, it should be given in the lower dilutions from 1x to 3x. Suffocative feeling, asthmatic paroxysms, spasmodic cough; cough so violent, seems as if each spell would terminate fe. Child must be raised up, gets hiue in face, cannot exhale. Mucus rales through upper part of chest. Patient wants to bathe in ice-cold water., Mind. — Excited, full of fancies. Can neither sleep nor work.

Eyes. — Pain from overexertion; blur; unable to distinguish letters; conjunctiva red; eyes hot and painful.

Mouth. — Painful jerks in root nf teeth. Bloated face. Coppery taste, as after eating onions.

Respiratory. — Sudden contraction of glottis, when drinking or talking. Food goes down wrong way. False croup; cannot exhale. Spasmodic ond whoopingcough, Few paroxrysms in day-time, but many at night; with vomiting after eating, Asthma, as if inhaling sulphur; cough from talking; hollow, deep, with rawness, hoarseness, and pains through chest. Violent spasmodic cough; worse at night.

Sleep. — Awakes at night with rush of blood to lower legs. Vivid dream of water, fire, ete. Relationship, —- Compare: Dros.; Coral.; Sticta.

Dose. — First to third potency. Has a very short action,

remedies.name: Mercurialis Perennis
remedies.text:
(Dog's Mercury) Great exhaustion and drowsiness. Tumor at ensiform appendix, very sensitive, Affections of the muscular fibres of stomach, intestines, bladder.

Head. — Vertigo un going down stairs. Head coniused. Pain as from a band tightly across forehead. Nostrils sore, conscious of mose, feels as if she had two noses.

Mouth. — Great dryness of mouth and throat; tongue feels heavy and dry, numb, Burning blisters of tongue, lips and cheeks. Ulcers on paiate, tonsils and. back of pharynx. Female, — Amenorrhea, scanty menses, accompanied with orgasms. Pains and swelling of breasts. Dysmenorrhaca, Relationship. — Compare: Boras; Croton; Euphorb.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Mercurius
remedies.text:
(Quicksilver) Every organ and tissue of the body is more or less affected by this powerful drug; but especially so the lymphatic system, with all the membranes and glands, and internal organs, bones, etc. Tremors everywhere. Weakness with ebullitions and tremblings from Jeast exertion, All Mercury symptoms are worse at night, from warmth of bed, from damp, cold, rainy weather, worse during perspiration. Complaints increase with the sweat and rest; all associated with a great deal of weariness, prostration, and trembling. Sensitive to heat and cold. Parts are much swollen, with raw, sore feeling; the profuse, oily perspiration does not relieve. Breath, excretions and body smell foul. Tendency to formation of pus. A human “thermometer.” Mind.-~Slow in answering questions. Memory weakened, and loss of will-power. Weary of life, Mistrustful, Thinks he ts losing his reason. Head, — Vertigo, when tying on back. Band-feeling about head. One-sided, tearing pains. Tension about scalp, as if bandaged. Catarrhal headaches; much heat in head. Stinging, burning, fetid eruptions on scalp. Loss of hair. Exostosis, with feeling of soreness. Scalp tense; oily sweat on head.

Eyes. — Lids red, thick, swollen. Profuse, burning, acrid discharge. Floating black spots. After exposure to glare of fire; foundrymen. Parenchymatous keratitis of syphilitic origin with burning pain, Iritis, with hypopyon, Ears. —- Thick, yellow discharge; fetid and bloody. Otalyia, worse warmth of bed; at night, sticking pains. Boils in external canal. [Cole. pic.} Nose. — Much sneezing. Sneezing in sunshine, Nostrils raw, ulcerated; nasal bones swollen. Yellowgreen, ietid, pus-like discharge. Coryza; acrid discharge, but too thick to run down the lip; worse, warm room. Pain and swelting of nasal bones, and caries, with greenish fetid ulceration, Nosebleed at night. Copious discharge of corroding mucus. Coryza, with Sneezing; sore, row, smarting sensation; worse, damp weather; profuse, fluent, Face. — Pale, earthy, dirty-looking, puffy. Syphilitic pustules on face.

Mouth. — Sweetish taste. Salivary secretions greatly increased; bioedy and viscid. Saliva fetid, coppery. Speech difficult on account of trembling tongue. Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily. Whole mouth moist. Crown of teeth decay. Teeth loose, feel tender and elongated. Furrow in upper surface of tongue lengthwise. Tongue heavy, thick; moist coating; yellow, flabby, iccth-indenied; feels as if burnt, with ulcers. Fetid odor from mouth; can smell it all over room, Alveolar abscess, worse at night, Great thirst, with moist mouth, Throat. Bluish-red swelling. Constant desire to swallow. Putrid sore throat; worse right side. Ulcers and inflammation appearing at every change in weather, Stitches into ear on swallowing; fluids return through nose. Quinsy, with difficult swallowing, afier pus has formed, Sore, raw, smarting, burning throat. Complete loss of voice. Burning in throat, as from hot vapor ascending.

Stomach. — Putrid eructations. Intense thirst for cold drinks. Weak digestion, with continuous hunger. Stomach sensitive to touch. Hiccough and regurgitation. Feels replete and constricted.

Abdomen. — Stabbing pain, with chilliness. Boring pain in right groin. Flatulent distention, with pain. Liver enlarged; sore to touch, indurated. Jaundice. Bile scecreted deficiently. Stool.—Greenish, bloody and slimy, worse at night; with pain and tenesmus. Never-get-done feeling, Dis~ charge accompanied by chilliness, sick stomach, cutting colic, and tenesmus. Whitish-gray stools.

Urine. — Frequent urging. Greenish discharge from urethra; burning in arethra on beginning to urinate. Urine dark, scanty, bloody, albuminous.

Male. — Vesicles and ulcers; soft chancre. Cold genitals. Prepuce irritated; itches. Nocturnal emissions, stained with blood, Female.— Menses profuse, with abdominal pains. Leucorrhoea excoriating, greenish and bloody; sensation of rawness in parts. Stinging poin in ovaries [.4pis.) Itching and burning; worse, after urinating; better, washing with cold water. Morning sickness, with profuse salivation. Mammez painful and full of milk at menses.

Respiratory. — Soreness from fauces to sternum. Cunnot lie on right side. [Left side, Lycop.] Cough, with yellow muco-purulent expectoration, Paroxysms of two; worse, night, and from warmth of bed. Catarrh, with chilliness; dread of air. Stitches from lower lobe of right lung to back. Whooping-cough with nosebleed. [Arnica.] Cough worse, tobacco smoke.

Back. — Bruised pain in small of back, especially when sitting. Tearing pain in coccyx; better, pressing on abdomen.

Extremities. — Weakness of limbs. Bone-pains and in limbs; worse, night. Patient very sensitive to cold. Oily perspiration. Trembling extremities, especially hands; paralysis agitans. Lacerating pain in joints. Cotd, clammy sweat on legs at night. Dropsica! swelling of feet and legs.

Skin. — Almost constantly moist. Excessive odorous viscid perspiration; worse, night. General tendency to free perspiration, but patient is not relieved thereby. Vesicular and pustular eruptions. Ulcers, irregular in shape, edges undefined. Pimples around the main eruption. Itching; worse from warmth of bed. Crusta lactea; yellowish-brown crusts, considerable suppuration. Glands swell cvery time patient takes cold. Buboes. Orchitis. [Clemai.; Hamem.; Puls.]

Fever. — Generally gastric or bilious, with profuse nightly perspivatiou; debility, slow and lingering. Heat and shuddering alternately. Yellow perspiration. Profuse perspiration without relief. Creeping chillincss; worse in the eveniug and into night. Alternate flashes of heat in singfe parts.

Modalities. — Worse, at night, wet, damp weather, lying on right side, perspiring; warm room and warm bed. Relationship.-—- Compare: Capparis coriaccra (polyuria, glandular affections, mucous diarrhoca; influenza); Epilobium — Willow herb —- (chronic diarrhoea with tenesmus and mucus discharges; ptyalism, dysphagia); Kali hyd. (in hard chancre); Mercur. acet. (Conges-~ tion with stiffness, dryness and heat of parts affected. Eyes inflamed, burn and itch. Lack of moisture, Throat dry, talking difficult. Pressure in lower sternum). Mercurius nitrosus — Nitrate of Mercury — (especially in pustular conjunctivitis and keratitis; gonorrhcea and mucous patches, with sticking pains; syphilides); Mercurius auratus (psoriasis and syphilitic catarrh); Mercurius bromatus (secondary syphilitic skin affection); Mercurius phusphoricus (nervous diseases irom syphilis; exostoses); Mercurius precipitatus suber (suffocative attacks at night on lying down while on the point of falling asleep, obliged to jump up suddenly, which relieves; gonorrhoea; urethra felt as a hard string; chancreid; phagedanic ulcer and bubo; pemphigus, mucous patches, eczema with rhagades and fissures, barber’s itch; blepharitis, internally and externally; teaden heaviness in occiput, with ootorrhoea); Mercwrius tonnicus (syphilides in patients with gastrointestinal diseases, or, if very sensitive, to ordinary mer~- curial preparations); Erythrinus — South American Red Mullet Fish— (in pityriasis rubra and syphilis; red rash on chest; pityriasis); Lolium temuelentum (in trembling of hands and legs); Mercur. cum kalt (inveterate colds, acute facial paralysis). Compare: Mez.; Phos.; Syph.; Kali mur. Different Mercurial Salts; Zthiops. Antidote: Hep.; Aur.; Mez. Complementary: Badiaga.

Dose. — Second to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Mercurius Sulphuricus
remedies.commonName: Turpethum Minerale — Yellow Sulphate of Mercury
remedies.text: (Turpethum Minerale — Yellow Sulphate of Mercury) ‘Diarrhoea early in the morning; the stool bursts out in a hot stream of yellow matter. Intense evacuations, like rice-water. Scanty, clear, scalding urine. Intense dyspnoea; must sit up. Respiration rapid, short; burning in chest. Hydrothorax. [Ars.} Relationship. — Compare: Mercur. acet. (cutting in urethra when last drop is flowing out).

remedies.name: Mercurius Cyanatus
remedies.text:
(Cyanide of Mercury) Acute infections, pneumonia, nephritis. Its action is similar to that of the toxines of infectious diseases, Great and rapid prostration, tendency toward haemorrhages, from the different orifices, of dark fluid blood, cyanosis, rapid respiration and heart action, albuminuria and twitching and jerking of muscles. Typhoid pneumonia. Livid states from great struggling, where suffocation y imminent and paralysis of lung threatening; great sweat, Affects most prominently the buccal cavity. This, together with marked prostration, gives it a place in the treatment of diphtheria, where it has achieved unquestioned great results. Malignant types, with prostration. Coldness and nausea, Syphilitic ulcers when perforation threatens. Head—Great excitement, fits of passion; fury; talkativeness. Atrocious headache. Eyes sunken; face pale.

Mouth. — Covered with ulcerations. Tongue pale. Free salivation. Fetor of breath. Pain and swelling of salivary glands, Astringent taste. Ulcerations of mouth have a gray membrane.

Throat. — Feels raw and sore. Mucous membranes broken down, ulcerated. Looks raw in spots, especially in public speakers. Hoarseness, and talking is painful. Necrotic destruction af soft parts of palate and fauces. Intense redness of fauces. Swallowing very difficult, Dark blood from nose. Diphtheria of the larynx and nose. [Kali bich.] Stomach, — Nausea, vomiting, bilious, bloody; hiccough; abdomen painful, tender to pressure. Rectum, — Intolerable pain. Redness around anus. Frequent haemorrhage; stools with tenesmus. Discharge of fetid liquid with gangrenous odor. Black stools. ’ Urinary. — Suppression of urine. Amber color, painful. Nephritis with great debility and chilliness, albuminous, scanty.

Skin. — Moisture, with icy coldness.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency. Aggravation is apt to occur from potencies below the sixth,

remedies.name: Mercurius Dulcis
remedies.text:
(Calomel) Has marked effect on catarrhal inflammation of ear, and useful in Eustachian catarrh, deafness. Diarrhcea, with soreness of anus. Prostatitis. Remittent hilious attacks. Pallor, flabby bloaicdness, and turgid flaccidity. Inflammation with plastic exudate. Especially indicated in systems disposed to remittent bilious fevers; in peritonitis and meningitis with plastic cxudate, Ears. — Otitis media; closure of Eustachian tube, ear troubles of scrofulous ‘children; membrana tympani retracted, thickened and immovable, Mouth. — Offensive breath; salivation; sore gums. Ulcers. Tengue black. Constant flow of dark, putrid saliva; very offensive. Ulceration of throat, with dysphagia. Granular pharyngitis. Stomach. —- Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting of infants. [Cup. ars.; Iris] Stool.—Scanty, bloody mucus, with bile, and constant desire, without tenesmus. Dark-green, watery, with griping. aus sore and burning. Dysentery; small stools of mucus and blood, covered with bile, Skin. — Flabby and ill nourished. Swollen glands. Phargedenic ulcers. Copper-colored eruptions.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali mur.

Dose. — Third to sixth trituration. For palliative (non-homeropathic) purposes, to secvre evacuation of bowels, two or three-grain deses of first decimal trituration, repeated several times every hour.

remedies.name: Mercurius Iodatus Flavus
remedies.text:
(Proto-iodide of Mercury) Throat affections, with greatly swollen glands and ipllaracteristic coating of tongue. Worse, right side..Chancre; induration remains long time. Swollen inguinal glands, large and hard. Mamonary tumors. with tendency to much warm perspiration and gastric disturbances, Tongue. — Coated thickiy; yellow at the base. Tip and edges may be red and take imprint of teeth, Throat. — Lacunar tonsitiitis. When only the superficial part of the tonsit is involved. Cheesy exudates with offensive breath. Swelling begins on right side. Simatl ulcers on posterior pharynx. Easily detached patches on inflamed pharynx and fauces; wvorse, on right tonsil; much tenacious mucus. Sensation of a lump. Constant inclination fo swatloee.

Relationship. — Compare: Plum. tod. (in mammary tumors).

Dose. — Second trituration,

remedies.name: Mercurius Iodatus Ruber
remedies.text:
(Bin-iodide of Mercury) Diphtheria and ulcerated sore throats, especially on left side, with much glandular swelling. Chronic suppurating buboes. Hard chancres. Old cases of syphilis in scrofulous patients. Early stages of cold, especially in children, Throat.— Fauces dork red; swallowing painful. Phlegm in nose and throat. Disposition to hawk, with sensation of a lump in throat. Stiffness of muscles of throat and neck, Nose. —Coryza and dull hearing; right side of nose hot. Hawks mucus from posterior nares, Turbinated bones swollen. Boggy mucous membrane of nose and throat; closure of Eustachian tube, opening with a pop. Mouth, — Gums swollen; toothache; glands swollen. Scalded feeling on tongue. Aphthe. Profuse saliva. Tongue feels stiff at base, and pains on moving.

Throat. — Diphtheria; submaxillary glands painfully engorged, fauces dark red; worse on Jeft tonsil. Parenchymatous tonsillitis. Will often abort peritonsillitis if given frequently. Cough from elongated uvula, with sore throat, Laryngeal troubles with abhonia.

Skin. — Small fissures and cracks; hard papules; Hunterian chancre; syphilitic ulcers. Bubo. Sarcocele.

Dose. — Third trituration. Mercuric iodide is far more active as a hactericide than the other mercurials, including the chloride.

remedies.name: Mercurius Corrosivus
remedies.text:
(Corrosive Sublimate) This salt leads all other remedies in tenesmus of the rectum, which is incessant, and is not relieved by the stool, The tenesmus often involves the bladder as well. Bright’s disease. Gonorrhcea; second stage, with continuous tenesmus. Destroys the secreting portions of the kidneys, This process is slow, but sure. Albuminuria in early pregnancy. (Phosph, later and at full term.) Head-—Delirium, stupor. Frontal pain, congestion of head, with burning in cheeks. Drawing pain in periostenm of skull.

Eyes. — Pain behind eyebal!s, as if forced out. Phlyctenule; deep ulcers on cornea. Excessive photophobia and acrid lachrymation. Iritis. Pain severe at night; burning, shooting, tearing. Little tendency to pus formation. Jris muddy in color, thick, and nether contracts nor dilates, Retinitis albuminuric, ophthalmia neonatorum. Lids adematous, red, excoriated. Severe burning. Soreness of the eyes.

Nose. — Excessive coryza, Ozena, with perforation of septum nasi. (Kali dich.) Rawness and smarting igpostrils. Post-nasal swelling, mucous membrane dry, jwed, and covered with bloody mucus. Ears, — Violent pulsations. Fetid pus.

Face. — Swollen. Red, puffy. Lips black, swollen. Sordes. Faciai neuralgia within the bones, Mouth, — Teeth loose. Gums purple, swotlen, and spongy. Tongue swollen and inflamed. Salivation. Pyorrheea. Ptyalism. Taste salty and bitter.

Throat. — Red, swollen, painful, intensely inflamed. Uvula swollen. Swallowing painful. Most pain is pestnasal with sharp pains to cars. Burning pain, with great swelling; worse, slight external pressure, All glands about thorax swollen. Stomach, — Incessant, green, bilious vomiting. Epigastrium very sensitive, Abdomen. — Bruised seusation: cxcal region and transverse colon painful. Bloated: very painful to least torch.

Stool. — Dysentery; tcnessmus, not relieved by stool; incessant. Stoo] het, bluody, slimy, offensive, with cutting pains and shreds of mucous membrane.

Respiratory. — Pain in larynx as cut with knife. Aphonia. Cough, with bloody expectoration. Pulse rapid and intermittent. Stitches through side of chest.

Urine. — Intense burning in urethra. Urine hot, burning, scanty or suppressed; bloody, greenish discharge. Albuminous. [Helon.; Tereb.; Uran. s.; Ammon, benz.; Ars.) Tenesmus of bladder. Stabbing pain extending up urethra into bladder. Perspiration after urinating.

Male. — Penis and testes enormously swollen. Chancres assume phagedznic appearance. Gonorrhoea; urethral orifice red, swollen; glans sore and hot. Discharge greenish, thick. Fever, — Chilly from slightest exposure. Profuse perspiration; surfaces cold.

Modalities. — Worse, evening, night, acids. Better, while at rest. Relationship. -—- Compare: Ars.; Lach.; Leonurus— Motherwort (Influences pelvic organs, allays spasm and nervous irritability, promotes secretion and reduces febrile excitement. Valuable in suppressed menses and lochia; {dysentery; vomiting, frightful pains in abdomen, violent thirst. Tongue dry and cracked). Antidote: Calcium sulphide is antidotal to Bichloride poisoning. Use intravenous injection of 714 grains in 714 ozs. boiled water. Stlicea. Dose, — Sixth potency. In solution 1: 1000, hypodermically injected under conjunctiva in choraditis with progressive myopia. Stops immediately the severe aching pain behind eyeballs. (Dr. G. D. Hallet.)

remedies.name: Methylene Blue
remedies.text: (One of the Aniline Dyes) A remedy for neuralgia, neurasthenia, malaria; typhoid, here it diminishes the tympanites, delirium, and fever: pus infection. Tendency to tremor, chorea and epilepsy. Nephritis (acute parenchymatous), scarlatinal nephritis Urine acquires a green color. Bladder irri+ tation from its use antidoted by a little nutmeg. Dose, — 3x attenuation. A 2 per cent. solution locally, in chronic otitis with foul smefling discharge. A O01 per cent. aqueous solution for ulcers and abscesses of cornea,

remedies.name: Mezereum
remedies.text:
(Spurge Olive) Skin symptoms, affections of bones, and rteuralgias most important, especially about teeth and face. Bruised, weary feeling in joints, with drawing and stiffness. Pains of various kinds, with chilliness and senwet sitiveness to cold air, Bone pains. Eruptions after vaccination. Burning, darting sensation in the muscles; subsultus tendinum. Pains shoot upward and seem to draw patient up out of bed. Semi-lateral complaints, Patient is very sensitive to cold air, Head. — Hard work to talk. Headache; worse from talking. Stupetying headache in right side. Affections of external head; scaly eruption, white scabs. Head covered with tack, leathery crusts, under which pus collects. Violent neuralgia about face and teeth, running towards ear, at night; worse, eating; better, near hot stove, Roots of teeth decay. Teeth feel elongated.

Nose. — Sneezing, coryza, interior of nose, excoriated, Post-nasal adenoids.

Ears. — Feel too much open, as if tympanum was exposed to the cold air and at blew into the ear. Eyes.-— Ciliary acuralgio after operations, Especially after remoyal of eyeball, Pains radiate and shout downward, with cold feeling and stiffucss of bone. Face, — Red. Eruption areund mouth, with coryza, Stomach. — Desire for ham-fat. Burning in tongue, extending to stomach. Mouth waters. Nausea felt in throat; better, eating. Chronic gastritis; burning, cortoding pain; nausea, vomiting, chocolate color. Gastric ulcer with much burning. Abdomen. —- Swelling of glands with large abdomen in children. Pressure in inguinal ring. Flatulent colic, with shivering and difficult respiration, Rectum. — Constipation after confinement. Prolapse of rectum, Diarrhoea, with small, white particles, Green discharges, Constipation, with hepatic and uterine inertia. Constriction of anus; stitches and prolapse of rectum., Urine, — Red flakes float on top of urine, Hot, bloody. Biting, burning in forepart af urethra at the close of micturition. Hamaturia preceded by cramp pain in the bladder. After urinating, a few drops of blood are passed. Female,—Menses too frequent, soon, profuse. Leucorrhoea like albumen; very corroding.

Male. — Enlargement of testicles. Violent sexual desire. Gonorrhcea, with hematuria. Respiratory. -—Sorcness and burning in bones of thorax, Cunstriction across chest. Cough; worse, eating, irritation lower than can be reached, on taking a warm drink, Extremities. — Pain in neck and back; worse, motion and at night; intolerant of all touch. Pain and burning in tibia and long bones. Legs and fect go to steep, Pain in hip and knee.

Skin. — Eczema; intolerable itching; chilliness with pruritus; worse in bed. Ulcers itch and burn, surrounded by vesicles and shining. fiery-red areola. Zuna, with burning pain. Bones, especially long bones, inflamed and swollen; caries, exostosis; pain worse night, touch, damp weather. [Merc.; Syph.] Eruptions ulcerate and form thick scabs under which purulent matter exudes, Modalities. — Worse, cold air; night, evening until midnight, warm food, touch, motion. Better, open air.

Relationship. — Compare: Dirca palustris — Leather wood —a gastro-intestinal irritant inducing salivation, emesis and purgation (neuralgic pains, with depression, palpitation, and dyspnoea); Mere.: Phyt.; Rhus; Gaatec.; Syph. Antidotes: Auli hyd.; Mere, * ose. —- Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Micromeria
remedies.text:
(Yerba Buena) A California plant acting on stomach and bawels. Used as a tea to cure colic and relieve flatulence.

Stomach. — Nausea; pain in stomach and bowels; flatulence.

Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Millefolium
remedies.text:
(Yarrow) An invaluable remedy for various types of hemorthages; blood bright ced. Incarcerated heritia; smallpox, with great pain in pit of stomach. Aiter operations for stone. Bad effects from fall from a height; overlifting. Continued high temperature. Hemoptysis.

Head. — Vertigo when moving stowly. Sensation as if he had forgotten something. The head seems full of blood. Convulsions and epilepsy from suppressed menses, Piercing thrusts of pain.

Nose. — Noseblecd. [Erechi.] Piercing pain from eyes to root of nose.

Stool. — Haemorrhage from bowels. Bleeding haemorrhoids. Urine bloody. [Senec. aur.) Female. — Menses.early, profuse, protracted. Haemorrhage from uterus; bright red, fluid. Painful varices during pregnancy.

Respiratory. — Hemoptysis in incipient phthisis, Cough, with bloody expecturation, in suppressed menses or hamorroids. Violent palpitation. Relationship. Compare: Fieus venosa (Pakur). Haemorrhage from bowels and lungs. Acalypha and Helix tosta — Snail — (in hemoptysis, diseases of chest, consumption); also, Jpec.; Evecht.; Geren.; Hamam.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Mitchella
remedies.text:
(Partridge-berry) Bladder symptoms accompany complaints, especially uterine congestion.

Urinary. — Irritation at neck of bladder, with urg~ ing to urinate. [Eup. purp.; Apis.) Dysuria. Catarrh af biadder. Female,— Cervix dark red, swollen. Dysmenorrhea and uterine haemorrhage; blood bright red.

Relationship. — Compare:- Chimaph.: Senecio; Ova; Geran.; Gossyp,, Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Momordica Balsamina
remedies.text:
(Balsam Apple) Griping, colic, pain in back and hypogastrium with painful and excessive menses, Accumulation of flatus in splenic flexure of colon, Head. — Dizzy, contents of head feel lighter; mist before eyes.

Abdomen. — Rumbling, griping, colicky pains, starting from back, spreading over abdomen, Female,— Painful and profuse menses; labor-like pains, followed by gushes of blood; pain at small‘ of back coming towards front of pelvis.

Relationship. — Momordica charantia—Indian variet — More severe symptoins — intestines tull of yellow watery fluid, discharged explosively — cramps, thirst, prostration. Choleraic symptoms. Similar to Croton, Elaterium, Use 3x. Dose, — Tincture.

remedies.name: Morphinum
remedies.text:
(An Alkaloid of Opium) Morphine bears the same relation to Opium as Atro- Pine to Belladonna —i. e., represents its nervous side. It is less stimulating, Jess conyulsaut, and more decidedly hypnotic. Constipates less and affects contractility of the bladder more. It is less diaphoretic and more pruritic, Mind. — Profound depression. Irritable, fault-finding, hysterical. Shoch induced by terror. Dream-like state, Head.—Vertigo from the least amovement of the head. Headache, with sensation of being “wound-up.” Bursting pain; head drawn hack. Eyes, — Bluish, drooping ids. Jiching of eves. De- Tusion of vision on closing eyes. Staring, injected: diverging strabismus. Pupils unequatly contracted. Jeok unsteady. Ptosis. Parcsis of recti interni. Ears,— Left ear throbs painfully; better, heat, Seems to hear circulation all over body, Face.— Dusky red or pallid lividity of face, lips, tonguc, mouth or throat.

Nose. — Sneezing in paroxysms, Jfching and tingling on end of nose. Mouth.--Very dry. Tongue dry, brown violet in middle. Thirst, Loss of appetite, wth aversion to meat.

Throat. — Dry and constricted. Pharynx paralyzed, swallowing almost impossible; better hot drinks, worse solids, Stomach. -- Nausea incessant and deathly, faintness, constant retching. Vomiting of green fluid. Nausea and vomiting on rising up.

Abdomen. — Distended. Acute pain in abdomen and along spinal column, Rectum. — Diarrhoea watery, brown, or black with horrible tenesmus. Constipation; stools targe, dry, knotty, with tendency to bruise and fissure. Urinary—Paresis of bladder. Strangury. Slow and diffcul! urination. Retention of prostatic hypertrophy. Uramia, acute and chronic, Male.—-Impotency, Pain in right spermatic cord. [O-val. ac.]

Heart. — Alternation of tachycardia and bradycardia. Cardiac muscular tissue is intact, even if severely exhausted. Pulse small, weak, dicrotic, Respiratory. ~ Faint and struggling for breath; diaphragmatic paralycis- hiccouzh; dyspneea, paroxysmal, on first falling asleep. (Lach.; Grindel.) Cheyne- Stokes respiration. Chest tight. Pain in middle of sternum. Dry, hard, teasing, exhausting cough, worse at night. Strangling cough, with viscid mucus sputum; thin, scanty, but sounds loose and abundant. Back, —- Pain along spine. Weakness of loins, Aching across Jumbo-sacra] region; cannot walk erect. [Cimstcif.] Extremities. —- Staggering gait. Numbness. Skin, — Livid; purple spots; zoster-like herpes. /iching. Skin lost its elasticity. Urticaria appearing at climaxis, Nervous. —- Restlessness and hyperssthesia; trembling, twitching, jerking, convulsions. Extremely susceptible to pain. Pain causes twitching and jerking of ‘limbs. Violent and sudden neuralgic pains and sudden fainting. Delirium, melancholic in character. Neuralgias tutensely painful; left supraorbital; right intercostal, better from heat; multiple neuritis, Sore feeling all over. Bed fects too hard. Aggravation after sleep. [Lack.] Neuralgia after zoster. [Mezer.]

Sleep. — Yawning. drowsy; prolonged, deep sieep. Sleepless; restless sleep, with {frequent startings. Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Fever, — chills. Icy coldness. Burning heat: profuse sweat. Dose.-— Third to sixth trituration.

remedies.name: Moschus
remedies.text:
(Musk) A remedy for hysteria and nervous paroxysms, fainting fits and convulsions, catalepsy, etc. The characteristic condition being aggravation by cold; there is great sensitiveness to air. Much nervous trembling and frequent fainting. Great flatulence. Diseases do not follow a normal course.

Mind. — [ncentrollable laughter. Scolding. Anxiety, with palpitation; starting as if frightened. Sexual hypochondriasis.

Head. — Compressive pain over root of nose. Pressure on top of head. Vertigo on least motion; sensation as if falling from a great height. Scalp sensitive. Sounds in ears as from the report of a cannon.

Stomach. — Desire for black coffee, stimulants. Aversion to food. Everything tastes flat. With stomach symptoms, anxiety in chest. Distended, Faints when eating. Abdomen greatly distended. Spasmodic, nervous hiccough. [Hydrory. ac.; Sulph. ac.; Ignat.; Cayap.} Male, — bioient desire; involuntary emissions. Impotence, associated with diabetes, [Coca.] Premature senility, Nausea and vomiting after coition.

Female. — Menses too early, too profuse, with dis position to faint. (Nusr m.; Veratr,.) Sexual desire, with intolerable titillation in parts. Drawing and pushing in the direction of the genilals; sensation as if menses appear, ‘ Urine. — Profuse urination. Diabetes, Respiratory. — Tightuess of chest, is obliged to take a deeper breath. Sudden constriction of larynx and trachea. Difficult respiration; chest oppressed; trysterical spasm of chest; asthma. Spasm of glottis. Impending paralysis of lungs. Asthma, with intense anxiety, fear, and smothering sensation. Cough ceases, and miucks connot be capectorated, Globus hystericus.

Heart. — Hysterical palpitation, Trembling around heart. Weak pulse and fainting.

Modalities. — Better, in open air, rubbing. Worse, cold.

Relationship. — Compare: Nux mosch.; Asaf.; Voaler.; Sumbut.; Ign.; Castor. Compatible: Ambra. Antidotes: Camph.; Coff, Dose. — First to third potency.

remedies.name: Murex
remedies.text:
(Purple Fish) The symptoms of the female sexual organs are most pypminent, and have been clinically verified, Especially qdupted to nervous, lively, affectionate women. Patient weak and run down, Mind, —Great sadness, anxiety, and dread.

Stomach. — Sinking, all-gone sensation in stomach. [Sep.} Hungry, must eat.

Female. — Conscions of a womb. Pulsation in neck of womb. Desire easily excited. Feeling as if something was pressing on a sore spot in the pelvis; worse sitting, Pain from right side of womb to right or lett breast. Nymphomania. Least contact of parts causes violent sexual excitement. Sore pain in uterus. Menses irregular, profuse, frequent, large clots. Feeling of protrusion. Prolapse; enlargement of uteius, with pelvic tenesmus and sharp pains, extending toward breasts; aggravated lying down. Dysmenorrhaa and chronic endomietritis, with displacement. Must keep legs tightly crossed, Leucorrhwa green or bloody, alternate with mental symptoms and aching in sacrum. Benign tumors in breasts. Pain in them during menstrual period.

Urinary. — Urine frequent at night; smells like Vale-; constant urging. [Kreos.]

Modalities. — Worse, Jeast touch.

Relationship. — Compare: Plat.; Lit; Sep. (the latter lacks sexual erethism of Mfurer.} Dose. — Third ta thirtieth potency. Tia

remedies.name: Muriaticum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Muriatic Acid) This acid has an elective affinity for the blood, producing a septic condition similar to that found in law fevers with high temperature and great prostration. Patient becomes so weak she slides down the bed, Decomposition of fluids. Involuntary stools while passing urine, Haemorrhages. Mouth and anus chiefly affected.

Mind. — Irritable and peevish; fretful. Loud moaning. Great restlessness. Sad, taciturn; suffers in silence.

Head. — Vertigo: occiput heavy as if filled with lead. Sound of voice is intolerable. Pain as if brain were’ crushed, Nose. — Haemorrhage; much sneezing.

Face. — Lower jaw fallen; pimples and freckles; lips raw, dry, cracked. Mouth, — Tongue dry, leathery, paralyzed. Deep ulcers on tongue. Hard lumps in tongue. Epithelioma; edges bluish-red. [Carbol. ac.) © Aphthous mouth. Gums and glans swollen. Fetid breath. Serdes on teeth, Throat. — Uvula swollen. Ulcers and false membrane. Cidematous, dark, taw. Attempted swallowing produces spasm and checking.

Stomach. — Cannot near sight or thought of meat. At limes, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink, Rectum. — Tendency to involuntary evacuations while urinating. Haemorrhoids most sensitive to all touch; even sheet of toilet paper is painful. Anal itching and prolapsus ani while urinating. Haemorrhoids during pregnancy; bluish, hot, with violent stitches, Heart. -— Pulse rapid, feebte, and small. lntermits every third beat..

Urine. — Cannot urinate without having bowels niove at same time.

Female. — Menses appear too soon, Leucorrhoea. During menses, soreness of anus. Ulcer in genitals. Extremities. —- Heavy, painful, and weak. Tottering gait, Pain in tendo-Achilles. Skin. -~ Papular and vesicular eruptions, with great itching. [Rhus.] Carbuncles; foul-smelling ulcers on lower extremities. Scarlet fever, livid, with petechix; scanty eruption, Fever. — Cold extremities. Heat without thirst. Typhoid types, stupid. Haemorrhages. Restlessness. Involuntary discharges. Bed-sores. Pulse rapid and feeble. Excessive prostration, Modalities, — Horse, in damp weather, before midnight, Hetier, lying on teft side.

Relationship. — Compare: Phos. ac.; Ars.: Bapt. Follaws well after Bry. and Rhus. Antidote: Bryonia. Dose. ~- First to third potency.

remedies.name: Mygale Lasiodora
remedies.text:
(Black Cuban Spider) Chorea js the principal therapeutic field of this remecy. Sexual symptoms are important.

Mind. — Delirious, restless, sad; fears death; despondent.

Face. — Tiwtiching a7 facial muscles. Mouth and eyes open in rapid succession. Hot and flushed. Tongue dry and parched; put out with difficulty. Head jerked tu one side. Grating of teeth at night, Stomach. — Nausea, with dim sight. Aversion to food. Excessive thirst. Male, — Violent erections. Chordee. [Kali brom.; Camph.] Extremities. -- Unsteady gait. Constant motion of whole body. Tremulous. Intense redness in streaks, following course of lymphatics. Twitching of limbs. Restless hands. Convulsive, uncontrollable movements of arms and icgs. Limbs drag while walking. Relationship, —- Compare: Agar.; Tarant.; Cuodr.; Zizia. Modalities, — Better, during sleep. Worse, in morning.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Myosotis
remedies.text: (Forget-me-not) Chronic bronchitis and phthisis. Night-sweats, Respiratory. — Cough with profuse muco-purulent expectoration, gagging and vomiting during cough; worse while or after eating. Bronchorrhea. Pain in left jung (lower); painful while coughing and sensitive to percussion. Dose, — Tincture to second potency.

remedies.name: Myrica
remedies.text:
(Bayberry) Marked action on the liver, with jaundice, Persistent sleeplessness, Mind. — Despondent, irritable, indifferent, Head. -- Scalp feels tight. Headache, with drowsiness; yellow sclerotica; aching in eyeballs. Pressure in vertex and forehead. Pain and stiffness in nape of neck. Face. —- Yellow. Itching and stinging. Creeping sensation.

Mouth. — Tongue furred, with bad taste in mouth, and nausea, Tenacivus, thick, nauseous secretion. Tender, spongy, and bleeding gums. [Merc.] ‘Throat. -—Constricted and rough feeling, with a constaiit desire to swallow, Stringy mucus; detached with difficulty.

Stomach. — Taste bitter and nauseous, with offensive breath. Complete loss of appetite, but with a feeling of fullness in the stomach after a hearty meal, Strong desire for acids. Weak, sinking feeling in the epigastrium, approaching’ nausea; increased after eating; relieved by rapid walking.

Abdomen. — Dull pain in the region of the liver. Compicte jaundice. with bronze-yellow skin; foss of appetite. Fullness in the stomach and abdomen. Scanty, yellow, frothy urine, Stool. — Constant discharge of flatus when walking. Urging to stool, with no other results than the expulsion of a great amount of flatus. Loose, light-colored stool; ash-colored and destitute cf bile.

Urinary. — Dark, frothy, scanty, high-colored, biliary. Sleep.--Disturbed, bad dreams and frequent waking; insomnia. Extremities, — Pain under shoulder-blades and back of neck, in al! muscles, in hollow of right foat, Yellow and itching. Jaundice.

Relationship. — Compare: Ptel.; Cornus cir.; Chelid.; Lept.; Fagap. Antidote: Digit, (jaundice).

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Myristica Sebifera
remedies.text:
(Brazilian Ucuba) A remedy of great antiseptic powers. Inflammation af skin, cellular tissue and periosteum. Specific action in panaritium. Pain'in the finger nails with swelling of the phalanges, Hands are stiff, as if from squeezing something a long time. Coppery taste and burning in throat. Tongue white and cracked. Phlegmonous inflammations, Hastens suppuration. Often does away with use of the knife. Inflammation of middle ear, suppurative stage. Fistula in ano.

Dose. — Low potencies,.

remedies.name: Myrtus Communis
remedies.text:
(Myrtle) Chest pains, as found often in consumptives, call for this remedy. Incipient phthisis, Chest, —- Stitching pain in icft breast, running through to shouldcr-blade, [Jllic.; Therid.; Pix.] Dry, hollow cough, with tickling in chest. Worse in the morning, Sensation of burning in left chest.

Relationship. — Compare: Myrtus Cheken (Chronic hronchitis with dense, yellowish sputum, difficult to detach, Copious vapcctoration keeps patient distressed and coughing). Dose, -— Third potency.

remedies.name: Naja Tripudians
remedies.text:
(Virus of the Cobra) Naja is not a haemorrhagic or septic, medicine like Lachesis and Crotalus. Its action settles around the heart; valvular treubles. Marked surging of blood upwards, marked dyspnoea, inability to lie on left side. Hypertrophy, and valvular lesions. Organs seem fo be drawn together, Very susceptible to cold. With heart symptoms, pain in torehead and temples. Diseases primarily depending upon degeneration of motor cells.

Mind. — Broods constantly oyer imaginary troubles. Suicidal insanity. [Aur.) Depressed. Aversion to fealking. Dreads to be teft alone. Fear of rain.

Head. — Pain in left temple and in left orbital region, extending to occiput, with nausea and vomiting. Hayfever, with dry larynx. Suffocative spells after sleeping. [Lach.] Eyes staring. [Medorrh.]

Ears. — lliusions of hearing; otalgia: chronic ootorrhoea, hlack discharges; smells like herring brine.

Respiratory. — Grasping at throat, with seuse of choking. Irritating, dry cough, dependent on cardiac lesions. {Spong.; Lauroc,] Asthmatic constriction in evening. Asthma heginning with coryza.

Heart. — With the heart symptoms pain in forehead and temples. Pulse irrryular in force. Threatened paralysis of heart, body cold, pulse slow, weak, irregular. Acute and chronic endocarditis, Palpitation. Stitching pain in region of heart, Angina pectoris. Damaged heart after infectious discases

Female. — Neuralgia of ‘eft ovary; often serviceable in obscure pain in left groin, especially in post-operative cases; seems to be drawn to heart.

Sleep. — Profound, like a log, with stertorous breathing, a typical reptilian state.

Modalities. — Worse, from use of stimulants; better, from walking or riding in open air, Relationship. — Compare: Bungarus Fasciatus (Banded Krait).- This venom produces a condition like an acute polio-encephalitis and myelitis, both symptomatically and histologically. Lach.; Crotat.; Spig.; Spong. Dose, — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Naphthaline
remedies.commonName: A chemical compound from Coal-tar; Tar Camphor
remedies.text:
(A chemical compound from Coal-tar; Tar Camphor) Coryza, hay-fever, phthisis pulmonalis, also gonorrhoea, have been influenced favorably by this drug. Pyelonephritis. Whooping-cough.

Eyes. — Marked affinity for the eye. It produces detachment of the retina; papillo-retinal infiltration; deposits in patches upon the retina; amblyopia and consecutive amaurosis; sparkling synchisis; soft cataract. Exndation in the retina, choroid and ciliary body; corneal opacity. Cataract. Opacity of the cornea. Urine, — Irresistible desire. Meatus red, swollen, and cedema of prepuce. Black urine. Cuttmg pain down penis. Pain in bladder. Terribly offensive odor of decompusing ammoniacal urine, Respiratory. — Sneezing; eyes inflamed; painful; head hot. Ifay-fever. Spasmodic asthma; better in open air. Soreness in chest and stomach; must loosen clothing. Dyspnoea and sighing inspiration. Whooping-cough, long and continued paroxysms of coughing, unable te get a respiration, Acute laryngo-tracheitis. Bronchitis when the spasniodic element is associated with tenacious expectoration and oppression. ( Cartier.) Non-homuwopathic

Uses. — For worms, and especially pin-worms, one-gramme dose. Externally in skin diseases, five per cent, ointment.

Relationship. — Compare: Dros., Corall.; Coceus, Dose, — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Narcissus
remedies.text:
(Daffodil) Symptoms of nausea followed by violent vomiting and diarrhoea, Daffodil bulbs contain an atkaloid the action of which, according to authorities, varies as to whether the alkaloid is extracted from the flowering bulb or from the bulb after flowering. Thus in the former case the al- Mdtloid produces dryness of the mouth, checks cutaneous Hleretions, dilates the pupil of the eye, quickens the ‘pudse, and slows ond weakens the heart contractions, On the other hand, the alkaloid from the bulbs after flowering produces copious salivation, increases cutane~ ous secretion, contracts the pupil of the eye, produces slight relaxation of the pulse, and slight faintness and nausea.— The Lancet. A remedy for cough and bronchitis. Coryza; frontal headache. Convulsive stage of whooping-cough.

Skin. — Erythema of a papular, vesicular and pustular type, aggravation in wet weather. Dose. -— First attenuation.

remedies.name: Natrum Arsenicum
remedies.text:
(Arseniate of Sodium) A remedy for nasal catarrh, with headache, pain at root of nose, dry and painful eyes. Psoriasis. {Ars.; Chrys, ac.; Thyroid.) Bronchitis of children over seven years. Facilitates the termination of the cold and conserves strength and appetite. (Cartier.) Head. —- Floating sensation on turning head quickly; aching in frontal region and root of nose, over orbits. Headache; worse, pressure and tobacco smoke.

Nose. — Watery discharge; drops into throat. Feels stopped; pain at root. Dry crusts, on removal, leave mucous membrane raw. Post-nasal dropping of thick, bland, yellowish mucus. Crusis in nose, Ears. — Catarrha! conjunctivitis and blepharitis marginalis. Eyes feel weak, stiffness uf balls and tendency of lids to close. Feel heavy and droop. Lachrymation in wind. Agglutination in morning. Dry, painful, burning; soon tire, (Edema of orbital region. Supraorbital pain.

Throat. — Dark, purplish, swollen, adematous; red and glassy. Respiratory. —- Racking cough, with profuse greenish expectoration. Oppression of chest and about heart, and also larynx, Miner’s asthma. Lungs feet as though smoke had been inhaled. Extremities. —- Aching in arms; worse in shoulder. Pain in antcrior crural nerves. Joints stiff. Feels tired all over. Knee-joints crack.

Relationship. — Compare: Ars.; Kati carb.; Apis. Dose. ~— Third to thirtieth potency. NATRUM CARBONICUM (Carbonate of Sodium) ureat debility caused by swunmer heat; chronic effects of sunstroke; exhaustion; anemic; milky, watery skin; very weak ankles, are al) peculiar Narrum carbonicum conditions.

Mind. — Unable to think; difficult, slow comprehension. Anxious and resiless during thunder storm; worse from music. {Amdra.] Marked gayety. Head. ~— Aches from slightest mental exertion, worse from sun or working under gaslight, [Glon.} Feels 10 large. Oversensitive af hearing. Head aches with return of hot weather. Nose, -— All troubles of external nose which may attain a morbid size— pimples and puffiness. Constant coryza; abstruction of nose. Catarrh; bad smell of nasal seerction. Many troubles of external nuse. {Canst.] Posterior nasal catarrk. Hawking much mucus from throat; worse. slightest draught. Face, —- Freckles, yellow spots, pimples. Swelling of upper lip. Pale, with blue rings arvund eyes and swollen hes…

remedies.name: Natrum Carbonicum
remedies.text:
Stomach. — Feels swollen and sensitive. Il! effects of drinking cold water when overheated. Waterbrash. Very weak digestion, caused by slightest error of diet. Averse to milk. Depressed after eating. Bitter taste. Old dyspeptics, always belching, have sour stomach and theumatism. Dyspepsia relieved by soda biscuits. Bowels, — Sudden call to stool. Escapes with haste and noise Fellow substance like pulp of orange in discharge. Diarrhoea from milk.

Female. — induration of cervix. Pudenda sore. Bearing-down sensation, {Sep.; Murea.J Heaviness; worse, sitting; better, by moving. Menses late, scanty, like meat-washings. [Nitric ae} Leucorrhaea! discharge, offensive, irritating, preceded by colic. Respiratory. —Dry cough, when coming into warm room from out ef doors. Cough with coldness of Seft side of breast, Sleep.— Wakes too early in morning. Amorous dreams, Drowsy during day.

Extremities. — Old sprains. Great weakness of limbs, especially in morning. Easy dislocation and spraining of ankics. Foot bends under. [Caxst.] Soreness between toes and fingers. Heel and tendo-Achilles affected, Chapped hands. The hollow of the knee is painful on motion.

Skin. — Inclination to perspire easily, or dry, rough. cracked skin, Eruption on finger-tips, knuckles and toes. Vesicular eruption in patches and circles, Modalities. — i/’orse, sitting, from music, sun, summer ‘cat, mental exertion, thunder-storm, Least draught, changes of weather. Betier, by moving, hy boring in ears and nose.

Relationship. — Compare: Sodit bicorbanas (in vomiting of pregnancy with acetonuria, 30 grains in water spread over twenty-four hours); Nat. sulph.; Caust.; Natr. cacodyl. (in phthisis, 5 centigrams hypodermically, daily, Increase number of red blood corpuscles to double. Also in malignant disease). Antidote: Ars.; Camph.

Dose. — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Natrum Chloratum
remedies.text:
(Labarraque’s Solution) In congested and atonic states of the uterus and its ligaments, with hepatic disorders. Chronic catarrhal diseases of the middle ear. Flabby, debilitated constitution. Both hands swollen in morning. Philegmatic. Depressed, faint, Head. — Vertigo, with aching across forehead. Swimming feeling, as if top of head would float off. Bleeding of nose in clots..

Mouth. — Sore irritable spots along sides of tongue ard throat, gums sore, tongue swollen; aphthous ulceration, Putrid taste. Furred tongue, large, flabby, indented. Cough with aphonia.

Stomach. — Drowsy after meals.

Urine. — Dark, with albumen and casts. Diffuse nephritis. Much pain across small of back, Female. — Feeling as if uterus were pushed up on sitting down. JFerr. iod.] Feels as if it opened and shut. Violent metrorrhagia. Leucorrhoea and backache. Passive, hearing-down from heavy condition of uterus. Womb is heavy, sodden. with tendency to prolapse. Extremities.— Hands swollen every morning. Ex- -oeeme weakness tu ankles and knees. “Relationship.— Compare: Aur, mur. nat.; Cale.; Sepia; Heliotropium (uterine displacement, with active bearing-down sensation and loss of voice; membranous dysmenorrhea). Antidotes: Pulsat.; Guaiacum, Dose, — Fifteen to twenty drops of Labarraque’s solution in water, Third attenuation made with dilute alcohol, lower with water,

remedies.name: Natrum Muriaticum
remedies.text:
(Chloride of Sodiurn) A great remedy for certain forms of intermittent fever, amemia, chlorosis, many disturbances of the alimentary tract and skin. Great debility; most weakness felt in the morning in bed. Emaciation most notable in neck. Great liability to take cold. Dry mucous membranes. Great weakucss ard weariness, Oversensitive to all sorts of influences. Hyperthyroidism. Mind. -- Depressed, particularly in chronic diseases. Consolation aggravates. Irritable; gets into a passion about trifles. Awkward, hasty. [Apis.] Head.—Throbs. Blinding headache. [Kali bich,; Sil.; Gels.) Aches as if a thousand little hammers were knocking on the brain, in the morning on awakening, after menstruation, from sunrise to sunset, Feels too large; cold. [Cale.; Laur.; Pod.) Anzmic headache of school-girls. [Calc. phos.] Chronic headache, from sunris¢ to sunset, with pale face, nausea, vomiting; periodical; from eyestrain; menstrual. Before attack, numbness and tingling in lips, tongue and nose. Frontal sinus inflammation. Eyes.—-Feel bruised, with headache in school children, Muscles weak and stiff, Letters run together. Sees sparks. Fiery, zigzag appearance around all objects. * Burning in eyes, Stricture of Jachrymai duct with suppuration. Escape of muco-pus when pressing upon sac. Lachrymation, burning and acrid. Lids swollen. Tears Stream down face on coughing, [Euph.] Asthenopia due to insufficiency of internal recti muscles. [Gels. and Cup. ecet, when due to external muscles.) Pain in eyes when looking down. Cataract incipient. [Secate.]

Ears. — Noises; roaring and ringing.

Nose. — Violent, fivent coryza, tasting from one to three days, then changing into stoppage of uose, making breathing difficult. Discharge thin and watery, like raw white of egg. Violent sneezing coryza, Loss of smell and taste, Internal soreness of nose. Face, — Oily, shiny, as if greased. Earthy complexion. Fever-blisters.

Mouth. — Frothy coating on tongue, with bubbles on side. Sense of dryness Scorbutic gums. Numbness, tuging of tongue, lips, and nose. Vesicles and burning on tongue, as if there was a hair on it. Eruptions around mouth and vesicics like pearls on lips. Lips and corners of mouth dry, ulcerated, and cracked. [Nit ac] Tongue mapped, [Ars.; Rhus; Tarax.} Loss of taste. [Gymoena.] Large vesicle on lower Sip, which is swollen and burns.

Stomach. — Hungry, yet loose flesh. [/od.] Heartburn, with palpitation. Unquenchabie thir t. Seats while eating, Craving for salt. Aversion to bread. Throbbing in pit. Sticking sensation in cardiac orifice.

Abdomen. — Cutting pain in abdomen, Distended. Pain in abdominal! ring on coughing. Rectum. -- Burning pains and stitching after stool. Anue: contracted, torn, bleeding. Constipation; stool dey, crumbling. [.4m, m.; Mag. mJ Urine. — Pain just after urinating. [Sars.] Increased, involuntary when walking, coughing, etc. Has to wait a long time for it to pass if others are present. (Hep.; Mur, ac.). Male, — Emission, even after coitus. Impotence with retarded emission.

Female. — Menses irregular; usually profuse. Vagina dry. Leucorrhoea acrid, watery. Bearing-down pains; worse in morning. [Sep.] Prolapsus uteri, with cutting in urethra. Ineffectual labor-pains. Suppressed menses. [Follow with Kalt cavb.] Hot during menses, Respiratory. — Cough from a tickling in the pit of stomach, accompanied by stitches in liver and spurting of urine. [Caus?.; Squilla.) Stitches all over chest. Congh, with bursting pain in head. Shortness of breath, especially on going upstairs. [Cale.]

Heart. — Fluttering, palpitating; intermittent pulse. Heart's pulsations shake body. /#termits on lying down, Extremities. — Pain in back, with desire for some firm support, {Rhus; Sep.] Every movement accelerates the circulation, Palms hot and perspiring. Arms and legs, but especially knees, feel weak. Hangnails. Dryness and cracking about finger-nails. Numbness and tingling in fingers and toes. Ankles weak and turn easily. Painful contraction of hamstrings. [Casst.] Cracking in joints on motion. Coldness of legs with congestion to head, chest, and stomach.

Sleep. — Sleepy in forenoon. Nervous jerking during sleep. Dreams of robbers. Sleepless from grief. {Phos. ac.; Ignat.]

Skin. — Lupus. {4rs.; X-Ray.] Urticaria; itch and burn. Crusty eruptions in bends of Umbs, margin of scalp, behind ears. [Cawst.] Warts on paims of hands. Eczema; raw, red, and inflamed; worse, eating salt, at seashore, Affects hair follicles. Atopecia. Hives, itch~ ing after exertion.

Fever. — Chill between 9 and 11 a. mM. Heat; violent thirst, increases with fever. Fever-blisters, Coldness of the body, and continued chilliness very marked. Hydramia in chronic malarial states with weakness, constipation, loss of appetite, etc. Modalities, — Worse, noise, music, warm room, lying down; about 10 a, M., at seashore, mental exertion, heat, talking. Jectter, open air, cold bathing, going without regular meals, lying on right side; pressure against back.

Relationship. — Complementary to Apis; Scpia; Ign. Compare: Aqua marina—Isotonic plasma. Marine plasma is sea water taken some miles from shore and some depth helow surface, filtered and diluted with twice as much pure fresh water. It acts primarily on the blood, as in intoxications, scrofutous conditions, enteritis. It disintoxicates m cancer (administered subcutaneously in the treatment of diseases of skin, kidneys and intestines, gasiro-enteritis, and tubercilosis). Scrofutous affection of children. Lymphadenitis. Lupus, eczema, varicose ulcers. A great “blood nurifier and vitalizer.” Potentized sea-water in weakness, lack of reaction; symptoms worse seaside. Sal martnum (sea salt), indicated in chronic enlargements of glands, especially cervical. Suppurating glands. It appears likely to become a most usefu! remedy as an auxiliary, if not as a principal, in the treatment of diseases in patients of a strumous diathesis. Also useful in constipation, Natrum sclenicum (laryngcal phthisis with expectoration af small lumps of bloody mucus and slight hoagecness. [Argent. met.]); Natrum silicxm (hamopilia; serofulous bone affections); fanat,; Sep.; Thuy.; aph.; Alum. Antidotes: Ars.; Phos.

Dose. — Twelfth to thirtieth and higher, The very highest potencies often yield most brilliant results.

remedies.name: Natrum Nitricum
remedies.text:
(Nitrate of Sodium) A Radeinacherian remedy for inflammations, [Acon.; Ferr, phos.) Specific for uoselleed, Hamuptysis. [Afittes.1 Influenza, Heamaturia. Purpura haemorrhagica. Haemorrhagic Variola, Abdomen. — Flutsicnt, Abdominal muscles become painfully contracted towards the spine. Relationship. -~ Compare: Natrum nicrosuin (throbdling and fullness; faintuess. nervous pain in head, nausea, eructations, blue lips). Natrum silicofluoricum — Salufer— (a cancer remedy; tumors, bone affection, carics, Jupus, ethmoiditis. Must be used carefully).

Dose. — Second trituration.

remedies.name: Natrum Phosphoricum
remedies.text:
(Phosphate of Sodium) Natrum phosphoricum is the remedy for conditions arising from excess of lactic acid, often resulting from too much sugar. Ailments, with excess of acidity. Sour eructations and taste. Sour vomiting. Vellow, creamy coating at the back of the roof of mouth and tongue. Inflammation of any part of the throat, with sensation of a lump in throat. Flatulence, with sour risings. Colic, with symptonis of worms. Cracking of joints. Jaundice (1x trit.).

Mind. — Imagines, on waking at night, that pieces of furniture are persons; that he hears footsteps in next room. Fear, Head. — Feels dull in the morning, full feeling and throbbing. Eyes, — Discharge of golden-yellow, creamy matter from the eyes. Dilation of one pupil. Whites of eyes dirty yellow.

Ears. — One ear red, hot, frequently itchy, accompanied hy gastric derangements and acidity. Nose, —- Offensive odor. Itching of nose. Nasopharyngeal catarrh, with thick, yellow, offensive mucus.

Face. — Paleness or bluish, florid appearance of face.

Mouth. — Canker sores of tip and cheeks. Blisters on tip of tongue, with stinging in evening. Thin, moist coating on the tongtte. Yellow, creamy coating at the back part of the roof of the mouth, Dysphagia. Thick, creamy membrane over tonsils and soft palate.

Stomach. — Sour eructations, sour vomiting, greenish diarrhoea, Spits mouthful of food. Male, — Emissions without dreams, with weakness in back and trembling in limbs. Desire without erection. Gonorrhoea.

Female. — Menses too early; pale, thin, watery. Sterility, with acid secretions from vagina. Leucorrhoea; discharge creamy or honey-colored, or acid and watery. Sour-smelling discharges from uterus, Morning sickness, with sour vomiting.

Extremities. — Rheumatism of the knee-joint.

Back. — Weariness; aching in wrists and finger-joints. Hamstrings sore. Synovial crepitation, Rheumatic arthritis, Sti. — Yellow. Itching in various parts, especially of ankics. Hives. Smooth, red, shining. Erysipelas. Feet icy cold in daytime, burn at night. Swelling of lymphatic glands.

Relationship. — Compare: Natrum lactic, (rheumatism and gout; gouty concretions); Nat. nitrosum (attgina pectoris, cyanosis, fainting, copious liquid stools at night); Nat. scien, (chronic laryngitis and laryngeal phthisis}; Nat. si/icofuor, (bone affections, caries); Nat. suiphurosum (diarrhoea, with yeasty stools); Nat. sulpho-carbol. (pyeemia; purulent pleurisy, 3 to 5 grains every three hours); Nat. telluricum (breath has odor of garlic; night-sweats of phthisis); Calc.; Robin.; Phos. (n Jaundice Ix. Dose.-- Third to twelfth trituration, Non-homaopathically, Phosphate Seda used hypodermically for Morphine habit, by Dr. M. J, Lays. Phosphate Soda, 75 gr. daily, for constitutional iodism, thyroidism and Grave’s disease.

remedies.name: Natrum Salicylicum
remedies.text:
(Salicylate of Sodium) Has an extensive range of action affecting the head, ear, throat, kidneys and liver and on metabolism. Haemorrhages, especially epistaxis. Produces marked effects upon the internal ear, with vertigo, deafness,… Loetpageemmedl ? noises in ears and logs-of bone conduction, hence, its use in Meniere's diseal One of The best remedies for the prostrating after-effects oF influenca, "Lassitude, drowsiness, listlessness, tremor. Incipient dementia. Increases the quantity of bile. Head.—Perfectiy rational periods, alternate with manifestations of insanity of 2 sombre character. Vertigo; worse, raising head. All objects seem to move to the right. Dull headache and confusion, Fibrasitis of the scalp.

Eyes. — Retinal haemorrhage, albuminuric retinitis with haemorrhage.

Ears. — Tinnitus of a low tone. Deafness. Auditory vertigo, [Petrol.; Tabac.; Chinin.]

Chest. — Dyspneea; breathing noisy, shallow, panting; pulse irregular. Complete loss of voice. Skin, — (Edema, urticaria, red in circumscribed patches. Tingling and itching. Pemphigoid eruption, Relationship.— Compare: Lobelia purpurascens (drowsiness; dizzy headache between eyebrows; cannot keep eyes open; tongue white ~ feels paralyzed as also do the heart and lungs; intense prostration of alt vital forces; deadly chill, without shivering; useful for the low, nervous prostration of grippe); Gaulth.; China.

Dose. — Third potency. Non-Homepathic Uses, — In acute articular rheumatism, lumbago, sciatica, etc, Usual doses, ten to twenty Brains every three hours. Must be used carefully, as it is often destructive of kidney tissue, Ordinary allopathic doses aliay the pain of dysmenorrhaea and promote menstrual flow. -

remedies.name: Natrum Sulphuricum
remedies.text:
(Sulphate of Sodium —. Glauber’s Salt) A liver remedy, especially indicated for the so-called hydrogenoid constitution, where the complaints are such as are due to living in damp houses, basements, cellars, They are worse in rainy weather, water in any form, Feels every change from dry to wet; cannot even eat plants growing near water, nor fish. Always feels best in warm, dry air. Clinically, it has been found a valuable remedy for spinal meningitis, head symptoms from injuries to head, mental troubles therefrom. Every spring, return of, skin affections. Tendency to warts, Fingers and toes affected.

Mind. — Lively music saddens. Melancholy, with periodical attacks of mania Suicidal tendency; must exercise resiraint, Inability to think, Dislikes to speak, or to be spoken to.

Head. — Occipital pain. Piercing stitches in ears. Vertigo; relieved by sweat on head. Bursting feeling on coughing. Hot feeling on top of head. Boring in right temple, preceded by burning in stomach. Illeffects of falls and injuries to the head, and mental trowbles arising therefrom, Ears. — Sticking pain, earache, lightning-like stitches in damp weather. Nose. -— Nasal catarrh, with thick, yellow discharge and salty mucus, Coryza, Eyes. — Conjunctiva yellow. Granular lids. Photobhobia. [Graphtics.] Mouth, — Slimy, thick, tenacious, white mucus. Bitter taste, blisters on palate.

Throat. — Thick, yellow mucus, drops from posterior nares, Stomach.-— Vomits sour. Brown, bitter coating on tangue. Yellow complexion. Thirst for something cold. Bilious vomiting, acid dyspepsia, with heartburn and flatulence.

Abdomen. — Liver sore to touch, with sharp, stitching pains; cannot bear tight clothing around waist; worse, lying on left side. Flatulency; wind colic in ascending colon; worse, before breakfast. Burning in abdomen and anus. Bruised pain and urging to stool. Loosr morning stools; worse, after spell of wet weather. Stoojs involuntary, when passing flatus. Great size of the farcal mass, Urine. — Loaded with bile. Brick-dust sediment, Excessive secretion. Diabetes.

Female. — Nosebleed during menses, which are acrid and profuse. Burning in pharynx during menstruation. Herpetic vulvitis, Leucorrhoea vellowish-green, following gonorrhoca in female, ‘eucorrhaa with hoarseness.

Male. — Condylomata; soft, fleshy excrescences; greenish discharges. Gonorrhoea; discharge thick, greenish; little pain, Respiratory. — Dyspnoea, during damp weather. Must hold chest when coughing. Humid asthma; rattling in chest, at 4.and 5 a. mM. Cough, with thick ropy, greenish expectoration; chest feels all! gone. Constant desire to take deep, Jong breath. Asthma in children, as a constitutional remedy. Springs up in bed the cough hurts so; holds painful side. [8ry.] Pain through fower left chest. Back. ~— Itching when undressing. Violent pains in back of neck, and at base of brain. Piercing pain between scapule, Spinal meningitis; opisthotonos.

Extremities. — Swelling of axillary glands. Inflammation around root of nails. Burning in soles; oedema of feet; itching between toes. Gout. Pain in limbs, compels frequent change in position, Ren-arounds. Pain in hip-joints; worse, stooping. Stiffness of knees, cracking of joints.

Skin. — Itching while undressing. Jaundiced, watery blisters. Sycotic excrescences; wart-like red lumps all aoeirer body.

Modalities. — #’orse, lying on left side; dampness of Dasement, damp weather. Better, dry weather, pressure, changing position.

Relationship. — Compare: Molario offictnalis — decomposed vegetable matter—-Has evident power to cause the disappearance of the plasmodium of malaria and higher, (Malariat cachexia. General sense of weariness, Spleen affections, Malaria and rheumatism. Sixth potency.) Natrum choleinicum— Fel Tauri Depuratum — (constipation; chronic gastric and intestinal catarrh; cirrhotic liver; diabetes: nape of neck pains; tendency to sleep after eating; much flatus; ascites); Momordica — Balsam Apple — (Colic, dysmenorrhea with gushes of blood.) Palme vulpis— Wolf's lung (persistent shortness of breath causing a paroxysm of asthma on the slightest motion. Strong, sonorous bubbling rales. 1 trit.). Peumus Boldus — Boldo — (atonic states of stomach and intestinal canal; liver states following malaria. Burning weight in region of liver and stomach, bitter taste, languor; abscess of liver; asthma, bronchitis, catarrh, oedema of lungs}; Natrum iodat. (chronic catarrhal affections, arteriosclerosis. Here various symptoms, as angina pectoris, vertigo, dyspnoea become less marked after continued use of 5-10 grs., 3 times a day.) Natrwm hyposulph, (liver-spots, locally and internally); Sulph.; Thujo; Merc.; Stilling. Complementary: Ars.; Thuja.

Dose. — First to twelfth trituration.

remedies.name: Niccolum
remedies.text:
(Metallic Nickel) Periodical nervous sick headaches, with asthenopia, weak digestion, constipation, Catarrh. Suits debilitated, nervous, literary patients, with frequent headaches, dyspepsia and constipation. Head, ~~ Cracking in cervical vertebra when moving the head. Pain on top as froma nail, Pressure on vertex, in morning; worse till noon and in warm room. Stitches. Objects appear too large. Migraine; first on left side. Twitching of upper lip.

Nose. — Violent sneezing; stopped up. Nasal catarrh, with redness and swelling at tip of nose, Acute pain at root of nose, extending to vertex and through temples.

Throat. — Sore, right side with great tenderness; soreness to touch externally, Strangulated feeling.

Gastric. — Gone, cmpty feeling in epigastrium, without desire for food. Acute gastralgia with pains extending to shoulder. Thirst and intense hiccough. Sour, fetid secretions ooze from molar teeth. Diarrhoea and tenesmus after milk.

Female. — Menses late, scanty, with great debility and burning in eyes. Profuse teucorrhoea; worse, after urinating [Mag. mur.; Plat.]: also worse after menses. Respiratory. ~- Hoarseness. Dry, hacking cough, with stitches in chest. Obliged to sit up and hold head. Must put orms on thighs, when coughing.

Skin. — Itching alt over, worse on neck, not relieved by scratching.

Modalities. — Worse, periodically, every two weeks; yearly, forenoon. Better, in evening.

Dose. — Third trituration,

remedies.name: Niccolum Sulphuricum
remedies.text:
(Sulphate of Nickel) Useful in ctimacteric disturbances. Petiodic neuralgias of malarial origin. Urine and saliva increased. Coppery taste. Weak, asthenopic literary persons with weak digestion and constipation, are worse in morning and suffer from periodic headaches.

Head. — Nervous, uneasy, desire to recline, tired, cannot settle down to any occupation. Periodic headaches, occipital pain, extending down to spine, worse lying on back; sore pain in eyes.

Back. — Stiff, numb sensation, worse in neck. Spine sore. Awakened in morning with burning soles. Spinal pains, legs and arms heavy and weak, cannot lie on back. Female, — Du!l aching in ovaries, with sensation as if menses appear. Hot flashes, followed by perspiration on parts touching each other, when separated become dry.

Dose. — Second trituration,

remedies.name: Nitricum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Nitric Acid) Selects for its special seat of action the outlets of the body where the mucous membrane and skin meet; these pain as from splinters, Marked improvement of all symptoms while riding in a carriage. Acts best on the dark complexioned and past middie life. Syphilis, after abuse of Mercury. Pains appear and disappear quickly. [Bell.} Blisters and ulcers in mouth, tongue, genitals; bleed easily. Fissures, with pain during stool, as if rectum were torn, All discharges very offensive, especially urine, faces, and perspiration. Persons who have chronic diseases, and take culd easily and disposed to diarrhoea, Excessive physical irritability. Cachexia, due to syphilis, serofula, etc. Gravel; arthritis. Capillary bleeding after currettage. Mind. —/rritabie, hateful, vindictive, headstrong. Hopeless despair.

Head. — Sensation of a band around heed. Headache from pressure of hat; full feeling; worse from street noises. Hair falls out. Scalp sensitive.

Ears. — Difficult hearing; better by riding in car- Tiage or train. Very sensitive to noise, as the rattle of wagons over pavements. [Coff.; Nux.) Cracking in ears when chewing.

Eyes. — Double vision; sharp, sticking pains. Ulceration of cornea, Nose.—‘Ozeena. Green casts from nose cvery morning. Coryza, with sore and bleeding nostrils, Tip red. Stitches, as of a splinter in nose. Caries of mastoid. Nosebleed, with chest affections. Chronic nasal catarrh, with yellow, offensive, corrosive discharge. Nasal diphtheria, with watery and exeedingly excoriating discharge.

Mouth. — Putrid breath. Salivation. Bleeding of gums. Painful pimples on the sides of the tongue. Tongue clean, red and wet with center furrow. Teeth hecome loose; gums soft and spongy. Ulcers in soft palote, with sharp, splinter-like pains, Salivation and fetor oris. Bloody saliva.

Throat. — Dry. Pain into ears. Hawks mucus constantly. White patches and sharp points, as from splinters, on swallowing. Stomach — Great hunger, with sweetish taste. Longing for indigestible things —- chalk, earth, etc. Pain in cardiac orifice. Dyspepsia with excess of oxalic acid, uric acid and phosphates in urine and great mental depression. Abdomen, — Great straining, but little passes. Rectum feels torn. Bowels constipated, with fissures in rectum, Tearing pains during stools. Violcnt cutting pains after stouls, lasting for hours. [Ratank.] Haemorrhages from bowels, profuse, bright. Prolapsus ani. Haemorrhoids bleed easily. Diarrhoea, slimy and offensive, After stools, irritable and exhausted. Colic re- Héved from tightening clothes, Urine. — Scanty, dark, offensive. Smells like horse's urine. Cold om passing, Burning and stinging. Urine bloody and albuminous, Male. — Soreness and burning in glans and beneath prepuce. Ulcers; burn atid sting; exude, offensive matter. Female,— Externa! parts sore, with ulcers. [Hep.; Merc.; Thuja.} ‘Leucorrhoea brown, flesh-colored, watery, or stringy, offensive. Hair on genitals falls out. [Natr, m.; Zine.) Uterine haemorrhages. Menses early, profuse, like muddy water. Metrerrhagia after parturition. Respiratory. Hoarseness. Aphonia, with dry hacking cough, from tickling in larynx and pit of stomach, Soreness at lower end of sternum. Short breath on going upstairs, [Ars.; Cale.) Cough during sleep. [Cham.]

Extremities. — Fetid foot-sweat, causing soreness of toes, with sticking pain; chilblains on tocs. Sweating of palms, hands; cold, blue nails. Offensive sweat in axille at night.

Skin. — Warts, large jagged; bleed on washing. Ulcers bleed easily, sensitive; splinter-like pains; zigzag, irregular edges; base looks like raw flesh. Exuberant granulations. Black pores on face, papules worse on forehead.

Modalities. — Worse, evening and night, cald climate, and also kot weather. Better, while riding in carriage. (Reverse: Cocculus.]

Relationship. — Complementary: Ars.; Caled; Lac com, Inimical: Lack. Compare: Merc.; Kali c.; Thuja; Hepar; Cate. Dose. ~— Sixth potency. As the nitric acid patient begins to improve skin symptoms may appear for a time, a favorable indication,

remedies.name: Nitri Spiritus Dulcis
remedies.text:
(Sweet Spirits of Nitre) Sensorial apathy in low fevers when there is stupor, difficulty of arousing patient, is met by this remedy. Ti-effects of salt (halophagia). [Ars.; Phos.) Catching cold in stormy weather. Acute nephritis following Scarlet Fever. Salty taste. Face, — Prosopalgia, with photophobia. Burning in cheeks, and vomiting, followed by lassitude. Boring in facial bones; in angles of lower jaw. Very sensitive to cold.

Respiratory. — Very rapid breathing by going only a short walk. Painful constriction beveath sternum.

Modalities. — Worse, from mental disturbance, during winter and spring.

Relationship. — Increases the action of Digitalis. Compare: Phas. ac.; Lycop. Doee.--A few drops of the pure spirits in water every two or three hours.

remedies.name: Nitro-muriatic Acid
remedies.text:
(Aqua Regia) Almost a specific in Oxaluria. Removes the distressing skin symptoms resembling psoriasis. Three to five drops three times a day. So-called bilious conditions. Constricted anus. Gravel, Mouth — Gums bleed easily. Ptyalism. Constant drooling ot night. [Merc.] Cankers; small, superficial ulceration over inside of mouth and tongue. Metallic taste. [Cupr. met.].

Stomach. — Sour eructations, with empty hungry feeling in stomach; not relieved by eating. Satlivation; worse at night, Stool.—-Constipated, with ineffectual urging. pPhincter constricted. Anus moist and sore.

Urine. — Cloudy. Burning in urethra. Oxaluria. Lysidit (ten drops of a 50 per cent. solution three times a day. Irritable bladder, irregular heart, and nervous symptoms}. Also Kali sulph, Dose. — Five to ten drops, well diluted.

remedies.name: Nuphar Luteum
remedies.text:
(Yellow Pond-lily) Produces nervous weakness, with marked symptoms in the sexual sphere.

Male. — Complete absence of sexual desire; parts relaxed; penis retracted. Impotency, with involuntary emissions during stool, when urinating. Spermatorrha, Pain in testicles and penis. Stool. —Entero-colitis, Yellow diarrhoea; worse in the morning. Diarrhcea during typhoid. Relationship, —- Compare, in sexual weakness; Agnus; Keli brom.; Lycop.; Selen.; Yohimbin, In diarrhoea: Chelid.; Gambog.; Sulph.; Nymphea odorata —~ Sweet Water Lily — (early morning diarrhoea, backache).

Dose. — Tincture to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Nux Moschata
remedies.text:
(Nutmeg) Marked tendency to fainting fits, with heart failure. Cold extremities, extreme dryness of mucous membranes and skin. Strange feeling, with irresistible drowsiness, General inclination to become unconscious during acute attacks, Lypothynia. [/gnatio.] Staggers on trying to walk.

Mind. — Changeable; laughing and crying. Confused, impaired memory. Bewildered sense, as in a dream, Thinks she has two heads.

Head. — Vertigo when walking in open air; aches from eating a little too much, Feeling of expansion. with sleepiness. Pulsating in head. Cracking sensation in head, Sensitive to slightest touch in a draught of air, Bursting headache; better hoard pressure.

Eyes. — Objects look larger, very distant, or vanish. Motes before eyes. Mydriasis.

Nose. — Oversensitive to smell; nosebleed, dark blood; dry, stopped up.

Mouth. — Very dry. Tongue adheres to roof of mouth; but no desire for water. Saliva like cotton. [Berb.] Toothache in pregnancy. Tongue numb, paralyzed. Dryness of throat.

Stomach. — Excessively bloated. Flatulent dyspepsia. Hiccough, and craving for highly-seasoned food. Retrocession of gout to stomach. Abdomen, — Paralytic weakness of intestines. Enormously distended. Stovul is soft, and yet is unable te expel it, even with long straining. [Alsm.] Faintness during or after stool, Protruding piles.

Female. — Uterine haemorrhage. Menses too long, dark, thick, Leucorrhoea muddy and bloody, Suppression, with persistent fainting attacks and sleepiness. [Kali c.] Variableness of menstruation, irregularity of time and quantity, Respiratory. ~ Loss of voice from walking against the wind. [Hep.] Cough when getting warm in bed.

Heart. — Trembling, fluttering. Sensation as it something grasped heart. Palpitation; pulse intermits. Extremities. Pain in right hip to knee; worse, motion, especially going upstairs. Rheumatism from getting feet wet, from exposure to draughts, Rheumatism relieved by dry, warm clothes. Fatigue on slight exertion. Sleep.--Great drowsiness. (Indol.) Complaints cause sleepiness. Coma, Fever. — Chill begins in left hand. (Carbo.) Chilliness and heat without thirst; want of perspiration. Dry skin and of inner parts, also of eyes, nose, lips, mouth, tongue, throat, etc.

Modalities. — Worse, cold moist wind, cold food, cold washing, lying on painful side, motion, jar. Better, warmth, dry weather.

Relationship. — Oleum myristice — Oil of Nutmeg — {as a remedy for boils, felons, poisonous ulcers, it has been used in the 2x potency); Ornithogalum (flatulence, swollen feeling across lower chest; whenever she turns in bed, feels as if a bag of water turned also; gastric ulcer and cancer). Myristica Sebifera (phlegmonous inflammations, hastens suppuration; powerful antiseptic. Ulcerative tendency in ali tissues. Said to act more powerfully than Hepar and Silica). Compare: Nux v.; Puls.; Rhus; Ign.; Asof. Antidotes: Camph.; Gels.; Valer. Dose. -—- First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Nux Vomica
remedies.text:
(Poison-nut) Is the greatest of polychrests, because the bulk of its symptoms correspond in similarity with those of the commonest and most frequent of diseases. It is frequently the first remedy, indicated after much dosing, establishing a sort af equilibrium of forces and counteracting predominant drug effects, Nux is pre-eminently the remedy for many of the conditions incident to modern fife. The typical Nux patient is rather thin, spare, quick, active, nervous, and irritable. He does a good deal of mental work; has mental strains and leads a sedentary life, found in prolonged office work, overstudy, and close application to business, with its cares and anxieties. This indoor life and mental strain seeks stimulants, coffee, wine, possibly in excess; or, again, he hopes to quiet his excitement, by indulging in the sedative effects of tobacco, if not really a victim, to the seductive drugs, like opium, etc. These things are associated with other indulgences; at table, he takes preferably rich and stimulating food; wine and women play their part to make him forget the close application of the day. Late hours are a consequence; a thick head, dyspepsia, and irritable temper are the next day’s inheritance. Now he takes some cathartic, liver pills, or mineral water, and soon gets into the habit of taking these things, which still further complicate matters. Since these frailties are more yielded to by men than women, Nux is pre-eminently a male remedy, These conditions produce an irritable, nervous system, hypersensitive and overimpressionable, which Nux wilt do much to soothe and calm. Especially adapted to digestive disturbances, portal congestion, and hypochondrical states depending thereon. Convulsions. with consciousness; worse, touch, moving. Zealous fiery temperament, Nux patients are easily chilled, avoid open air, etc, Nux always seems to be out of tune; inharmonious spasmodic action.

Mind. — Very irritable; sensitive to all impressions. Ugly, malicious. Desires to kilt loved ones; impulse deplored. Cannot bear noises, odors, light, etc. [Bell.] Hypochondriacal mood. Does not want to be touched. Time passes too slowly. [Aim] Even the least ailment affects her greatly, Disposed to reproach others. Suilen, foultfisding.

Head. — Headache in occiput or over eyes, with vertigo; brain feels turning in a circle. Oversensitiveness, Vertigo, with momentary loss of consciousness. Intoxicated feeling; worse, morning, mental exertion, tobacco, alcohol, coffee, open air. Pressing pain on vertex, as if a nail driven in. Vertigo in morning and after dinner. Scalp sensitive.
