Mouth. — Teeth ache and are sensitive and sore to touch, Swelling of cheeks. Salivation; teeth feel too long; worse, cold air and contact. Toothache, better while eating. Profuse flow of saliva. Toothache, with reflex neuralgia of eyelids.

Stool. — Wants to defecate; goes aften, but cannot. Piles so bad, can hardly stand Diarrhoea, with brown watery stools. Urine. —- Profuse flow; nocturnal enuresis. [Rhus avom.; Caust.] Skin. —- Itching and burning; papule. Urticaria, chilbiains. [(Agar.; Tamus.] Poison-oak.

Relationship. — Compare: Kalm.; Cham.; Puts. Dose, — Tincture, and lower potencies. Local use in tonthache in hollow teeth, ootorrhoea, pruritus, and Poison-oak. Incised wounds.

remedies.name: Platanus Occidentalis
remedies.text: (Sycamore-Buttonwood) Tarsal tumors. Apply the tincture. Both acute and old neglected cases, where destruction of tissue occurred and cicatricial contraction caused marked deformity of lid, restored to practically normal conditions. Acts best in children. Must be used*for some time,

remedies.name: Platina
remedies.text:
(The Metal) Is pre-eminently a woman’s remedy. Strong tendency to paralysis, anzsthesia, localized numbness and coldness are shown. Hysterical spasms; pains increase and decrease gradually. {Stannum.) Tremulousness.

Mind. — Irresistible impulse to kill. Self-exaltation; contempt for others. Arrogant, proud. Weary of everything. Everything seems changed. Mental troubles, associated with suppressed menses. Physical symptoms disappear as mental symptoms develop. Head. -~-Tense, pressing pain, confined to a small spot. Cramp-like, squeezing pain. Constriction about forehead and right temples, Numbness, with headache.

Eyes. — Objects look smailer than they ore. Twitching of lids, [Ager.] Eyes feel cold. Cramp-like pain in orhits.

Ears. — Feels numb, Cramp-like twinges. Roaring and rumbling.

Face. — Prosupalgia, with numb feeling in malar bones, as if the parts were between screws. Pain at root of nose, as if squeezed in a vise. Coldness, creeping, and numbness, in whole cight side of face. Pains increase and decrease gradually. [Staun.]

Stomach. — Fermentation, much flatulence; constric- Hon, ravenous hunger; persistent nausea, with anxiety and weakness.

Abdomen. — Painter’s colic. Pain in umbilical region; extending through to back. Pressing and bearing down in abdomen, extending into pelvis.

Stool. — Retarded; faces gganty; evacuated with difficulty. Adheres to rectum, like soft clay. Sticky stool. Constipation of travelers, who are constantly changing food and water. Stool as if burnt.

Female. — Parts hypersensitive. Tingling internally and externally. [Keli brom.; Orig.] Ovaries sensitive and burn. Menses too early, too profuse, dark-clotted, with spasms and painful bearing-down, chifliness, and sdnsitiveness of parts. Nymphamania. Excessive sexual development; vaginismus. Pruritus vulve. Ovaritis with sterility. Abnormal sexual appetite and melancholia.

Extremities. — Tightness of thighs, as if too tightly wrapped. Numb and weary sensation. Feel paralyzed, Sleep, — Sleeps with legs far apart. [Chamom.]

Modalities. — Worse, sitting and standing; evening. Better, walking.

Relationship. — Compare: Rhodium; Stann.; Valer.; Sep. Comparey also: Platinum muriaticxm (this remedy has achieved beneficial results after Iodide uf Pot~ ash failed to cure in syphilitic affection; violent occipital headaches, dysphagia, and syphilitic throat and bone affections); Plot. mur. nat. (polyuria and salivation}; Sedum acre (sexual irritability, relieves irritation of nerve centers and gives rest). Antidote: Puls, Platina antidotes the bad effects of lead.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency, (Iedide of Lead) Has been used empirically in various forms of paralysis, sclerotic degenerations, especially of spinal cord, atrophies, arterio-sclerosis, pellagra. Indwrations of mammary glands, especially when a tendency to become inflamed appears; sore and painful, Indurations of great hardness and associated with a very dry skin. Relationship. —- Compare: 4rg. nit. (painful mammary glands, with tendency to ulcerate, bleeding and proud flesh). Compare, also: Merc, iod. flav.; Asterias; Caninm: Phytol.; Carb. an.; Silic, Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Plumbum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Lead) The great drug for general sclerotic conditions; hardening of tissues from sclerotic processes, The blood, alimentary and nervous systems are the special seats of action of Plumbum. Havnatosis is interfered with, rapid reduction in number of red corpuscles; hence pallor, icterus, ansemia. Delirium, coma and convulsions, Hypertension ang arterio-sclerosis. Trembling, or followed by paralysis. Progressive muscular atrophy. Infantile paralysis. Locomotor ataxia. Excessive and rapid emaciation. Bulbar paralysis. Important in peripherat affections, ‘The points of attack for Plumbum are the neuraxons and the anterior horns. Produces granular degeneration ot red blood corpuscles. Symptoms of multiple sclerosis, posterior spinal sclerosis, Contractions and boring pain.

Mind. — Fear of being assassinaied. Quiet melancholy. Slow perception; toss of memory; amnesic aphasia. Hallucinations and delusions. Intellectual apathy. Memory impaired. [4uue.; Baryia.] Paretic dementia. Head. —- Delirium alterating with colic. Pain as té a ball rose from throat to brain. Hair very dry. Tinnitus. [Chin,; Nat. salic.; Carbon, sulph.} Eyes. — Pupils contracted. Yellow. Optic nerve infiamed. Intraocular, suppurative inflammation Glaxcoma, especially if secondary to spinal lesion. Face.—-Pule and cachectic, Yellow, corpse-like; cheeks sunken. Skin of face greasy, shiny. [Nat mur.; Sanic.) Mouth. -—Gums swollen, pale; distinct bime fines along margins of gums. Tongue tremulous, red on margin. Stomach. Contraction in oesophagus and stomach: pressure and tightness. Gastralgia.

Abdomen. — Excessive colic, radiating to all purts of body. Abdominal wall feels drawn by a string to spine. Pain causes desire t stretch, Intussusception; strangu- ' lated hernia. Abdomen retracted. Obstructed flatus. with intense colic. Colic alternates with delirium and pain in atrophied limbs. Rectum, — Constipation; steels hard. Jumpy, bluck~ with urging and spasm of anus. Obstructed evacuation from impaction of faeces. [#/at.] Neuralgia of rectum,.duus drawn up with constriction.

Urinary. — Frequent, ineffectual tenesmtts. Albuminous; low specific gravity. Ch onic interstitial nephritis, with great pain in aldomen, Urine scanty.

Male. — Loss of sexual power. Testicles drawn up, feel constricted. Female. —Vagintsmus. Induration of mammary glands. [Planb. iod.] Stitches and burning pains in breasts..[Apis; Con.; Carb. an.; Sil] Tendency to abortion. Heart. -— Cardiac weakness. Pulse soft and small, dichrotic. Wiry pulse, cramp-like constriction of peripheral arteries..

Back. — Spinal cord sclerosed. Lightning-tike pains, especially in thighs; temporarily better by pressure. Paralysis of lower extremities, Skin. — Yellow, dark-brown liver spots. Jaundice. Dry. Dilated veins of forearms and legs.

Extremities. — Paralysis of single muscles. Cannot raise or lift anything with the hand. Extension is difficult. Paralysis from overexertion of the extensor muscles in piano players. [Cwrarc.] Pains in muscles of thighs; come in paroxysms, Wrist-drop. Cramps in calves, Paralysis. Feet swollen. Pain'in atrophied limbs alternates with colic. Loss of patellar reflex. Hands and feet cold. Pain in right big toe at night, very sensitive to touch.

Modalities. — Worse, at night, motion. Better, rubbing, hard pressure, physical exertion. [Alumen.]

Relationship. — Compare; Plumb, acet. (painful cramps in paralyzed limbs; severe pain and muscular cramps in gastric ulcer; locally, as an application (nonhomeopathic) in moist eczema, and to dry up secretions from mucous surfaces. Care must be used, as sufficient lead can be absorbed to produce lead poison, one to two drams of the liquor plumbi subacetatis to the ounce of water; also in pruritus pudendi, equal parts of the liquor plumbi and glycerin), Compare: Alumina; Plat.; Opium; Podoph.; Merc.; Thall, Plectranthus (paralysis, ‘spastic, spinal form); Plumb. chromicum (convulsions, with terrible pains; pupils greatly dilated; retracted abdomen); Piumb. phosph. (loss of sexual power; locomotor ataxia). Antidotes: Plat.; Alum.; Petrol.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Podophyllum
remedies.text:
(May-apple) Is especially adapted to persons of bilious temperament, It affects chiefly the duodenum, smal! intestines, liver, and rectum. Many troubles during pregnancy; pendulous abdomen after confinement; prolapsus uteri; patiless cholera morbus. Torpidity of the liver; portal engorgement with a tendency to haemorrhoids, hypogastric pain, fullness of superficial veins, jaundice.

Mind. — Loquacity and delirium from eating acid fruits. Depression of spirits.

Head. — Vertigo, with tendency to fall forward. Headache, dull pressure, worse morning, with heated face and bitter taste; alternating with diarrhoea. Rolling of head from side to side, with moaning and vomiting and eyelids half closed. Child perspires on head during sleep.

Mouth. — Grinding the teeth at night; intense desire to press the gums together. [Phytol.} Difiigult den-s tition. Tongue broad, large, motst. Fou!, putrid taste. Burning sensation of tongue. Stomach, — Hot, sour belching; nausea and vomiting. Thirst for large quantities of cold water. [Ary.] Vomiting of hot, frothy mucus, Heartburn; gagging of empty retching. Vomiting of milk.

Abdomen. — Distended; heat and emptiness. Sensation of weakness or sinking. Can lie comfortably only on stomach. Liver region painful, better rubbing part. Rumbling and shifting o7 flatus in ascending colon.

Rectum. — Cholera infantum and morbus, Diarrhoea of Jong standing; carly in morning; during teething, with hot, glowing cheeks while being bathed or washed; in hot weather after acid fruits. Morning, painless diarrhoea when not due to venous stasis or intestinal ulceration. Green, watery, fetid, profuse, gushing. Prolapse of rectum before or with stool. Constipation; clay-colored, hard, dry, difficult. Constipation alternating with diarrhoea [Axt, erwd.) Internal and external piles.

Female. — Pain in uterus and right ovary, with shiftmg gases along ascending colon. Suppressed menses, with pelvic tenesmus, Prolapsed uteri, especially after parturition. Haemorrhoids, with prolapsus ani during pregnancy. Prolapsus from overlifting or straining; during pregnancy. Frequent urination at night.

Extremities. — Pain between shoulders, under right scapula, in loins and Jumbar region. Pain in right inguinal region; shoots down inner thigh to knee. Paralytic weakness on left side, Fever. — Chill at 7 a.™., with pain in hypochondria, and knees, ankles, wrists. Great loguacity during fever. Profuse sweat.

Modalities. — Worse, in early morning, in hot weather, during dentition. Relationship. Compare: Aloc; Chelid.; Merc; Nux,; Sulph.

Dose. — Tincture to sixth potency. The 200th and 1000th seem to do good work in chulera infantam, when indicated.

remedies.name: Polygonum Punctatum
remedies.text:
(Smartweed) Amenorrhea in young girls. Rectal pockets. Burning in stomach followed by feeling of coldness in the pit of the stomach. Alternate chills and heat. Varicosis. Abdomen. —Griping pain, with great rumbling, nausea, and liquid faeces. Flatulent colic.

Rectum. — Interior of anus studded with itching eminence, Hamarrhoids. Liquid faces. iUrinary. — Painful constriction at neck of bladder. ees long time. # je. — Aching pains in hips and loins. Sensation as tf hips were being draun together, Sensation of weight and tension within pelvis, Shooting pains through breasts. Amenorrhza.

Skin. — Superficial ulecrs and sores on lower extremities, especially in females at climacteric.

Relationship. — Compare: Carduus mar. (ulcers); Hamam; Puls.; Senecio; Potygonum persicarie (renal colic and calculi; yangrene); Polygonum eviculare — knot-grass — (in material doses of tincture, found useful in phthisis pulmonalis and intermittent iever, and especially in arteriosclerosis, Erythema).

Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Polyporus Pinicola
remedies.text:
(Pine Agaric) Useful in intermittent, remittent and bilious fevers. with headache, yellow tongu¢, constant nausea, faint~ ness at episgastrium, and constipation. Similar to its hotanicai relative, Poalyp. officinalis, or Bolctus laricis, gq. U.

Fever. — Great lassitude, congestion of head, with sertigo, face hot and fiushed, prickling sensation all over: restless at night from pain in wrists and knee; rheumatic pains; profuse perspiration. Headache about 10 a. M., with pain in back, ankles and tegs increasing until 3 r.., then gradually better.

remedies.name: Populus Candicans
remedies.text:
(Balm of Gilead) Seems to have a remathable power over acute colds, especially when accompanied by a deep, hoarse voice, or ever. aphonia. General insensibility of surface (worse, hack and abdomen); rubbing and pounding borne without pain, and is grateful on account of warmth produced. Finger-ends thickened, horny; imsensible to pinching and pricking. Instantaneous voice-producer. [Coca.]

Head. — Discusses her symptoms with every one. Hot head with cold extremities, Cold-sores on lips. [Nat. mur.] Tongue feels thick and numb. Burning irritation of eyes, nose, mouth, throat, and air passages, Respiratory. — Acute hoarsencss, Throat and nostrils burn. Sits bent forward with dry cough. Pharynx and larynx feel dry, and the voice weak and toneless, Rawness and soreness of chest and throat, Cough of children caused by naso-pharyngeal catarrh; mucus drops from posterior nares. Dose. —- Tincture.

remedies.name: Populus Tremuloides
remedies.text:
(American Aspen) The gastric and urinary symptoms point to its usefulness in dyspepsia and catarrh of the bladder, especially in old people, Good remedy in vesical troubles after operations and in pregnancy. Cystitis. Fullness of head, and sensation of heat of the surfaces of the body. Night-sweats. Ague.

Stomach. — Jndigestion, with flatulence and acidity. Nausea and voniting.

Urine. — Severe tenesmus; painful scalding. Urine contains mucus and pus. Prostate enlarged. Pain behind pubis, at end of urination, Relationship. — Compare: Nux; Chino; Cornus flor.; grote Cantharis, “Pose. — Tincture or Populin trit. 1x.

remedies.name: Pothos Foetidus
remedies.text:
(Skunk-cabbage — Ictodes} For asthmatic complaints; worse from inhaling any dust, Hysteria. Erratic spasmodic pains. “Wilt-o’-thewisp” like character of its subjective symptoms and its physometric property are special features. (Samuel Jones.) Inflation and tension in the abdomen, Millar's asthma.

Head. — Absent-minded, irritable. Headache in single spots, with violent pulsation of temporal arteries, Outward drawing from glabella. Better in open air. [Puls.] Red swelling across the bridge of the nose.

Abdomen. — /nflation and fension in abdomen.

Respiratory. — Spasmodic croup. Troublesome res- Piration, with sudden feeling of anguish and sweat. Sneezing, with pain in throat. Pain in chest, with difficult breathing. Tongue feels numb, Asthma; refieved by stool. Dose, — Tincture and Jower potencies.

remedies.name: Primula Veris
remedies.text:
(Cowslip) Cerebra] congestion, with neuralgia; migraine; rheumatic and gouty pains, Head. — Sensation of a band around head; cannot keep hat on. (Carbol. ac.] Skin of forehead tense. Fear of falling when standing up. Violent vertigo, as if everything turned around. Buzzing in ears; better in open air.

Respiratory. — Cough, with burning and pricking in respiratory tracts, Weak voice.

Urinary. — Urine smells strongly of violets.

Extremities. — Right axillary muscles painful. Weight and lassitude in fintas, especially the shoulders. Burning in hellow of tight hand. Drawing pain in thumb and big toc Relationship. —- Compare: Cyclamen; Raaiwnae.; Genothera — Evening Primrose — (exhausting, watery diarthea; cholera infantum; hydrocephaloid); Prinula farinasa — the wild Primrose —~ (dermatitis, especially on index fingers and thumbs.) Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Primula Obconica
remedies.text: (Primrose) The poison of the Primrose oecurs in its gluaduler fars, whieh break easdy and- discharge an irritating fhad which is absorbed into the shin. But skin symptoms of poisoning appear in sensitive patients even without coming in direct contact with the plant. mere nearness being sufficient, just like Poison wy. Jutermittency of symptoms; worse right side. Pain in liver and spleen, Deep infiltration and tension of tissues; blisters. Paralysed sensation, Weakness. Pharyngeal soreness alternates with diminished facial irritation, Face.—- Moist eczema. Papular eruption on chin. Burns at night. Urticaria-like eruption. Eyelids swollen. Extremities, — Eczema on arms, wrists, forearms, hands, papular and excoriated. Rheumatic pain around shoulder. Palms dry and hot. Cracking over joints and fingers. Eruption hetween fingers. Purpie blotches on back of hands, palmar surface stiff. Blisters on fingers. in. — Great ticking, worse at night, red and swollen like erystpelas, Tumefied. Small papules on a raised base. Skin symptoms accompanied hy febrile symptoms, Relationship. —— Compare: Kitus; Fegopyrun (Antidotal). Hiusea Klevans, similar skin symptoms.

remedies.name: Propylamin
remedies.text:
(Distilled Herring-brine) In acute rkeamatism, dissipates fever and pain in 2 day or two. Rheumatic prosopalgia, and rheumatic metastases, vspecially heart lesions, Extremities. — Pain i wrists and ankles, worse, slightest motion, [Bry] Great restlessness and thirst. Rheumatism, needle held in fingers gets too heavy. Tingling and numbness f fingers. Vain in wrist and ankle, unable to stand.

Dose. — Ten to fifteen drops, in about six ounces of water; teaspooniul doses every two hours.

remedies.name: Prunus Spinosa
remedies.text:
(Black-thorn) Special action on the urinary organs and head. Very valuable in certain neusalgias, anasarca, and especially oedema pedum. Ankle and foot feel sprained. Ciliary neuralgia, [Sptg.; Saponin.]

Head. — Pressing-asunder pain heneath skull. Shooting from right frantal bone through brain to occiput, Pain in right cyeball, as if it would burst. Piercing toothache, as if teeth were pulfed out; worse, taking anything warm.

Eyes. — Ciliary neuralgia. Bursting pain in right eyehall, shooting like lightuing through the brain to occiput. Sudden pain in left cye as if it would burst, better by lachrymation. Irido-choroiditis. Opacity of vitreous humor. Eyes feel as if bursting.

Abdomen. — Ascites. Cramp-like pain in bladder region; worse, walking.

Rectum. — Hard, nodular stool, with rectal pain, as if angular body were pressed inward, Burning in anus after slimy diarrhoea.

Urine. — Tenesmus of bladder. Ineffectual effort to urinate. Hurriedly impelled to urinate; the urine seems to pass as far as glans, and then returns and causes poin in urethra, Neuralgic dysuria. Must press a long time bcfore urine appears.

Respiratory. — Wheezing when walking. Oppression of chest; anxious, short respiration. Angina pectoris, Furious heating of heart; worse, slightest motion.

Skin. — Herpes zoster. Dropsy. Itching on tips of fingers, as if frozen.

Relationship. — Compare: Lourec.; Prunus padus — Bird-cherry ~- (sore throat, pressure behind sternum and sticking pain in rectum}; Prunus Virginiana — Wild Cherry ~~ (heart tonic; relieves the flagging and distended ventricle; irritable heart; dilatation of right heart; cough, worse at night on tying down; weak digestion, especially in elderly people}; Pyrus— Mountain. Ash — (irritation of eyes; constriction around waist; spasmodic pains in uterus, bladder, heart, coldwater sensation in stomach, coldness extends up 2#sophagus; neuralgic and gouty pains).

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Psorinum
remedies.text:
(Scabies Vesicle) The therapeutic field of this remedy is found in socalled psoric manifestations. Psorinum -is a cold medicine; wants the head kept warm, wants warm clothing even in summer, Extreme sensitiveness to cold. Debility, independent of any organic disease, especiatly the weakness remaining after acute disease. Lack of ve-* action, i, ¢., phagocytes defective; when welt-chosen remedies fail to act, Scrofulous patients. Secretions have a filthy smell. Profuse sweating. Cardiac weakness, Skin symptoms very prominent. Often gives immunity from cold-catching. Easy perspiration when walking. Syphilis, inherited and tertiary, Offensive discharges, Mind. — Hopeless; despairs of recovery. Melancholy, deep and persistent; religious, Suicidal tendency.

Head. — Awakens at night with pain as from blow on head. Chronic headaches; hungry during attacks; with vertigo. Hammering pain; brain feels too large; worse, change of weather. Dull, pressive pain in occiput. Humid eruption on scalp; hair matted. Hair dry. Eyes, — Agglutinated. Blepharitis. Chronic ophthalmia, that constanily recurs, Edges of lids red, Secretion acrid, Mouth. — Obstinate rhagades at corners. Tongue, gums ulcerated; tough mucus of foul taste adheres to soft palate.

Nose. — Dry, coryza, with stoppage of nose. Chronic catarrh; dropping from posterior nares. Acne rosacea. Ears. -— Raw, red, oozing scabs around cars, Sore pain behind ears. Herpes from temples over ears to cheeks. Offensive discharge from cccema ardund ears. Intolerable itching. Chronic ootorrhoea, Most fetid pus from ears [Tellur.], brownish, offensive. Deafness, Face. — Swelling of upper lip. Pale, delicate. Humid eruption on face. Sickly.

Throat. — Tonsifs greatly swollen; painful swallowing, with pain in ears. Profuse, offensive saliva; tough mucus in throat. Recurring quinsy. Eradicates tendency to quinsy. Tlawking up of cheesy, pea-like balls of disgusting smell and taste. {Agar.) Stomach. — Eructations like bad eggs. Very hungry always; must have something to cat in the middle of the night. Nausea; vomiting of pregnancy. Pain in abdomen after eating.

Stool. — Mucous, bloody, excessively fetid, dark fixid. Hard, difficult stool, with blood from rectum and burning piles. Constipation of infants, especially in pale, sickly scrofulous children. [Coullinson.} Female. — Leucorrhara fetid, lumpy, with much lackache and dcbslity. Mamme swollen and painful. Pimples oozing an acrid fluid that burns and excoriates the glands.

Respiratory. — Asthma, with dyspnoea; worse, sitting up; better, lying down and keeping arms spread wide apart. Dry, hard cough, with great weakness in chest. Feeling of ulceration wnudcr sternum. Pain in chest; better, lying down, Cough returns every winter, from suppressed eruption, Hay-fever returning irregularly every year.

Extremities. — Weakness of joints, as if they would not hold together. Eruption around finger-nails, Fetid foot-sweats.

Skin. — Dirty, dingy look. Dry, lustreless, rough hair, Intolerable ttching. Herpetic eruptions, especially on scalp and bends of joints with itching; worse, from warmth of bed. Enlarged glands, Sebaceous glands secrete excessively; oily skin. Indolent ulcers, slow to heai, Eczema behind ears. Crusty eruptions all over, Urticaria after every exertion. Pustules near finger-nails,, Fever, — Profuse perspiration; night-sweats.

Sleep. — Sleeptess from intolerable itching. Easily startled. Frightful dreams.

Modalities. — Horse, coffee; Psorinum patient does uot improve while using coffee. Worse, changes of weather, in hot sunshine, from cold; in winter. Better, heat, warm clothing, even in summer. Relationship. —- Complementary: Sulphur. Compare: Pediculus — Head-louse — (psoric manifestations in chitdren, Eruption on dorsum of hands, feet, neck. Prurign; pellagra. Unusual aptitude for study and work). Pedicnius (Cooties} transmit typhus and trench fever. Tuber, Hepar, Su.; fad. In lack of reaction compare Cafeurca and Natrust ars, Dose.— Two hundredth and higher potencies. Should not be repeated too often.

remedies.name: Ptelea
remedies.text:
(Wafer-ash) Is a remarkehle remedy in stomach and liver affection, The achmg aid heaviness in the region of the hver is greatly aygratiicd by tying on the left side. cHtonic states of stomach. Asthma. Head, — Feels dull and stupid. Pam from forehead te root of nose; pressing-outward pain. Frontal headcehe; worse, noise, motion, night, rubbing eyes, with acidity. Temples as if pressed together. Mouth —- Excess of saliva, with dry bitter taste, Tongue coated white or yellow; feels rough, swollen. Papille red and prominent, [ciry. 4.) Coating may be brownish-yellow. Stomach. —- Weight and fullness. Griping in epigastric region, with dryness of mouth. Eructations, nausea, vomiting, Constant sensation of corrosion, heat and burning in stomach. Stomach feels empty after eating. Stomach and fiver symptoms associated with pain in hmbs.

Abdomen. — Much weight and pain in right side; heavy, aching feeling, relieved by lying on right side. Liver sore, swollen, sensitive to pressure. Retraction of abdomen, Respiratory. —- Feeling of pressure on lungs and of suffocation, when lying on back. Asthma; dyspnoea; cramp-like pain in cardiac region. Sleep. —- Restless, with frightful dreams; nightmare, awakes languid and unrefreshed.

Modalities. — Worse, lying on left side; early morning. Better, eating sour things, Relationship.— Compare: <Afercur.; Magn. mur.; Nux,; Chelid, Dose, — First to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Pulex Irritans
remedies.text:
(Common Flea) Marked urinary and female symptoms. Head, -— Very impatient, cross, and irritable. Frontal headache, with enlarged feeling of eyes, Face werinkicd and old-looking.

Mouth. — Metallic taste. Sensation of a thread in throat. Thirsty, especially during headache.

Stomach. — Breath and taste foul. Intense nausea, with vomiting, purging, and faintness. Stool very offensive, Abdomen bloated. Urine, — Scanty with frequent urging, with pressure on bladder and burning in urethra, Flow stops suddenly followed ty pain. Urine toul. Cannot retain urine; must attend to the call without delay. Irritable bladder before menses.

Female. — Menses detayed. Increased fiow of saliva during. Intense burning in vagina. Leucorrhca, profuse, foul, staining a greenish yellow; stains of menses and leucorrhoea very hard to wash out. Backache. {Oxal, ac.]

Back. — Aches, weak; drawing of muscles below scapulza.

Fever. — Feels a glow all over, like being over steam; chilly, while sitting heside the fire.

Skin. — Prickty itching. Sore spots alt over. Skin emits foul cdor.

Modalities. — Better, sitting or lying down. Worse, left side: moving about.

Dose. — The higher poteticies.

remedies.name: Pulsatilla
remedies.text:
(Wind-F lower) The disposition and mental state are the chief guiding symptoms to the selection of Pulsatilla, It is preeminently a female remedy, especially for mild, gentle, yielding disposition. Sad, crying readily; weeps when talking; changeable, contradictory. The patient seeks the open air; always feels better there. Mucous membranes are all affected. Discharges thick, bland, and yellowish-green. Often indicated after abuse of Iron tonics, and after badly-managed measles. Symptoms ever changing. Thirstless, peevish, and chilly, When first serious impairment of health is referred to age of puberty. Great sensitiveness. Wants the head high. Feeis uncomfortable with only one pillow.

Mind. — Weeps easily. Timid, irresolute. Likes sympathy. Easily discouraged. Morbid dread of the opposite sex. Religious melancholy. Given to extremes of pleasure and pain. Highly emotional.

Head. — Wandering stitches about head; pains exevening and by warmth, Bursting, semilateral headache, with nausea and vomiting, from overloaded tend to face and teeth; vertigo; better in open air. Frontal and supraorhital pains mostly; worse in the stomach. [#ry.; Nur.) Neuraigic pains, commencing in right temporal region, with scalding lachrymation of affected side. Headache from overwork. Pressure on vertex.

Ears. — Sensation as if semething were being forced outward. Hearing difficult, as if the ear were stuffed. Otorrhoea. Thick, bland discharge; offensive oder, External ear swollen and red, Catarrhal otitis. Otalgia, worse at night, Eyes.— Thick, profuse, yellow, bland discharges. Itching and burning in eyes. Profuse Jachrymation and secretion of mucus, tds inflamed, auglutinated. Styes, Veins of fundus oculi greatly enlarged. Ophthalmia neonaterum, Subacute conjunctivitis, with dyspepsia; worse, in warm room.

Nose. — Coryza; stoppage of right nostril, pressing pain at rout of nose. Loss of smell, Large green fetid scales in nose. Stoppage in evening. Yellow mucus; abundant in morning. Bad smeils, as of old catarrh. Nasal bones sore. Face, — Right-sided neuralgia, with profuse lachrymation. Swelling of lower lip, which is cracked in middle. Prosopalgia towards evening till midnight; chilly, with pain. Mouth. -— Greasy taste. Dry mouth, withoul thirst. Frequently licks the dry lips, Crack in middle of lower lip. Yellow or white tongue, covered with a tenacious muces. Tovthache; relieved by holding cold water in mouth. [Coff.} Offensive odor from mouth, [Merc.; Aur] Food, especially bread, tastes hitter. Much secet saliva. iterations of taste, hitter, bilious, greasy, salty, foul. Loss of taste. Stomach, — verse to fat food, warm food, and drink. Eructations; taste of food remains a tong time; alter ices, fruits, pastry, Bitter taste, diminished taste of all food. Pain as from subcutaneous ulceration, Distikes butter. [Savg.} Heartbura, Dyspepsia, with great tightness aiter a meal; must loasen clothing, Thirsé- fessness, with nearly all complaints. Vomiting of food eaten Jong before. Pain in stomach an hour after eating. [Nur] Weight as from a stone, especially in nosning on awakening. Gnawing, hungry feeling. [Abies ¢.} Perceptible pulsation in pit of stomach. [Asaf] All-gone setisation, especially in tea drinkers. Waterbrash, with foul taste in the morning, Abdomen. — Painful, distended; loud rumbling. Pressure as from a stone. Colic, with chilliness in evening.

Stool. — Rumbling, watery: worse night. A’o fwe stools ake. After fruit. [-drs.; Chin.) Blind haemorrhoids, with itching and sticking pains, Dysentery; mucus and blood, with chilliness. Uerc.; Rheum.] Two or three normal stools daily.

Urine. — Increased desire; worse when lying down. Burning in orifice of arethra during and after micturition. Involuntary micturition at night, while coughing or passing flatus. After urinating, spasmodic pain in bladder, Femate.— Amenorrhea. [Cimicif.; Senec.; Polygon.) Suppressed menses from wet feet, nervous dehility, or chlorosis. Tardy menses, Too fate, scanty, thick, dark, clotted, changeable, intermittent. Chilliness, nausea. downward pressure, painful, flow intermits. Leucorrhoea acrid, burning, creamy, Pain in back; tired feeling. Diarrhoea during or after menses.

Male. — Qgchitis; pain irom abdomen to testicles. Thick, yellow discharge from urethra; fate stage of gonorrhoea. Stricture; urine passed only in drops, and stream interrupted. [Clemat.] Acute prostatitis. Pain and tenesmus in urinating, worse lying on “Back.

Respiratory. — Capricious hoarseness; comes and goes. Dry cough in cvening and at night; must sit up in bed to get relicf; and loose cough in the morning, with copious mucus expectoration. Pressure upon the chest and soreness, Great soreness of episgastrium. Urine emitted with cough. [Cawst.] Pain as from ulcer in middle of chest. Expectoration bland, thick, bitter, greenish, Short breath, anxiety, and palpitation when lying on left side. [Phos.] Smothering sensation on lying down.

Sleep. — Wide awake in the evening; first sleep restless. Wakes languid, unrefreshed. Irresistible sleepiness in afternoon. Sleeps with hands over head.

Back. — Shooting pain in the nape and back, between shoulders; in sacrum after sitting. Extremities, — Drawing, tensive pain in thighs and legs, with restlessness, sleeplessness and chilliness. Pain in limbs, shifting rapidly; tensive pain, letting up with a snap. Numbness around elbow. Hip-joint painful. Knees swollen, with tearing, drawing pains. Boring pain in heels toward evening; suffering worse from letting the affected limb hang down. ([Vipera.) Veius in forearms and hands swollen. Feet red, inflamed, swollen. Legs feel heavy and weary.

Skin. — Urticaria, after rich fvod, with diarrhoea, from delayed menses, worse undressing. Measles. Acne at puberty. Varicose veins, Fever. — Chilliness, even in warm room, without thirst. Chilly with pains, in spots, worse evening, Chill about 4 r.™. Intolerable burning heat at night, with distended veins; heat in parts of body, coldness in other. One-sided sweat; pains during sweat. Externat heat is intolerable, veins ure distended, During apyrexia, headache, diarrhoea, loss of appetite, nausea. Modalities — Worse, from heat, rich fat food. after eating, towards evening, warm room, lying on left or on painless side, when allowing feet to hang down. Better, open air, motion, cold applications, cold food and drinks, though not thirsty.

Relationship. — Puisatilla Nuttaliana, identical effects. Compare: Cyclamen; Kali bich.; Kali sulph.; Sulphur, Pimenta — Allspice — (one-sided neuralgias, parts of body hot and cold). Anagyris (headache, amenorrhea), Complementary: Coffea; Chamom.; Nux.

Dose. — Third to thirticth attenuation.

remedies.name: Pyrogenium
remedies.text:
(Artificial Sepsin) This remedy was introduced by English Homeopathists, prepared from decoinposed lean beef allowed to stand in the sun for two weeks and then potentized. The provings and most of the clinical experience have been obtained from this preparation, But, subsequently, Dr. Swan potentized some septic pus, which preparation has also been proved and clinically applied. There does not seem to be any matked difference in their effects. Pyrogen is the great remedy for septic states, with intense restlessness. “In septic fevers, especially puerperal, Pyrogen has demonstrated its great value as a homeopathic dynamic antiseptic.” (H.C. Allen.) Hectic, typhoid, typhus, ptomaine poisoning, diphtheria, dissecting wounds, sewer-gas poisoning, chronic malaria, after-effects of miscarriage, all these conditions at times may present symptoms calling for this unique medicine, All discharges are horribly offensive — menstrual, lochial, diarrhoea, vomit, sweat, breath, etc. (areat pain and violent burning in abscesses. Chronic complaints that date back to septic conditions. Threatening heart failure in zymotic and septic fevers. Mind, — Fall of anxiety and insane notions, Loquacious. Thinks he is very wealthy, Restless, Feels if crowded with arms and legs, Cannot tell whether dreaming while awake or asleep. Head, — Painless throbbing. Fan-like motion of alx nasi. [Liye.; Phos. Bursting headache with restlessness.

Mouth. — Tongue real and dry, clean, cracked, smooth, as though varnished. Throat dry, articulation difficult. Nausea and vomiting. Taste terribly fetid. Breath horrible, Stomach. — Cofiec-grounds vomiting. Vomuts water, when it becomes warm in stomach, Abdomen, — Intolerable tenesmus of both bladder and rectum. Bloated, sore, cutting pain. Stool, — Diarrhwa, hornbly offensive, brown-black, painless, involuntary. Constipation, with complete inettia [Opina:]: obstinate from impaction, Stools large, Whack, carrion-like, or smal! black balls.

Heart. — Tired feeling about heart. Palpitation Sensation as if hearf were too full, Always can hear her heart beat. Pulse abnormally rapid, out of proportion to the temperature. Pain iu region of left nipple. Conscious of heart.

Female. — Puerperal peritonitis, with extreme fetur. Septicamia following abortion. Menses horribly offensive. Uterine haemorrhages, Fever at each menstrual period, conseyvent upon latent pelvic inflammation, Septic puerperal infection (12x).

Fever. — Coldness and chilliness. Septic fevers. Latent pyogenic condition, Chill begins in back. Temperature iises rapidly. Great heat with profuse hot sweat, but stveating dacs not cause a fall in temperature.

Extremities. — Throbling in vessels of neck. Numbnes of hands, arms, feet, Aching in all limbs and bones. Bed feels too hard. {Arn.] Great debility in the morning. Soreness; better by motion. [RAns.} Rapid decubitus of septic origin. Skin. ~—Smail cut or injury becomes much swollen and inflamed — discolored. Wry., Sleep.— Seems to be in semi-sleep. Dreams all night, Modalities. — Relief from motion.

Relationship. — Compare: Sireptocein (anti-febrile action; septic symptoms in infectious diseases}, Rapid in its action, especially in its effect on temperature; Staphylocin (Shedd) in. diseases where the staphylococcus is the chief hacterial factor, as acne, abscess, furuncle; empyema, endocarditis, etc.); Scepin—~A toxin of Proteus vulgaris, prepared by Dr. Shedd, same symptoms as Pyrogen, of which it is the main constituent; Echinacea; Carbo; Ars; Lach.; Rhus; Bapt.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth and higher potencies. Should not be repeated too frequently,

remedies.name: Quassia
remedies.text:
(Quassia-wood) Acts on gastric organs as a tonic. [Gentian; Hydr.] Seems to possess marked action on eyes, producing amblyopia and cataract.

Stomach. — Atonic dyspepsia, with gas and acidity. Heartburn and gastralgia. Regurgitation of food. Abdomen feels empty and retracted.

Urinary. — Excessive desire-— impossible to retain urine; copious micturition day and night. As soon as the child wakes up the bed is drenched, Extremities.~— Inclination to yawn and stretch. [Rhus.] Sensation of coldness over back. Prostration, with hunger, Cold extremities, with sensation of internal coldness. [Helodcrma.] Dose, — First to third potency. QUERCUS GLANDIUM SPIRITUS (Spirit distilled from Tincture of Acorn Kernela) Used first by Rademacher for chronic spleen affections; spleen-dropsy. Antidotes effects of Alcohol. Vertigo; deafness, with noises in head. Takes away craving for alcoholics; give dose as below for several months. Dropsy and liver affections, Useful in gout, oid malarial cases with flatulence.

Relationship. — Compare: Angelica in tincture, five drops, three times daily, produces disgust for liquor; also for atony of different organs, dyspepsia, nervous headache, etc.; chronic bronchitis to increase expectoratiom,: Ceanoth.: Lach.; Nat. mur.; Helianthus (spleen enlarged and painful).

Dose. — Ten drops to a teaspoonful of the distilled spirit to three to four tines a day. A passing diarrhoea often appears for a time when using it. Curative effect.

remedies.name: Quillaya Saponaria
remedies.text:
(Chile Soap-bark) Produces and cutes symptoms of acute catarrh, sneezing and sore throat, Most effective in the beginning of coryca, frequently checking its further development. Colds with sore throat: heat and dryness of throat. Cough with difficult expectoration.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali hyd.; Gels.; Cepa. Saponeria (sore throat, involunary urination).

Dose. — Tincture and first potency.

remedies.name: Radium
remedies.text:
(Radium Bromide) An important addition to the Materia Medica, especially since the provings by Diffenbach have precisionized its use. Radium brom. of 1,800,000 radio-activity was employed. Found effective in the treatment of rheumatism and gout, in skin affections generally, acne rosacea, navi, moles, ulcers and cancers. Lowered blood pressure. Severe aching pains all over, with restlessness, better moving about. Marked increase in the polymorphonuclear neutrophiles, Great weakness.

Mind. — Apprehensive, depressed; fear of being alone in the dark; great desire to be with people. Tired and irritable..

Head. — Vertigo, with pain in back of head, left when in bed. Occipital and vertex pain, accompanying severe lumbar aching. Scvere pain over right eye, spreading hack to acciput and to vertex, better in open air. Head feels heavy. Frontal headache, Both eyes ache. Itching and dryness of nasal cavities, better in open air. Aching pain in angle of right lower jaw. Vivlent trifacial neuralgia.

Mouth. — Dryness of mouth, Metallic taste. Pricklux sensation on end of tongue.

Stomach. — Empty feeling in stomach. Warm sensation in stomach. Aversion to sweets, ice-creatn. Nausea and sinking sensation, belching of gas, Abdomen, — Pain, viulent cramps, rumbling, full of gas, pain over McLurney’s point, and at lecation of sigmoid flexure. Much flatulence: Alternating constipation and Jonse movements, Pruritus ani and piles.

Urinary. — Sncreased elimination of solids, particularly of chlorides, Rena! irritation, albuminuria, granular and hyaline casts, Nephritis with rheumatic symptoms.

Female. — Pruritus vulyx. Delayed and irregular menstruation and backache. Aching pains in abdomen ovcr pubes when flow comes on, Right breast sore, relieved by hard rubbing.

Respiratory. — Persistent cough with tickling in suprasternal fossa. Dry, spasmodic cough. Throat dry, sure, chest constricted. Back, —- Aching in back of neck. Pain and lameness m cervical vertebra, worse dropping head forward, better standing, or sitting erect. Lumbar and sacrut Lackache, pain appears te he in dene, continued motion relieves. Backache between shoulders and lumbar-sacral region, better alter walking.

Extremities. — Severe pain in all the limbs, joints, especially in knee and ankles, sharp pains in shoulders, arms, hands and fingers. Legs, arms and neck feel hard and brittle, as though they would break on moving. Arms feel heavy, Cracking in shoulder, Pain in toes, calves, hip-joint, popliteal spaces, Muscles of legs and hips sore. Arthritis, aching pains, worse at night.

Skin. — Smal! pimples. Erythema and dermatitis. with itching, burning, swelling and redness. Necrosis anoe ulceration. Itching all over body, burning of skin, as if afire, Sleep. — Restless, Sleepiness with lethargy. Dreams vivid, busy.

Fever. — Cold sensation internally, with chattering of teeth until noon. Internal chilliness followed by heat of the skin, associated with bowel imovements and flatulence. Modalities, — Beticr, open air, continued motion, hot Lath, lying down, pressure. Isorse, getting up.

Relationship. — Compare: X-Ray; Rhus; Sepia. Craniton; Ars.; Pulsat.; Caustic. Antidotes: Khus ven.; Tellur.

Dose. — Thirtieth and twelfth trituration

remedies.name: Ranunculus Bulbosus
remedies.text:
(Buttercup) Acts especially upon the muscular tissue and skin, and its most characteristic effects are upon the chest walls, like pleurodynia. Bud effects of Alchohol: delirium tremens, Spasmodic hiccough. Hydrothorax. Shocks throughout the whole body.

Head. — Irritable, pains in forehead and eyeballs. Creeping sensation in scalp. Eyes. —- Day-blindness; mist before eyes; pressure and smartng in eyes, as from smoke. Pain over right eye; better, standing and walking. Herpes on cornea. Vesicles on cornea, with intense pain, photophobia, and lachrymation.

Chest. — Various kinds of pains and soreness, as tf bruised in sternum, ribs, intercostal spaces, and both hypochondria. /#tercostal rheumatism. Chilliness in chest when walking in open air. Stitches in chest, between shoulder-blades; worse, inspiring, moving. Rheumatic pain in chest, as from subcutaneous ulceration. Tenderness of abdomen to pressure, Muscular bain along lower margin of the shoulder-blade; burning in smail spots from sedentary employment.

Skin. — Burning and intense itching; worse, contact. Hard excrescences. Herpetic eruptions, with great itchwg. Shingles; bluish vesicles. Itching in palms. Blister-like eruption in palms, Corns sensitive. Horny skin, Finger-tips and palms chapped. Vesicular and pustular eruptions. Modalities. -— #orsr, open air, motion, contact, atmospheric changes, wet, stormy weather, evening. Cold air brings on all sorts of ailments.

Relationship. — Incompatible; Sufph.; Staph. Compare: Ranunc. acris (pain in tumbar muscles and joints by bending and turning body); Ranunc. glacialis —Carlina— (enormous weight in head with vertigo and sensation as of impending apoplexy; night-sweats —more on thighs); Ranune. repens (crawling sensation in forehead and scalp in evening in bed); Ranunc, flammula (ulceration; gangrene of arm). Compare, also: Bry.; Croton; Mez.; Euphord. Antidotes: Bry.; Camph.; Rhus.

Dose. — Mother tincture, in ten to thirty drop doses in delirium tremens; third to thirtieth potency generally.

remedies.name: Ranunculus Sceleratus
remedies.text:
(Marsh Buttercup) Js more irritating than others of this botanical family, as seen in the skin symptoms. Boring, gnawing pain very marked. Pemphigus. Periodical complaints. Fainting with pain in stomach.

Head. — Gnawing in one spot left of vertex. Frightful dreams about corpses, serpents, battles, etc. Fluent coryza, with sneezing and burning micturition, Mouth. — Teeth and gums sensitive. Tongue mapped. Denuded patches. Mouth sore and raw. Burning and rawness of tongue.

Abdomen. — Sensation of a plug behind umbilicus. Pain over region of liver, with sensation as if diarrhoea would set in. Pressure as of a plug behind right false ribs; worse, deep inspiration. Chest. —Integument sensitive. Bruised pain and weakness in the chest every evening. Sore burning behind xiphoid cartilage.

Skin. — Vesicular eruption, with tendency to form large blisters. Acrid exudation, which makes surround ing parts sore, Extremities. — Boring pain. Sudden burning sticking in right toe, Corns, with burning and soreness, especially when feet hang down. Gout in fingers and toes, Dose. — First to thicd potency.

remedies.name: Raphanus
remedies.text:
(Black Garden Radish) Great accumulation and incarceration of flatulence. “Globus” symptoms. Sehorrhosa, with greasy skin, Pemphigus, Hysteria: chilliness in lack and arms. Sexval insomnia. [Kali brom.] Nysnphomania. Postoperative gas pains.

Head. — Sadness, aversion to chitdren, especially girls, Headache, brain feels tender and sore. CEdema of lower eyelids.

Throat. — Hot-hall feeling from uterus to throat, stopping there. Heat and burning in throat.

Stomach. — Putrid cructations. Burning in epigastrium, followed by hot eructation, Abdomen. --- Retching and vomiting, loss of appetite. Distended, tyupanitic, hard. No flatus emitted upward er downward. Griping about navel. Stool liquid, frothy, profuse, brown, with colic, and pad-like swelling of intestines.

Female. — Nervous irritation of genitals. Menses very profuse and long-lasting. Nymphomania, with aversion to her own sex and to children, and sexual insomnia.

Urine. — Turbid, with yeast-like scdiment. Urine more copious, thick like milk.

Chest. — Pain in chest extends to back and to throat. Heavy lump and coldness in center of chest.

Relationship. — Compare: Momordica (worse, near splenic flexure); Carbo; Anacar.; Arg. nit.; Brassica.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Ratanhia
remedies.text:
(Krameria — Mapato)} The rectal symptoms are most important, and have received much clinical confirmation. It has cured pterygium. Violent hiccough, Cracked nipples. [Graph.; Exp. ar.) Head, -- Bursting in head after stool, and when sitting with head bent forward. Sensation as if scalp from nose to vertex were stretched.

Stomach. — Pain like knives cutting the stomach.

Rectum. — Aches, as if full of broken glass. Anus aches and burns tor hours after stool. Feels constricted. Dry heat at anus, with sudden knife-like stitches. Stools must be forced with great effort; protrusion of hemmorrhoids. Fissures of anus, with great constriction, burning like jire, as do the hxmorrhoids; temporarily relieved by cold water. Fetid, thia diarthea; stools burn; burning pains before and after stools. Oozing at anus. Pin-worms. ([Sant.; Teuc.; Spig.] Itching of anus.

Relationship. — Compare: Peon.; Croton (rectal neuralgia); Macuna prurens — Dolichos (piles, with burning; haemorrhoidal diathesis); Sang. ntt.; Silico. sulpho-catcite of Alumina — (cancer); Slag — blast iron furnace cinder — (anal itching, piles, and constipation; housemaid’s knee).

Dose. — Third to sixth potency. Locally, the Cerate has proved invaluable in many rectal compiaints.

remedies.name: Rhamnus Californica
remedies.text:
(California Coffee-tree) One of the most positive remedies for rheumatism and wuseulur pains. Pleurodynia, lumbago, gastralgia. Vesical tenesmus; dysmenorrhad of myalgic origin; pain in head, neck, and face. Juflamamatory rheumatism, jeints swollen, painful: tendency to metastasis; profuse sweat, Provings of students. 2x potency.

Mind. — Nervous. restless, irritable. Lassitude; mentally dull and dazed; unable to concentrate mind on stitdies.

Head. — Piscy full feeling. Heavy bruised sensation; better, from pressure. Bursting (eeling with every step. Soreness, especially sn occiput and vertex, worse, bending over. Dull pain in left cemple. Dell aching in frontal region (lett), extending Lackwards and over forehead. Deep, right-sided froutal headache, Twitching eyelids, Ears. ~Pusilness of hearnns Soreness. deep under tight tragns on swallowing.

Face. — Flashed, hot and glawing. Ontward pressere fram malar processes. Mouth.--—Canker sore between gums and fips. Tongue coated, with clean, pink central patch.

Throat. — Dry, rough. Sercness on right side and tonsil. i Bowels, -- Constipation with some flatus, Tenesmus and dry stool. Flatulent diarrhoea. Genito-urinary. — Increased urination, Tickling in anterior urethra, smalt morning drop (no previous gyuorrlwea). Sexual desire increased.

Respiratory. — Substernal oppression. Tenderness on pressure of right intercostal musctes, Heart. — Variation of pulse. Siow pulse (55).

Extremities. — Unable to contro] muscular action. Legs sore. Walked like a drunken man. Modality. —- Symptoms worse in evening.

Relationship. — Rhamuss cothurtica — Frangula — European Buck-Horn — (alidominal symptoms, colic, diarrhoea: haemorrhoids, especially chronic), Rhamnuns Purshiana — Cascera Sagrada — (pailiative in constipation, as an intestinal tonic, and dyspepsia dependent thereon 10-15 drops of tincture).

Dose. — Tincture in 15-drop doses every four hours,

remedies.name: Rheum
remedies.text:
(Rhubarb) Of frequent use in children with sour diarrhoea; difficult dentition. Whole child smells sour, Mind. — Impatient and vehement; desires many things and cries, [Cia.} Head. — Sweat an hairy scalp; coustant and profuse. Cool sweat on the face, especially about mouth and nose.

Mouth. — Much saliva. Sensation of coolness in teeth, Difficult teething; restless and irritable. Breath smells sour. [Chant.]

Stomach. — Desire for various kinds of food, but soon tires of all. Throbbing in pit. Feels full.

Abdomen. — Colicky pain about navel. Colic when uncovering. Wind seems to rise up to chest.

Rectum. — Before stool]. unsuccessful urging to urinate. Stools smell sour, pasty, with shivering and tenesmus, and burning in anus. Sour diarrhoea during dentition, Colicky, even ineffectual urging to evacuate altered fzcal stools.

Modalities. — Worse, uncevering, after eating, moving about. Relationship. —- Compare: Mag. phos.; Hep.; Pod.; Cham.; Ipec. Antidotes; Camph.; Cham. Complementary: Mag. carb.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Rhodium
remedies.text: (Metal Chemical Element) {Proved by MacFarlan with the 200th potency.) Nervous and tearful. Fronta] headache; shocks through head. Fleeting neuralgic pains in head, over eys, in ear, both sides of uuse, teeth. Loose cold in head. Lips dry. Nausea especially from sweets. Dull headache. Stiff neck and rheumatic pain down left shovider and arm. Itching in arms, palms and face. Loose stools with gripings in abdomen, Hyperactive peristalsis, tenesmus after stool, More urine passed. Cough scratchy, wheezy. Thick, yellow mucus from chest. Feels weak, dizzy and a tired feeling.

remedies.name: Rhododendron
remedies.text:
(Snow-rose) Rheumatic and gouty symptoms well marked. Rheumatism in the hot season. The modality (worse before a storm) is a true guiding symptom.

Mind. — Dread of a storm; particularly afraid of thunder. Forgetful.

Head. — Aching in temples. Tearing pain in bones, Headache; worse, wine, wind, cold and wet weather. Pain in eyes before a storm. Ciliary newralgia, involving eyeball, orbit, and head. Heat in eyes when using them. Eyes,— Muscular asthenopia; darting pains through eyes from head, worse before a storm. Ears, -- Difficult hearing, with whizzing and ringing in ears. Hearing better in the morning; noises come on after patient has been up a few hours, Face. —- Prosopalgia; violent, jerking pain involving dental nerves, from temple to lower jaw and chin; better, warmth and eating, Toothache in damp weather and before a storm. Swollen gums. Stumps of teeth are loosened.

Chest. — Violent pleuritic pains running downward in left anterior chest. Breathless and speechless from violent pleuritic pains running down the anterior chest. Stitches in spleen from fast walking. Crampy pain under short ribs. Male. —Testicles swollen, painful, drawn up. Orchitis; glands feel crushed. Induration and swelling of testes after gonorrhoea. Hydrocele. [Sil.]

Extremities. — Joints swollen. Gouty inflammation of great toe-joint. Kheumatic tearing in all limbs; worse, at rest and in stormy weather. Stiffness of neck. Pain in shoulders, arms, wrists; worse when at rest. Pains in bones in spots, and reappear by change of weather. Cannot sleep unless legs are crossed.

Modalities. — Worse, before a storm. All symptoms reappear in rough weather, night, towards morning. Better, after the storm breaks, warmth, and eating.

Relationship. — Compare: Ampelopsis (hydrocele and renal dropsy); Dule.; Rhus; Nat. suiph. Dose, — First te sixth potency,

remedies.name: Rhus Aromatica
remedies.text:
(Fragrant Sumach) Renal and urinary affections, especially diabetes. Enuresis due to vesicat atony: senile incontinence. Hematuria and cystitis come within the range of this remedy.

Urine. — Pale, albuminous. Jucoutinence. Severe fain at beginning or before urination, causing great agony iu children, Constant dribbling. Diabetes, large quantities of urine uf low specific gravity. (Phos. ac.; eleet. ac.) Dose. — Tincture, in rather material doses.

remedies.name: Rhus Glabra
remedies.text:
(Smooth Sumach) Epistaxis and occipital headache. Fetid flatus, Ulceration of mouth. Lreams of flying through the cir. {Sticta.] Profuse perspiration arising from debility. China.} 11 is claimed that this zemedy will so disinfect the bowels that the flatus and stools will be free from odor. Ii acts well in putrescent conditions with tendency to ulceration.

Mouth. — Scurvy; nursing sore mouth, [Verasice.] Aphthous stomatitis.

Relationship. — Said to be antidotal to the Hetion of Mercury, and bas been empieyed in the treatment of secundary syphilis ‘after mercurialization, Dose, — Tincture. Usually locally to soft, spongy ‘igums, aphtha, pharyngitis, etc. Internally, first potency.

remedies.name: Rhus Toxicodendron
remedies.text:
(Poison-ivy) The effects ov the skim, rheumatic pains, mucous membrane affections, and a typhoid type of fever, make this remedy frequently indicated. Motion always “limlers up” the Rhus patient. and hence he feels better jor a time from a change of position, Ailments from trams, overlifting, getting wet while perspiring. Septie conditions. [#ehinac.] * Rhenmatism in the cald season. Mind. ~- Listless, sad. Thoughts of suicide, Eortreme restlessness, with continued change of position. Delimum, with fear of beimg poisoned. {f/yes.) Seisit becomes cloudy. Great apprehension at might, conmot remain in hed.

Head. — Feels as of a board were strapped on the forehead, Vertigo wheo rising, /feoty head. Brain feels toose and as if struck against skull on walking or rising. Occipital pain. Scalp sensitive: worse on side Jain on, Headache in occiput (Ris rod.]: painful to tuuch, Humid eruptions on scalp; itching greatly.

Eyes. — Swollen, red, oedematous; orbital ceflutitis. Pustular inflammations. Photophobia; profuse flow of yellow pus. Lids inflamed, agglutinated, swollen. Old inured eyes. Circumscribed corneal injection. — Iritis. after exposttre to cold and dampness, and of rheumatic origin. Eye painful on turning it or pressing, cat hard? move it, as in acute retrobulbar neuritis. Profuse gush of hot. scalding tears upon opening lids, Ears. — Pain in ears, with sensation as if something were in them. Lobules swolien. Discharge of biaody

remedies.name: Rhus Diversiloba
remedies.text:
Nose. — Sneezing, coryza from getting wet, Tip of nose red, sore, ulcerated. Swelling of nose. Nosebleed on stooping.

Face. — Jaws crack when chewing. Easy dislocation of jaw. [/gn.; Petrol.) Swollen face, erysipelas. Cheek bones sensitive to touch. Parotitis. Facia! neutalgia, with chilliness; worse, evening. Crusta factea. [Catc.; Viol. tric.]

Mouth. — Teeth feel loose and tong; gums sore. Tongue red and cracked; coated, except red triangular Space at the tip; dry and red at edges. Corners of mouth ulcerated; fever-blisters around mouth and chin. [Net. mur] Poin tn maxillary joint, Throat. — Sore, with swollen glands. Sticking pain on swallowing. Parotitis, left side. Stomach. ~— Want cf appetite for any kind of food, with unquenchable thirst. Btffer taste. [Cupr.] Nausea, vertigo, and bloated abdomen after eating. Desire for milk. Great thirst, with dry mouth and throal. Pressure as from a stone. [Bry.; Ars.] Drowsy after eating.

Abdomen. — Violent pains, relieved by fying on abdomen. Swelling of inguinal glands. Pain in region of ascending colon. Colic, compelling to walk bent. Excessive distention after eating. Rumbling of flatus on first rising, but disappears with continued motion.

Rectum. — Diarrhoea of blood, slimne, and reddish mucus. Dysentery, with tearing pains down thighs. Stools of cadaverous odor. Frothy, painless stools.

Urinary. — Dark. turbid, high-colored, scanty urine, with white sediment. Dysuria, with loss of blood.

Male. — Swelling of glans and prepuce —dark-red erysipelatous; scrotum thick, swollen, ademaious. dehing intense.

Female. — Swelling, with intense itching of vulva. Pelvic articulations stiff when beginning to move. Menses early, profuse, and prolonged, acrid. Lochia thin, protracted, offensive, diminished [Puls.; Secale}, with shooting upwards in vagina. [Sep.]

Respiratory. — Tickling behind upper sternum. Dry, teasing cough from midnight until morning, during a chill, or when putting hands out of bed. Haemeptysis from overexertion; blood bright red. Influenza, with aching in all bones. ([£up. perf.) Hoarseness from overstraining voice. [Arn.} Oppression of the chest, cannot get breath with sticking pains. Bronchial coughs in old people, worse on awaking and with expectoration of small plugs of mucus.

Heart. — Hypertrophy from overexertion. Pulse quick, weak, irregular, intermittent, with numbness of left arm, Trembling and palpitation when sitting still.

Back. — Pain between shoulders on swallowing. Pain and stiffness in small of back; better, motion, or Lying on something hard; worse, while sitting. Stiffness of the nape of the neck.

Extremities. — Hot, painful swelling of joints. Pains tearing in tendons, ligaments, and fascia. Rheumatic pains spread over a large surface at nape of neck, loins, and extremities. Soreness of condyles of bones. Limbs stiff, paralyzed, The cold fresh air ts not tolerated; it makes the skin painful. Pain along ulnar nerve. Tearing down thighs. Sciatica; worse, cold, damp weather, at night. Numbneis and formication, after overwork and exposure. Paralysis; trembling after exertion. Tenderness about knee-joint. Loss of power in forearm and fingers; crawling sensation in the tips of fingers, Fever. — Adynamic; restless, trembling. Typhoid; tongue dry and brown; sordes; bowles Joose: great restlessness. Intermittent; chill, with dry cough anc restlessness, During heat, uticana. Hydrva. Chilly, a: if cold water were poured over him, followed by hea! and inclination ta stretch the Jimbs. Skin, — Red, swollen; fiching sitense. Vesicles herpes; wrfiraria; pemphigus; erysipelas; vesicular sup purative forins. Glands swollen. Cellulitis.

Sleep. — Jrcams of great exertion. Heavy sleep, a from stupor. Sleepless before midnight. Modalities, — Il'orse, cold, wet rainy weather anc after rain; at night, during resi, drenching, when lying on back or “right side. etter, seatlhy! dry weather, motion; walkhie;eHahge of postti8s, “Fabbing, warm applications, irom ‘stretching out’ fHerts, Relationship. - Complementary: Bry; Cale. fluor Jn urticaria follow with Bovisia. Inimical:.4 pis. Antidotes: fuecurd.; Creton.; AMleser.; Cyprip.. Plumbago (eczema of vulva); Graph.; Bry.; Rhed. Compare: AKhus radicans (almust identical action}: characteristics are, burning in tongue, tip feels.sorc. pains are often semilateral and in various parts,:aften remote and successive, Many symptoms are belter-aiter a storm has thoroughly set in, especially after an -electric storm. Has pronounced yearly. aggravation. {Lavhes.] Rhus diversiloba — Califurnia Poison-oak — (antidote to Rhus; violent skin symptoms, with frightful itching; much swelliig of face, hands and genitals; skin very sensitive: eczema and erysipclas, great ucrvous weakness, tired from ‘east effort; goes to sleep from sheer exhaustion); Xerophyilum (dysmenorrhea and skin symptoms). Compare, also: Arn.; Bapt,; ach; Ars.; Hyosc.: Op. (stupefaction more profound). Afimosa — Sensitive Plant —— (rheumatism, knee stiff, lancinating pains in back and limbs. Swelling of ankles. Legs tremble).

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency, The 200th and higher are antidotal to poisoning with the plant and tincture,

remedies.name: Rhus Venenata
remedies.text:
(Poison-elder) The skin symptoms of this species of Rhus are most severe, Mind,— Great melancholy: no desire to live, gloomy.

Head. — Heavy, frontal headache; worse, walking or stooping. Eyes nearly closed with great swelling. Vesicular inflammation of ears. Nose red and shiny. Face swollen.

Tongue. — Red at tip. Fissured in middle. Vesicles on under side.

Abdomen. — Profuse, watery. white stools in morning, 4 a.m., with colicky pains; expelled with force. Pain in hypogastrium before every stool. Extremities. ——- Paralytic drawing in right arm, especially wrist, and extending to fingers.

Skin. — Itching; relieved by hot water. Vesicles. Erysipelas; skin dork red, Erythema nodosum, with nightly itching and pains in long bones. Relationship.—- The California Poison-oak (Rhus diversiloba) is identical with it. It antidotes Radium and follows it well. Compare: Anacard.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Ricinus Communis
remedies.text:
(Castor-oil) Has marked action on gastro-intestinal tract. Increases the quantity of milk in nursing women. Vomiting and purging. Languor and weakness, Head. -— Vertigo, occipital pain, congestive symptoms, buzzing in ears. Face pale, twitching of mouth, Stomach. — Anorexia with great thirst, burning in stomach, pyrosis, nausea, profuse vomiting, pit of stomach sensitive. Mouth dry.

Abdomen. — Rumbling with contraction of recti muscles, colic, incessant diarrhoea with purging. Rice water stoois with cramps and chilliness.

Stool. — Loosc, incessant, painless, with painful cramps in muscles of extremities. Anus inflamed. Stools green, slimy, and bloody. Fever, emaciation, somnolence, Relationship. — Compare: Kesercin (summer complaint with vomiting}; Cholos tcrrapina (cramps of muscles}. Ars.; Verat.

Dose. — Third potency. Five drops every four hours for increasing flow of milk; also locally a poultice of the leaves.

remedies.name: Robinia
remedies.text:
(Yellaw Locust) The remedy for hperchlorhydria. In cases where albuminoid digestion is too rapid and starch digestion is perverted. The gastric symptoms with the most, pronounced acidity are well authenticated, and are the guiding symptoms. The acidity of Robinia is accompanied by frontal headache, -/ntensely acrid erwetations. Acrid and greenish vomiting, colic and flatulence, nightly burning pains in stomach and constipation with urgent desire.-- Acidity of children, Stools and perspiration sour. Incarcerated flatus.

Head. — Dull, throbbing, frontal pain; worse, motion and reading. Gastric headache with acid vomiting.: Stomach. — Dull, heavy aching. Nausea; sour eructations; rofuse vomiting of an intcasely sour fluid. [Sulph. ac} Great distention of stomach and bowels. Flatulent colic. [Cham., Diosc.]) Suur stools; child smells sour.

Female. — Nympbomania, Acrid, fetid leucorrhoea, Discharge of blood between menstrual periods, Herpes on vagina and vulva, Relationship. — Magnes. phos.; Arg. nit.; Orexine tannate. (Hyperchlorhydria.} Dose, — Third potency. Must be continued a loug time,

remedies.name: Rosa Damascena
remedies.text: (Damask Rose) Useful in the beginning of hay-fever, with involvement of Eustachian tube, Ear.— Hardness of hearing; tinnitus, Exstachion catarrk, {Hydr.; Mere, dule.} Relationship, — Compare: in hay-fever: Succin. acid; Sabad.; Euph.; Psor.; Kali hyd.; Naphth, Dose. — Tower potencies.

remedies.name: Rumex Crispus
remedies.text:
(Yellow Dock) Is characterized by pains, numerous and varied, neither fixed nor constant anywhere. Cough caused by an incessant tickling in the throat-pit, which tickling runs down to the bifurcation of the bronchial tubes. Touching the throat-pit brings on the cough. Worse from the least cold air; so that ali cough ceases by covering up all the body and head with the bedclothes. Rumex diminishes the secretions of mucous membranes, and at the same time exalts sensibility of the mucous membranes of the larynx and trachea. Its action upon the skin is marked, producing an intense itching. Lym- Phatics enlarged and secretions perverted.

Stomach. — Tongue sore at edges; coated; sensation of hard substance in pit of stomach; hiccough, pyrosis, natisea; cunot cat meat; it causes eructations pruritus. Jaundice after excessive use of alcoholics. Chronic gastritis; aching pain in pit of stomach and shooting in the chest; extends towards the throat-pit, worse any motion or talking. Pain in left breast after meals; flatulence, Respiratory. — Nose dry. Tickling in throat-pit causes cough, Copious usucous discharge from nose and trachea. Dry, tcasing cough, preventing sleep, Aggratated by pressure, talking, and especially by inspiring coo! air and at night. Thin, watery, frothy expectoration by the mouthful; later, stringy and tough. Rawness of larynx and trachea. Soreness behind sternum, especially left side, in region of left shoulder. Raw pain under clavicle. Lamp in throat.

Stool. — Brown, watery, diarrhoea carly in morning, with cough, driving him out of bed, Valuabie in advanced phthisis, (Seney.; Puls.; Lyvep.; Ars] ltching of annus, with sensation as of a stick im rectum. Piles.

Skin. — Intense itching of skin, espectally of lower extremitics; worse, exposure to cold air when undressing, Urticaria; contagious prurigo, Modalities. — Worse, in evening, from inhaling cold air; left chest; uncavering.

Relationship. — Compare: Caust.; Suiph.; Bell.; Rumex acetosa (dry, unremitting short cough, and violent pains in the bowels: uvula elongated; inflammation of esophagus; alsa cancer); Rumex obtusifolins — Lapathum —(nose-bleed and headache following; pain in kidneys; leucorrhoea). Dose. -— Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Ruta Graveolens
remedies.text:
(Rue-bitterwort) Acts upon the periosteum and cartilages, exes and uterus. Complaints from straining fleror tendons especially. Tendency to the formation of deposits in the periosteum, tendons, and about joints, especially wrist, Overstrain of ocylar muscles. Al parts of thé body are painful, as if bruised. Sprains (after Anica). Lameness after sprains. Jaundice. Feeling of intense lassitude, weakness and despair, Injured bones.

Head. — Pain as from a nail; after excessive intoxicating drinks. Periosteum sore. Epistaxis, Eyes. — Eye-strain followed by headache, Eyes red, hot, and painful from sewing or reading fine print. {Nat, mur.; Arg. nit.] Disturbances of accommodation. Weary pain while reading. Presstre deep in orbits, Tarsal cartilage feels bruised. Pressure over eyebrow. Asthenopia.

Stomach. — Gastralgia of aching, gnawing character.

Urinary. — Pressure in neck of bladder after urinating; painful closure, [Apis.] Constant urging to urinate, feels bladder full.

Rectum. — Difficult faeces, evacuated only with straining. Constipation, alternating with mucous, frothy stools; discharge of blood with stool. When sitting, tearing stitches in rectum. Corcinoma affecting lower bowel. Prolapsus ani every time the bowels move, after confinement. Frequent, unsuccessful urging to stool. Protrusion of rectum when stooping.

Respiratory. — Cough with copious, thick, yellow expectoration; chest feels weak. Painful spot on sternum; short breath with tightness of chest.

Extremities. — Spine and limbs feel bruised. Smail of back and loins pain. Legs give out on rising from a chair, hips and thighs so weak, [Phos.; Con,] Contraction of fingers. Pain and stiffness in wrists and hands. Ganglia. Sciatica; worse, lying down at night; pain from back down hips and thighs. Hamstrings feel shortened. [Graph.] Tendons sore. Aching pain in tendo-Achilles. Thighs pain when stretching the limbs. Pain in bones of feet and ankles. “ Great restlessness.

Modalities. — Worse, lying down, from cold, wet weather. Relationship. —-Compare: Jaborundi; Phyt.; Rhus; Sil; Arn, Antidote: Camph. Complementary: Cule. phos. Dose, — First to sixth potency. Locally, the tincture for ganglia and as a lotion for the eyes.

remedies.name: Sabadilla
remedies.text:
(Cevadilla Seed. Asagraa Officinalia) Action on mucous membrane of the nose and the lachrymal glands, producing coryza and symptoms like hay-fever, which have been utilized homoopathically. Ascarides, with reflex symptoms (nymphomania; convulsive symptoms). Children’s diarrhoea with constant cutting pains.

Mind. — Nervous, timid, easily startled. Has er- Toreous notions about himself. Imagines that he is very sick; that parts are shrunken; that she is pregnant; that she has cancer; delirium during intermittents, Head.— Vertigo with sensation as though all things were turning around each other, accompanied by blackness before eyes and sensation of fainting. Dultness and oppression. Oversensitiveness to odors. Thinking produces headache and sleeplessness. Eyelids red, burning. Lachrymation, Difficult hearing. Nose.—Spasmodic snecsing, with runnince nose. Coryza, with severe frontal pains and redness of eyes and fachrymation. Copious, watery, nasal discharge.

Throat. — Sore; begins on left side. [Lach.} Much tough phlegm. Sensation of a skin hanging loosely; must swallow over it. Warm food and drink relieve. Empty swaflowing most painful, Dry fauces and throat, Sensation of a Jump in throat with constant necessity to swallow. Chronic sore throat; worse, from cold air.

Stomach. — Spasmodic pairti in stomach with dry cough and difficult breathing. No thirst. Loathing for strong food. Canine appetite for sweets and farinaceous food. Pyrosis; copious salivation, Cold, empty feeling in stomach. Desire for hot things. Sweetish taste.

Female. — Menscs too late; come by fits and starts. Intermit [Kreos.; Puls.) (due to transient and localized congestion of womb alternating with chronic anemic state). Fever, ~~ (fill predominates; from below upwards. Heat in head and face; hands and feet icy cold, with chill. Lachtymation during paroxysm. Thirstless. Extremities.-— Cracking of skin under and beneath tecs; inflammation under tue-nails, Skin.-- Dry, like parchment. Horny. deformed, thickened sails, Hot, hurning, creeping, crawling sensation. Itching in anus. Modalities, -— IF orse, cold and cold drinks, full moon. Retter, warm food and drink, wrapped up.

Relationship. — Complementary: Sepiu. Compare: Meratring (is alkaloid of Sabadilla, nof of Veratrum, lucally in neuralgias, and for removal of dropsy. Five grains te two drams Lanoln, rabbed on wuside of thighs, causes diuresis). Colci.; Nx, -truido and Poallatm thay-fever}, Antidotes: Puls. Lycap.; Couiton; Lach.

Dose. — Third to thirtivth potency,

remedies.name: Sabal Serrulata
remedies.text:
(Saw Palmetto) General and sexual debility. Promotes nutrition and tissue building. Head, stomach, and ovatian symptoms marked. Of unquestioned value in prostatic enlagement, epididymitis, and nrinary difficulties. Acts on membrano-prostatic portion of urethra. Iritis, with prostatic trouble. FMaluahle for undeveloped mammary glands, Fear of going to sleep. Languor, apathy and hdifference.

Head. — Confused, fell; dislikes sympathy. Vertigo, with headache. Neuralgia in feeble patients. Pain runs up from nose and centers in forehead.

Stomach. — Belching and acidity. Desire for milk. [Rhus; Apis.} Urinary. — Constant desire to pass water at night. Enuresis; paresis of sphincter vesice. Chronic gonorthea. Difficult urination..

Male. — Prostatic troubles; enlargement; discharge of prostatic fluid. Wasting of testes and loss of sexual power. Coitus painful at the time of emission. Seruat neuvotics, Female.— Ovaries tender atid enlarged; breasts shrivel. [lod.; Kali iod.] Young female neurotios; suppressed or perverted sexual inclination.

Respiratory. — Copious expectoration, with catarrh of nose. Chronic brenchitis. [Stann.; Hep]

Relationship. — Compare: Phosph. ac.; Stigmata maydis; Santal.; Apis. In prostatic symptoms: Ferry pic.; Thuja; Picric acid (more sexual erethism). Populus tremul.; (prostatic enlargement with cystitis).

Dose. — Mother tincture, ten to thirty drops.

remedies.name: Sabina
remedies.text:
(Savine) Has a special action on the uterus; also upon serous and fibrous membranes; hence its use in gout. Pain from socrum to the pubis, Haemorrhages, where blood ts fluid and clots together, Tendency to miscarriage, especially at third month, /solent pulsations; wants windows open.

Mind. — Music is intolerable, produces nervousness. [Natr. ¢.]

Head. — Vertigo with suppressed menses. Bursting headache, suddenly coming and going slowly. Rush of blood to head and face. Drawing pains in masseter muscles. Teeth ache when chewing.

Stomach. — Heartburn. Desire for lemonade. Bitter taste. [RAus.] Lancinating pain from pit of stomach across back..

Abdomen. — Bearing-down, constrictive pain, Colic, mostly in hypogastric region. Tympanitic distention.

Rectum. — Sense of fullness. Constipation. Pain from back to pubis. Haemorrhoids, with bright red blood; bleed copiously.

Urine. — Burning and throbbing in region of kidneys. Bloody urine; much urging. Bladder inflamed with throbbing all over. Inflammation of urethra, Male.— Inflammatory gonorrhoea, with pus-like discharge. Sycotic excrescences. Burning, sore pain in glans, Prepuce painful with diffculty in retracting it. Increased desire, Female. -— Menses profuse, bright. Uterine pains extend into thighs. Threatened miscarriage. Sexual desire increased. Leucorrhoea after menses, corrosive, offensive. Discharge of blood between periods. with sexual excitement. [.4mdr.]} Retained placenta; intense after-pains. Menorrhagia in women who aborted readity. Inflammation of ovaries and uterus after abortion. Promotes expulsion of moles from uterus, (Canth.] Pain from sacrum to pudis, and from below upwords shooting up the vagina. Haemorrhage; partly clotted; worse frum least motion. Atony of uterus.

Back. — Pain betwren sacrum and pubis from one bone to another. Paralytic pain in small of back.

Extremities. — Bruised pains in anterior portion of thighs. Shooting in heels and metatarsal bones. Arthritic pain in joints, Gout; worse, in heated room. Red, shining swelling. Gouty nodosities. [Asmon, phos.]

Skin. — Fig-warts, with intolerable itching and burning. Exuberant granulations. [Thaj.; Nit. ac.) Warts. Black pores in skin.

Modalities. — Horse, from least motion, heat, warm air, Better, in cool fresh air. Relationship, —- Complementary: Thuja. Compare: Rosmarinus (menses too early; victent pains followed by uterine haemorrhage. Head heavy, drowsy. Chilly with icy coldness of lower extremities without thirst, followed by heat. Memory deficient}. Croc.; Cale.; Trill; Ipec.; Millef.; Eri. Antidote: Puls, Dose, — Locally, for warts, tincture. Internally, third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Saccharum Officinale
remedies.text:
(Cane-sugar) Sugar is an antiseptic. Combats infection and putrefaction; has a solvent action on fibrin and stimulates secretion by the intense osmotic changes induced, thus rinsing out the wound with serum from within outward, favoring healing. Leg ylcers, Sugar must be considered a sustainer and developer of the musculature of the heart and hence useful in failure of compensation and a variety of cardio-vascular troubles. Acts as a nutrient and tonic, in wasting disorders, anaemia, ‘neurasthenia, etc., increasing weight and power. Opacity of cornea. Dim sight. Acidity and anal itching. Cold expectoration. Myocardial degeneration. Fat, bloated, large-limbed children, who are cross, peevish, whining; capricious; want dainty things. tidbits, and refuse substantial food. CEdema of feet.

Relationship. — Compare: Saccharum factis (diure- Sis; amblyopia; cold pains, as if produced by finé, icy cold needle with tingling, as if frost bitten; great physicat exhaustion); Cale.; Arg. uit.; Caust.

Dose. — Thirtieth potency and higher. Locally in gangrene. One ounce of Jump sugar morning and evening valuable adjunct in the treatment of obstinate cases of heart failure due to deficient heart muscle without valvular lesion. Sugar as an oxytocic has its most suitable application towards the end of labor when there is no mechanical obstruction and delay is due to uterine inertia. 25 grammes dissoived in water, several times every half hour, Compare: Saccharin (hinders both the salivary and peptic ferment actions with consequent dyspepsia. Prof. Lewin believes its action to be on the secretory ceils themselves and it has caused pain (right hypogastrium), loss of appetite, diarrhoea and wasting).

remedies.name: Selaginella Apus
remedies.text: (Snake-moss) Said to be a perfect antidote to the bites of snakes and spiders. About half a diam of the moss is macerated with cne ounce of milk, This is drunk and also bound upon the wound, Compare: Goloudrina; Cedron; indigo,

remedies.name: Salicylicum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Salicyclic Acid) The symptoms pvint to its use in rheumatism. dys- ’ pepsia, and Aeniere’s disease. Vrostration after ifluenza, [ematuiia.

Head. — Vertigo; tendency to fall to left side. Headache: contusion m head on rising suddenty. Incipient coryza. Piercing pain in temples.

Eyes. — Retinal haemorrhage. Retinitis after influenza, also albuminuric, Ears. — Kouring and ringing in cars. Deafness, with vertigo, Throat. -- Sore, red and swollen. Pharyngitis; swallowing dificult.

Stomach. — Cank-r sores, with burning soreness and fetid breath. Flatulenec; hot, sour belching. Vutrid fermentation. Frrmentative dyspepsia. Tongtte purplish, leaden-colured. Stools, — Putrid diarrhaea; stools like green frog's spawn. [AMaga. carb.j

Extremities. — Knees swollen and painful. Acute articular rheumatism; worse, touch and motion, pro-~ tuse sweat, Pain shifts, Sciatica, burning pain; worse at night. Copious foot-sweat.

Skin. — itching vesicles and pustules; better by scratching. Sweat without sleep. Urticaria. Hot and burning skin, Purpura. Herpes zoster, Relationship. — Compare: Salo! (rheumatic pain in joints, with soreness and stiffness, headache over eyes; urine violet-smelling); Celch.; China; Lect, ac. Dose — Third decimal trituration.

remedies.name: Salix Nigra
remedies.text:
