Head. — Ruises head frequently from the pillow, Pain in forehead and over eyebrows, beginning at 9 A.M.; worse until noon. Boring pain, preceded by obscure vision. Rush of blood to head; staggers, with tendency to fall ferward and to the left, Eyes. — Seem prominent, staring wide open; pupils dilated. Loss of vision; complains that it is dark, and culls for fight. Small objects look lurge, Parts of the body seem enormously swollen. Strabismus, Face, — Hot, red; circumscribed redness of cheeks, Blood rushes to face; distorted, Expression of terror. Pale face. Mouth, — Dry; dribbling of viscid saliva. Aversion to water.” Stammering. (Cannab, sat.) Riss sardonicus. Cannot swallow on account of spasm, Chewing Motion, Stomach. — Food tastes like straw. Violent thirst. Vomiting of mucus and green bile.

Urine. — Suppressed, bladder empty.

Male. — Sexual erethism, with indecent speech and action. Hands constantly kept on genitals.

Female. — Metrorrhagia, with loguacity, singing, prayirig. Puerperal mania, with characteristic mental symptoms and profuse sweatings. Convulsions after labor.

Sleep. — Awakens terrified; screams with fright. Deep snoring sleep. Steepy, but cannot sleep. [Aell.} Extremities. — Graceful, rhythmic motions. Convulsions of upper extremities and of isolated groups of muscles. Chorca; spasms partial, constantly changing. Violent pain in Icft hip. Trembling, twitching of tendons, staggering gait. Skin. ~~ Shining red flash. Effects of suppressed cruption in scarlatina, with delirium, etc.

Fever. — Profuse sweat, which does not relieve. Violent fever.

Modalities. — !¥orse, in dark room, when alone, looking at bright or shining objects, after sleep, on swallowing. Better, from bright light, company, warmth. Relationship. ~ Compare especially: Hyoscy. and Bellad. It has less fever than Belled., but more than HHyos. it causes more functional excitement of the brain, but never approaches the true inflammatory condition of Betlad. Antidotes: Beliad.; Tebac.; Nux.

Dose. — Tincture, to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Strontia
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Strontian) Rheumatic pains, chronic sprains, stenosis of aesophagus. Chronic sequele of Aaoemorrhages. Arteriosclerosis. Violent involuntary starts. Affections of bones, especially femur. Restlessness at night, smothering feeling. For shock after surgical operations.

Head. — Vertigo with headache and nausea. Distensive pressure. Aches from nape of neck, spreading upwards; better wrapping head up warmly. [Sii.] Flushes in face; violent pulsating. Supraorbital neuralgia; pains increase and decrease slowly. [Stann.] Bloody crusts in nose. Face red; burns, itches. Itching, redness and burning of nose.

Eyes. — Burning and redness of eyes. Pain and lachrymation on using eyes, with dancing and chromatic alterations of objects looked at.

Stomach. — Loss of appetite, aversion to meat, craves bread and beer. Food tasteless. Eructations after eating.

Abdomen. — Sticking in abdominal! ring, Diartheea; worse at night; continuous urging; better towards morning. Burning in anus lasts a tong time after stool. [atanh.] Uncomfortable fullness and swelling of abdomen.

Extremities. — Sciatica with oedema of ankle. Rhewmatic patn in right shuwlde:, Gnawing as if in marrow of bones. Cramps in calves and soles. Chronic spasms, particularly of ankle-joimt. Ccdematous swelling. Icy-cold feet. Rheumatic pains, especially in joints, Veins of hands engorged.

Fever. — Heat, with aversion to uncover or undress, Skin, — Moist, itching, burning eruption; better in open air. especially warm sunshine, Sprains of anklejoint, with adema. Violent perspiration at night.

Modalities. — Better immersing in hot water.

Relationship. — Compare: Amica; Ruta; Sil; Baryia ¢.; Carbo.; Stront. jodat. (arterio-sclerosis.) Stronttum brom. (often gives excellent results where a bromide is indicated. Vomiting of pregnancy.).

Dose. — Sixth trituration.

remedies.name: Strophanthus Hispidus
remedies.text:
{Kombe-seed) Strophantus is a muscle poison; it increases the contractile power uf all striped muscles. Acts on the heart, trrvcasing the systole and dimimishes the rapidity. May he used with advantage to tone the heart, and run off dropsical accumulations. In smail doses for weak heast; it feels enJarged. In mitra) regurgitation, where cedema and dropsy have supervened. [Digst.] Strophantus occasions no gastric distress, has no cumulative effects, is a greater diuretic, and is safer for the aged, as it does not affect the vaso-motors, In pneumonia and in severe prostration from haemorrhage after operations asd acute diseases, After the long use of stimn- Jants; irritable heart of tobacco-smokers. Artericsclerosis; rigid arteries of aged. Especially useful in failing compensation dependent upon fatty heart. Hives, Anaemia with palpitation and breathlessness. Head. —- Tempora) pains with double vision, impaired sight; brillant eyes, flushed face.

Urinary. — Increased secretion; scanty and albuminous.

Female. — Menorrhagia; uterine haemorrhage; uterus heavily congested, Respiratory. —~ Dyspnoea. Lungs congested. C&dema of tungs. Bronchial and cardiac asthma, Heart.— Pulse quickened. Heart's action weak, due to musculdr debility; muscular insufficiency, Cardiac pain. {crategus.]

Skin. — Urticaria, especially more chronic forms.

Extremities. — Swollen, dropsical.

Relationship. — Compare: Digit. (but is slower than Strophant. in its action}; Phos. ac. (weak heart, irregular pulse, fluttering sensation in cardiac region, palpitation during sleep, fainting).

Dose. — Tincture and 6x potency. In more acute cases, five to ten drops of the tincture three times a day.

remedies.name: Strychninum
remedies.text:
(Alkaloid of Nux Vorica) Tetanic convulsions with opisthotonas. The muscles relax between paroxysms; worse slightest touch, sound, odor. Influences more directly the spinal cord and is less appropriate in visceral derangements than Nux. Tetanus. Explosive nervousness. The pains and sensations come suddeniy and return at infervals, The 3x hypodermically, 10 m. in shock. Head, — Restless. Over-irritability. Full and bursting headache, with heat in eyes. Vertigo, with roaring in ears. Jerking of head forwards. Scalp sore. Itching of scalp and nape, Byes.— Hot, painful, protruding, staring. Pupils dilated, Sparks before eves. Spasmodic contraction of veular muscles; twitching and trembling of lids.

Ears. — Hearing very acute; burning, itching, and ruaring in ears.

Face. — Pale, anxious. livid. Jaws stiffened; lower jaw spasmodically closed. Throat,— Dry, contracted; feeling of a lump. Deglutition impossible. Burning along and spasms of cesophagus. Violent itching in roof of mouth. Stomach. —~ Constant retching. Violent vomiting. Nausea of pregnancy. Abdomen.-—Sharp pain in abdominal muscles, gripmg pain in bowels.

Rectum. — Faeces discharged involuntarily during spasms. Very obstinate constipation. Female, — Desire for coitus. [Caxth.; Camph.; Fi. ac.; Lach.; Phos,; Plat.) Any touch on body excites a voluptuous sensation, Respiratory, — Spasm of muscles about larynx. Excessive dyspnoea. Sharp, contractive pains in muscles of chest. Persistent cough, recurring after influenza.

Back. — Kigidtty of cervical muscles. Sharp pain in nape and down spine. Back stiff; violent jerks in spinal column. Jey sensation down spine.

Extremities. — Limbs stiff. Rheumatism with stiff joints. Violent jerking, twitching, and trembling. Vielent tetanic convulsions and opisthotonos; spasms provoked hy slightest touch and attempt to move. Vio- Tent shocks in the muscles. Cramp-like pats, Fever. —- Cold chilis down spine. Perspiration in a stream dow: head and chest. Lower extremities cold, Skin. — Itching of whole body, especially nose. Icy sensation down the spine, Modalities. -~ Worse, morning; touch; noise; motion; after meals. Better, lying on back.

Relationship. — Compare: Eucalyptus {neutralizes ill) effects of Strychnin). Strych. ars. (Psoriasis; chronic diarrhoea with paralytic symptoms; compensatory hypertrophy of heart with beginning fatty degeneration; marked dyspnoea when lying down; oedema of lower extremities, urine scanty, high specific gravity, heavily loaded with glucose. Diabetes. 6x trit.). Strych. ct Ferr. cit. (chlorotic and paralytic conditions; dyspepsia, with vomiting of ingesta; 2x and 3x trit.); Strych, valerin, (exhaustion of brain-power; women of high nervous erethism; 2x trit.). Compare: Cicute, Arnica (tetanus). Dose.—-Third to thirtieth potency. For nonhometopathic use, to produce its direct physiological effects in paralysis the dose will range from one-fiftieth to one-twentieth 6f a grain, repeated three times a day. Under twelve years of age, one-fiftieth to one twohundredth of a grain. Strych., hypodermically, is capable of arresting progressive muscular atrophy, and is a certain stimulant to the respiratory centers, and is tseful in embarrassed breathing, in the course of pneuvmonia especially. Dose, one one-hundredth to onesixtieth grain every three hours.

remedies.name: Strychnia Phosphorica
remedies.text: (Phosphate of Strychnin) This drug acts through the cerebro-spinal systein upon muscles, causing twitching, stiffness, weakness and loss of power; upon circulation, producing irregularity of pulse, and upon the mind, producing lack of control, uscontrellable desire to laugh and disinclination to use the brain. ~Very irregular pulse. Useful in chorea, hysteria, acute asthenia after acute fevers. Symptoms worse motion, better rest and in open air. An excellent remedy it, anaemia of spina! card; paralysis: burning, aching, and weakness of spine: pain extends to front of chest; tenderness on pressure in mid-dorsal region; cold, clammy feet; hands ond axille covered with clammy perspivotion. Atelectasis and break in the compensation of a hypertrophied heart; the beginning of fatty degeneration of the heart miuscle. ( Royal.) Dose. — Third trituration,

remedies.name: Succinum
remedies.text:
(Electron. Amber) — (A Fossil Resin) Nervous and hysterical symptoms, Asthma. Affections of spleen, Head. — Fear of trains and close places. Headache, lachrymation, sneezing.

Respiratory. — Asthma, incipient phthisis, chronic bronchitis, pains in chest. Whooping-cough. Relationship.-—— Compare: Succinic acid. (Hayfever. Paroxysmal sneezing, itching of eyelids and canthi and nose worse drafts. Use No. 6 to 30th potency). Compare. Arundo, Wycthia, Sabadilla, Sinapis.

Dose. — Third trituration. Five drop doses of the oil.

remedies.name: Sulfonal
remedies.text:
(A Coal-tar Preduct) Vertigo of cerebral origin, cerebellar disease, ataxic syinptoms, and chorea, present a field for the homaopathic employment of this drug. Profound weakucss, gone, faint feeling, and despondency. Less of control of sphincter. Muscular inco-ordination.

Mind. — Mental confusion, incoherency, illusions; apathetic. Alternation of happy, hopeful states with depression and weakness. Extreme irritabiluy. Head— Dropsy, stupid; pain on attempting to raise head. Double vision; heavy look about eyes; tinnitus, aphasia; tongue as if paralysed. Eyes bloodshot and restless. Vertigo, unable to rise. Double vision; ptosis; tinnitus; dysphagia, difficult speech, Urinary. — Albuminuria, with casts. Scanty. Pink color, Constant desire to urinate; scanty, brownish red. Hzamatoporphyrinuria, Respiratory. Congestion of lungs, stertorous breathing. Sighing dyspnoea.

Extremities. — Ataxic movements, staggering gait; cold, weak, trembling; legs scem too heavy. Extreme restlessness: muscular twitchings. Kmnee-jerks disappear. Stiffness and paralysis of both legs. Anzsthesia of legs.

Sleep. — Fidgety, wakeful, drowsy. Skin, — Itching, bluish purpura. Erythema.

Relationship. — Triona! (vertigo, loss of equilibrium, ataxia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stertorous breathing, cyanosis, tinnitus, hallucinations).

Dose. — Third trituration. Non-Homacopathic Uses.-—~ As a hypnotic. Dose, ten to thirty grains in hot water, Takes about two hours to act.

remedies.name: Sulphur
remedies.text:
(Sublimated Sulphur) This is the great Hahnemannian anti-psoric, Its action is centrifugai—from within outward —having an elective affinity for the skin, where it produces heat and burning, with itching; made worse by heat of bed, Inertia and relaxation of fiber; hence feebleness of tone characterizes its symptoms. Ebullitions of heat, dislike of water, dry and hard hair and skin, red orifices, sinking feeling at stomach ‘about 12 a. M., and cat-nap sleep; always indicate Sulphur homeopathically. Standit; is the worst position for sulphur patients, it is always uncomfortable. Dirty, filthy people, prone to skin affections, Aversion to being washed. When carefullyselected remedics fail to act, espectally in acuty discases, it frequently arouses the reactionary powers af the organism. Complaints that relapse. General offensive character of discharge and cxhalations, Very red lips and face, flushing easily.

Mind. — Very forgetful. Difficult thinking. Delusions; thinks rags beautiful things—that he is immensely wealthy. Busy al! the time. Childish peevishness in grown people. Irritable. Attections vitiated; very seljish, no regard for others. Religious melancholy. Averse to business; loafs—tou lazy to arouse himself. Imagining giving wrong things to people, causing their death. Sulphur subjects are nearly always irritable, depressed, thin and weak, even with good appetite.

Head. — Constant Ayat on top of head. (Cup. sulph.; Graph.) Heaviness and fullness, pressure in temples. Beating headache; worse, stooping, and with vertigo. Sick headache recurring periodically, Tinea capitis, dry form. Scalp dry, falling of hair; worse, washing. fiching; scratching causes burning. Eyes. —- Burning ulceration of margin of fids. Halo around lamp-light, Heat and burning in eyes. [Ars.; HRell.} Black motes before eyes. First stage of ulceration of cornea. Chronic ophthalmia, with much burnmg and itching. Parenchymatous keratitis. Cornea like ground glass.

Ears. — Whirzing in ears. Bad effects from the suppression of an otorrhoea. Oversensitive to odors. Deafness, preceded by exceedingly sensitive hearing; catarthal deafness.

Nose. — TUlerpes across the nose. Nose stuffed indoors, Imaginary foul smells. Ale red and scabby. Chronte dry catarrh; dry scabs and readily bleeding. Polypus and adenoids, Mouth, ~ Lips dry, bright red, burning. Bitter taste in morning. Jerks through teeth. Swelling of gums; throbbing pain. Tongue white, with red tip and borders.

Throat. — Pressure as from a lump, as from a splinter, as ofa hair. Burning, redness and dryness. Ball seems to rise and close pharynx. Stomach — Complete loss of, or excessive appetite. Putrid eructation. Food tastes too salty. Drinks much, eats little. Milk disagrees. Great desire for sweets. [-4rg. nit} Great acidity, sour eructation, Burning, painful, weight-like pressure. Very weak and faint about 11 a, m.; must have something to eat. Nausea during gestation, Water fills the patient up.

Abdomen. — Very sensitive to pressure; internal feeling of rawness and soreness. Movements as of something alive. [Croc.; Thuj.) Pain and soreness over liver. Culic after drinking.

Stool. — Frequent, unsuccessful desire; hard, knotty, insufficient. Child afraid on account of pain. Redness around the anus, with itching. Morning diarrhoea, painless, drives out of bed, with prolapsus recti, Hlemorthoids, oozing and belching.

Urine. — Frequent micturition, especially at night, Enuresis, especially in scrofulons, untidy children. Burning in urethra during micturition, lasts long after. Mucus and pus in urine; parts sore over which it passes. Must hurry, sudden call to urinate. Great quantitics of colorless urine, Male. — Stitches in penis. Involuntary emissions. [Nux; Cale.] Itching of genitals when going to bed. Organs cold, refaxed and powerless, Female. — Pudenda itches. Vagina burns. [Berb.; Nitr, ac.) Much offensive perspiration. [Lye.; Merc.; Petrol.; Thi. Menses too late, short, scanty, and difficult; thick, biack, arrid, making parts sore. {Kali c.; Lach.; Sit] Menses preceded by headache [Xrcos.] or suddenly stopped. Leucorrhoea, burning, excoriating. Nipples cracked; smart and burn. (Agar.; Lye; Sil.} Respiratory. — Oppression and burning sensation in chest. Difficult respiration; wants windows open. Aphonia. Heat, throughout chest. Red, brown spots all over chest. Loose cough; worse talking, morning, yteenish, purulent. sweetish expectoration. Much rattling of mucus. Chest feels heavy; stitches, with heart feeling too large and palpitating. Pleurttic exudations, Use Tinctura sulphuris. Stitching pains shooting through to the back, worse lying on back or breathing deeply. Flushes of heat in chest rising to head. Oppression, as of a load on chest, Dyspnara in middle oi night, relieved by sitting up. Pulse more rapid in morning than in evening. [Ars.]

Back. — Drawing pain between shoulders. Stiffness of nape. Sensation as if vertebre glided over each other.

Extremities. — Trembling of hands. [Yot, sweaty hands. Rheumatic pain in left shoulder. Heaviness; paretic feeling. Rheumatic gout, with itching. Burning in soles and hands at night, Sweat in armpits, smelling like garlic. Drawing and tearing in arms and hands. Stiffness of knees and ankles. Cannot walk erect; oop-shouldered. Ganglion.

Sleep. — Talks, jerks, and twitches during sleep. Vivid dreams. Wakes up singing. Wakes frequently, and becomes wide awake suddenly. Catnaps,; slightest noise awakens. Caanot sleep between 2 and 5 a. 3s.

Fever. — Frequent flashes of heat. Violent ebullitions of heat throughout entire bedy. Dry skin and great thirst Night sweat, on nape and occiput. Perspiration of single parts. Disgusting sweats. Remittent type. Skin, ~ Dry, scaly, unhealthy; every little injury suppurates. Freckles. Itching, burning; worse scratching and washing. Pimply eruption, pustules, rhagades, hangnails. Excoriation, especially in folds. {Lyc.} Feeling of a band around bones. Skin affections after tocal medication. Pruritus, especially from warmth, in evening, often recurs in spring-time, in damp weather.

Modalities. — Worse, at rest, when ‘standing, warmth in bed, washing, bathing, in morning, 1] a. M., night, from alcoholic stimulants, periodically, Better, dry, warm weather, lying on right side, from drawing up affected limbs. Relationship.—Complementary: Aloe; Psorin,; Acon.; Pyrarara (a fish caught in the Amazon, clinically used for various skin affections). Lepra, tuberculides, syphilides, varicosities, etc. Compare: Acon. (Sulph. often follows in acute diseases); Mercur, and Calcerea are frequently useful after Sulphur, not before. Lyc.; Sep,; Sars.; Puls.; Sulphur hydrogenisatum (delirium, mania, asphyxia); Sulphur terebinthinatum (chronic rheumatic arthritis; chorea); Tannic acid (constipation). Magnes, artificialis (great hungez in evening, profuse sweat on face, bruised pain in joints, rectal constriction after stool). Magnetis polus Articus (anxious, coldness of eyes as if a piece of ice lay in orbit, increased flow of sativa, constipation, sopor, trembling, abdominal flatulence), Magnetis polus Australis (dryness of lids, easy dislocation of ankle, ingrowitg iov-nails, aching in patella, shooting in soles), Compare in adenoids: Agraphis, Dose. — Acts in all potencies from the lowest to the highest. Some of the best results are obtained from the higher, and not too frequent doses. The twelfth potency is a good one to begin treatment with, going higher or lower accor-ting to the susceptibility of the patient. In chronic diseases, 200th and upward. In torpid eruptions the lowest potencies.

remedies.name: Sulphur Iodatum
remedies.text:
(Iodide of Sulphur) Obstinate skin affections, notably in barber's itch and acne, Throat. — Uvula and tonsils enlarged and reddened. Swollen. Tongue thick. Parotid hypertrophied. Skin, -- Itching on ears, nose, and in urethra. Papu- Jar eruption on face. Cold-sures on lips, Boils on neck. Barher’s itch. steer. Lichen planus. Arms covered with itching rash. Hair feels as if erect.

Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Sulphuricum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Sulphuric Acid) The “debility” comincn to acids shows itself here, especially in the digestive tract, giving a very relaxed feeling in the stomach, with craving for stimulants. Tremor and weakness; everything must be done in a hurry. Jfot fiushes, followed by perspiration, with trembling. Tendency to gangrene following mechanical injuries. Writer's cramp. Lead poisoning. Mind, — Fretful, impatient. Unwilling to answer questions; hurried, Head. — Right-sided neuralgia; painful shocks; skin feels pinched, Sensation as if brain was loose in forehead and falling from side to side. (Beil; Rhus] Concussion of brain where skin is cold, body bathed in cold sweat. Compressive pain in side of occiput; relieved by holding the hands near the head. Pain of outer parts, as if there were subcutaneous ulceration; painful to touch. Thrust in right temple as if plug were pressed in. Eyes, — Intra-ocular haemorrhage following traumatism. Great chemosis of conjunctiva, with aching and sharp pain.

Mouth. — Aphthe; gums bleed readily. Offensive breath. Pyorrheea. Stomach — Heartburn: somr eructations: sets teeth on edye, (Robin. Craving for alcohol. Water causes coldness of stomach; must be mixed with liquors. Refaxed feeling in stomach, Averse w smell of coffee. Sour vomiting. Desire for fresh food. Hiccough. (Nus.; Hydroc. av.; Mosch.] Coldness of stomach relieved by applied heat. Nausea with chilliness. Abdomen, — Weak feeling, with dragging into the hips and small of back. Feeling as if hernia would protrude [Nuwx]. especially left side.

Rectum. — Piles: oozing dampness. Rectum feels as if it had a big ball. Diarrhoea, fetid, black, with sour odor of body, and empty fail feeling in abdomen.

Female. — Menstruation early and profuse. Erosion of cervix in the aged; easily bleeding. Acrid, buening leucorrhoea, aften of bloody mucus, Respiratory. -— Respiration rapid with shooting in cervical muscles and movement of wings of nose; laryny moves “bp and down violently. Bronchitis in children with short, teasing cough, Extremities. —Cramp-like paralytic contraction in arms, hands; jerking of fingers while writing, [Stann.; Caust.; Cyctam.} Skin. — Bad effects from mechanical injuries, with bruises and livid skin. [4rn.; Acet. ac.] Ecchymosis. Petechiz. Purpura haemorrhagice. [Crotal.; Arn] livid, red, itching blotches, Haemorrhage of black ‘ blood from all outlets. Cicatrices turn red and blue and become painful. Chilblains with gangrenous tendency. Carbuncles, hoils and other staphylococcic and strepto- * coccic infections.

Modalities. — Worse, from excess of heat or cold in forenoon and evening. Heticr, from warmth, and lying on affected side.

Relationship. — Complementary: Puls. Compare: Stulphurous acid (acne rosacea, xlcerative stomatitis, pityriasis versicolor); Arn.; Calend.; Led.; Sep.; Cale.

Dose. — Sulphuric acid mixed with three parts of alcohol, ten to fifteen drops three times daily for several weeks, has been successfully used to subdue the craving for liquor, For homeopathic purposes second to thirtigth potency, SULPHUROSUM ACIDUM (Sulphurous Acid. H, § O,) Head. — Anxious, furious, disposed to fight. Headache better by vomiting. Ringing in ears.

Mouth. — Ulcerative inflammation of mouth. Tongue red or biuish-red.

Stomach. — Loss of appetite. Obstinate constipation.

Respiratory. — Persistent choking cough with copious expectoration. Hoarseness, constriction of chest, Difficult breathing. Female.—Fiuor albus. Debility.

Dose. — According to Ringer, ten to fifteen minims taken ten minutes before each meal will remedy pyrosis and prevent fermentation and flatulence. It also removes thrush. Homeopathicalty, third attenuation.

remedies.name: Sumbul
remedies.text:
(Musk-root) Has many hysterical and nervous symptoms, and is of use in neuralgic affections and anomalous, functional, cardiac disorders. Jnsomnia of delirium tremens (titteen drops of tincture). Sensation as if water dropped down spine. Asthma.

Head. — Emotional and fidgety. Dull in morning, clear in evening. Mistakes in writing and adding. Comedones. Tenacious, yellow, mucus in nose. Throat, —- Choking constriction; constant swallowing. Belching of gas from stomach. Spasm of pharyngeal muscles. Tenacious mucus in throat.

Heart. — Nervous palpitation, Neuralgia arquad left breast and left hypochondriac region. Loses breath on any exertion. Pulse irregular. Female. -—— Ovarian neuralgia. Abdomen full, distended, and pawful. Climacteric flushes. Urinary. —- Oily pelticle on surface of urine.

Relationship. — Compare: Asaf.; Mosh.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Symphoricarpus Racemosa
remedies.text: (Snowberry) This drug is highly recommended for the persistent vomiting of pregnancy. Gastric disturbances, fickle appetite. natsea, waterbrash, bitter taste. Constipation. Nausea duriug menstruation. Nausea, worse any mothon, Averse to all food.’ Better, lying on back. " Dose. -- Second and third potency. 200th has proved curative.

remedies.name: Symphytum
remedies.text:
(Comfrey -~ Knitbone) The root contains a crystalline solid, that stimulates the growth of epitheliuin on ulcerated surfaces. It may be administered interna!ly in the treatment of gastric and duodenal ulcers. Also in gastralgia, and externally in pruritus ani. Injuries to sinews, tendons and the periosteum. Of great use in wounds penetrating to perineum and bones, and in non-union of fractures; irritable stump after amputation, irritable bone at point of fracture. Psoas abscess. Prickwy pain and soreuess of periosteum.

Head. — Pain in occiput, top and forehead; changing places, Pain comes down hone of nose. Inflammation of inferior maxillary bone, hard, red, swelling.

Eye. — Poin in eye after a blow of an obtuse body. For traumatic injuries of the eyes no remedy equals this. Relationship. —Compare: Arn.; Cale. phos.

Dose. — Tincture Externally as a dressing for sores and ulcers and pruritus ani.

remedies.name: Syphilinum
remedies.text:
(The Syphilitic Virus —A Nosode) Utter prostration and debility in the morning. Shifting rheumatic pains. Chronic eruptions and rheumatism, Ichthyosis. Syphilitic affections. Pains from darkness to daylight; decrease and increase gradually. Hereditary tendency to alcoholism. Ulceration of mouth, nose. genitals, skin. Succession of abscesses. Mind. ~— Loss of memory; remembers everything previous to his illness, Apathetic: feels as if going insane or being paralyzed. Fears the night, and the suffering from exhaustion on awakening, Hopeless; despairs of recovery.

Head. — Linear pains from temple across, or from eyes backward; cause sleeplessness and delirium at night. Falling of the hair. Pain in bones of head. Top of head feels as if coming off. Stupefying cephalalgia.

Eyes. — Chronic, recurrent, phiyctenular inflammation of cornea; successive crops of phyctenules and abrasions of epithelial layer of cornea; photophobia intense, lachrymation profuse. Lids swollen; pain intense at night; ptosis. Tubercular iritis. Diplopia; one image seen below the other. Feeling of cold air blowing on eye. [Fluor ac.]

Ears. — Caries of ossicles in ear of syphilitic origin.

Nose. — Caries of nasal bones, hard palate and septum, with perforation; ozena.

Mouth. — Teeth decay at gum; edges serrated, dwarfed. Tongue coated, teeth-indented; deep iongitudinal cracks. Ulcers smart and burn, Excessive Row of saliva; it runs out of mouth when siceping.

Stomach. — Craves alcohol, Rectum. — Feels tied up with strictures. Enemas very painful. Fissures, prolapse.

Extremities. — Sciatica: worse at night; better about daybreak. Rheumatism of shoulder-joint, at insertion of deltoid. Run-around. Severe pain in long bones. Redness and rawness between toes, [Si/.] Rheumatism, muscles are caked in hard knot or lumps. d/- ways washing the hands. Indolent ulcers, Muscles contracted in hard knots. Female. -—Uicers on labia. Leucorrhoea profuse, thin, watery, acrid, with sharp, knife-like pain in ovaries.

Respiratory. — Aphonia; chronic asthma in summer, wheezing and rattling. [Tart, emei.] Cough diy, hard; worse at night; windpipe sensitive to touch, [Lach] Lancinating pains from base of heart to apex at night.

Skin. — Reddish-brown eruption, with a disagreeable odor. Extreme emaciation.

Relationship. — Compare: Mere.; Kal. hyd.; Nit ac.; Aur: dium, Modalities. — }t'orse, at night, sundown to sunrise, seashore, in summer. Better, inland and mountains, during day, moving about slowly.

Dose. — The highest potencies only, and in infrequent doses.

remedies.name: Syzygium Jambolanum
remedies.text: (Jambo) Seeds — Enlexing, active principle) A most useful remedy in diabetes mellitus. No other remedy causes in so marked degree the diminution and disappearance of sugar in the urine, Prickly heat in upper part of the body; small red pimples itch violently. Great thirst, weakness, emaciation. Very large amount of urine, specific gravity high. Old ulcers of skin. Diabetic ulceration. The seeds powdered, ten grains three times a day; also, the tincture.

remedies.name: Tabacum
remedies.text:
(Tobacco) The symptomatology of Tabacum is exceedingly well marked. The nausea, giddiness, death-like pallor, vomiting, icy coldness, and sweat, with the intermittent‘ pulse, are all most characteristic. Has marked antiseptic qualities, antidotal to cholera germs. Complete prostration of the entire muscular system. Collapse. Arterio-sclerosis, Gastralgia, enteralgia, seasickness, cholera infantum; cold, but wants abdomen uncovered. Vigorous peristaltic activity, diarrhoea.

Mind. — Sensation of excessive wretchedness. Very despondent, Forgetful. Discontented.

Head. — Vertigo on opening eves; sick headache, with deathly nausea; periodical. Sudden pain, as if struck by a hammer. Nervous deafness.

Eyes. — Dim sight; sees as through a veil; strabismus. Amaurosts; musce volitantes. Face. -~ Pale, blue, pinched, sunken, collapsed, covered with cold sweat. [-trs.; Merat.} Freckles.

Throat. — Nasopharyngitis and tracheitis, Acmming. morning cough, sometimes with vomiting. Hoarseness of public speakers.

Stomach. - Incessant nausea; worse, smell of tobacco smoke [Pitas.]; vomiting on least motion, during Pregnancy with much spitting, [Ant, t.; Asar.; Kreos.; Nuax v.; Sep.; Strych} Scasickness; terrible faint, sinking feeling at pit of stomach, Sense of relaxation of stomach, with nausea. [/pec.] Gastralgia; pain from cardiac end extending to left arm. Abdomen,— Cold. Wants abdomen uncovered. It lessens the nausea and vomiting. Rectum, — Constipation; rectum paralyzed, prolapsed, Diarthoea, sudden, watery, with nausea and vomiting, prostration, and cold sweat; discharges look like sour milk, thick, curdled, watery. Urinary. ~ Renal colic; violent pain along ureter, left side.

Heart. — Palpitation when lying on left side. Pulse intermits, feeble, imperceptible. Angina pectoris, pain in precordial region. Pain radiates from center of sternum, Tachycardia. Bradycardia.

Respiratory. — Difficult, violent constriction of chest. Przcordial oppression, with palpitation and pain between shoulders. Cough followed by hi¢cough. Cough dry, teasing, must take a swallow of cold water Caust; Phos.]. Dyspeena, with tingling down left arm when lying on !eft side, Extremities. — Legs and hands icy cold; limbs trem~ ble, Paralysis following apoplexy. [Plusmb.} Gait shuffling, unsteady.

Sleep. — Insomnia with dilated heart, with cold, clammy skin and anxiety.

Fever. — Chills, with cold sweat.

Modalities. — Worse, opening eyes; evening; extremes of heat and cold. Beiter, uncovering, open fresh air. Relationship, — Compare: Hydrobromtc acid; Camph.; Verat.; Ars. Compare: Nicotisum (Alternate tonic and clonic spasms, fotlowed by general relaxation and trembiing; nausea, cold sweat, and speedy collapse; head drawn back, contraction of eyelids and masseter muscles; muscles of neck and hack rigid; hissing respiration from spasm of Jaryngeal and bronchial muscles}.. Antidote: Ars, (chewing tobacco); /g#.; (smoking); Sep. (neuralgia and dyspepsia); Lycop. (impotency); Nwx (bad taste due to tobacco}; Calad. and Plantag. (cause aversion to tobacco); Phosp. (tobacco heart, sy xual weakness), * Dose. — Third to thirtieth and higher potencies.

remedies.name: Tanacetum Vulgare
remedies.text:
(Tansy) Abnormal lassitude. Nervous and tired feeling. “Half dead, half alive feeling” all over, Of use in chorea and reflex spasms (worms). Said to be a specific against effects of poison ivy, Head.—Heavy, dull, confused. Headache with teast exertion, Mental. — Irritable, sensitive to noise. Mental fatigue. nausea and vertigo, worse in a closed room. Ears, — Roaring and ringing; veice sounds strange; cars scem to close up suddenly. Abdomen, — Pain in bowels; relieved by stool. Desire for stool immediately after eating. Dysentery.

Female. — Dysmenorrhea, with bearing-down pains, tenderness, drawing in groins. Menses suppressed; later, profuse.

Respiratory. — Hurried, labored, stertorous respiration. Frothy mucns obstructs the air-passages. Relationship. -—- Compare: Cimicif.; Cina; Absinth. Ns follows well. Dose, — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Tarentula Cubensis
remedies.text:
(Cuban Spider) A toxamic medicine, septic conditions. Diphtheria. Adapted to the most severe types of inflammation and pain, early and persistent prostration. Various forms of matignant suppuration. Purplish hue and burning, stinging pains. Bubo. It is the remedy for pain of death; soothes the lost struggles. Pruritus, eapecially about genitals. Restless feet. Intermittent septic chills. Bubonic plague. As a curative and preventive remedy especially during the period of invasion.

Head. — Dizziness after heat and hot perspiration. Dull ache on top of head. Shooting pain through left eye across frontal region, Gastric. — Stomach feels hard, sore. Loss of appetite except for breakfast.

Back. — Itches across kidney region. Extremities, — Hands tremble, turgid with blood.

Urinary. — Retention. Cannot hold urine on coughing.

Skin. — Red spots and pimples. Feels puffed all over. Carbuncles, burning, stinging pains. Purplish hue. Gangrene. Abscesses, where pain and inflammation predominate. Scirrhus of breasts. “Senile” ulcers.

Sleep. — Drowsiness. Sleep restless. Sleep prevented by harsh cough.

Relationship. — Compare: Ars.; Pyrog.; Crotal.; Echin.; Anthrac,; Bellad.; Apis. Modalities. —- Bettvyr, smoking. Worse, night.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Tarentula Hispania
remedies.text:
(Spanish Spider) Remarkable nervous phenomena; hysteria with chlorosis; chorea, dysmenorrhea, spinal irritability. Extreme restlessness; toust keep in constant motion. Hysterical epilepsy. Mind — Sudden alteration of mood. Foxy, Destructive impulses; moral relaxation, Must constantly busy herself or walk. Head. —'Intense pain, as if thousands of needles were pricking into brain. Vertigo. [Grangtum.]

Male. — Sexual excitement; lasciviousness reaching almost to insanity; semina] emissions, Heart. — Palpitation; precordial anguish, sensation as if heart twisted and turned around.

Female. — Vulva dry and hot, with much itching. Profuse menstruation, with frequent erotic spasms. Pruritus vulvoe; nymphomania. Dysmenorrhea, with very sensitive ovaries, Extremities. — Weakness of legs; choreic movements. Numbness of legs. Multiple sclerosis, with trembling. Turtching and jerking.

Modalities. — [Vorse, motion, contact, noise. Better, in open air, music, bright colors, rubbing affected parts. Horse, seeing others in trouble. Relationship, — Compare: Agar.; Ctmicif.; Cupr.: Mag. phos. Antidote: Lach.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Taraxacum
remedies.text:
(Dandelion) For gastric headaches, bilious attacks, with characteristically mapped tongue and jaunced skin. Cancer. Relief from touch. Hysterical tympanitcs, Head, — Sensation of great heat on top of head. Sterno-masioid muscle very painful to touch.

Mouth. — Mapped tongue. [Ant ¢.; Ars.; Kali] Tongue covered with a white filin; feels raw: comes off in patches, leaving red, sensitive spots, Loss of appetite. Bitter taste and eractations. Salivation. [Aferc.; Syph.} Abdomen. — Liver enlarged and indurated. Sharp stitches in left side. Sensation of bubbles bursting in bowels. Tympanites. Evacuation difficult, Extremities, Very restless limbs. Neuralgia of knec; better, pressure. Limbs painful to touch.

Fever. — Chilliness after eating, worse drinking; finyer tips cold. Bitter taste. Heat without thirst, in face, in aliacks in toes. Sweat on falling asleep.

Skin. — Profuse night-sweats.

Modalities. — Worse, resting, lying down, sitting.

Relationship. — Compare: Choline, a constituent of Taraxacum root, has given encouraging results in the treatment of cancer. Choline is closely related to Neurin, it is the “Caneronie” of Prof. Adamkiewicz (E. Schlegel.) &ry.; Hydrast.; Nua Tela aranca (nervous asthma and sleeplessness), Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Tartaricum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Tartaric Acid) Great weakness, with diarrhoea, with dry and brown tongue. Continued vomiting. Burning in throat and stomach, Pain in heels. [Physol.]

Abdomen. — Pain around umbilicus and region of loins. Stool color of coffee-grounds (worse at night), with brows and dry tongue, and dark-green vomiting. Dose, — Third trituration,

remedies.name: Taxus Baccata
remedies.text:
(Yew) In pustular diseases of skin and night-sweats. Also in gout and chronic rheumatism.

Head. — Supra-orbital and temporal pain on right side, with Jachrymation. Pupils dilated. Face puffy and pale. Stomach, — Saliva hot, acrid. Nausea. Pain im pit of stomach and region of navel. After eating, cough. Feeling of pins and needles at pit of stomach; of emptiness.

Skin. — Large, flat, itching pustules. Badly smelling night-sweats, Podagra. Erysipelas. Dose, — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Tellurium
remedies.text:
(The Metal Tellurigm) Marked skin (herpes circinatus), spinal, eye and ear symptoms, Very sensitive back. Pains all over body. Offensive discharges. Siow development of symptoms. (Radiurn.]

Head. — Neglectful and forgetful, Pain in left side of head and in forehead above left eye. Distortion and twitching of left facial muscles; when speaking left angle of mouth drawn upwards and to left. Fear of being touched in sensitive places. Congestion to head and nape of neck, followed by weakness and faintness in stomach. Itching of scalp; red spots. Eyes, — Lids thickened, inflamed, itching, Pterygium; pustular conjunctivitis. Cataract, following ocular lesions; aid the absorption of infiltrations in iris and choroid. Ears.—- Eczema behind ear. Catarrh of middle ear; discharge acrid, smelis like fish-pickle, Itching, swelling, throbbing in meatus. Deafness. Nose, — Coryza, lachrymation and hoarseness; better in open air. [Cepa.} Obstructed; hawks salty phlegm from posterior nares.

Stomach. — Craving for apples. Empty and weak feeling. Heartburn.

Rectum. — Pruritus ani et perinei after every stool.

Back. — Pain in sacrum. Pain from lasi cervical to fifth dorsal vertebra, very sensitive; worse touch, (Chin. s.; Phosph.] Sciatica; worse right side, coughing, straining, and at night, with sensitive vertebral columns. Contraction of tendons in bends of knees.

Skin. — Itching of hands and feet. Herpetic spots; ringworm. [Tuberc.] Ring-shape tesions, offensive odors from affected parts. Barber's itch. Stinging in skin. Fetid exhalations. [Sulph.] Offensive footsweat. Eczema, back of ears and occiput. Circular patches of eczema, Modalities. — Horse, while at rest at night, cold weather, from. friction, coughing, laughing. lying on painful side, touch.

Relationship. — Compare: Radium; Selentum; Tetradymite (coccygodynia, ulceration of nails; pains in ankles, heels, and tendo-Achilles); Sep.; Ars.; Rhus. Dose, — Sixth potency and higher. Takes long time to develop its action, which is very prolonged,

remedies.name: Terebinthina
remedies.text:
(Turpentine) Has a selective affinity for bleeding mucous surfaccs. Tympanites and urinary symptoms very marked. Inflammation of kidneys, with haemorrhages —~ dark, passive, fetid. Drowsiness and strangury. Coma, Unbroken chilbtains, Head. — Dull pain like from a band around the head. (Corb, ac.} Vertigo, with vanishing of vision. Cold in head with sore nostrils with disposition to bleed. Eyes.——Ciliary neuralgia over right eye. Intense pain in eye and side of head. Amblyopia from alcohol.

Ears. — Own voice sounds unnatural; humming as of a seashell, talking toudly is painful. Otalgia, Mouth. — Tongue dry, red, sore, shining; burning in tip, with prominent papille. [4rg. s.; Bell; Kali b.; Nux om] Breath cold, foul. Choking sensation in throat. Stomatitis. Dentition. Stomach — Nausea and vomtiting; heat in epigastric region, Abdomen. — Enormous distention. Diarrhoea; stools watery, greenish, fetid, blaody. Hzmorrhage from bowels, Worms; lumbrici. Abdominal dropsy; pelvic peritonitis, Fainting aftes every stool. Entero-colitis, with haemorrhage and ulceration of bowels. Urinary. —Strangury, with bloody urine. Scanty, suppressed, odor of violcts. Urethritis, with painful erections. [Canthar.] Inflamed kidneys following any acute disease. Constant tenesmus.

Female. — Intense burning in uterine region. Metritis; puerpetal peritonitis. Metrorrhagia with burning in uterus.

Respiratory. — Diticult breathing; lungs feel distended; haemoptysis, Heart. — Pulse rapid, small, thready, intermittent.

Back. — Burning pain in region of kidneys. Drawing in right kidney extending to hip.

Skin. — Purpura. ecchymosis, dropsies. Scarlatina. Chilblains; with excessive itching and pulsative pains. Fever, — Heat, with violent thirst, dry tongue, profuse cold, clammy sweat, Typhoid with tympanites, haemorrhages, stupor, delirium. Prostration.

Relationship. — Compare: Alumen; Secale; Canth.; Nit. ac. Terebene 1x (subacute stages of inflammation of respiratory tract. Loosens secretion, relieves tightened feeling, makes expectoration easy). Neurotic coughs. Huskiness of public speakers, and singers, Antidote: Phos. Ononis spinosa ~ Rest Harrow — (Diuretic, Lithontriptic). (Chronic nephritis; vatcutus; nosebleed, worse washing face.} Dose. — First to sixth potency,

remedies.name: Teucrium Marum
remedies.text:
(Cat-thyme) Nasa! and rectal symptoms marked. Polypi. Affections of children, Suitable after too much medicine has been taker Oversensitiveness. Desire to stretch, A remedy of first importance in chronic nasal catarrh with atrophy; targe, offensive crusts and clinkers, sena, Loss of sense of smeil, Head. — Excited, tremulous feeling. Frontal pain; worse, stooping, Strengthens brain after delirium tremens.

Eyes. — Smarting in canthi; ids red and puffy; tarsal tumor. [Staph.} Ears. — Hissing and ringing otalgia.

Nose. — Catarrhal condition of both anterior and posterior nostrils. Mucous polypus. Chronic catarrh; discharge of large, irregular clinkers. Foul breath. Crawling in nostrils, with lachrymation and sneezing. Coryza, with stoppage of nostrils.

Stomach. — Vomiting of large quantities of darkgreen masses, Constant hiccough, attended with pain in back. Unnatural appetite. Hiccough on eating, after nursing.

Extremities. — Affection of finger-tips and joints of toes. Tearing pains in arms and legs. Pains in toenails, as if they had grown into flesh.

Rectum. — Jiching of anus, and constant irritation in the evening in bed. Ascaridcs, with nightly restlessness. Crawling in rectum aiter stool.

Sleep. — Restless, with twitching, choking, and starting up frightened. Skin ~— Itching causes tossing about all night. Very dry skin. Suppurating grooves in the nails. Relationship.—Compare: Texcrinm scorodonia (in tuberculosis with muco-purulent expectoration; dropsy; orchitis and tuberculous cpididymitis; especially in young, thin individuals with tuberculosis of lungs, glands; bones and urogenitals, 3x). Cina; Ignat.; Sang.; Sil. ‘ Dose. — First to sixth potency. Locally for polypi, dry powder,

remedies.name: Thallium Metallicum
remedies.text:
(The Metal Thallium) Relieves the violent pains in locomotor ataxia, Poralysis of lower limbs, Pain in stomach and bowels, Vike electric shocks. Paraplegia. 4ilopecio, Night aweats. Polyneuritis, Dermal trophic Sesions.

Extremities. — Trembling. Paralytic feeling. Lancinating pains, like etectric shocks. Very tired. Chronic myelitis. Numbness in fingers and toes, with extension up lower extremities, involving lower abdomen and perineum. Paralysis of lower limbs, Cyanosis of extremities. Formication, beginning in fingers and extending through pelvis, perineum and inner thighs to feet. Relationship —Compare: Lathyr.; Caust.; Arg. nit.; Plambyen.

Dose. — Lower trituration to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Thaspium Aureum
remedies.text:
(Meadow Parsnip) Hysteria, epilepsy, chorea, hypochondriasis, come within the sphere of this remedy.

Mind. — Suicidal; depressed; laughing and weeping moods alternate. Head, — Pressure on top, in right temple, associated with backache.

Male. — Great lassitude following coitus. Sexual power increased.

Female. — Intermittent neuralgia of left ovary. Acrid, profuse Jeucorrheea, with retarded menses, Respiratory.~-Dry cough, with stitches in chest. Dyspnoea.

Extremities. — Unusual tired feeling. Chorea, espe cially during slecp. Fidgety tegs. [Tarant.] Lameness in arms and spasmodic twitching.

Modalities. — Worse, during sleep.

Relationship. — Compare: Agar.; Stram.; Tarant.; Cicwta; ZEthusa. Dose, — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Thea
remedies.text:
(Tea) Nervous sleeplessness, heart troubfes, palpitation, and dyspepsia of old tea-drinkers.

Head. — Temporary mental exaltation, 11]-humored, Sick headache radiating from one point. Sleepless and restless. Hallucinations of hearing. Cold damp feeling at back of head, Stomach, — Sinking sensation at episgasirium. Feint, gone fechng. [Sep Hyd.; Olcand,] Craves acids, Sudden production of wind in large quantities.

Abdomen. — Borborygmi. Liability to hernia.

Female. — Soreness and tenderness in ovaries. tLach., Naja; Vespa]

Heart. — Anxious oppression. Pracordial distress. Palpitation; unable to lie on left side, Fluttering. Pulse rapid, irregular, mtermittent.

Sleep. — Sleepy in daytime; sleepiness at night, with vascular excitement and restlessness, and dry skin. Horrible dreams cause no horror.

Modalities. — H’orse, night, on walking in open air, after meals, Hettcr warmth: wart bath, Relationship. — Antidote: Kali hypophos.; Thuja; Ferr.; Beer, (Coffee-drinkers should drink wine: tea drinkers should drink beer.) Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency, Theine '4-% grain hypodermically for sciatica and supraorbital neuralgia,

remedies.name: Theridion
remedies.text:
(Orange- spider) Vertigo, sick headache, peculiar pain around heart region, phthisis florida, scrofula have all been treated successiully with this remedy. Sensttwe to noise; tt penetrates the bady, especially teeth, Rachitis, caries, necrosis. Phthisis, stitch high up in left apex, [4nthrax.) Where the indicated remedy does not hold long

Mind. — Resticss; finds pleasure in nothing. Time passes too quickly. Head.-- Pain worse anyone walking over floor, Fertigo, with nausea and vomiting on least motion, particularly when closing eyes. Eyes. —- Luminous vibrations before eyes; sensitive to light. Pressure behind eyeballs. Throbbing over leit eye.

Nose. — Discharge yellowish, thick, offensive; ozena. [Puls.; Thuja.) Stomach, — Seasickness. Nausea and vomiting when closing eyes and on motion, [Tebur.] Stinging pain on Jeft side over anterior aspect of spleen. Burning in liver region.

Respiratory. — Pain in upper left chest. [Afyrt.; Pix.; Anis.) Poin in left floating ribs, Catdiae anxiety and pain, Pinching in left pectoral muscle.

Back. — Sensitiveness between vertebre; avoids pressure on spine. [Agar., Bell.; Chin. s.; Lach.; Phos.; Zinc.) Stinging pains.

Skin. — Stinging thrusts everywhere. Sensitive skin in thighs. Itching sensations. Modalities. —W'orse, touch; pressure; on shipboard; riding in carriage; closing eyes; jar; noise; coitus; left side. Dose, — Thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Thiosinaminum
remedies.text:
{A Chemical Derived from Oil of Mustard-seed) A resolvent, externally and internally, for dissolving Scar tissue, tumors, enlarged glands; lupus, strictures, adhesions. LEctropion, opacities of cornea, cataract, ankylosis, fibroids, scleroderma. Noises in ear. Suggested by Dr, A. S. Hard for retarding old age. A remedy for Tabes dorsalis, improving the lightning pains. Gastric, vesicle and recta! crises.

Ear. — 7innitus. Catarrhal deafness with cicatricial thickening. Sub-acute suppurative otitis media, formation of fibrous bands impeding free movement of the ossicles. Thickened drum, Deafness due to some fibrous change in the nerve.

Dose. — Inject under skin, or, into the lesion a 10 per cent. solution in glycerine and water, 15-30 drops twice a week. Internally in capsules % grain daily. 2x attenuation.

remedies.name: Thlaspi Bursa Pastoris
remedies.text:
(Shepherd's Purse) Is an anti-haemorrhagic and anti-uric-acid remedy. Albuminuria during gestation. Chronic neuralgia. Rena! and yesical irritation. Haemorrhage from uterine fibroid; uterine haemorrhage, with cramps and expulsion of clots.

Head. — Eyes and face puffy. Frequent epistaxis. Vertigo; worse, rising. Frontal pain; worse toward evening. Scaly ¢ruption behind ears. Tongue white, coated, Mouth and lips cracked.

Nose. — Bleeding in nasal operations. Especially passive haemorrhage, Male. — Spermatic cord sensitive to concussion of walking or riding.

Female. — Metrorrhagia; too frequent and copious menses, Haemorrhage, with violent uterine colic. Every alternate period very profuse. Leucorthaa before and after menses; bloody, dark, offensive. Sore pain in tromb on rising. Scarcely recovers from one period beore another begins. Urinary. —- Frequent desire; urine Acavy, phosphatic. Chronic cystitis. Dysuria and spasmodic retention. Hezmaturia. Accumulation of gravel. Renal colic, Rrick-dust sediment. Urethritis; urine runs away in littte jets. Often replaces the use of the catheter.

Relationship. — Compare: Urtica; Croc.; Trill; Afillefol.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Thuja Occidentalis
remedies.text:
(Arbor vite) Acts on skin, blood, gastro-intestinal tract, kidneys, and brain, The main action of Thuja is on the skin and genitourinary organs, producing conditions that correspond with Hahnemann's sycotic dyscrasia, whose chief manifestation is the formation of wart-like excrescences upon mucous and cutaneuts surfaces —fig-warts and condylomata. Has a specific antibacterial action, as in gonorrhaea and vaccination. Suppressed gonorrhcea, salpingitis. Ill-effects of vaccination. Hydrogenoid constitutions, whose blood is morbidly hydroscopic, so that damp air and water are inimical, [Nat. s.] Complaints from moonlight. Rapid exhoustion and emactation, Left-sided and chilly medicine.

Mind. — Fixed ideas, as if a strange person were at his side; as if soul and body were separated; as if something alive in abdomen. [Croc.} Emotional sensitiveness; music causes weeping and trembling.

Head. — Pain as if pierced by a nail. [Coff.; Ign] Neuralgia from tea. [Selen.] Left-sided headache. White, scaly dandruff; hair dry and falling out.

Eyes. — Ciliary neuralgia; iritis. Eyelids agglutinated at night; dry, scaly, Styes and tarsal tumors. [Staph.} Acute and subacute inflammation of sclera. Sclera raised in patches, and looks bluish-red. Large, flat phlyctenules; indolent. Recurring episcleritis. Chronic scleritis.. Ears, — Chronic otitis; discharge purulent. Creaking when swallowing. Polypi.

Nose. — Chronic catarrl; thick, green mucus; blood and pus. On blowing nose, pain in teeth. Ulceration within the nostrils, Dryness of nasal cavities. Painful Pressure at root.

Mouth. — Tip of tongue very painful. [White blisters on sidv close to root, painfully sore. Teeth decay next to gums, very sensitive; gums retract. Drinks ial! audibly into stomach. Kanula; varicose veins on tongue and mouth. [siab.] Pyorrhoea atveolaris. Goetomach. — Complete loss of appetite. Dislike for fresh meat and potatoes. Raucid eructations after fat food. Cutting pain in epigasttium. Cannot’ eat onions. Flatulence; pain after food; sinking sensation in epigastrium before food; thirst. Tea-drinking dyspepsia. Abdomen, — Distended; indurations in abdomen. Chronic diarrhoea, worse after breakfast, Discharges forcibly expelled; gurgling sound. Brown spots. Flatulence and distention; protruding here and there. Rumdling and colic. Constipation, with violent rectal pain, causing stool to recede, [Si.; Sanic.] Piles swollen; pain worse sitting. Anus fissured; painful to touch, with warts, Movement os of something lwing [Crocs], without pain.

Urinary. — Urethra swollen, inflamed, Urinary stream split and small. Sensation of trickling after urinating. Severe cutting after, ([Sars.] Frequent micturition accompanying pains, Desire sudden and urgent, but cannot be controlled. Paralysis sphincter vesica.

Male. — Inflammation of prepuce and glans; pain in penis, Balanitis. Gonorrhaal rheumatism. Gonorrhoea (tincture). Pain and burning felt near neck of bladder, with frequent and urgent desire to urinate. Prostatic enlargement. [Ferr, pic.; Thiosinaminm; Ioa,; Sabai.) Female. -- Vagina very sensitive. [Berb,; Kreos.; Lyssin.] Warty excrescences on vulva and perineum. Profuse teucorrheea; thick, greenish, Severe pain in left ovary and left inguinal region. Menses scanty, retarded. Potypi; fleshy excrescences. Ovaritis; worse left side, at every menstrual period. {Zach.]

Respiratory. — Dry, hacking cough in afternoon, with pain in pit of stomach, Stitches in chest; worse, cold drinks. Asthma in children. (Nat. sulph.] Papitloma of larynx. Chronic laryngitis.

Extremities. — When walking, limbs fee] as if made of wooed or glass, and would break easily, Tips of fingers swollen, red, feel dead. Muscular twitchings, weakness and trembling.

Skin. — Polypi, tuberctes, warts epithelioma, nzva, carbuncles; ulcers, especially in ano-genital region. Freckles and blotches. Perspiration sweetish, and strong. Dry skin, with brown spots, Zona; herpetic eruptions. Tearing pains in glands, Glandular enlargement. Nails crippled; brittle and soft. Eruptions only on covered parts; worse after scratching. Very sensitive to touch. Coldness of one side.

Sleep. — Persistent insomnia.

Fever. — Chill, beginning in thighs, Sweat only on uncovercd parts, or all over except head, when sleeping; profuse, sour, smeiling like honey. Orgasm of blood in the evening, with throbbing in the blood-vessels. Modalities, —~ fVorsc, at night, from heat of bed; at 3a.mM.and 3p. M., from cold, damp air; after breakfast; coffee; vaccination, Better, left side; while drawing up a limb. Relationship.—Compare: Cupressus australis (sharp, prickling pain; general feeling of warmth; rheumatism and gonorrhoea). Cupressus Lawsoniana (acts like Thuja; terrible pains tm the stomach). Sphingurus (falling out of hair from beard; pain in jaw-joint and zygoma); Ant. tart.; Sil; Maland. (vaccination); Medorrh, (suppressed gonorrhoea); Mere.; Cinnat.; Terebdinth.; Juniperus; Sabin.; Sil; Canth.; Cannab.: Nit. a¢.; Puls.; Arborin is a non-alcoholic preparation of.Thufo. Antidotes: Merc.> Camph.; Sabin, (warts). Complementary; Sabina; Ars.; Nat. sulph.;. Silica. Dose. -- Locally, for warts and excrescences, tincture, or cerate. Internally, tincture to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Thymol
remedies.text:
(Thyme Camphor) A remedy having a wide field in genito-urinary diseases, It is indicated in pathological emissions, spermatocystitis, priapism and prostatorrhaa. The provings show an action limited to the sexual organs, producing a typical sexual neurasthenia. Specific for hook-worm disease. [Chenopodium.] Mental. ~— Irritable, arbitrary, must have his own way, Craves company, Energy gone.

Back. — Tired, aching throughout lumbar region. Worse, mental and physical labor.

Male. — Profuse, nightly, seminal emissions with lascivious dreams of a perverted character. Priapism. Urinary burning and subsequent dribbling of urine. Polyuria. Urates increased. Phosphates decreased.

Sleep. — Awakes tired and unrefreshed. Lascivious and fantastic dreams.. Modalities, — }4’orse, mental and physical labor.

Dose. — Sixth attennation.

remedies.name: Thymus Serpyllum
remedies.text:
(Wild Thyme) Respiratory infections of children; dry nervous asthma, whooping cough, severe spasms but little sputum. Ringing in ears with feeling of pressure in head. Burning in pharvnx, sore throat worse empty swallowing; blood vessels distended, dark.

Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Thyroidinum
remedies.commonName: Dried Thyroid Gland of the Sheep
remedies.text:
(Dried Thyroid Gland of the Sheep) Thyroid produces anaemia, emaciation, muscular weakhess, sweating, headache, nervous tremor of face and limbs, tngting sensations, paralyses. Heart rate increased, exophthalmus and dilatation of pupils. Jn myradema aid erctuiism its effects are striking. Rheumatoid arthritis. Infantile wasting. Rickets. Delayed union of fractures. In half grain doses twice a day over a considerable period said to he effective im undescended testicle in hoys, Thyroid exercises a general regulating influence over the mechanism of the organs of nutrition, growth and development. Thyroid weakness causes decided craving for large amount of sweets. Of use in psoriasis; and tachycardia, Arrested development in children. Improves the memory. Goitre. Excessive obesity. Acts better with pale patients, rather than those of high color. Ambiyopia. Mammary tumor Uterine fibroid. Great weakness and hunger, yet loses fiesh. Nocturnal enuresis, Agalactea. Begin treatment early in pregnancy. Dose 1% gr. 2 to 3 times daily. Vomiting of pregnancy (give early in morning before patient gets up}. Fibroid tumors of the breast, 2x trit. Dilates arterioles. [4drenalin contracts ithem.J Sensation of faintness and nausea, Mind. — Stupor, alternating with restless melan~ choly. Irritable, worse least opposition; goes into a rage’ over trifles. Head. -- Frontal headache. Eyeballs prominent. Face flushed; Jips burn. Tongue thickty coated.

Heart. — Weak, frequent pulse, with inability to lie down. Tachycardia. [Naja.] Anxiety about chest, as if constricted. Palpitation from least exertion, Severe heart pain. Ready excitability of heart. Heart’s action weak.

Urinary. — Increased flow; polyuria; some albumen and sugar. E£aurests in weakly children who are nervous and irritable (1% gr. night and morning}. Urine smells of violets, burning along urethra, increase of uric acid.

Extremities. — Aching pains, C&dema of legs. Respiratory, -- Dry, painful cough with scanty, diffcult expectoration and burning in pharynx. Skin, -— Psoriasis associated with adiposity (mot in develoning stage). Skin dry, impoverished. Cold hands and feet. Ecsemo. Uterine fibroids, Braweny swelling. Swelling of glands of stony harduess, Shugeish cases. Jaundice with pruritus. Ichthyosis, lupus. Relationship. —- Compare: Spongis; Cale.; Fucus; Lycopus; Jadothyrine, the active principle jsolated from thyroid gland, a substance rich in Iodine and nitrogen, affects metabolism, reducing weight. may produce glycosuria. Use cautiously in obesity, for a fatty heart may not be able to maintain the accelerated rhythm. Milk contains the internal secretion of the thyroid.. Thymus gland extract (arthritis deformans; metabolic osteoarthritis, 5-grain tablets 3 times daily).

Dose. — Crude Thyroid at times; better sixth to thirtieth potency. If the crude ‘Fhyroid is taken (two to three grains or more daily); the pulse should be watched. Must not be given in physiological doses where with feeble heart there is high blood pressure and not in tubercular patients.

remedies.name: Tilia Europaea
remedies.text:
(Linden) Of value in muscular weakness of the eye; haemorrhage of thin, pale blood. Puerperal metritis, Diseases of the antrum. ]Kali Ayd.; Chelid.]

Head. — Newralgis (first right, then left side), atth veil before eyes. Confusion, with dimness of vision. Much sneezing, with fluent coryza. Bleeding from nose.

Eyes. — Sensation as of gauze before eyes, [Catle.; Coust.; Nat. m.] Binocular vision imperfect. Female. ~~ /utense sore feeling about uterus; bearingdown, with hot sweat, but without relief, Much slimy Jeucorrhora when walking. [Bov.; Carb. an.; Graph.} Soreness and redness of external genitals. (Thwy.; Sulph.] Pelvic inflammation, tympanites, abdominal tenderness and hot sweat which does not relieve.

Skin. — Urticaria. Violent itching, and burning like fire after scratching. Eruption of small, red itching pimples. Sweat warm and profuse soon after falling asleep. Sweat increases as rheumatic pains increase. Modalities, — Worse, in afternoon and evening; in warm room, heat of bed. Better, cool room, motion.

Relationship. — Compare: Lilium; Bellad.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Titanium
remedies.text: (The Metal) Is found in the bones and muscles, Has been used: in lupus and tuberculosis processes externally, also in skin disease, nasal catarrh, etc. Apples contain 0.11 per cent. of Titan. Imperfect vision, the peculiarity being that Aaif an object only could be seen at once. Vertical hemiopia. Also, sexual weakness, with too early ejaculation of semen im coitus. Bright's disease. Dose, — Lower and middle potencies.

remedies.name: Tongo
remedies.text:
(Tonka-bean — Diptrix odorata) In neuralgia; pertussis. Head, ~- Tearing pain in supra-orbital nerve, with heat and throbbing pain in head and epiphora. Confused, especially the occiput, with somnolence and a sort of intoxication. Trembling in right upper lid. Coryza; nose stopped, must breathe through mouth, Extremities. — Tearing pains in hip-joints, femur, and knee, especially left side.

Relationship. — Melilotus. Anthoxanthum, Asperula, and Tonga contain Coumarin, the active principle. Compare them in hay-fever: also, 7rifol.; Napth.; Sabed. Dose, — Tincture and Jower potencies.

remedies.name: Tribulus Terrestris
remedies.text: (Ikshagandha) ©- - An East Indian drug useful in urinary affections, especially dysuria, and in debilitated states of the sexual organs, as expressed in seminal weakness, ready emis- Sions and impoverished semen. Prostatitis, calculous affections and sexual neurasthenia. It meets the autoiraumatism of masturbation, correcting the emissions and spermatorrhaa. Partial impotence caused by overindulgence of advancing age, or when accompanied by urinary symptoms, incontinence, painful micturition, ete. Dose.—-Ten to twenty drops of the tincture three times daily,

remedies.name: Trifolium Pratense
remedies.text:
(Red Clover).. Produces most marked ptyalism, Feeling of fullness with congestion of salivary glands, followed by increased copious flow of saliva. Feeling as if mumps were coming on. Crusta laciva; dry, scaly crusts. Stiff neck. Cancerous diathesis, Mouth, —Jacreased flow ef saliva, (Merc.; Syphil.} Sore throat, with hoarseness.

Respiratory. — Coryza like that which precedes hayfever; thin mucus, with much irritation, Hoarse and choking; chills at night, with cough. Cough on coming into the open air, Hay-fever. Spasmodic cough; whooping cough, paroxysms; worse at night. Back. —~ Neck stiff; cramp in sterno-cleido muscles; relieved by heat and irritation.

Extremities. — Tingling in palms. Hands and fect cold, Tibial ulcers.

Relationship. — Compare: Trifolum repens — White clover — (Prophylactic against mumps, feeling of congestion in salivary glafids, pain and hardening, especially submaxillary’; worse, lying down. Mouth filled with watery saliva, worse lying down, Taste of blood in mouth and throat. Sensation as if heart would stop, with great fear, better sitting up er moving about; worse, when alone. with cold sweat on face.) Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Trillium Pendulum
remedies.text:
(White Beth-root) A general haemorrhagic medicine, eith great faintness and diszincss. Chronic diarrhoea of bloody mucus, Uterine haemorrhage. Theatened abortion. Relaretion of privie revion. Cramp-tike pains. Phthisis with purulent and copious expectoration and spitting of blood.

Head. — Pain in forehead; worse, noise, Confused; eveballs feel too large. Vision blurred; everything tooks bluish. Nosebleed. [Millef.; Metitot.]

Mouth. — Haemorrhage from gums. Bleeding after tooth extraction.

Stomach. — Heat and burning in stomach rising up in cesophagus. limatemcsis, Rectum. — Chronic diarrhoea; discharge IJoudy. Dysentery; passage almost pure blood, Female, -— Uterine hatnorrhages, with sensation as though hips and back were falling to pices; better tight bandages, Gushing of bright blood on Jeast movement. Haemorrhage from fibroids. [Cale.; Nitr. ac.; Phes.; Sulph. ac.] Prolapse, with great bearing-down. Lencorrhea copious, yellow, stringy. {Hydras.; Kalt 0.; Sabin.) Metrorrhagia at climacteric. Lochia suddenly becomes sanguineus. Dribbling ef urine after labor.

Respiratory. — Cough, with spitting of blood. Copicus, purulent expectoration. Hemoptysis. Aching at end of sternum. Suffocative attack of irregular breathing with sneezing. Shooting pains through chest. Relationship.—-Compare: }’eccinum myrtillus (dysentery, acute and chronic typhoid, keeps’ intestines aseptic and prevents absorption and reinfection (Berries); Trillium cernuum (eye symptoms) everything looks bluish; greasy feeling in mouth); Ficus (haemorrhages; menorrhagia, hamaturia, epistaxis, hamatemesis, bleeding piles}; Sangwisuga — Leech —~ (haemorrhages; Meeding from anus). Jpec.; Sab.; Lach.; Hamam.

Dose. — Tincture and lower potencies,

remedies.name: Triosteum Perfoliatum
remedies.text:
(Fever-root) Triosteum is a very valuable remedy in diarrhoea attended with colicky pains and nausea, numbness of lower limbs after stool, and increased flow of urine; also in influenza. Quiets nervous symptoms, [Coffea.; Hyos.} Biliousness. Bilious colic, Head, — Occipital pain, with nausea on rising, followed by vomiting. Influenza, with aching pains all over, and heat in the limbs, Osaoena; frontal pain.

Stomach. — Loathing of food; nausea on rising, followed by vomiting and cramps. Stools watery, frothy.

Extremities. — Stiffness of all joints; calves numb; aching in bones, Rheumatic pain in back. Pains in limbs. Skin, ~ Itching welts. Urticaric from gastric derangement.

Dose. — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Triticum
remedies.text:
{(Couch-Grass) An excellent remedy in excessive irritability of the bladder, dysuria, cystitis, gonorrhoea.

Nose. — Always blowing nose.

Urinary. — Frequent, dificult, and pamful urination. {Pop.] Graveliy deposits, Catarrhal and purulent discharges, [Pareira.] Strangury, pyelitis; enlarged prostate. Chronic cystic irritability. Incontinence; constant desire. Urine is deuse and causes irritation of the mucous surfaces.

Relationship. — Compare: Tradescentia (painful urination, urethral discharge; scrotum inflamed). Chimaph.; Senecio; Populus trem.

Dose. — Tincture or infusion by boiling two ounces in a quart of water until it is reduced to a pint. To be taken in four doses in 24 hours.

remedies.name: Trombidium
remedies.text:
(Red acarus of the fly) Has a specific place in the treatment of dysentery. Symptoms are worse by food and drink. Abdomen.-- Much pain before and after stool; stool only after eating. Griping in hypochondrium in morning. Congestion of the liver, with urgent, loose, stools on rising. Brown, thin, bloody stools, with tenesmus, During stool, sharp pain in left side, shooting downward. Burning in anus.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency. TUBERCULINUM {A Nueleo-protein, a Nosode from Tubercular Abscess) Tuberculinum is indicated in renal affections, but caution is necessary, for where skin and intestines do not perform normally even high potencies are dangerous. In chronic cystitis, brilliant and permanent results. (Dr. Nebel Montreux.) -Of undoubted value in the treatment af incipient tuberculosis. Especially adapted to the light-complexioned, narrow-chested subjects, Lax fiber, low Tecuperative powers, and very susceptible to changes in the weather. Patient always tired; motion causes intense fatigue; aversion to work; wants constant changes. When symptoms are constantly changing ond wellselected remedies fail to improve, and cold is icken

remedies.name: Tuberculinum
remedies.text:
from the slightest exposure. Rapid emaciation. Of great value in epilepsy, neurasthenia and in nervous children. Skin affections, acute articular rheumatism. Very sensitive, mentally and physically. General exhaustion. Nervous weakness, Trembling. Epilepsy.

Mind. — Contradictory characteristics of Tuberculinum are mania and melancholia; insomnia and sopor. Irritable, especially when awakening. Depressed, melancholy. Fear of dogs. clnimats especially, Desire to use foul language, curse and swear.

Head. — Subject to deep brain headaches and intense neuralgias. Everything seems strange. Intense pain, as of an iron band around head. Meningitis. When critical discharges appear, sweat, polyuria, diarrhoea, exanthema, repeating the dose only when crises’ come on. Noctwal hallucinations, awakes frightened. Plica polonica. [Vinea.] Crops of small boil, intensely painful. successively appear in the nose; green, fetid pus, Ears. —Lersistent, offensive otorrhes. Perforation in mebrana tympani, with ragged edges.

Stomach. — Averse to meat, All-gone, hungry sensation. [Sulph.] Desire for cold milk. Abdomen, -—- Early-morning, sudden diarrhoea. {Sufph,] Stools dark-brown, offensive, discharged with much force, Tabes mesenterica. Female, — Benign mammary tumors, Menses too early, too profuse, long-lasting, Dysmenorrheea. Pains: increase with the establishment of the flow.

Respiratory. — Hard, dry cough during sleep. Expectoration thick, easy; profuse brouchorrheea, Shortness of breath. Sensation of suitocation, even with plenty of fresh air. Longs for cold air.

Back. — Tension in nape of neck and down spine. Chilliness between shoulders or up the back.

Skin. — Chronic eczema; itching intense; worse at night. Ringworm..[Teller.$ Acne in tuberculous children. Measles; psoriasis [Thyroid.]

Sleep. — Poor; wakes early. Overpowering sleepiness in daytime. Dreams vivid and distressing.

Fever. — Post-critical temperature of 2 remittent type. Here repeat dose every two hours, (MacFarlan.) Profuse sweat. General chilliness. Modalities. -- Worse, motion, music; before a storm; Standing: dampness; from draught; early morning, and after sleep, A&ctter, open air. Relationship—Compare: Koch's lvmph (acute parenchymatous nephritis; produces pneumonia, broncho-pneumonia, and congestion of the lungs in tubereutous patients, and is a remarkably efficacious remedy ia lobular pneumonia — broncho-pneumonia); Aviaire —Tuberculin from birds-- (acts on the apices of the fungs; has proved an excellent remedy in influenzal bronchitis; symptoms similar to tuberculosis; relieves the debility, diminishes the cough, improves the appctite, and braces up the whole organisin; acute broncho-pulmonary diseases of children: itching of palms and ears; cough, acute, inflammatory, irritating, incessant, and tickling; loss of strength and appetite); Aydrast. (to fatten patients after Tuberc.): Formic acid (tuberculosis, chronic nephritis, malignant tumors; pulmonary tuberculosis, not in thitd stage, however; lupus; carcinoma of breast and stomach; Dr. Kruil uses injections of solutions corresponding to the third centesimal potency; these must not be repeated before six months). Compare: Bacil.; Psorin.; Loch. Kalagua (tuberculosis; garlicky odor of all secretions and breath). Tescrinm scorndonia, Complementary: Calcerca; China: Bryon.

Dose. — Thirtieth and much higher, in infrequent doses. When Tuberculinum fails Syphilinem often follows advantageously, producing a reaction. The use of Tuberculinum in phthisis pulmonalis demands attention to the following points: In apyretic purely tubercular phthisis results are marked, provided the eliminative organs are in good order, but nothing below the 1000th should be used, unless absolutely necessary, With patients where strepto-staphylo-pneumococci are in the bronchi; where also, after washing the sputum, a pure “t. b.” bacilli-mass remains, the same treatment is indicated. With mixed infection ~~ found in the majority of cases— where the sputum swarms with virulent micro-organisms in addition to the “t. b.,” other procedure is necessary. If the heart is in good shape, a single dose of Tuberculinum 1000-2000 is given, provided there are no marked indications: for other remedies. With due attention to temperature and ponssible critical excreliuns, the dose is allowed to work until effects are no longer observed, eight days to eight weeks. Usually a syndrome then presents, permitting the accurate choice of an antipsoric Silica, Lycopodium, Phosphorus, etc. After a while the picture again darkens and now a high potency of the isopathic remedy corresponding to the most virulent and prominent microorganism found in the sputum is given: Staphylo-, Strepto-, or Pneumococcin. The accurate bacteriological analysis of the sputum is absolutely essential; the choice of the ison again clears the picture, and so, proceeding on the one side etiologically (where these isopathica have not yet been proved); on the other side symptomatically with antipsoric remedies, the disease is dominated. My own experience warns, in the case of mixed infection, against the use of Strepto-, Staphylo-, or Pneumococein helow the 500th. I use them only from 2000 to 1000, having seen terrible aggravations from the 30, 100, 200, with a lowering temperature from 104 to 96, Hence the admonition, which need not concern scoffers, but those alone who wish to avail themselves of a potent weapon. The toxins used as remedies are, like Tuberculinum, prepared from pure and virulent cultures, And cases, seemitgly condemned to speedy death, are brought in a year or two back to normal’ temperature, though, of course, sacrificmg a large portion of lung tissue. This result is sure when the patient can and will take care of himself, where the heart has withstood the toxin, and the stomach and liver are in good function. Further, climatic variations must be avoided. With the great mineral metabolism of the phthisic, diet regulation is imperatve, and should be preponderately vegetuble, together with the addition of physiological salts in low potency, Calcarea carb., 3x, 5x, Calcarea phos, 2x, 6x, and intercurrently according to indica~ tions organ-remedies as Cactus Tr. 30, Chelidonium Tr. 30, Taraxacum Tr., Nasturtium Tr., Urtica urens Tr., Tussilago farfara Tr., Lysimachia numularia Tr., for short periods. The first dose of Tuberculinum in any difficult case is, however, the most weighty prescription, The remedy should not be given without a most careful cardiac examination. As the surgeon before the anasthetic, so must the physician know the heart before administering this drug, especially to children, and seniles—and to young seniles. He who observes this rule will have fewer clinical reproaches on his conscience, When Tuberculinum is contraindicated, recourse must be had to the neatest antipsoric. The above caution applies also to asthma, pleutitis, peritonitis in scrofulous (tuberculous) subjects. [Dr. Nebel Montreux.] Verner (Paris) never gives Tuber-

remedies.name: Turnera
remedies.text:
(Damiana) Said to be of use in sexual neurasthenia; impotency. Sexual debility from nervous prostration, Incortinence of old people. Chronic prostatic discharge, Aids the establishment of normal menstrual flow in young girls.

Dose. — Tincture and fluid extract —ten- to fortydrop doses.

remedies.name: Tussilago Petasites
remedies.text:
(Butter-burr) Has some action ou the urinary organs, and found useful in gonorrhoea. Affections of pylorus. Urinary. Crawling in nrethra.

Male. — Gonorrhoea; yellowish, thick discharge. Erections, with urethral crawling. Pain in spermatic cord.

Relationship. — Compare: Tussilago fregrans (pylorus pain, plethora and corpulency); Tussilago farfara (coughs); as an intercurrent medicine in phthisis pulmonalis. (See Tubercutinum.) Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Upas Tiente
remedies.text:
(Upas-tree — Strychnos Tiente) Freduces ‘ionic spasms, tetanus, and asphyzia.

Head. — Disinclined for mental work, Irritable. Dull headache deep in brain

Eyes. — Pain in eyes and orbits, with conjunctivitis. Dull, sunken eyes. Styes.

Mouth. — Herpes on lips. Burning on the tongue. Pain in mouth, as from a splinter. [ Mit. ac.J Male. — Desire increased, with loss of power. Dull backache, as after excessive coitus, Chest, — Lancinating pain throughout right lung toward the liver, stopping breathing. Violent palpitation; sensation of heaviness in stomach.

Skin. — Nomb hands and feet. Hangnails inflamed; itching and redness of roots of nails.

Relationship. — Compare: Upas antaris (differs in producing clonic spasms, violet vomiting, diarrhoea, great prostration). Oval. ac. Upas when Brvonia fails (typhoid. Antidote: Curare.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency,

remedies.name: Uranium
remedies.text:
(Nitrate of Uranium) Is known to produce nephritis, diabetes, degeneration of the liver, high blood pressure and dropsy. Its therapeutic keynote is great emaciation, debility and tendency to ascites and general dropsy. Head. —I!-tempered; dull, heavy pain. Nostrils sore, with purulent, acrid discharge.

Eyes. — Lids inflamed and agglutinated; styes. Stomach. ~— Excessive thirst; nausea; vomiting, Ravenous appetite; eating followed by flatulence. Boring pain in pyloric region. Gastric and duodenal ulcers. Burning pain. Abdomen bloated. Urinary. -- Copious urination. Diwresis, Incontinence of urine. Diabetes. Emaciation and tympanites. Burning in urethra, with very acid urine. Unable to retain urine without pain. Enuresis. [Mullein oil]

Male. — Complete impotency, with nocturnal emissions, Organs cold, relaxed, sweaty, Relationship. — Compare: Phos. ac.; Lact. ac.; Arg. nit.; Kali bich.; Ars.; Phloridzin (a glucosidal principle obtained from the bark of the apple and other fruit trees. Produces diabetes and fatty degeneration of the liver; intermittent fever. Daily doses, 15 grains). Dose, — Second trituration,

remedies.name: Urea
remedies.text: (Carbamide) Tuberculosis. Lumps. Enlarged glands. Renal dropsy, with symptoms of general intoxication. Gouty eczema. Albuminuria, diabetes; uremia. Urine thin and of low specific gravity. Relationship — Compare: Uric acid (gout, gouty eczema. rheumatism, lipoma); Urinum (acne, boils, scurvy, dropsy); U'rtica, Tubercul.; Thyroid.

remedies.name: Urtica Urens
remedies.text:
(Stinging-nettle) A remedy for agalactia and ftthiasts. Profuse discharge from mucous surfaces. Enuresis and urticaria. Spleen affections. Antidotes tll-effects of eating shellfish, Symptoms return at the same time every year,’ Gout and uric acid diathesis. Favors elimination. Rheumatism associated with urticaria-like ernptions. Neuritis, Abdomen. — Diarrhora chronic disease of large intestine characterized by large secretion of mucus.

Male. — Itching of scrotum, keeps him awake; scrotum swotten. Female, — Diniinished secretion of silk, Uterine hicmorrhage. Acid and eacoriating Jeucorrhua.
