Prue rilus valmec, wilt stinging, ching, and oedema. Arrests flow of milk after weaning. Excessive swelling of breasts, Extremities. — Pain in deltoid; pain in ankles, wrists. Skin. —Jiching blorch Usticarm, burning heat, with fermication; violent itching. Consequences of suppressed ncith:-rash. Rheumatism alternates with nettles rash. Buru confined to skin. Urticaria nodosa, fez.) Erythema, with burning and stinging. Burus and scalds, ken-por. [Duly] Angio-neurotic mdema. Herpes s with sensation of heat and itching. Itching: aid sdnging of scrotum.

Fever. — General heat in bed with soreness over abdomen. Fever of gout. Tropical fever.

Modalities. — J} orse, from snow-air; water, cool invist air, touch.

Relationship. — Compare: Medusa; Nat, mur.; Lac. con,; Ricin (diminished mamnuiary secretion) ¢ Bombyr > Rhus; Apis; Chioral; Astac.; Puls, Cartivari. Bolctus luridus and Anacard. (urticaria tubercsa): Lycop, and Hedeoma (uric acid conditiuns); Formica

Dose. — Tincture and Iower potencics.

remedies.name: Usnea Barbata
remedies.text:
(Tree-moss) Is a remedy in some forms of congestive headache; sunstroke.

Head. — Bursting feeling, as if temples would burst, or the eyes burst out of the sockets. Throbbing carotids. [Bell]

Relationship. — Compare: Glonoinc; Beilad.

Dose. — Tincture, drop doses.

remedies.name: Ustilago
remedies.text:
(Zea Etalica) Possesses curative properties in skin diseases, particularly in psoriasis and eczema rubrum.

Mental. — Mania for bathing. Impulse to suicide, particularly by drowning. Easily angered, Stomach. — Appetite increased, voracious, alternating with disgust for foud. Pyrosis, nausea, vomiting, better drinking wine.

remedies.name: Ustilago Maydis
remedies.text:
(Corn-smut) Flabby condition of uterus. Haemorrhage. Congesliun to various parts, especially at climacteric, Crusta lactea. [}tola trie.} Head—Very depressed. Full feeling. Nervous headache from menstrual irregularities. Aching in eyeballs, with much lachrymation.

Male. — Uncontrollable masturbation. Spermatorrhua, with erotic fancies ard amorous dreams. Emissions, with irresistible tendeacy to masturbation. Dull pain in lumbar region, with great despondency and mental irritability, Female. — Vicarious menstruation. [Bry.; Phos.) Ovaries burn, pain, swell. Profuse menses after miscarriage; discharge of blood from slightest provocation (ipec., Sabina]; bright red; partly clotted. Menorrhagia at climaxis, [Cofe…: Lack.] Oozing of dark Ifood, clotted, forming long black strings. [Argn. #.; Croc.; Lac. c.] Uterus hypertrophied. Cervix bleed easily. Suiph. ac.] Postpartum haemorrhage. [/pec.; Sab,; Sec] Profuse lochia.

Fever. — Abundant sweat. Pulse at first accelerated then enfeebled, Palpitations, Extremities. — Muscular debility, sensation of boiling water along the back. Clonic and tetanic movements, Muscular contractions, especially of lower limbs.

Skin. — Alopecia. Tendency to small boils. Skin dry; eczema; copper-colored spots. Pruritus; sunburn. Psoriasis. (Internally and externaily.) Relationship. — Compare: Secale; Sabin.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Uva Ursi
remedies.text:
(Beacberry) Urinary symptoms most important. Cystitis, with bloody urme. Uterine haemorrhage. Chronic vesical irritation, with pain, tenesmus, and catarrha! discharges. Burning after the discharge of slimy wrine. Pyetitis. Cafculous inflammation.

Urinary. — Frequent urging, with severe spasms of bladder; burning and teariug pain. Urine contains blood, pus, and much tenacious mucus, with clots in large masses. Involuntary; green urine, Painful dysuria, Relationship. — Compare: Arbutin (a crystallized glucoside of Uva; found also in Kalmia, Gaultheria; given in doses of 15 grains with sugar). Arctosphylos manzanita (acts on renal and reproductive organs. Gonorrhoea, vesical catarrh, diabetes, menorrhagia. Tincture of leaves).

Dose. — Tincture, five to thitty drops. In pyelitis a trituration of the leaves.

remedies.name: Vaccininum
remedies.text:
(Nosode--- From vaccine matter) Vaccine poison is capable of setting up a morhid state of extreme chronicity, named by Burnett Vaccinosis, symptoms like those of Hahneniann's Sycosis. Neuralgias, inveterate skin eruptions, chilliness, indigestion with great flatuient distension (Clark). Whooping-cough.

Head. — lrontal headache. Forehead and eves feel as if split. Inflamed and red lids.

Skin. — Hot and dry. Pimples and hlotebes. Fruption like variola.

Relationship. — Compare: Variolin; Malundrium; Thuja, Dose. — Sixth to 200th potency.

remedies.name: Valeriana
remedies.text:
(Valerian) Hysteria, over-sensitiveness, nervous affections, when apparently well-chosen remedies fail. Hysterical spasms and affections generally. Hysterical flatulency.

Mind. — Changeable disposition. Feels light, as if floating in air. Over-sensitiveness. [Staph] Haltucinations at night, Irritable, Tremulous. Head. —- Sensation of great coldness. Pressure in forehead, Feeling of intoxication. Ears, — Earache from expesure to draughts and cold. Nervous noises, Hyperesthesia.

Throat. — Sensation as if a thread were hanging down throat, Nausea felt in throat. Pharynx feels constricted, Stomach. -— Hunger, with nausea. Eructations foul. Heartburn with guiping of rancid fluid. Nausea, with faintness. Child vomits curdled milk in forge lumps after nursing. Abdomen. ~ Bloated. Hysterical cramps. Thin, watery diarrhoea, with lumps of coagulated milk, with violent screaming in children. Greenish, papescent, bloody stool, Spasms in bowels after food and at night in bed.

Respiratory. — Choking on falling asleep. Spasmodic asthma; convulsive movements of the diapbragm. Female. -— Menses Jate and scanty. [Puis.J Extremities. — Rheumatic pains in limbs. Constant jerking. Heaviness. Sciatica: pain worse standing and resting on floor [Bell.]; better walking, Pain in heels when siting.

Sleep. — Sleepless, with nightly itching and muscular spasms, Worse on waking

Fever. — Long lasting heat, often with sweat on face. Jicat predominates. Sensation of icy coldness. [Helodcrma; Camp.; Abies c.} Relationship. — Compare: tsaf.; Jgu.; Croe.: Castor.; Amm.valer. (in neuralgia, gastric disturbance, and great nervous agitation), Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Vanadium
remedies.text: (The Metal) Its action is that of an oxygen carrier and a catalyzer, hence its use in wasting diseases. Increases amount of hemogiobin, also combines its oxygen with toxines and destroys their virulence. Also increases and stimulates phagocytes. A remedy in degenerative conditions of the liver and arteries. Anorexia and symptoms of gastro intestinal irritation, albumen, casts and blood in urine. Tremors: vertigo; hysteria and melancholia; neuro-retinitis and blindness. Anaemia, emaciation. Cough dry, irritating and paroxysmal, sometimes with haemorrhages. Irritation of nose, eyes and throat. Tuberculosis, chronic rheumatism, diabetes. Acts as a tonic to digestive function and in early tuberculosis. Arterio-sclerosis, sensation as if heart was compressed, as if blood had no room in the aorta. Anxious pressure on whole chest. Fatty heart. Denegerative states, has brain softening. Atheroma of arteries of brain and liver, Compare: Ars.; Phos, Dose, 6-12 potency. Ammon, vanad. (fatty degeneration of liver.) Dose, -—- The best form is Vanadiate of Soda, 2 mg. daily, by mouth,

remedies.name: Vanilla
remedies.text: (Vanilla) Marked skin. irritation resembling mild Poisov-cak; is sometimes produced by handling the beans, also by local use of vanilla essence in a hair wash. Vanilla, 6th to 30th, has been found effective in curing the skin affection. Vanilla is supposed to stimulate the brain and sexual propensities. Do not use the synthetic Vanilla extract.

remedies.name: Variolinum
remedies.text:
; (Lymph from Smail-pox Pustule) Used for “internal vaccination.” Seems to be efficacious in protecting against, modifying and aiding in the cure of small-pox, Head, — Morbid fear of smat!-pox. Deafness. Pain in occiput. Inflamed eyelids. t

Respiratory. — Oppressed breathing, Throat feels closed. Cough with thick viscid, bloody mucus. Feeling of a lump in right side of throat, Relationship. — Excruciating backache. Aching ts legs. Tired ali over with restlessness, Wrists pain. Bains shift from back to abdomen. Fever,— Hot fever, with intense radiating heat. Profuse bad-smelling sweat.

Skin. — Hot, dry. Eruption of pustules. Shingles. Relationship, — Compare: Varcin. (same action); Malandrium — the morbid product of the grease of the horse (a prophylactic of small-pox and a remedy for the ill-effects of vaccination; chronic eczema following vaccination). Dose, — Sixth to thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Veratrum Album
remedies.text:
(White Hellebore) A perfect picture of collapse, with extreme coldness, blueness, and weakness, is offered by this drug. Postoperative shock with cold sweat on forehead, pale face, rapid, fecble pulse. Cold perspiration on the forehead, with nearly all complaints. Vomiting, purging, and cramps in cxtremities. The profuse, violent retching and vomiting is most characteristic. Surgical shock. Mind. -- Melancholy, with stupor and mania. Sits in a stupid manner; notices nothing. Sullen indifference. Frenzy of excitement; shricks, curses. Puerperal mania, Aimless wandering from home. Delusions of impending misfortuncs. Mania, with desire to cut and tear things. [Taront.] Attacks of pain, with delirium driving to madness. Cursing and howling all night.

Head. — Contracted features. Cold sweat on forehead. Scnsation of a lump of ice on vertex. Headache, with nausea, vomiting, diarrhaoea, pale face. Neck too weak to hold head up. Eyes, — Surrounded by dark rings. Staring; turned upwards, without lustre. Lachrymation with redness. Lids dry, heavy.

Face. — Features sunken. Icy coltiness of tip of nose and face. Nose grows more pointed. Tearing in cheeks, teinples, and eyes. Face very pate, blue, collapsed, cold.

Mouth. — Tongue pale, cold; cool sensation, as from peppermint. Toothache, teeth feel heavy as if filled with lead.

Stomach. — Voracious appetite. Amst for cold water, but is vomited as soon as swallowed. Averse to warm food. Hiccough. Copious vomiting and nausea; aygravated by drinking and ivast motion, Crayes fruit, juicy and cold things, ice. Anguish in pit of stomach, Great weakness after vomiting.

Abdomen. — Sinking and empty feeling. Cold feceiiny i stomach and abdomen. Pain in abdomen preceding stoul, Cramps, knotting abdomen and legs. Sensation as if hernia would protrude. [Nar] Abdomen sensitive to pressure, swollen with terrible colic. Rectum, — Constipation from inactivity of rectum, with heat and headache. Cunstipation of babies, and when produced by very cold weather. Stools large. with much straining until exhausted, with cold sweat. Diarrhoea, very painful, watery, copious, and forcibly evacuated, followed by great prostration. Evacuations of cholera morbus and true cholera.

Respiratory. — Hoarse, weak voice, Rattling in chest. Much mucus in bronchial tubes, that cannot be coughed up. Coarse rales. Loud, barking, stomach cough, iollowed by eructation of gas; worse. warm room, Hollow cough, tickling low down, with blue face. Cough comes on from drinking, especially cold water; urme escapes when coughing. Cough on entering warm room from cold air. [Bryonts,]

Heart. — Palpitation with anxiety and rapid audible respiration. Pulse irregular, intermittent, feeble. Tobacco heart from chewing. Female, — Menses too early; profuse and exhausting. Dysmenorrhaa, with coldness, purging, cold sweat. Faints from least exertion. Sexual mania precedes menses. Extremities.—Soreness and tenderness of joints. Sciatica; pains like electcic Hashes. Cramps in calves. Neuralgia in brachial plexus: arms feel swollen, cold, paralytic,.

Skin. — Blue, cold, clantmy, iselastic: cold as death, Cold sweat. Wrinkting of skin of hands and feet. Fever. -= Chill, with extreme coldness and thirst.

Modalities. — Horse, at mght; wet. cold weather. Better, walking and warmth.

Relationship. — Compare: J" eruirinin: — alkaloid froma seeds of Sahadilla,— (electric pains, electric shocks in muscles, fibrillary twitchings): Cholos terrepina (cramps in calves); Comp; Cupr.; drs: Cuprust ars. (uitermittent, cold, clammy sweat); Narcissus foctiits (gastro-enteritis with much grmping and cutting pain in bowels. Fainting, trembling, cold limbs, small and irregular pulse); ?rychosanthes; Trychosanthes — Fatal —~ (diarrbuea, dizziness after every stool}; Agaric. emetic. (vertigo; longing for ice-cold water; burning pains in stomach}; dyaric. phatloides (cholera, cramps in stomach, cold extremities, urine suppressed). Veratrine (Inereased vascular tension, It relaxes it and stimulates the elimination of toxins by skin, kidneys, and liver).

Dose. — First to thirtieth potency. In diarrhoea, not beluw the sixth, VERATRUM VIRIDE (White American Hellebore} Congestions, especially to lungs, base of brain, Twitchings and convulsions. Especially adanted to full-blooded, plethoric persons, Rheumatism of heart. Bloated, livid

remedies.name: Veratrum Viride
remedies.text:
face. Furious delirium. Effects of sunstroke. Verat. vir, will raise the opsonic index against the diplococcus Pewmonia, 70 to 109 per cent. Congestive stage and early manifestations of hepatization in pneumonia. Clinically, it is known that such diseases as Tiegel’s contracture, Thompson’s Disease, athetosis and pseudohypertrophic muscular paralysis present a symptomatology quite like that produced by Veratrum vir, vpon mucular tisste. (A. E. Hinsdale, M.D.) Mind. — Quarrelsome and delirious. Head.—Congestion intense, almost apoplectic, Hot head, bloodshot eyes. Head retracted, pupils dilaicd, double vision. Meningitis. Pain from nape of neck; cannot hold head up. Sumstroke; head full, throbbing arteries. [Bell.; Glon.; Usnea.) Fare flushed, Cone vulsive twitching of facial muscles. (A yaricus.] Tongue. —~ White or yellow, with red streak down the middic. Feels scalded. [Sang.] Stomach, — Thirsty. Nausea and yvoiniting. Smallest quantity of food or drink immediately rejected. Constrictive pain; increased by warm drinks. Hiccough; excessive and painful, with spasms of oesophagus.

Abdomen. — Pain above pcivis, with soreness, Respiratory. —- Congestion of fungs. Difficult breathing. Sensation of a heavy load on chest. Pneumonia, with faint feeling in stomach and Violent congestion Croup. Menstrual cutic before the appearance of the discharge with strangury.

Urine. — Scanty with cloudy sediment, Female. — Rigid os. [Bell.; Gels.} Puerperal fever. Suppressed menstruation, with congestion to head. [Rell] Menstrual colic before the appearance of the discharge with strangury.

Heart. — Pulse slow, soft, weak, irregular, intermittent. [Tubac.; Dig.) Constant, dull, burning pain in region of heart. Valvular diseases. Beating of pulses throughout body, especially in right thigh.

Extremities. — Aching pain in back of neck and shoulders, Severe pain in jomts and muscles. Violent electric-like shocks in limbs, Convulsive twitchings. Acute rheumatism, Fever. Skin. -- Frysipelas, with cerebral symptoms. Erythema. [itching in various parts. Aut sweating. Fever, — Hyperthermy im the evening and hypothermy in the morning. Suppurative fevers with great variation of temperature.

Relationship. — Compar: 2 Bapt;: Bell: Aceon; Ferr. phos. Antidotes Stryehnm— Auid extract, 20- 40 drops, Dose, — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Verbascum
remedies.text:
(Mullein) Has a pronounced action on the inferior maxillary lnanch of the fifth pair of the cranial nerves; on the ear: and respiratory tract and bladder. Cutarrhs, and colds, with periodical prosopalgia, Quicts nervous, and bronchial, and urinary irritation, and cough, Face. — Neuralgia affecting zygoma, temporo maxillary jomt, and ear [Menyanth.], particularly of left side, with lachrymation, coryza, and sensation as if * parts were crushed with tongs. Talking, sneezing, and change of temperature aggravate the pains; also, pressing teeth together.

Ears. — Otalgia, with a sense of obstruction. Deafness. Dry, scaly condition of meatus (use locally).

Abdomen. — Pain extends decp down, causing contraction of sphincter ani.

Rectum. — Many movements a day, with twisting about uavel. Haemorrhoids, with obstructed, hardened Stool. Inflamed and painful piles, Respiratory. — ffoarse; voice deep, harsh; sounds like a trumpet; “basso profunde.” Cough; worse at night. Asthma. Soreness in pharynx, cough during sleep. Urinary. -- Constant dribbling. Enurrsis. Burning urination, Inercase with pressure in bladder.

Extremities. — Cramp-like pain in soles, right foot, and knee. Lower extremities feel heavy. Thum! feels numb, Neuraigic pain in left ankle. Strffness and soreness of joints of lower extremities. Modalities, — }J‘orse, change of temperature, talking, sneezing, biting hard; from 9 a.m, to 4d M, Relationship. —- Compare: Rhus erom.; Caust.; Phain.; Sphingurus (pain in zygema).

Dose. — Midlein oif, locally, for earache and dry, scaly condition of meatus, Also for teasing cough at night or Iving down. Enuresis, five-drop doses night and morning. Internally, tincttire and lower potencies.

remedies.name: Verbena
remedies.text: {Blue Vervain) Affects the skin and servous system. Neryous depression, weakness and irritation and spasms. Promotes the absorption of blood and allays pain in bruises. Vesicular erysipelas. Passive congestion and intermittent fever. One of the remedies for Poison-cak. Epi-" insomnia, mental exhaustion. In epilepsy, it itens up the patient's mental powers and helps the constipation. Dose. —Singte dose of the tincture. In epilepsy must be continued for a long time. Verbena in the form of a tea as a diuretic drink is used by Vannier ' (Paris) to aid elimination in tubercular therapy.

remedies.name: Vespa Crabro
remedies.text:
(Live Wasp) Skin and female symptoms marked. Indurated feeling. Vasomotor symptoms of skin and mucous membranes, Dizzy, better tying on back. Nausea and vomiting, followed by creeping chills from feet upward. Cramping pain in bowels. Axillary glands swollen with soreness of upper arms. Perspiration on parts laid on with itching.

Face. — Painful and swollen. Erysipelatous inflammation of lids, Chemosis of conjunctiva, Swelling of mouth and throat. with violent burning pains.

Female. — Menstruation, preceded by depression, pain, pressure. and constipation. Lcft ovary markedly affected, with frequcn? burning, micturition; sacral pains extending up back, Erosion around external os, Skin. — Erythema; intense fiching; burning. Botts; stinging and soreness, relieved by bathing with vinegar. Wheals, macules and swellings with burning, stinging and soreness. Erythema multiforme, relizved by bathing with vinegar.

Relationship. — Compare: Scorpo (salivation; strabismus; tetanus); Apis. Antidote: Sempervivum tector., locally. Dose, — Third to thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Viburnum Opulus
remedies.text:
(High Cranberry) A general remedy for cramps. Female symptoms most important. Often prevents miscarriage, False labor-pains. Spasmodic and congestive affections, dependent upon ovarian or uterine origin.

Head. — Irritable. Vertigo; feels as if falling forward, Severe pain in temporal region. Sore feeling in eyeballs. [Cimicéf.]

Stomach. — Constant nausea; relieved by eating.

Abdomen. — Sudden cramps and calic pains, Tender to pressure about umbilicus. Female.—-Menses too late, scanty, lasting a few hours, offensive in odor, with crampy pains, cramps ex~ tend down thighs. [cil,] Bearing-down pains before. Ovarian region feels heavy and congested. Aching in sacrum and pubes, with pain in anterior muscles of thighs [Xanthox.]; spasmodic and membranous dysmenorrhea, [Borax.] Leucorrliuwa, excoriating, Smarting and itching of genitals. Faint on attempting tu sit up. Frequent and very early miscarriage, causing seeming sterility.

Urinary. — brequent urging. Cupous, pale, lighscolored urme. Cannot bold water on coughing or walking. Rectum. —- Stools Jarge and hard, with cutting in tectum and soretiess of anus, Extremities, —Stiff, sore feeling in nape of neck. Sacral backache. Lower extremities weak and heavy.

Modalities. — Worse, tying on affected side, in warm room, evening and night. Beticr, in open air and resting.

Relationship. — Compare Virburnum prunifolium (habitual miscarriage; ofter-pains; cancer of the tonguc; obstinate hiccough; supposed to be a uterme tonic). Cimicif.; Cowloph.; Sep.; Xanthoz. Dose.—Tincture, and lower potencies.

remedies.name: Vinca Minor
remedies.text:
(Lesser Periwinkle) A remedy for skin affections, eczema, and especially plica polonica; also for haemorrhages and diphtheria.

Head. — Tvaring pain in vertex, ringing and whistling in ears, Whirling vertigo, with flickering before eyes. Spots om scalp, oociny moisture, matting hatr together. Corrosive itching of scalp. Bald spots. Plica potontia. Irresistible desire to scratch. Nose.-— Tip gets red easily. Moist eruption on septum. Stoppage cf one nostril. Sorcs in nose. Seborrhea upper lip and base of nose.

Throat. — Difficult swallowing. Ulcers, Frequent hawking. Diphtheria.

Female. — Excessive menstruation with great weakness. Passive uterine haemorrhages. [Ust.; Trill; Secale.) Menorrhagia; continuous flow, particularly at climacteric. {ach.] Haemorrhages from fibroids.

Skin. — Corrosive itching. Great sensitiveness of skin, with redness and soreness from slight rubbing. Eczema of head and face; pustules, itching, burning, and offensive odor. Hair matted together, Relationship. — Compare: Olrand.; Staph, Dose. —- First to third potency,

remedies.name: Viola Odorata
remedies.text:
(Violet) Has a specific action on the ear. Affects especially dark-haired patients; supra-orlital and orbital regions; rheumatism in upper parts of the body when on the right side. Worm affections in children. [Teuc.} Locally, for pain due to uterine fibroids. Also against snake-bites, bee-stings, Head. — Burning of the forehead. Vertigo; everything in head seems to whirl around. Heaviness of head, with sensation of weakness in muscles of nape of neck, Scalp tense; must knit the brows. Tendency to pain immediately above cycbrows. Throbbing under eye and temple. Headache across the forehead. Acts upon frontal sinuses. Eyes.—Ileaviness of lids. Eyeball feels compressed, I‘lames before eyes. Myopia. Choroiditis. Itlusions of vision; fiery, serpentine circles.

Ears. — Shooting in cars. Aversion to music. Roaring and tickling. Deep stitches beneath ears. Deatness; oforrheoea. °. Respiratory.~- Torpor in the end of nose, as from a blow. Dry, short, spasmodic cough and dyspnoea; worse in daytime. Oppression of chest. Pertussis, with hoarsenes. Dyspnara during pregnancy. Difficult breathing, anxiety and palpitation, with hysteria, Extremities. — Rheumatism of the deltoid muscle. Trembling of inls. Dresting pain tu right carpal and metacarpal joints. [Ulnus.] Urinary, — Milky urine; smells strong. Modalities, — I#’orse, cool air.

Relationship. — Compare: Ulmius (formication in feet, numb, creeping pain in legs and fect; rheumatic pains above wrists; numbness, tingling, and full soreness where gastracnemius gives off its tendon); Chexapodium (cars; serous or bloody effusion in the labyrinth; chronic otitis media; Drogressive. ‘deafness to the voice, but sensitive to sounds of passing vehicles and other sounds; buzzing; absent or deficient bone conduction; a consciousness af the ear; hearing better for s shrill, highpitched sounds than for low ones); dur.; Puls; Sep.; Cina; Cauloph. (in cheumatism of small joints.) Dose. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Viola Tricolor
remedies.text:
(Pansy) The principal uses of this remedy are for eczema in childhood and nocturnal emission accompanied by very vivid dreams, Head. — ieavy, pressing-outward pain. Eczema of scalp, with swollen glands, Face hot and sweating after eating.

Throat. — Much phlegm, causing hawking; worse in the air. Swallowing difficult.

Urinary. — Copious; disagreeable, cat-like odor. Mate. -~ Swelling of prepuce, burning in glans, Itching. Involuntary, seminal emissions at stool. Skin.—/mpctigv. Intolerabie itching. Eruptions, particularly over face and head, with burning, itching; worse at night. Thick scabs, which crack and exude a tenacions yellow pus. Eczema impetigonoides of the face. Sycosis.

Modalities. — Worse, winter; 1! a.m. Compare: Lycop, Relationship, — Compare: Rhus; Cale.; Sepia, Dose, ~Lower potencies. VIPERA -:~¢Bhe German Viper) Indicated in inflammation of veius with great swelling: bursting sensation, Enlargement of liver. Ailments of menopause, Cdema of glottis. Face. Excessively swollen. Lips and tongue swollen, livid, protruding. Tongue dry, brown, black. Speech difficult. Liver, — Violent pain in enlarged liver, with jaundice and fever; extends to shoulder and hip.

Extremities. — Patient is obliged to keep the extremities elevated. When they are allowed to hang down, it secms as if they would burst, and the pain is unbearable. [Diad.) Varicose veins and acute phlebitis. Veins swollen, sensitive; bursting pain. Severe cramps in lower extremities.

Skin. — Livid. Skin peels in large plates. Lymphangioma, boils, carbuncles, with bursting sensation, relieved by elevating parts. Relationship.—Pelias berns—Adder. ( Prostration and fainting, faltering pulse, skin yellow, paik about navel. Swetling of arm, tongue, right eye: giddiness, nervousness, faintness, sickness, compression of chest, could not breathe properly or take a deep breath; aching and stiffness of limbs, joints stiff, collapsed feeling, great thirst.) Eel serunt Cheart and kidney diseases. Failure of compensation and impending asystole), Dose. — Twelfth potency.

remedies.name: Viscum Album
remedies.text:
(Mistletoe) The symptoms point especially to rhgumatic and gouty complaints; neuralgia, especially sciatica. Epifepsy, chorea, and metrorrhagia. Rhcumatic deafness. Asthma. Spinal pains, due to uterine causes. Rheumatism with tearing pains. Arterial hypertension. Hypertensive albuminuria, Valvular disease, with disturbances in seaual sphere.

Head. — Feeling as if whole vault of skull were lifted up, Blue rings around eyes. Double vision. Buzzing and stepped-up feeling in ear. Deafness from wid. Facial muscles in constant agitation, Respiratory. — Dyspneea; feeling of suffocation when fying on tcjt side. Spasmodie congh dsthma, if connected with gout or rheumatism. Stertorous breathing.

Female. — Haemorrhage, with pain; blood partly clots and bright red. Climacteric complaints. [Lach.; Suiph.] Pain from sacrum into pelvis, with tearing, shooting pains from above downwards. Retained placenta. [Secele.] Chronic endometritis.

Heart. — Hypertrophy with valvular insufficiency; pulse small and weak; unable to rest in a reclining position. Palpitation during coitus. Failing compensation, dyspnoea worse lying on left side. Weight and oppression of heart; as if a hand were squeezing it; tickling sensation about heart.

Extremities. — Pains alternate in the knee and ankle with shoulder and elbow. Scistica. Tvaring, shooting pains in both thighs and upper extremities. A glow rises from the feet to the head; seems to be on fire. Periodic pains from sacrum into pelvis, worse wt bed, with pains into thighs and upper extremities. General tremor, as if all muscles were in state of fibrillary contraction, Dropsy of extretnities. Modalities, — Horse, winter, cold, stormy weather; in bed. Movement; ling on left side.

Relationship. — Comparc: Secale; Convallar.; Bry.; Puls.; Rhodod. Guipsine — active principle — (exalts the hypotensive properties of Viscum).

Dose. — Tincture and lower potencies.

remedies.name: Wyethia
remedies.text:
{Poison-weed) Has marked effects on the throat, and has proven an excellent remedy in pharyngitis, especially the follicular form. Useful also in haemorrhoids. Irritable throats of singers and public speakers, Head. — Nervous, uneasy, depressed. Dizzy. Rush f blgod to head. Sharp pain in forehead, Mouth, — Feels as if scalded; seusation of heat down esophagus..

Throat. — Constant clearing and hemming. Dry, posterior nares; no relief from clearing. Throut feels swollen; epiglottis dry and burning. Difficult swallowing. Constant desire to swallow saliva. Uvula feels elongated.

Stomach. — Sense of weight. Belching of wind alternating with hiccough. Nausea and vomiting.

Abdomen. — Pain below ribs of right side.

Stool. — Louse, dark, at night. Itching of anus. Constipation, with haemorrhoids; not bleeding. Respiratory, -—- Dry, hacking cough, caused by ticl:- ling of the epylottis. Burning sensation in the bronchial tubes. Tendency to get hoarse from talking or singing; throat is het and dry. [Belh] Dry asthma.

Female. — Pain in left ovary, shooting down to knee. Pain in uterus, could cutline its contour.

Extremities. — Pain in back; extends to end of spine. Pain m right arm, with stiffness of wrist and hand. Aching pains alf over.

Fever. — Chill at 11 4. m. Thirst for ice-water during chill. No thirst with heat. Profuse sweat all night. Terrific headache durmg sweat.

Relationship. — Compare: Arita; Sang: Lack, Dose. — First to sixth potency. (Prickly Ash) XANTHOXYLUM Its specific action is on the nervous system and mucous membranes, Paralysis, epecially Aemiplegia. Painful haemorrhages, after-pains, neuralgic dysmenorrhoca, and rheumatic affections, offer a therapeutic field

remedies.name: Xanthoxylum
remedies.text:
for this remedy, especially in patients of spare habit and nervous, delicate organization. Indigestion from overeating or {rom too much fluid. Sluggish capillary circulation. Neurasthenia, poor assimilation, insomuie, occipital headache. Mind, — Nervous, frightened. Mental depression.

Head. — Feels full. Weight and pain on vertex. Pain over eyes, throbhing pressure over nose, pressure in forehead; head seems divided; ringing in ears. Ovcipital headache. Sick headache with dizziness and fiatulence.

Face. — Neuralgia of lower jaw. Dryness of mouth and fauces. Pharyngitis. [}’yethia.]

Abdomen. — Griping and diarrhoea. Dysentery, with tyunpanites, tenesmus; inodorous discharges. Female, -— Menses too early and painful. Ovarian neuralgia, with pain in loins and lower abdomen; worse, efi side, extending down the thigh, along genito-crural nerves. Neuralgic dysmenorrhaa, with neuralgic headaches; pain in back and down legs. Menses thick, almost black. After-pains. [Arnica; Cup.;. Cham.) Leucorrhoea at time of menses. Neurasthenic patients who are thin, emaciated; poor assimilation with insomnia and occipital headache. Respiratory. —- Aphonia. Constant desire to take a lang breath; oppression of chest. Dry cough, day and night.

Extremities. — Paratysis of left side following spinal disorders. Numbness of left side; impairment of nerves of motion. Hemiplegia. Pain in nape, extending down back. Sciatica; worse, hot weather, Anterior, crural neuralgia, [Siaph.] Left arm numb. Neuralgic shooting pain, as from electricity, all over limbs. Sleep. ~ Hard and unrefreshing; dreams of flying. Sleeplessness in neurasthenics, Relationship.— Compare: Gnaph.; Cimictf.; Staph.; Meser,; Piscida. White dogwood (pains of irregular menstruation; regulates the flow; sudden profound sleep. Neuralgic and spasmodic affections.) Dose. — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Xerophyllum
remedies.text:
(Tamalpais Lily. Basket Grass Flower) Should prove curative in eczematonus conditions, puison-oak, early typhoid states, etc.

Mind. — Dull, cannot concentrate mind for study; forgets names; writes last letters of words first; misspells common words, Head. — Feels full, stuffed up, pain across forehead and above eyes. Great pressure at rout uf nose. Bewildered. Loss of conscionsness.

Eyes. — Painful, as of sand, smarting; difficult to focus for close work.

Nose. — Stuffed; tightness at bridge of nose; acute nasal catarrh, Face. -- Bloated in morning. Puffy under eyes.

Throat. — Stitching pain upon swallowing. Stomach, — Feels full and heavy. Eructations sour;. offensive, an hour after juncheon and dinner. Vomiting at 2 Pp, M, Abdomen, — Intestinal flatulence. In morning rumbling in bowels, with desire tor stool.

Rectum. — Constipation, stools hard, smalt lumps. Difficult, soft stools, with much straining. Much flatus. Bearing-down pain in rectum.

Urine. — Difficulty of retaining; dribbling when walking. Frequent urination at night. Female. -- Bearing-down sensation. Vulva inflamed, with furious itching. Increased sexual desire, with ovarian and uterinc pains and leucorrhoea, Respiratory. — Posterior nares raw; discharge thick, yellow mucus, Sneezing. Trachea sore; lumps feel constricted, Back. —- Feels hot from sacrum to scapule. Backache, extending down legs. Pain over kidneys, Heat deep in spine.

Extremities. — Muscular lameuess, trembling. Pain in knees. Limbs fee! stiff. [Rhus.} Skin. — Erythema, with vesication and intense itching, stinging, and burning. Blisters, little lumps. Skin rough and cracked; feels like leather. Dermatitis, especially around knees. Inflammation resembling puison oak. Inguinal glands and behind knee swollen, Modalities. — Horse, application of cold water, in afternoon and evening. &ctter, application of hot water, in morning, moving affected part.

Relationship. — Compare: Rius; Anecard.; Grindelta. Dose, — Sixth potency or higher,

remedies.name: X-ray
remedies.commonName: Vial containing alcohol exposed to X-Ray
remedies.text:
(Vial containing alcohol exposed to X-Ray) Repeated exposure to Roentgen (X-ray) has produced skia lesions often followed by cancer. Distressing pain. Sexual glands are particularly affected. Atrophy of ovaries and testicles. Sterility. Changes take place in the blood lymphatics and bone marrow. Anaemia and teukmemia. - Corresponds to stubbornness as in burns, they refuse to heal. Psoriasis. Has the property of stimulating cellular metabolism. Arouses the reactive vitality, mentally and physically. Rrings to the surface suppressed symptoms, especially sycotic and those due to mixed infections. Its homeeapathic action is thus centrifugal, towards the periphery.

Head. — Sticking pains in different parts of head and face. Dull pain in right upper jaw. Stiff neck. Sudden cricks in neck, pains more severe behind ears. Pain in muscles of neck when lifting head from pillow, Fullness in ears, ringing in head, Mouth. —- Tongue dry, rough, sore. Throat painful on swallowing. Nausea. Male,— Lewd dreams. Sexual desire lost. Reestablishes suppressed gonorrhcea, Extremities. --— Rheumatic pains, Gencra! tired and sick feeling, Palms rough and scaly.

Skin. — Dry, itching eczema. Erythema around roots of nails, Skin dry, wrinkled. Painful cracks. Warty growths. Nails thicken. Psoriasis.

Modalities. — forse, in bed. afternoon, evening and night; open air, Dose. — Twelfth potency and higher. Birning iancinations throughout the body; pains as if broken in joints, when cartilages of two bones touch; shooting and jerkings; headache as if a nail were driven in; tendency of old wounds to bleed afresh.) remedies.name: Yohimbinum
remedies.text:
(Johimbin) Excites sexual orgaus ard central nervous system. A potent aphrodisiac, used in physiological doses. Homecopathically, should be of service in congestive conditions of the sexual organs. Causes hyperemia of the milk glands and stimulates the function of lactation.

Head. — Agitation, with flying sensations of heat in face. Disagreeable, metallic taste. Copious salivation. Nausea and eructation. Sexual—Strong and lasting erections, Bleeding piles. Intestinal haemorrhage. Urethritis.

Fever. — Rigor; intense heat, waves of heat and chilliness, tendency to sweat, Sleep. — Sleepless. Thoughts of events of whole past life keep him awake.

Dose. — As a sexual stimulant, ten drops of a one per cent, solution, or hypodermic tablets of 0.005 gm. Homeopathic dose, third potency.

remedies.name: Yucca Filamentosa
remedies.text:
(Bear-grass) So-called bilious symptoms, with headache. Despondent and irritable.

Head. — Aches as if top of head would fly off. Arteries of forehead throb, Nose red.

Face. — Yellow; tongue yeilow, coated, taking imprint of teeth. [Merc.; Pod.; Rhus.} Mouth, — Taste as of rotten eggs, [Arwica.] Throat, — Sensation as if something hung down from posterior nares; cannot get it up or down.

Abdomen. — Deep pain in right side over liver, going through back. Stool yellowish brown, with bile. Male, — Burning and swelling of the prepuce, with redness of meatus. Gonorrhoea. [Cann.; Tussil.]

Skin. — Erythematous redness. Dose, — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Zincum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Zine) The provings picture cerebral depression. The nervous symptoms of most importance. Defective vitality. Impending brain paralysis. Period of depression in disease, Spinal affections. Twitchings. Pain, as if between skin and flesh. Great relicf from discharges. Chorea, from fright or suppressed eruption. Convuisions, with pale face und sto heat. Marked anaemia with profound prostration. It causes a decrease in the number, and destruction of red blood curpuseles.

Mind. — Weak memory. Very sensitive fo noise. Averse to work, to talk. Child repeats everything said to tt, Fears arrest on account of a supposed crime. Melancholia. Lethergic, stupid. Paresis. Head, — Feels as if he would fall to left side. Headache from the smallest quantity of wine. Hydrocephalus. Rolls head from side to side. Bores head into pillow. Occipital pain, with weight on vertex. Auto- Matic motion of head and hands, Brain-fag; headaches of overtaxed school children. Forehrad cool; base of brain Aot. Roaring in head. Starting in fright.

Eyes. — Pterygium; smarting, fachrymation, itching. Pressure as if pressed into head. Jiching and soreness of lids and inner angles. Ptosis. Rolling of eyes. Blurring of one-half of vision; worse, stimulants, Squinting, Amaurosis, with severe headache, Red and inflamed conjunctiva; worse, inner canihus, Ears. -— Tearing, stitches, and external swelling. Discharge of fetid pus.

Nose. — Sore feeling high up; pressure upon root.

Face. — Pale lips, and corners of mouth cracked. Redness and itching eruption on chin. Tearing in facial bones.

Mouth. — Teeth loose. Gums bleed. Gnashing of teeth. Bloody taste. Blisters on tongue. Difficult dentition; child weak; cold and restless feet.

Throat. — Dry; constant inclination to hawk up tenacious mucus. Rawness and dryness in throat and larynx. Pain in muscles of throat when swallowing.

Stomach. — Hiccough, nausea, vomiting of bitter mucus. Burning in stomach, heartburn from sweet things. Cannot stand smallest quantity of wine, Ravenous hunger about 11 4, mM. [Sulph.] Great greediness when eating; cannot eat fast enough. Atonic dyspepsia, feeling as if stomach were collapsed. Abdomen, — Pain after a light meal, with tympanitis. Pain in a spot beneath navel. Gurgling and griping; distended. Fiatulent colic, with retraction of abdomen. [Piumb.] Enlarged, inderated sore liver. Reflex symptoms from floating kidney. Griping after eating.

Urine. — Can only void urine when sitting bent backwards. Llysterical retention. Involuntary urination when walking, coughing or sneezing. Rectum, — Hard, small. constipated stool Cholera infantum, with tenesmus; grecn mucous discharges. Sudden cessation of diarrhoea, followed by cerebral symptoms, Male, — Testicles swelled, drawn up. Erections violent, Emissions with hypechondriasis. Falling off of hair (pubic). Drawing in testicles up to spermatic cord.

Female. — Ovarian pain, espertally ieft; can't keep sti, (Viburn.} Nymphomania of lying-in women. Menses too late, suppressed; lochia suppressed. [Puis.] Breasts painful. Nipples sore. Menses flow more at night, [Bor.] Complaints all beter during menstrual flow. [Eupion; Lach.) AN tae female symptoms are associated with restlessness, depression, coldness, spinal tenderness and restless fect.

Respiratory. — Burning pressure beneath sternum. Constriction and cutting in chest. Hoarseness. Dehilitating, spasmodic cough; worse, eating sweet things. Child grasps genitals during cough. Asthmatic bronchitis, with constriction of chest. Dyspuaa better as soon as ca pectoration appears. Back. -~ Pain in small of back. Cannot bear back touched. [Sul.; Therid.; Cinch.] Tension and stinging between shoulders. Spinal irritation. Dull aching about the last dorsal or first lumbar vertebra; worse sitting. Burning along spine. Nope of neck weary from writing or any exertion. Tearing in shoulder-blades. Extremities, — Lameness, weakness, trembling and twitching of various muscles. Chilblains. [Agar.] Feet in continued motion; cannot keep still. Large varicose veins on legs. Sweaty. Convulsions, with pale foce, Transverse pains, especially in upper extremity. Soles of fect sensitive. Steps with entire sole of foot on floor

Sleep. — Cries out during sleep; body jerks; wakes frightened, stares. Nervous motion of feet when asleep, Loud screaming out at ight in sleep without being aware of it. Somnamhulism. [Ali phos.]

Skin. — Furicose veins, especially of lower extremities, [Pxls. Formication of feet and legs as from bugs crawling over the skin, preventing sleep. Eczema, especially in the anamic and neurotic. Itching of thighs and hollow of knees. Retrocession of eruptions..

Fever. — Frequent, febrile shiverings down hack. Cold extremities. Night-sweat. Profuse sweat on fect.

Modalities. — Worse, at menstrual period, from touch, between § to 7 p, m.; after dinner, from wine. Better, while eating, discharges, and appearance of eruptions.

Relationship. — Compare: Agaric.; Ign.; Plumb, Argent.; Puls; Helleb.; Tuberc. Inimical: Nex Chem. Compare in amelioration by secretions: Lach. Stan.; Mosch. Compare: Zincum aceticum (effects of night-watching and erysipelas; brain feels sore; Rademacher’s solution, five-drop doses three times a day in water, for those who are compelled to work, on an insufficient amount of sleep); Zinc, bromatum (dentition, chorea, hyrocephalus; Zinc. oxydatum {hypochrondriasis due to masturbation); Zine. cyanatum (as a remedy for meningitis and cerebro-spinal meningitis, paralysis agitans, chorea, and hysteria, it has received some attention); Zinc. ars. (chorea, anaemia, profound exhaustion on slight exertion. Depression and marked involvement of lower extremities); Zinc. carb, (postgonorrheal throat affections, tonsils swollen, bluish superficial spots); Zine. phos. {herpes zoster 1x); Zinc. muriat, (disposition to pick the bedclothes; sense of smell and taste perverted; bluish-green tint of skin; cold and sweaty); Zinc. phos. (neuralgia of head and face; lightning-like pains in locomotor ataxia, brainfag, nervousness, and vertigo; sexual excitement and sleeplessness); Ammon. valerion (violent neuralgia, with great nervous agitation); Zinc, picricum {facial paralysis; brain-fag, headache in Bright's disease; seminal emissions; loes of memeary and energy); Zine. sulph. (corneitis; granular lids; tongue paralyzed; cramps in arms and legs; trembling and convulsions). Dose. -—- Second to sixth potency,

remedies.name: Zincum Valerianum
remedies.text:
(Valerinate of Zinc) A remedy for neuralgia, hysteria, angina pectoris, and other painful affections, notably in ovarian affections. Epilepsy without aura. Hysterical heart-pain. Fociaf neuralgia, violent in Jeft temple and inferior maxiilary. Sleeplessness in children, Obstinate hiccough, Head. — Violent, neuralgic, intermittent headaches, Becomes almost insane with pain, which is piercing and stabbing. Uncontrollable steeplessness from pain in head with melancholy.

Female. — Ovaralgia; pain shoots down limbs, evea to foot. Extremities, — Severe pain in neck and spine. Cannot sit still; must keep legs in constant motion. Sciatic neuralgia. Dose, — First and second trituration. Must be continued for sume time in treatment of neuralgia.

remedies.name: Zingiber
remedies.text:
(Ginger) States of debility in the digestive tract, and sexual system and respiratory troubles, call for this remedy. Head. -- Hemicrania; sudden glimmering before eyes; teels confused and empty. Pain over eyebrows, Nose. — Feels obstructed and dry. Intolerable itching; red pimples. Stomach, — Taste of food remains long, especially of bread and toast. Feels heavy, like from a stone. Complaints from eating melons and drinking impure water. Acidity. [Cale.; Robinia.] Abdomen, — Colic, diarrhoea, extremely loose bowels. Diarrhoea from drinking bad water, with much flatulence, cutting pain, relaxation of sphincter. Hot, sore, painful anus during. pregnancy. Chronic intestinal catarrh, Anus red and inflamed. Hzmorrhoids hot, painfyl, sore. [Alge.]

Urinary. — Complete cessation of function of kidneys. Frequent desire to urinate. Stinging, burning in orifice. Yellow discharge from urethra. Urine thick, turbid, of strong odor, suppressed. Complete suppression after typhoid. After urinating, continues to ooze in drops. Male. -—Itching of prepuce. Sexual desire excited; painful erections. Emissions.

Respiratory. — Hoarseness. Smarting below laryne; breathing difficult. Asthma, without anxiety, worse toward mosning. Scratching sensation in throat; stitches in chest. Cough dry, hacking; copious morning sputa.

Extremities. — Very weak in all joints. Back fame. Cramps in soles and palms.

THERAPEUTIC INDEX THERAPEUTIC INDEX Any attempt to select the proper homeopathic remedy for any case except by the study of the totality of symptoms must prove futile. In order to prescribe homeeopathically, the essentials for so doing must be observed, —i. ¢., to let the characteristic symptoms of the individual patient, largely independent of the pathological natsre of the case, be paramount in selecting the remedy. Such characteristics are found especially — (1) In the location or part affected; (2) In the sensations; (3) In the modalities. The study of the repertory alone will give the indicated remedy. But throughout this work are found numerous suggestiuns for remedies based on clinical observations or deductions from partial prevings, all of which may prove most valuable additions to our Materia Medica if further verified at the bedside. As many of them haye no place as yet in our published repertories, 1 have thought it advisable to give them a place with others in this therapeutic index, in order to bring them to the attention and further study of the physician, At best, a clinical index is but suggestive.
